jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About
**Bright Money**

Bright Money
is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi’s Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India.

**What is the role about?**

We are hiring a UI Product Manager to own the customer-facing experience of the Bright app - onboarding, credit building, offers, money movement, and the AI money assistant - and the metrics those surfaces drive.

You will work with Design, mobile and frontend Engineering, Data Sciences, and Growth. Based in Bengaluru, in-office.

**What will you do?**

**Product Ownership**

* Own the roadmap and backlog for customer-facing surfaces across iOS, Android, and web.
* Define success metrics-activation, conversion, engagement, retention-and the trade-offs between them.

**User Experience**

* Partner with Design on journeys, wireframes, and prototypes; run design reviews with a clear point of view.
* Own the full experience, including navigation, empty states, error states, and edge cases.
* Drive consistency through the design system, and hold the quality bar at release.

**Experimentation**

* Design and run A/B tests on UI and flow changes.
* Use funnel and drop-off analysis to find friction; run usability testing and turn findings into backlog.

**Delivery**

* Write PRDs with acceptance criteria and edge-case coverage.
* Prioritise across new features, UX debt, and polish.
* Work day-to-day with mobile and frontend engineers, and sign off on UI quality.

**Stakeholders**

* Work with Growth, Data Sciences, Engineering, and Compliance so disclosures and consent are designed into the flow.
* Communicate progress, results, and decisions to senior stakeholders.

**Ideal candidate profile**

**Experience & Background:**

* 3-5 years in Product Management on consumer-facing mobile or web products.
* Track record of owning UI and UX surfaces end-to-end, with metrics that moved.
* Strong design sensibility; fluent with designers and in Figma.
* Hands-on with funnels, cohorts, and A/B testing; comfortable in SQL, Mixpanel, or Amplitude.
* Working understanding of mobile constraints: release cycles, native versus web, platform guidelines.
* Based in Bengaluru, in-office five days a week.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* High bar for craft and detail.
* Uses KPIs and OKRs to drive prioritisation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Ships iteratively; comfortable with ambiguity and pace.

**Non-Fit Profiles:**

* B2B, enterprise, or internal-tools PMs without consumer product experience.
* Platform or backend-only PMs without ownership of customer-facing surfaces.
* PMs who have written specs without owning outcomes or metrics.
* Programme or Project Managers.
* Candidates seeking remote or hybrid.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Design system ownership.
* Fintech or another regulated consumer product, with disclosure and consent flows.
* AI or LLM-driven product surfaces.
* Accessibility standards in practice.
* Consumer products built for the U.S. market.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale - liquidity potential at $1-3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You own the surfaces customers touch every day, end to end.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Location: 5 days from the Bengaluru office each week.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Associate Product Manager (Audit & Compliance)**

**Experience: 2-4 Years**

**Location: Bengaluru, KR (Hybrid)**

**About the Role**

We are seeking an Associate Product Manager (APM) who operates with an "owner’s mindset." This role is for a problem solver who can analyze complex requirements, manage tough stakeholders (especially Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams), and unblock engineering teams independently. You will be responsible for participating and playing a vital role in critical regulatory compliance audits, and ensuring that product/data delivery happens on time, everytime. We need someone comfortable with high visibility, data precision, and driving execution without constant supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Specification & Delivery:**
Translate customer/business requirements into clear, detailed product specifications, one-pagers, and user stories. You will work with your manager to write effective specs and ensure functionality is described in sufficient detail. You are someone who understands an engineer’s language and ensures that your engineering peers are clear about what you ask for. Specifications you write are clear enough that AI can read from it and write working code.

**End-to-End Ownership:**
Take full independent ownership of your pod to drive the product roadmap and execution pace without requiring constant intervention or supervision.

**Stakeholder Management:**
Proactively engage with stakeholders across the organization to gather feedback and ensure everyone is on the same page regarding the sequence of execution. You will act as the primary Point of Contact (POC)—specifically for the Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams—building strong rapport while managing their expectations firmly. Your stakeholders feel comfort in being heard and feel obliged to give you business outcomes.

**Operational Visibility & Presence:**
Maintain high visibility and availability in the office to facilitate real-time coordination with cross-functional teams. You must be present during critical tasks (e.g., audits, scrutinies) to unblock dependencies immediately.

**Data & Requirement Precision:**
Deeply understand data complexities to streamline requirements for the engineering team. Ensure all necessary data is gathered from stakeholders
*before*
handing off to developers to avoid redundant work or delays.

**Data-Informed Decisions:**
Define success metrics for your features, ensure proper data instrumentation is in place, and analyze post-launch results to measure impact and recommend the next steps. Your ‘why’ to every problem has an analytical benefit line-of-sight.

**Proactive Communication:**
Providing accurate, transparent updates on roadmap progress. Ensure "firm" follow-ups with stakeholders to keep projects moving, rather than acting solely as a messenger.

**Qualification:**

An ideal candidate would have:

* **Experience:**
  BTech/BE from a top engineering school strongly preferred
* Graduate with 1-3 years of experience and at least 1 year of Product Management experience in the fintech industry (lending industry experience preferred)
* **High Agency:**
  Thrives in pressure; does not just survive it. Demonstrated ability to solve problems autonomously and manage complex personalities or stakeholders in a high-speed setting.
* **Constructive Pushback:**
  Acts as a quality gatekeeper capable of saying "no" to noise and rejecting incomplete requirements and demanding stakeholder clarity to protect engineering bandwidth.
* **Technical/Data Aptitude:**
  Comfortable defining complex logic for data-heavy requirements (e.g., accounting ledgers, reconciliations) and analyzing data dependencies to effectively support the engineering team.
* Should be adept in using Gen AI to unlock productivity for yourself and others
* Can quickly make no-code prototypes on Lovable/any other prototyping software
* Working knowledge of SQL & Excel and basic knowledge of APIs
* Structured thinking & problem solving
* Strong communication (both verbal & written) - Should be able to individually lead mini projects
* Comfort with ambiguity and fast paced environment
* Clearly demonstrable impact in past roles
* Intellectual curiosity/agility
* A great attitude

jobs.title: Product Associate
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Join J.P. Morgan's Corporate & Investment Bank Client 360 team to transform how organizational data is managed, governed, and leveraged. Drive innovative, AI-enabled data solutions that enhance accuracy, operational efficiency, and business decision-making.
  
  
As a Product Associate within the Corporate & Investment Bank Client 360 (C360) team, you will be responsible for driving product strategy and execution across entity resolution, organizational profiles, and third-party data integration. You will develop scalable, governed data solutions that improve accuracy, transparency, and operational efficiency. Partnering with cross-functional teams, you will leverage advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI-enabled capabilities to enhance data quality and usability. You will also drive product innovation, stakeholder alignment, and measurable business outcomes across interconnected platforms.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for entity resolution, organizational profiles, and third-party data integration.
* Develop scalable entity resolution capabilities integrating internal and external data sources into a unified, governed organizational dataset.
* Drive AI- and machine learning-enabled solutions to improve matching accuracy, processing efficiency, and operational scalability.
* Design governed challenge-and-override workflows to support data accuracy, feedback management, and consistent decision-making across systems.
* Build diagnostic and explainability capabilities to enhance transparency, identify data quality issues, and support operational decisions.
* Lead organizational profile arbitration, ensuring accurate attribute selection, data lineage, auditability, and governance.
* Drive vendor data integration and data model evolution while maintaining architectural standards and operational controls.
* Establish data quality frameworks, documentation standards, and performance metrics to improve data reliability and usability.
* Evaluate third-party data capabilities and prioritize integrations based on business value, feasibility, and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Data Science, Architecture, Data Governance, and business stakeholders to deliver integrated product solutions.
* Define success metrics, manage dependencies, and communicate product priorities, delivery progress, and risks to senior stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications, Skills And Capabilities**

* Demonstrated product management experience delivering complex, scalable data products or platforms.
* Proven ability to translate business requirements into product strategies, roadmaps, and actionable delivery plans.
* Hands-on experience with entity resolution, identity matching, data mastering, or organizational data management.
* Strong understanding of deterministic matching, machine learning-assisted classification, and high-volume data processing.
* Knowledge of data quality management, entity modeling, metadata, data lineage, and attribute arbitration.
* Ability to evaluate algorithmic performance using precision, recall, processing efficiency, and explainability metrics.
* Experience designing governed data workflows, feedback mechanisms, and operational controls.
* Understanding of data architecture principles, schema management, and third-party data integration.
* Experience collaborating with Engineering, Data Science, and AI/ML teams on data-driven product solutions.
* Strong product execution capabilities, including roadmap prioritization, backlog management, and dependency resolution.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, analytical, and cross-functional leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications, Skills And Capabilities**

* Experience delivering data products within financial services, particularly Corporate & Investment Banking.
* Exposure to enterprise-wide data platforms supporting multiple business lines and interconnected systems.
* Experience implementing AI-enabled or agent-based capabilities within production data environments.
* Familiarity with human-in-the-loop AI workflows, model evaluation, and AI governance frameworks.
* Knowledge of third-party data vendor evaluation, selection, and commercial engagement processes.
* Experience with vendor data normalization, automated onboarding, and scalable integration frameworks.
* Familiarity with organizational reference data and its applications in client onboarding, risk management, and analytics.

**About Us**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

jobs.title: Data Product Strategy and Design Lead
jobs.description:
**Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Data Product Strategy and Design Lead.**
**In This Role, You Will**

* The jobholder is responsible to collaborate and work closely with Data Domain Product Owners to develop the product strategy for each data domain, with the objective of providing a consistent and efficient data service to our data consumers.
* Apply a cross-domain lens to the product strategy to identify opportunities for co-design, re-utilisation of existing IT services, and efficient implementation.
* Establish, define and enforce robust design principles, based on a clear understanding of the data consumers’ needs and priorities, while overlaying their own vision of a coherent and practical service model.

* Good presentation skills, Strong analytical skills with a problem-solving capability & drive solutions; Very good prioritizing, planning and organizing skills; Proven experience in product management and problem-solving; Strong orientation on risk management.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Consumer Growth
jobs.description:
**About Rupeek**

Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Bangalore, Rupeek is an asset-backed digital lending fintech making credit more accessible by helping Indians unlock the value of their gold. We combine technology, customer-focused design, and on-ground execution to make borrowing simpler and more convenient.

Rupeek is backed by leading investors including
**Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & Southeast Asia), Accel, Bertelsmann India Investments, and Elevation Capital**
.

Join us to solve meaningful challenges at the intersection of consumer experience, technology, and financial services—with ownership to shape products and see their impact on customers and the business.

**Work directly with leadership:**
Collaborate with
**Sumit Maniyar
, Founder & CEO**
,
**Setu Poddar
, CTO**
, and Rupeek’s business and operations leaders. Gain firsthand exposure to company strategy, contribute to important product decisions, and build products alongside the people shaping Rupeek’s next phase of growth.

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Experience:**
3–5 years in product management

**The opportunity**

**Help more customers discover Rupeek, take their first loan, and choose us again.**

As Product Manager for Consumer Growth, you’ll own growth opportunities across our app and web journeys—from initial discovery and onboarding to conversion, repeat borrowing, and referrals.

You’ll combine customer research, product analytics, and experimentation to make borrowing simpler and more intuitive. Your mandate is to deliver measurable, sustainable growth while building customer confidence at every step.

**What you’ll own**

* **Activation and conversion:**
  Identify where customers hesitate or drop off, and improve the journey from first visit to a successfully disbursed loan.
* **Customer understanding:**
  Use interviews, feedback, funnel analysis, and cohort insights to uncover customer needs and barriers.
* **Growth experimentation:**
  Develop hypotheses, prioritize opportunities, and run A/B tests or pilots with clear success criteria.
* **Retention and repeat usage:**
  Build relevant journeys that bring customers back when they need credit and encourage referrals.
* **Personalized experiences:**
  Partner with business and marketing teams on messaging, offers, and lifecycle engagement that reflect customer needs.
* **End-to-end execution:**
  Work with design, engineering, analytics, and operations to launch improvements, measure results, and scale what works.

**What success looks like**

Better onboarding completion, higher conversion to disbursal, stronger repeat usage and referrals, and improved funnel efficiency—with customer trust, satisfaction, and business economics as guardrails.

**What you’ll bring**

* 3–5 years of product management experience, preferably in consumer technology, fintech, or digital platforms.
* Evidence of improving a customer or business metric through product changes—and a clear explanation of what you learned.
* Strong understanding of funnels, cohorts, retention, and experimentation.
* Hands-on experience with analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Google Analytics. SQL proficiency is a plus.
* Strong product judgment: the ability to connect customer needs, user experience, and commercial outcomes.
* Clear communication and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into focused, testable opportunities.
* Experience in onboarding, conversion, lifecycle engagement, or referral products is valuable.

**Why this role**

* **Own measurable growth:**
  Connect your product decisions directly to customer and business outcomes.
* **Solve a meaningful consumer challenge:**
  Make a trust-sensitive financial journey easier to understand and complete.
* **Shape the full customer lifecycle:**
  Work across first-time adoption, engagement, repeat usage, and advocacy.
* **Build and learn:**
  Take ideas from customer insight to experiment to scale product improvement.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager  – Digital Assets
jobs.description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
  
  
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
  
  
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
  
  
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.
  
  
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own stablecoin-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it
* Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line
* Design and ship on/off-ramp flows — fiat-to-digital and digital-to-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience
* Drive stablecoin-based cross-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production-grade
* Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy
* Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required
* You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck
* Strong payments foundation — cross-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it
* Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no-go decisions
* Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against
* Comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign-off

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins + payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
* Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin-funded card products
* On/off-ramp conversion rate and time-to-settlement
* Time-to-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
* Regulatory coverage: number of markets with compliant, live digital asset product

**What We Offer At Nium**
**We Value Performance:**
Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.
  
  
**We Care for Our Employees:**
The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our discretionary year-end shut down (dependant on company OKRs). We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).
  
  
**We Upskill Ourselves:**
We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.
  
  
**We Celebrate Together:**
We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!
  
  
**We Thrive with Diversity:**
Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.
  
  
**Beware of recruitment scams:**
Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites.
**Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**
. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Product Manager II
jobs.description:
**The Role**

Having built strong foundations in India, we now operate across multiple international markets and are expanding into new ones. International Payments (i18n) takes Razorpay’s products into these markets: local payment methods, cross-border flows, and the partnerships with banks, wallets and schemes that make them work — on top of a platform and systems layer that has to be rebuilt for each market’s rails, currency, regulation and settlement cycle. Much of this is 0 to 1 work. You will be deciding what to build, building it with engineering, taking it to merchants, and growing it. There is no running playbook to inherit. You will write it.

This is a builder role as much as a product role. In a new market, Razorpay has no brand recall and few relationships, so you will open doors yourself and because a new market means new rails, you will also own the systems underneath — machinery that every downstream product depends on.

**What you will own**

* Build Customer Empathy: PMs have to regularly meet and understand customer needs first-hand as well as stay on top of the customer pulse via secondary insights - both qualitative and quantitative.
* Devise Strategy: Define both long-term strategy and quarterly roadmap to achieve the product vision and create impact.
* Conceptualize new solutions: Product Conceptualization with a problem first, data-driven, and test & iterate approach. Ensures conceptualization from a platform and a long-term view. Ensures value-based prioritization of product initiatives.
* Build products: Collaborate with Engineering and ecosystem players to build products that customers love. Produce high-quality product specifications and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver products and features on time.
* Launch products: Draft and execute a go-to-market plan in conjunction with Product Marketing. Be the internal and external authority and advocate for your given area of focus.
* Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to collaborate closely with ecosystem players to co-build products that don’t exist
* Business focus: Build business strategy around ecosystem product that would define the success for the Razorpay and the Ecosystem players

**Mandatory Qualifications:**

* You understand technology, but love customer-first & business-first thinking.
* You are comfortable working hands-on in a fast-paced start-up environment.
* You are curious about metrics, execution processes, macro trends.
* Problem-solving and detail orientation come naturally to you.
* You have an analytical and data-driven approach in day-to-day work. Energetic self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* You are entrepreneurial and have the hunger to solve problems end-to-end.
* You have at least 4 years of experience in Product Management.

jobs.title: Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations
Product Owner – Card Fraud, Payments & Authentication
jobs.description:
****Job Summary****
Synechron is seeking an experienced
**Product Designer**
to join its Card Fraud squad and shape capabilities that protect customers from card fraud while supporting secure and seamless payment experiences.

* Exposure to regulatory, scheme, and payment-transformation delivery tools and processes.

* Candidates should be able to assess changes across card-payment systems, scheme requirements, fraud controls, operational processes, and technology dependencies.

****Overall Responsibilities****

* Translate customer, fraud, regulatory, scheme, operational, and technology requirements into clear product outcomes.
* Define product goals, outcomes, priorities, delivery milestones, acceptance criteria, and success measures.

****Technical Skills (By Category)****

****Essential****

Global Merchant & Network Services brings together American Express' merchant and network-related businesses, including relationships with merchants, issuers, acquirers, processors, and strategic partners globally.

**Role Overview**

**AvenuesAI Limited** is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Product Manager to manage and drive the development, enhancement and performance of its digital payment products and financial technology solutions.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in payment processing, digital payment ecosystems, prepaid payment instruments (PPI), banking and financial integrations, regulatory compliance and product operations.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the product lifecycle, identifying business opportunities, coordinating with technology and business teams, implementing product enhancements and ensuring seamless product delivery in line with business objectives, regulatory requirements and customer expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management**

* + Define and execute product strategies aligned with the company's business goals.
  + Manage the complete product lifecycle, from conceptualisation and requirement gathering to development, launch and post-launch performance monitoring.
  + Identify opportunities for new product development, enhancements and business expansion.
  + Prepare product roadmaps, business requirement documents (BRDs), product requirement documents (PRDs) and functional specifications.
  + Monitor product performance and recommend improvements based on business and customer feedback.

**2. Digital Payments & Financial Integrations**

* + Manage and drive payment products and integrations across BBPS, PPI and other applicable payment channels.
  + Coordinate with banks, NPCI, payment aggregators, technology partners and other financial institutions for product integrations.
  + Oversee payment workflows, transaction processing, settlement, reconciliation and exception management.
  + Ensure smooth implementation, testing and deployment of new payment features and integrations.
  + Identify and resolve product-related operational challenges affecting transaction success rates and customer experience.

**3. Product Development & Technology Coordination**

* + Work closely with technology, engineering, QA and operations teams to translate business requirements into product specifications.
  + Define product priorities, development milestones and implementation timelines.
  + Coordinate UAT, functional testing, integration testing and product acceptance.
  + Track product development progress and ensure timely delivery.
  + Identify system gaps, process bottlenecks and opportunities for automation.

**4. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management**

* + Ensure product processes and functionalities are aligned with applicable RBI guidelines, NPCI regulations and other relevant regulatory requirements.
  + Work closely with compliance, risk and legal teams to implement regulatory changes.
  + Monitor transaction risks, fraud indicators, operational exceptions and control mechanisms.
  + Support internal, external and regulatory audits by maintaining appropriate product documentation and operational records.
  + Ensure appropriate controls are incorporated into product design and delivery.

**5. Business & Operational Performance**

* + Define and monitor product KPIs, including transaction success rates, transaction volumes, revenue, active users, turnaround time and customer complaints.
  + Analyse product performance and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and profitability.
  + Drive initiatives to improve customer and merchant experience.
  + Work with sales and business development teams to support product adoption, partner onboarding and revenue growth.
  + Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for product-related processes.

**6. Stakeholder & Team Management**

* + Act as the primary coordination point between business, technology, operations, compliance and external partners.
  + Manage relationships with banks, payment networks, vendors and technology service providers.
  + Lead product review meetings and provide regular updates to senior management.
  + Guide and mentor team members involved in product operations and implementation.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* + Graduate degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, Technology or a related discipline.
  + 8–12 years of experience in fintech, digital payments, banking, financial services or payment operations.
  + Strong understanding of digital payment systems, payment processing and settlement mechanisms.
  + Practical experience in UPI, IMPS, PPI and other payment integrations.
  + Experience in product onboarding, implementation, product enhancement and operational management.
  + Good understanding of RBI guidelines, NPCI processes, compliance requirements and risk management.
  + Proven experience working with technology, operations, business and compliance teams.

**Required Skills**

* + Product lifecycle and roadmap management
  + Digital payment ecosystem knowledge
  + Payment processing and reconciliation
  + UPI, IMPS, PPI and banking integrations
  + BRD, PRD and functional requirement documentation
  + UAT and product implementation
  + RBI and NPCI regulatory understanding
  + Risk management and fraud monitoring
  + Data analysis and KPI monitoring
  + Stakeholder and vendor management
  + Team leadership and problem-solving
  + Strong communication and decision-making skills

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated on the basis of:

* + Successful and timely delivery of product launches and enhancements.
  + Improvement in transaction success rates and payment processing efficiency.
  + Reduction in transaction failures, reconciliation issues and operational exceptions.
  + Timely completion of banking, NPCI and third-party integrations.
  + Compliance with applicable regulatory and internal control requirements.
  + Improvement in product adoption, customer experience and business performance.
  + Effective coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The preferred candidate should be a hands-on fintech professional with a strong understanding of the Indian digital payments ecosystem. The candidate should be capable of bridging the gap between business requirements and technology execution, while ensuring operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and sustainable product growth.

Experience in PPI services, UPI/IMPS integrations, payment settlements, banking partnerships and payment product implementation will be an added advantage.

**Associate - Integrity & Investigations**
==========================================

Req ID: 128329

Department: Financial Crime - Strategy and Threat Management

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

**Note:** We have multiple opportunities available at the Associate - Group Integrity level. Candidates who meet the role requirements may be considered for more than one vacancy as part of the selection process.

  

The Associate - Group Integrity plays an important role in protecting ANZ by conducting investigations into internal fraud, theft, conflicts of interest, and other forms of insider misconduct. Working within a highly regulated environment, you will gather and assess evidence, conduct investigative activities, and develop clear, evidence-based findings that support fair and consistent outcomes.

  

This role offers the opportunity to work on a diverse range of integrity matters while partnering with stakeholders across the business to identify risks, strengthen controls, and contribute to a culture of accountability and ethical conduct.

  

Role Type: Permanent  
Role Location: Bengaluru

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As an Associate - Group Integrity, you will:

  

* Conduct internal fraud, theft, and insider risk investigations in accordance with established investigation standards and methodologies.
* Assist in defining investigation scope and approach, gather and assess evidence, conduct interviews, and maintain accurate case documentation.
* Analyze information from multiple sources to identify key facts, themes, and findings that support investigation outcomes.
* Prepare clear, concise, and evidence-based investigation reports, findings, and recommendations.
* Engage with stakeholders across Risk, Legal, Employee Relations, Security, and business teams to obtain information and support effective case management.
* Escalate significant risks, control issues, conflicts, or investigation concerns through appropriate governance channels.
* Contribute to thematic reviews, fraud trend analysis, and the identification of opportunities to strengthen controls and risk management practices.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives, quality assurance activities, and knowledge sharing within the Group Integrity team.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:

  

* 6+ years' experience in investigations, fraud risk, misconduct, compliance, or related disciplines.
* Experience investigating fraud, theft, misconduct, insider risk, or integrity-related matters.
* Knowledge of investigation principles, including evidence assessment, interviewing, and procedural fairness.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Experience gathering, interpreting, and synthesizing information from multiple sources.
* Strong report-writing and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes.
* Experience engaging with stakeholders across Risk, Legal, Employee Relations, Compliance, and business teams.
* Knowledge of banking operations, products, fraud risks, and control environments.
* Exposure to forensic analysis, digital evidence review, or investigative technologies.
* Understanding of risk frameworks and governance within a regulated environment.
* Experience contributing to process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.

  

We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.

  

We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. **Senior Platform Engineer (AI Gateway, Identity & Observability)**

**Agentic AI Platform | Financial Services | Full-time**

*Experience: 8+ years overall, including 5+ years hands-on API platform, identity or observability engineering*

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
==================

We are building an enterprise agentic AI platform for a financial services client: the runtime, gateway, developer tooling and data interfaces that internal engineering teams will use to build and run AI agents in production.

You will build the control plane every agent passes through, regardless of where that agent runs. That means three connected things: the AI gateway that fronts all model traffic, the identity and registration path that governs which agents are allowed to call it, and the observability plane that makes the whole fleet visible and attributable.

These are deliberately held together in one position rather than split. The gateway is where identity is enforced and where much of the telemetry originates, so an engineer who understands only one of the three will build seams into what should be a single plane. You will be expected to work across all three, with depth in at least one and real working competence in the others.

This work is also the most time-critical on the platform: an external engineering team needs the gateway carrying production traffic early in the engagement, and the interface published to them cannot change afterwards.

This is a hands-on engineering position on a small, senior delivery team. It is not an oversight or coordination role.

**INDICATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES**
===============================

*The platform is being designed as the engagement progresses, so responsibilities will evolve. Indicative, and not limited to:*

**? Deliver the AI gateway** that routes model traffic across cloud-hosted models, other providers and on-premises inference, presenting one consistent, provider-agnostic interface to every consuming agent.

**? Implement gateway policy:** routing and backend pools, token-based rate limiting and quotas, retries, failover and circuit breaking, caching, and request and response transformation.

**? Harden an existing service for production** and run a controlled migration to the long-term gateway, moving consumers across without changing the contract they already integrated against.

**? Build the agent identity and registration path:** workload or service identity for agents, registration on deployment, and the promotion gate that governs what reaches production. Full automation is not assumed; part of the work is automating what can be automated and designing a clean, documented path for the steps that require human approval.

**? Design and implement the telemetry schema** and the OpenTelemetry pipelines that carry it, spanning agents in every runtime, so traces are consistent and attributable to an owning team.

**? Build the fleet view** showing each agent, its owner, version, environment, health and consumption, including the identifiers that make usage chargeable back to consuming teams.

**? Own the reliability view of the platform:** defining what good telemetry looks like, verifying that traces are complete and correctly attributed across every runtime, setting service level indicators and objectives for the gateway and the agent fleet, and building the alerting that surfaces failures, latency regressions and cost anomalies before consuming teams report them.

**? Apply guardrails at the gateway,** including content safety policy and a callout path to custom filtering services.

**? Establish the network and integration paths** the control plane depends on, including private connectivity or controlled egress to observability backends and third-party services, DNS and certificate handling, and the security review each path requires.

**? Load test and prove the gateway** under realistic production volume, and produce the runbooks and operational documentation the client will run it from.

**MUST HAVE**
=============

**? 5+ years hands-on engineering across API platforms, identity or observability,** with production depth in at least one and working competence in the others. All three areas are in scope for this position.

**? 4+ years building and operating API gateways in production:** routing, policy authoring, rate limiting and quotas, authentication, transformation and versioning. Azure API Management is strongly preferred; comparable depth in Apigee, Kong or an equivalent enterprise gateway is acceptable.

**? 3+ years enterprise identity and access engineering:** OAuth2, OpenID Connect and JWT validation, service principals and workload or managed identity, and secrets management using an enterprise vault.

**? 3+ years hands-on OpenTelemetry** or equivalent distributed tracing: instrumentation, collectors, resource attributes, span design, and trace, metric and log pipelines.

**? 3+ years in a site reliability, production engineering or platform operations role,** or equivalent hands-on responsibility for a service other teams depend on: service level objectives and error budgets, alerting design, on-call and incident response, and post-incident analysis. This position owns whether the telemetry is trustworthy, not only whether it is being collected.

**? 2+ years working with LLM or AI workloads in production,** including model routing across providers, token-based limits and quotas, streaming responses, content filtering, and how inference cost accrues and is attributed.

**? Experience with LLM observability tooling,** such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize or an equivalent platform, including how agent traces differ from conventional application traces.

**? 3+ years production API operations:** failover, circuit breaking, caching, load testing to prove capacity, and incident response for a service other teams depend on.

**? 2+ years integrating third-party or self-hosted services into an enterprise network,** including private connectivity or controlled egress, DNS resolution, TLS and certificate management, and working the firewall and security review needed to get each path approved.

**? Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure** on at least one major hyperscaler: networking, identity, container platforms and infrastructure-as-code.

**? Programming competence** in Python, C# or an equivalent language, sufficient to build and maintain policy extensions, callout services and instrumentation libraries.

**PREFERRED**
=============

**? Familiarity with Azure AI Foundry observability and Azure Monitor or Application Insights,** including agent tracing, continuous evaluation and how a managed observability plane compares with a self-hosted one such as Langfuse. This platform may run one, the other, or both, and the choice is still open.

**? Azure API Management depth,** including policy expressions, reusable policy fragments and the AI or LLM policy set.

**? Microsoft Entra ID experience,** including managed identity, app registrations and conditional access.

**? Experience with reliability engineering for AI or machine learning systems,** including quality regression detection, drift monitoring or evaluation-driven alerting.

**? Familiarity with emerging agent identity models** and how agent-to-service authentication differs from conventional service-to-service patterns.

**? Experience implementing chargeback or showback** for a shared platform service.

**? Content safety or guardrail services,** such as Azure AI Content Safety, or custom filtering and moderation services.

**? Enterprise workflow integration,** such as ServiceNow APIs for approval-driven provisioning.

**? Experience in financial services or another regulated industry,** where security review governs the pace of change.

**? Familiarity with agent frameworks** and how agents consume model endpoints, tools and memory.

**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
Treasury is the Vice Presidency, reporting to the Managing Director and World Bank Group Chief Financial Officer, performing treasury functions for the IBRD and IDA and, to varying degrees, for other members of the World Bank Group and other public sector investors. Its activities are organized and grouped into the following departments: Capital Markets & Investment Management, Client Asset Management and Advisory, and Treasury Operations.  
  
Treasury (TRE) has been a large and significant player in the international financial markets for over seventy years and has achieved a global reputation as a prudent and innovative borrower, investor and risk manager. Treasury is responsible for: (i) managing approximately $195 billion in assets for the World Bank and other official sector investors; (ii) leading IBRD’s and IDA’s triple-A rated financing programs in international and domestic bond and derivative markets; (iii) conducting asset and liability management for IBRD’s and IDA’s balance sheets; (iv) overseeing the development and outreach related to the financing and hedging products the Bank provides for its developing-country clients; and (v) collaborating with the World Bank member countries to help build their capacity. Staff in Treasury regularly interact and collaborate with other departments across the Bank and Finance Partners’ teams.  
  
The Treasury Operations Department (TREOP) provides a full range of operational support for Treasury’s asset management, capital markets and banking businesses. The Department is presently organized in 7 operational units: Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL), Quantitative Solutions and Analytics (TREQA), and Cash and Banking Operations (TREBK), Treasury Quantitative Modelling (TREQM), Treasury ALM & Collateral (TREAC), Treasury Market Data and Valuation (TREMV) and a Financial Technology coordination unit (TREFT).  
  
Treasury Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL) is the unit responsible for delivering on a range of operations functions supporting the funding, investment, and asset and liability management portfolios for internal World Bank Group (IBRD, IDA, MIGA, and Trust Funds) entities. In addition, the team supports investment portfolios for a growing roster of more than 60 client entities in domestic and international markets. The team provides integrated and end-to-end support for all trade execution and portfolio servicing activities including trade review, settlement and documentation, options monitoring, debt service and cash and collateral management across the full range of products including bonds, swaps, repos, deposits, and exchange-traded derivatives.  
  
In performing these functions, the team works closely with internal partners and market counterparts as well as external service providers such as technology vendors, custodians, and paying agents. In addition to managing the day-to-day operations, TREAL staff lead the research, coordination, and implementation of new products and markets across Treasury. The team has a heavy focus on, and takes a leadership role in, evaluating and deploying the latest products and technologies (core trading platforms and new initiatives and technologies like CBDC, blockchain, AI, robotics, etc.) to create efficiencies, reduce risk, and advance thought leadership amongst WB’s peers and clients. TREAL staff participate in capacity-building programs for clients in these areas of expertise. TREAL staff recently co-led projects where the World Bank issued innovative digital bonds using blockchain technology and CBDC. In recognition of their efforts to advance capital markets and asset management, the TREAL team received several industry awards including for “Innovation in Reserves Management” (2021) and “Asset Servicing Initiative of the year” (2023). The team has twice been shortlisted for “Operations Team of the Year” award (2023 and 2024).  
  
Treasury ALM & Collateral Operations (TREAC) delivers operations support for asset and liability management, client risk management and collateral activities across IBRD, IDA and IFC. It is the operational engine of Treasury Client Solutions (TCS) and the central collateral management provider for WBG entities and RAMP clients. Team covers the full transaction lifecycle for funding and client hedging transactions, from trade setup and confirmation through settlement, rate fixings, payment events, exception handling, reconciliations and reporting. On the collateral side, it manages margining for OTC derivatives, MBS and futures, including daily margin calls, dispute resolution, CSA agreement administration, and monitoring of valuation.  
  
The team also supports long-term local currency investment transactions through IFC in countries where market solutions are not sufficiently available under the IDA–IFC Private Sector Window. The team works closely with front office, risk, finance, legal and technology teams, and with external counterparties, custodians, brokers and clearing organizations. Operating from Washington, D.C., Chennai and Sofia give the unit time-zone coverage and continuity. Beyond daily operations, TREAC leads systems implementation, convergence and digital transformation, with a strong focus on operational risk, controls and governance. The team operates on a common WBG operating model that aligns with IBRD, IDA and IFC practices, reduces duplication and manual handoffs, and delivers scalable, traceable, automation-ready processes.  
  
**Duties and Accountabilities:**  
The TRE Operations Chennai (TRECH) is an integral part of TREOP and is responsible for a variety of duties providing vital support across its operational divisions. It works closely with the Headquarters in Washington D.C and another shared services center in Sofia, Bulgaria. Under the guidance and supervision of a Team Lead and/or Functional Lead, the incumbent will have responsibilities for specific individual tasks/projects as well as for working as an integral part of the team in executing the Treasury Operation’s work program, while maintaining close relationships with the other Treasury departments.  
  
The incumbent’s primary responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, some combination of the following activities:  
  

* Work closely with the team to understand various facets of post-execution activities for fixed income, derivatives, and cash products to identify, analyze and prioritize process reengineering, automation and streamlining opportunities focusing on enhancing efficiency and accuracy.
* Support data collection, analysis, visualization, and report writing, including by innovatively using data, stories, and analytics to build powerful narratives.
* Support automation initiatives and projects relating to various sub-operational areas including maintenance of databases, dashboards, and reports using

The role will lead product strategy, market research, proposition development, product launches, portfolio management, and continuous improvement. Dubai, Dubai, AE Permanent ID: 102700

  

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the financial requirements of some of the largest corporates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. CBD has been recognized as the number one bank in the UAE on the Forbes list of The World’s Best Banks 2022.

Just as important to us is your ability to demonstrate a talent for dealing with people - your colleagues and our customers and delivering service that really goes the extra mile.

**Job Purpose:** Responsible for performing and monitoring reconciliations of contingent and off-balance sheet General Ledger accounts, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of balances between source systems and the General Ledger. The role supports effective financial control through the identification, investigation, escalation and resolution of reconciliation exceptions while maintaining compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

**Principal Accountabilities:**

* Perform daily reconciliations between source applications, sub-ledgers and the General Ledger for assigned contingent and off-balance sheet accounts.
* Review and analyse reconciliation reports covering Trade Finance, Collections, loan commitments, undisbursed facilities and other designated contingent accounts.
* Identify and investigate reconciliation differences, unmatched entries, aged items, abnormal balances and other exceptions.
* Review transaction details, accounting entries, interfaces and audit trails to determine root causes of reconciliation breaks.
* Engage with Operations, Product and Technology teams to facilitate timely investigation and resolution of outstanding items.
* Maintain exception trackers and monitor progress until all issues are appropriately resolved and closed.
* Escalate significant, recurring or overdue reconciliation exceptions to management.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reconciliation MIS, ageing analysis, trend reporting and management dashboards.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and recommend enhancements to controls, data quality and automation.
* Ensure compliance with Bank policies, accounting controls, audit requirements and applicable regulatory standards.

  

### **Requirements**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Professional accounting qualification such as CA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent is preferred.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in banking operations, Trade Finance, reconciliation, financial control, business analysis or systems/change delivery.
* Hands-on experience in application-to-General Ledger reconciliation, exception investigation and management reporting.
* Working knowledge of contingent and off-balance sheet accounts and Trade Finance products is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with DCR (Data Control Reconciliation) or a similar automated reconciliation platform is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to investigate and resolve financial discrepancies.
* Good understanding of General Ledger reconciliation, accounting controls, exception ageing and balance substantiation.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and data reconciliation techniques.
* Exposure to Power BI, Power Query, SQL or similar analytics tools would be advantageous.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities within tight reporting deadlines.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Credit Analyst – Mortgages**

**About Yubi MENA**

Yubi is the world’s only technology company powering the end-to-end debt lifecycle. In the UAE, Yubi Mortgage operates as a premier digital mortgage marketplace connecting residents, UAE nationals, and non-resident homebuyers with 25+ leading retail, Islamic, commercial, and digital banks. By combining AI-driven underwriting tools, Business Rules Engines (BRE), and dedicated relationship management, we make home financing faster, simpler, and fully transparent.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Credit Analyst to join our Mortgage team in Dubai. Acting as the critical analytical and operational bridge between Yubi’s Relationship Managers (RMs), homebuyers, and our 25+ partner banks, you will evaluate borrower creditworthiness, verify mortgage application dockets, ensure strict compliance with UAE Central Bank (CBUAE) and partner lender policies, and drive smooth loan processing from pre-approval through to disbursement and registration.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Credit Assessment & Underwriting Support**

* Evaluate incoming retail and commercial mortgage applications (salaried, self-employed, resident, and non-resident profiles) against partner bank credit policies and Yubi’s Business Rules Engine (BRE) criteria.
* Calculate Debt Burden Ratios (DBR), Loan-to-Value (LTV) limits, net disposable income, and affordability metrics in alignment with CBUAE mortgage regulations.
* Analyze bank statements, AECB (Al Etihad Credit Bureau) credit reports, income proofs, and financial statements to identify credit risks, liabilities, or red flags early in the lifecycle.
* Draft accurate, structured Credit Appraisal Memoranda (CAMs) and recommend optimal partner lenders to RMs to maximize approval conversion rates.

**2. Document Scrutiny & Non-Discrepancy Verification**

* Conduct thorough pre-sanction and post-sanction scrutiny of loan files, including KYC documents, Emirates ID/passports, salary certificates, trade licenses, property valuation reports, Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs), and Title Deeds/Oqood.
* Maintain a high first-time-right (non-discrepancy) submission rate by screening files for completeness and accuracy before submission to partner banks.
* Follow up proactively with RMs and borrowers to resolve pending documents, lender queries, and sanction conditions within defined Turnaround Times (TAT) and SLAs.

**3. Disbursement, Islamic & Conventional Fulfilment Coordination**

* Support post-approval execution across both conventional mortgages and Islamic home finance structures (such as Ijarah and Murabaha), ensuring all security documents (PDCs, manager's cheques, settlement letters, and NOCs) are verified.
* Coordinate seamlessly with partner bank credit/operations teams, legal teams, developers, and trustees to track cases from Offer Letter issuance to final disbursement and DLD/municipality mortgage registration.
* Track Post-Disbursal Documents (PDD) and ensure timely closure of compliance requirements.

**4. MIS Reporting, Compliance & Platform Excellence**

* Maintain accurate application trackers, CRM updates, and daily Management Information Systems (MIS) reports covering pipeline status, approval ratios, discrepancy trends, and TAT performance.
* Ensure 100% adherence to UAE AML/KYC guidelines, internal Delegation of Authority (DOA) matrices, and partner bank regulatory standards.
* Provide feedback to Yubi’s Product and Tech teams to improve automated document classification, OCR accuracy, and BRE matching workflows.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, Banking, Economics, or a related discipline (MBA/CA Inter/CFA Level 1 is a plus).
* Experience: 2 to 5 years of hands-on experience in mortgage credit underwriting, home finance operations, or retail loan processing within a UAE bank, mortgage brokerage, or fintech lender.

Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of UAE mortgage products (resident/non-resident home loans, buyouts/equity release, commercial mortgages), CBUAE DBR/LTV guidelines, and both conventional and Islamic (Ijarah) financing workflows.

* Technical Skills: High proficiency in Microsoft Excel (financial calculations, VLOOKUP, pivot tables), CRM/Loan Origination Systems (LOS), and AI-assisted document review tools.
* Core Competencies: Sharp analytical eye for detail, ability to manage high transaction volumes with zero errors, strong stakeholder communication skills, and comfort working in a fast-paced fintech environment.
* Languages: Fluency in English is mandatory; proficiency in Arabic or Hindi/Urdu is an advantage.

jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The core client segments of VCA include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Role Summary:

The Analyst for Digital, Strategy and AI supports the delivery of digital transformation, strategy and artificial intelligence (AI) engagements across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

  

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

* Defining business, segment, channel and functional strategies, such as digital banking, affluent banking, loyalty, open finance, stablecoins and artificial intelligence.

Ideation:

* Supporting the innovation agenda of clients through foresight, strategic trends research and co-creation activities.

Value proposition design:

* Developing holistic offerings, including products, services and customer experience, for strategic consumer, business and corporate customer segments.

Customer experience and engagement:

* Developing best-in-class digital customer journeys and engagement strategies, including digital onboarding, end-to-end digital journey transformation, digital channel benchmarking and user interface and user experience enhancement.

Performance analytics:

* Improving client performance and process efficiency by deploying data, digital and AI tools.

Digital delivery:

* Supporting clients with the implementation of digital strategies, including the design and development of digital channels, generative AI (GenAI) use cases and proofs of concept.

Key Responsibilities:

* As an Analyst, you will work within project teams under the guidance of senior consultants and managers, contributing to research, analysis and the development of client deliverables.
* Support the delivery of digital, strategy and AI projects across the GCC, from scoping through to final recommendations.
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research, including benchmarking and trends analysis, to inform client recommendations.
* Gather, clean and analyze data from Visa and industry sources to generate insights that support client recommendations.
* Contribute to the problem-solving process, including structuring analytical frameworks and developing insight-driven recommendations.
* Build business cases and financial models that measure business performance and quantify return on investment (ROI).
* Prepare clear and compelling client presentations and reports that communicate findings and recommendations.
* Support the preparation and running of client workshops and stakeholder sessions, and document findings, decisions and next steps.
* Track project workplans and deliverables, and keep the project leadership informed of progress, risks and issues.
* Collaborate with Visa Account Executives and the Product, Value-Added Services (VAS), Marketing and other internal teams to deliver integrated solutions as One Visa.
* Contribute to proposals and responses to requests for proposal (RFPs), as well as practice thought leadership, points of view and case studies.
* Help build reusable toolkits, templates and best practice documents that can be applied across the VCA practice.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* At least 2 years of work experience in management consulting, preferably on financial services, payments, digital or AI projects.
* Degree from a leading university, preferably in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including building clear and compelling presentations, financial models and data analyses.
* Strong curiosity about AI, including GenAI and agentic AI, with hands-on experience using AI tools for research, analysis or content creation and an understanding of how to use them responsibly.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience working on projects in the GCC region.
* Exposure to digital transformation, strategy or digital banking projects.
* Knowledge of banking products, services, operations; payment schemes, services, card issuing and marketing initiatives.
* Strong interest in fintech and payments.
* Proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

What You Will Need to Be Successful:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex problems and work with large data sets.
* Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear and compelling presentations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the financial indicators used to measure business performance.
* A collaborative, diplomatic and flexible working style, with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to deliverables quality.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines at the same time.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn, take on feedback and develop new skills quickly.
* Ability to build strong working relationships with clients and colleagues.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Manager Internal Audit
jobs.description:
**Key Accountabilities**

* Audit planning and governance
  + Establish and maintain the Internal Audit Charter, audit methodology and risk-based annual audit plan for Board/Audit Committee approval.
  + Maintain an audit universe covering all licensed activities, corporate functions, systems and material third-party arrangements.
  + Coordinate with du Group Audit on methodologies, specialist support and assurance coverage while maintaining accountability to du Pay’s Board.
  + Identify resource and specialist requirements, including technology, cybersecurity and financial crime expertise.
* Operational and regulatory assurance
  + Audit wallet operations, payments, cards, digital remittances, finance, treasury, settlement and customer service.
  + Assess customer fund safeguarding, float management, reconciliations, liquidity, applicable capital and guarantee requirements, and regulatory reporting.
  + Independently assess AML/CFT, sanctions screening, customer due diligence, transaction monitoring and suspicious reporting controls.
  + Review consumer protection, customer disclosures, complaints handling, fraud controls and compliance with licence conditions.
  + Assess technology governance, cybersecurity, access management, data protection, outsourcing, business continuity and disaster recovery.
* Partner products and distribution
  + Audit governance and controls supporting lending, investment and insurance partnerships.
  + Review partner due diligence, contractual responsibilities, regulatory permissions, service standards, audit rights and ongoing oversight.
  + Assess customer journeys, disclosures, consent, fees, commissions, complaints ownership and escalation arrangements.
  + Examine controls over relevant money flows, including loan disbursements and repayments, investment subscriptions and withdrawals, and insurance premiums and refunds.
  + Evaluate whether du Pay’s activities remain within its permitted role and whether responsibilities between du Pay and each partner are clearly allocated.
  + Provide independent observations on material launches and changes without assuming management responsibility for product approval or control design.
* Reporting and remediation
  + Issue clear audit reports identifying findings, root causes, risk implications and practical recommendations.
  + Present significant findings and emerging risks to the Board/Audit Committee and management.
  + Track agreed actions and independently validate remediation before closing findings.
  + Escalate overdue material issues, restrictions on audit access and threats to independence.
  + Support regulatory examinations and external audits with appropriate evidence and coordination.
Authority and independence
The Internal Audit Manager will have unrestricted access to relevant employees, records, systems and governance forums, together with direct access to the Board/Audit Committee. The position will remain independent of operational activities, compliance monitoring and risk ownership.  

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business, information systems or a related discipline.
* CIA, ACA, ACCA, CPA or an equivalent professional qualification; CISA is an advantage.
