jobs.title: Director, Product Development/Management
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Directors in Product Development/Management at Visa are responsible for leading the development, commercialization, and optimization of technology products within the payments ecosystem. This role requires deep expertise in product strategy, design, and execution, with a focus on delivering innovative solutions that address customer needs and drive business growth. Directors operate in complex, matrixed environments, collaborating across functions to define product goals, manage lifecycles, and ensure successful launches and ongoing enhancements.
  
  
Visa’s Risk and Identity Solutions (RaIS) group delivers advanced fraud detection and prevention solutions, ensuring seamless, secure payment experiences. The Predictive Fraud Intelligence (PFI) team develops core AI/ML products within the Visa Protect suite, empowering clients to detect and prevent fraud throughout the payment lifecycle.
  
  
As fraud vectors have rapidly evolved, PFI has significantly expanded its product portfolio and reimagined its approach to building, deploying, and monitoring real-time, low-latency AI models. We seek a seasoned AI product Manager to drive platform capabilities and tooling, accelerating model development and supporting diverse client needs.
  
  
Visa is seeking a seasoned Director Product Manager with a keen interest in heavy tech platforms, deep understanding of ML development lifecycle & MLOps, and a strong passion for innovation. This role is pivotal in enhancing some of the fastest fraud detection models in the world. It is an opportunity to improve the end-to-end process, bring in continuous learning, keeping them up to date to catch the latest fraud trends.
  
  
As a product leader, you will collaborate closely with Technology, Data Science, Cross-functional Product, and Regional teams to define priorities, craft solutions, and deliver key product capabilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Customer-Centric Product: Understand customer needs and build empathy with technical users like data scientists and data engineers to define and evolve the product roadmap.
* Product Vision: Define and execute product strategy, vision statements, and product goals. Lead product design, customer discovery, and the development of new products based on market and customer insights.
* Data Ecosystem Leadership: Develop a deep understanding of the data lifecycle and drive strategic improvements across data sourcing, quality, and governance.
* Model Optimization: Continuously enhance existing AI/ML models to improve fraud detection accuracy and performance.
* GenAI Integration: Leverage generative AI to streamline model development, deployment, and monitoring processes.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, data science, and product teams across geographies to deliver scalable, impactful solutions.
* Leadership: Set a role model of product management for the rest of product management team. Mentor new product managers, set processes. Take team forward on the set vision. Recruit, grow, and retain high-caliber technical talent.
* Execution Excellence: Lead the delivery of complex, high-impact initiatives that transform the model development lifecycle and accelerate innovation. Structure and manage complex projects and processes with multiple stakeholders.
* The successful execution of this role will be achieved through a combination of leadership, technology/AI-ML knowledge, platform thinking, innovation, passion for customers, and applied strategy.
* All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* 12+ years of professional experience with a bachelor’s degree. 5+ years in product management, focused on platforms and/or data products.
* Senior product management experience in deep technical platform with exposure to Data management, ML/AI platform solutions.
* Strong grasp of Agile methodologies and proven success in fast-paced, iterative environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional AI/ML and data science teams.
* Strategic thinker with sharp analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills across global, diverse teams.
* Superior analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated intellectual rigor.
* Understanding payments, fraud and authentication landscape and ability to translate product strategy into executable plans.
* Experience recruiting, growing, retaining, and leading technical talent.
* Experience collaborating in global, cross-functional teams.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.description:

**Job Description**
**Location:**
Bengaluru, with regular travel to our Raipur head office.
**Reports to:**
CEO.
**Type:**
Full-time.
  
  
**About Elxer**
Elxer has connected Chhattisgarh since 2014. We run fibre broadband for homes and businesses, enterprise connectivity (leased lines, managed Wi-Fi and security), a data centre, and Elxer Solar for rooftop solar installations. We build much of our own technology in-house, including our customer app, field and sales app, HR system and a new operations platform, and we use AI across the business. We are now creating a product function, and we are looking for the leader to own it.
  
  
The role
  
  
You will own what Elxer builds and sells, and why: the software our teams and customers use every day, and the services we add on top of a connection, a rack or a solar installation. You will turn business problems into clear, prioritised products, take them to real users and prove they work with measured results. You will not be judged on documents or features shipped alone.
  
  
You will work directly with the CEO. You will partner with the Software team, which owns architecture and delivery, and with Sales, Operations, Network, Support, Marketing, Finance and HR as business owners. An AI product assistant will support analysis, requirements drafting and reporting.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
**Portfolio and roadmap**

* Own one product portfolio across the new operations platform, the in-house systems that run the business today (customer and field apps, HRMS, billing and ticketing integrations) and our experimental tools.
* Build and run the idea register, scoring and quarterly roadmap. Decide with the CEO what to build, improve, retire or stop.
* Set clear rules for when an experimental tool becomes a supported product or is retired.

**Discovery And Requirements**

* Spend regular time with field engineers, NOC, support agents, sales teams and customers to find the problems worth solving.
* Write problem statements, user journeys, acceptance criteria and non-goals that the Software team can estimate and build against.
* Make sure each business owner confirms the need before work starts and accepts the result before it counts as done.

**Commercial products and services**

* Shape the add-on and complementary products for home, enterprise, wholesale and solar customers, such as managed Wi-Fi, managed security, CCTV with cloud storage and solar maintenance.
* For each one, define the offer, SLA, pricing inputs, billing, fulfilment, support model and compliance checks, then hand over a launch-ready package to Sales and Marketing.
* Work with Finance on margin and with legal advisers on licence scope before anything is sold.

**Delivery and quality**

* Track each product slice from idea to production, and raise blockers early.
* Keep product data honest: correct metric definitions, complete records and dashboards management can trust.
* Plan releases with the Software lead, so changes reach users safely and with training.

**Measurement**

* Define and report product measures: active users by function, adoption, idea-to-production lead time, add-on attach rates and ARPU, churn and support tickets per customer.
* Present a monthly product review to the CEO.

**Team**

* Build the product function over time, starting with yourself and the AI assistant, and later product analysts or owners.

**Compliance**

* Make sure products follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, TRAI and DoT licence conditions, CERT-In directions and labour-law requirements where they apply.

What success looks like in the first year
  
  

* One product register and roadmap in use across all software and services, reviewed every quarter.
* At least one platform slice used daily by real business users, with acceptance recorded by its business owner.
* Trusted definitions and dashboards for tickets, attendance and leads.
* At least two complementary products launched with measured attach rate and margin.
* A shorter, measured idea-to-production lead time.

Must have
  
  

* 8+ years in product management, with 3+ years owning a roadmap and outcomes for an internal platform, a B2B product or a service business: ISP or telecom, SaaS, logistics, fintech, energy or a similar operations-heavy category.
* Has shipped products used by field or operations teams, not only web or consumer apps.
* Strong in discovery and requirements: can turn a messy workflow into clear acceptance criteria.
* Analytical: comfortable with SQL or BI tools, funnels, unit economics and product metrics.
* Works well with engineers. Understands APIs, data models, mobile apps and release processes well enough to make sound trade-offs.
* Excellent Hindi and English; clear writing.

Good to have
  
  

* Experience with broadband or telecom systems: billing, Radius/AAA, ticketing, GIS or network inventory.
* Experience pricing and launching a service product, including SLAs and margins.
* Familiarity with HR, field-workforce or CRM systems.
* Uses AI tools in everyday product work.
* Engineering degree; MBA a plus, not a requirement.

What we offer
  
  

* A leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, with the mandate to build the product function from scratch.
* Real influence over what a growing regional technology group builds and sells.
* In-house engineering, our own data and AI tools to work with.
* Competitive compensation based on experience.

Reports to: Head, Industry Solutions Group – Banking & Financial Services

**About the opportunity**

Our client, a global technology services and solutions provider, is seeking an India-based senior leader to head its Banking and Financial Services industry solutions agenda. The role combines industry expertise, client advisory, solution development and business growth, with a strong focus on Global Capability Centers (GCCs) in India and support for clients and opportunities worldwide.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The successful candidate will build and mentor the India industry solutions team while personally shaping propositions, developing executive points of view, supporting strategic pursuits and leading senior client conversations.

**Key responsibilities**

Lead the ISG BFS agenda for India, aligned with the global BFS strategy, priority sub-segments and market opportunities.

Act as the primary ISG BFS partner for Global Capability Centers in India, engaging GCC leaders on their evolving mandates, transformation priorities, product and platform ownership, operating models, AI adoption and value realization.

Build relationships across the GCC ecosystem, including business, product, operations, technology, data, risk and transformation leaders, while connecting their India priorities to the global agendas of their parent institutions.

Support BFS clients and account teams worldwide by providing domain expertise, shaping solutions, joining strategic pursuits and mobilizing the right India-based experts and assets.

Partner with regional ISG leaders, Market Units, Sales, Account teams, Delivery, AI and technology practices to create a consistent global BFS proposition while adapting it to local client needs.

Identify emerging industry, regulatory, GCC and technology trends, and convert them into targeted opportunity plays, propositions and thought leadership.

Create proactive propositions, value hypotheses, executive points of view and client-ready collateral, including quantified business cases tied to measurable banking outcomes.

Lead or support strategic BFS pursuits, including discovery, solution shaping, RFPs and RFIs, orals, solution defense and executive presentations.

Direct the design and development of PoCs, PoVs, reusable assets and accelerators, with a strong focus on AI, GenAI, data-led transformation and modern operating models.

Develop India as a global hub for BFS domain capability, ensuring that expertise, solutions and assets created in India are accessible and reusable across regions.

Build, mentor and grow the India ISG BFS team, strengthen domain communities and create practical mechanisms for knowledge sharing across delivery and account teams.

Represent the organization in relevant GCC, client, analyst, advisor and industry forums in India, while supporting global market positioning where required.

Share explicit accountability for proactive pipeline creation, strategic deals, solution adoption, TCV and revenue growth across India and supported global markets.

**Candidate profile**

**Essential experience and expertise**

15+ years of professional experience, primarily in Banking & Financial Services, gained within financial institutions, GCCs, consulting, professional services or global technology services organizations. Quality and seniority of experience matter more than tenure alone.

Senior experience leading or advising BFS transformation, industry solutions, domain consulting, product, operations or technology programs.

Strong understanding of the India GCC landscape and the role GCCs play in global financial institutions, including capability expansion, product and platform ownership, transformation, innovation and enterprise-wide delivery.

A proven record of engaging senior stakeholders in India and internationally, with the credibility to advise business, product, operations and technology leaders as a peer.

Deep BFS domain and operating-model knowledge across the front, middle and back office, with working knowledge of core platforms, data, cloud, digital channels, payments, risk, compliance and RegTech.

A strong record of shaping large change and transformation programs with measurable impact on outcomes such as cost-to-income, cycle time, straight-through processing, control effectiveness, customer experience and revenue growth.

Practical depth in financial-services AI and GenAI, including where it creates value, where it does not, and how to prove and scale outcomes through PoCs and PoVs.

Ability to shape and sell propositions internally and externally, build business cases, secure sponsorship, navigate complex stakeholder groups and lead solution narratives.

Strong commercial understanding of large programs, including proactive propositions, RFPs and RFIs, solution defense, pricing trade-offs, TCV and revenue impact.

Experience working effectively across geographies and time zones, mobilizing matrixed teams and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to create executive-ready content and lead senior client conversations.

Willingness to travel within India and internationally as business needs require.

**Preferred experience**

Leadership experience within, or significant advisory experience serving, a Global Capability Center in India.

Experience advising Product Management and Digital Product Management organizations on product strategy, operating-model design, value realization and digital product innovation.

Experience building domain-led solutions or consulting capabilities that have been deployed across multiple geographies.

Financial-services M&A, post-merger integration, captive setup, capability transition or GCC transformation experience.

Embedded finance, Banking-as-a-Service, fintech partnership or ecosystem experience.

Experience engaging industry analysts, advisors and external forums.

**Leadership approach**

Engages clients as a peer, brings a clear point of view and changes it when the evidence changes.

Understands both the global institution and the India GCC perspective, and connects the two rather than treating them as separate agendas.

Leads with why: understands the need behind a client’s ask and explains why change matters now and is worth the disruption.

Challenges obvious answers and reframes problems when the existing framing is limiting the outcome.

Operates as a player-manager: sets direction and gets hands-on, including shaping the solution, building the deck or writing the point of view.

Acts as a team builder and connector, raising the people around them and sharing credit.

Thinks consultatively and communicates clearly, credibly and persuasively.

Works effectively in a matrix and mobilizes people across organizational and geographic boundaries.

Balances global consistency with local relevance and understands when each is required.

Is genuinely curious about the industry, GCC evolution and what clients are actually trying to achieve.

**What the role offers**

A high-impact India leadership role within the global BFS Industry Solutions Group, with direct exposure to senior organizational and client leadership.

The opportunity to shape how the organization engages the rapidly evolving GCC ecosystem in India and connects GCC capabilities to global business priorities.

A mandate to build India as a global hub for BFS domain expertise, propositions, thought leadership and reusable solution assets.

The breadth that comes from working across financial institutions, GCCs, geographies and business models rather than within a single organization.

The opportunity to apply AI and GenAI to real banking problems at scale and turn successful approaches into repeatable solutions.

A visible platform across client, GCC, analyst, advisor and industry forums.

An open and transparent culture

jobs.title: Business Head - BFSI
jobs.description:
Business Head – BFSI | OTPless

Bengaluru or Mumbai · On-site · 8–12 years

**ABOUT OTPLESS**

OTPless builds the authentication, identity and trust infrastructure for digital businesses. We power login and user journeys for Zepto, Meesho, Ixigo and ShareChat, we run 300Mn+ silent verifications a month, and we're backed by General Catalyst, FJ Labs, SIDBI, Amrish Rau and Kunal Shah. We were founded by the founding team at BharatPe.

Authentication is where we started — Smart Auth is live across some of India's largest consumer and financial businesses. Our next growth engine is OTPless Watch, a device and risk intelligence platform that combines device fingerprinting, app protection, telecom and IP signals, and identity data to help businesses spot suspicious activity and make better risk decisions. Watch sits right next to Smart Auth, so businesses get authentication and fraud intelligence from one place.

**THE ROLE**

We're hiring a Business Head to own the entire OTPless BFSI business — the full vertical, end to end, across Smart Auth, Watch and everything we take to market in financial services.

You'll own the BFSI P&L outright: the strategy, the revenue, the customers and the roadmap. That means growing and deepening our existing Smart Auth footprint in BFSI, and opening the next frontier with Watch — starting with fintechs and NBFCs, then banks and insurance. You'll find the market, prove the products, carry the number, and build the business.

You won't be starting from zero. Smart Auth is already live in production with Navi, Paytm and Bajaj, which gives you relationships, reference customers and a running start to expand across the vertical and pull Watch into live accounts.

This is a hands-on ownership role — you'll lead the biggest deals yourself and work directly with the CBO and the founders, with real influence over product, pricing and strategy.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* The business. The full BFSI P&L — strategy, revenue growth and ownership across the vertical. You decide which fintechs, NBFCs, banks and insurers to go after, grow the accounts we already have, build the relationships that matter across Product, Risk, Fraud and Business teams, and set the pricing and commercial models that make the motion repeatable.

* The market fit. Run discovery with real buyers, find the use cases where OTPless wins, and work directly with the Product and Engineering teams to turn what you hear into roadmap. Use our live Smart Auth relationships to expand accounts and pull Watch into them.

* The deals. Lead consultative engagements end to end — discovery, solution design, technical evaluation, POC, commercial close and expansion — across the full OTPless stack. Prove measurable outcomes, not demos.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

Above all, someone who can own and grow a BFSI business — a builder who carries revenue, closes senior deals and can be trusted with the full vertical. Beyond that, we're looking for:

Domain & experience

* 8–12 years across product, growth, strategy or business roles, with real ownership of revenue or outcomes
* Deep experience in fintech, payments, UPI, digital lending, NBFCs, banking or insurance, and a real grasp of the Indian BFSI ecosystem
* A track record on products or deals involving fraud, risk, trust and safety, identity, authentication or digital onboarding
* Live relationships inside fintechs and NBFCs; connections into banks and insurers are a plus

Product & technical depth

* You don't have to code, but you're technically credible — you can sit with an engineer, understand how it works, and shape what gets built
* Comfort with APIs, SDKs, device intelligence, fingerprinting, SIM binding, risk scoring and digital onboarding flows
* You can translate what a customer needs into product requirements, and work with Product and Engineering to get it built

Business & growth instinct

* You turn market opportunities into revenue — hunting new logos and growing the accounts you already have
* Strong consultative selling, senior stakeholder management and commercial negotiation
* An entrepreneurial streak — you can operate alone, build from nothing, and own the outcome end to end

**STRONG SIGNALS**

This is likely to fit people coming from:

* Payments & fintech: Juspay, Razorpay, PhonePe, Paytm, Cashfree, CRED
* Lending & NBFCs: Navi, KreditBee, Fibe, Lendingkart and other tech-led lenders
* Fraud, risk & identity: Bureau, SHIELD, Signzy, HyperVerge, IDfy, GoKwik
* Banks & financial institutions: product, digital banking, payments and fraud-risk leaders

We're especially keen on product, growth and strategy people who've worked close to business, tech and risk teams and now want to own a business, not a backlog.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 6 MONTHS)**

* A clear BFSI strategy and target-account universe across the full OTPless portfolio
* Existing Smart Auth accounts grown and deepened, with measurable revenue
* 5–10 lighthouse fintech/NBFC wins across Smart Auth and Watch, with banks and insurers seeded in the pipeline
* A repeatable business development and account-growth motion
* Validated high-value use cases that have moved the product roadmap
* Real cross-sell between Smart Auth and Watch

**WHY OTPLESS**

You'll own an entire vertical with real P&L responsibility, at the intersection of payments, identity and fraud — three of the spaces moving fastest in Indian financial services. You build on top of an authentication platform and customer base that already exist, not a blank page.

You'll work directly with the CBO and the founders — the founding team behind BharatPe — backed by General Catalyst, FJ Labs, SIDBI, Amrish Rau and Kunal Shah. It's early enough that you shape the business, the product and the commercial model, with the autonomy and ownership of a founder and the backing of a company that's already at scale.

If you're ready to move past managing a product and own a business, let's talk.

jobs.title: Business Head - Navi UPI
jobs.description:
**About Navi**

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

**What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.**

**Why Explore a Career at Navi?**

**Where Ownership Creates Real Impact**

At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.

**Where Careers Accelerate**

Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.

**Where Great Talent Builds Together**

We take pride in building high talent-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.

**About the Team**

Since launching in August 2023, Navi UPI has grown from strength to strength to become India’s fourth-largest UPI TPAP. In a crowded market with large incumbents, Navi UPI has been able to capture a significant market share and win the loyalty of users on the back of a customer-first, product-led strategy. Our mission is clear: build on this foundation and become a leading and dominant player in India’s payments landscape.

**About the Role**

As Business Head, you will drive:

* The core acquisition engine of the group, bridging efforts across teams including product, growth, engineering, data and marketing; and
* The go-to-market strategy and execution of our to-be-launched PA (Payment Aggregator, i.e. merchant acquisition) business.

You will also act as the primary point of contact for our key partners and stakeholders including NPCI and work closely with our compliance, fraud, risk and engineering teams to ensure we deliver a stable and reliable experience to our customers. As a leader, you will be responsible for overseeing cross-functional efforts to build the Navi UPI user base, increase its loyalty and grow market share.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Proven experience in driving outcomes in business, sales, operations or other generalist roles;
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions and measure impact / ROI;
* Entrepreneurial mindset and work ethic with high ownership and comfort operating in a 0-to-1 setup;
* Sharp attention to detail and a strategic mindset for long-term process optimisation;
* Ability to think outside the box and be comfortable dealing with unstructured problem statements;
* Exceptional leadership, team management, collaboration and communication skills; and
* Adaptability to navigate the evolving payments landscape, leveraging new trends and technologies to drive innovation.

**Soft Skills & Traits**

To succeed in this role, you will need to:

* Operate with speed, ownership and a builder mindset—constantly challenging the status quo to scale our UPI and, eventually, PA businesses;
* Lead end-to-end program management, ensuring timely delivery, execution excellence and speedy resolution of issues;
* Constantly design, execute and iterate experiments to test new ideas and identify the most effective approaches to drive business growth or cost optimisation;
* Leverage data to identify pockets of inefficiency and opportunity and influence stakeholders and leaders across the organisation;
* Partner with marketing, product, analytics, data science, FRS (Fraud Risk & Strategy), compliance and finance teams to ensure delivery of key business goals;
* Lead, manage and mentor a lean and dynamic team, and foster a culture of collaboration that ensures each team member contributes effectively to Navi's goals;
* Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders such as NPCI, PSP banks and other partners to ensure Navi UPI’s strategic goals are being met; and
* Collaborate with our FRS), Data and Engineering teams to drive our Trust & Safety (TnS) and reliability agendas.

**The Navi OS**

The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.

* Start with the Customer
* Master the Details
* Act with Urgency
* Own the Outcome
* Build for a Decade - Not a Day
* Win as One

We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation.

To read more about the Navi OS, visit
navi.com/our-values

**Life at Navi**

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.

jobs.title: Senior Manager -Auto Loan : Fintech
jobs.description:
The Role

Flipkart is looking for a high-impact leader to spearhead the growth of our Auto Loan Marketplace. As the

Senior Manager of Business Development, you will be the primary architect of our 2-Wheeler (2W) and

4-Wheeler (4W) financing ecosystem. You aren't just managing a product; you are building a scalable

business from the ground up within the Flipkart app, ensuring that millions of customers have seamless

access to vehicle credit.

Key Responsibilities

● Lender Onboarding: Identify, negotiate, and integrate with leading Banks, NBFCs, and Captive

Finance companies to build a diverse lending panel.

● OEM & Dealer Relations: Build strategic alliances with major 2W/4W manufacturers (OEMs) and

large dealer networks to integrate financing at the point of intent.

● Product Ecosystem: Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to build a frictionless

"Apply-to-Disburse" journey for users.

● Stakeholder Management: Ability to influence internal product teams and external C-suite

executives at banking institutions.

● Revenue Growth: Take full accountability for the Auto Loan P&L, focusing on Top-line

(Disbursement volumes) and Bottom-line (Commission/Fee income).

● Market Penetration: Design and execute go-to-market (GTM) strategies to scale the business

across Pan India digitally.

● Incentive Design: Manage subvention programs and promotional budgets to drive conversion

without eroding margins.

● Entrepreneurial Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity and have the grit to build a vertical

in a fast-paced environment.

● Funnel Optimization: Deep-dive into the conversion funnel—from lead generation to loan

sanction—to identify and fix drop-offs.

● Risk & Quality: Work closely with the partners Risk team to ensure the lead quality meets lender

appetite while maintaining a healthy "Approval Rate."

● Analytical Rigor: You are a "Power User" of Excel. You don't just report numbers; you find the

story within them to drive strategy.

What We Are Looking For

● Experience: 6–10 years of experience, ideally in a FinTech, Digital Lending, or a high-growth

E-commerce environment. Direct experience in Auto Finance is a huge plus.

Qualifications:

Education: MBA in Finance, Banking or a related field.

Experience: 6 to 10 years of experience in lending operations, with at least 5 years in the Two-Wheeler

finance sector.

Why Join Flipkart Fintech?

You will be at the forefront of the "Credit Revolution" in India. With Flipkart's massive user base, you have

the unique opportunity to solve for credit under-penetration in the automobile sector using data and

technology at a scale very few companies globally can offer.

Note: This role requires a balance of "feet-on-street" partnership hustle and "office-at-desk" analytical

depth.

To succeed in this role – you should have the following: \*

● Strong understanding of the Indian two-wheeler market and lending landscape.

● Proficiency in financial modeling, budgeting, and forecasting.

● Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

● Ability to drive digital transformation and process automation in lending operations.

Mandatory Skills

Understanding of Two Wheeler & Four Wheeler Financing business, Ability to analyze data, Stakeholder

Management, Strong Problem Solving Skills, Strong Excel Skills

1. Strategic Partnerships & Marketplace Building

2. P&L Ownership & Scaling

3. Data-Driven Decision Making

jobs.description:
**About The Company**
Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and execution-focused
**Head of Product**
to lead our product vision, strategy, and roadmap. You will directly manage a team of 4–5 Product Managers and oversee a broader product organization of 20 professionals. In this role, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of our core messaging (SMS, RCS, WhatsApp), voice, and omnichannel APIs, balancing developer experience, enterprise scalability, carrier compliance, and commercial growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Product Strategy & Vision
  
  

* Define the Product Roadmap: Own and articulate a compelling multi-year product vision and quarterly execution roadmap aligned with company revenue and growth targets.
* Market & Competitive Intelligence: Stay ahead of emerging trends in the CPaaS ecosystems, including AI-driven conversational commerce, RCS Business Messaging, and omnichannel orchestration.
* Commercial Alignment: Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to establish pricing, packaging, and go-to-market (GTM) strategies that maximize customer acquisition and net dollar retention.

Leadership & Team Management
  
  

* Manage and Mentor: Directly lead, coach, and develop 4–5 Product Managers, fostering a high-performing, data-driven, and customer-obsessed culture.
* Organizational Oversight: Guide the broader product team—ensuring seamless collaboration across Product Management, UX/UI Design, Product Analytics, and API Documentation.
* Process Excellence: Establish scalable product development frameworks, discovery processes, and KPI tracking across all product pods.

CPaaS Domain & Technical Execution
  
  

* API & Developer Experience: Champion a "developer-first" mindset, ensuring our APIs, SDKs, and self-serve portals are intuitive, well-documented, and easy to integrate.
* Platform Reliability & Scale: Collaborate closely with Engineering and Telecom/Carrier Operations to ensure ultra-high availability, low latency, and optimal message deliverability across global routes.
* Compliance & Security: Ensure all product offerings adhere to global telecom regulations, data privacy laws (GDPR, TCPA, DPDP), and anti-spam/fraud standards (e.g., 10DLC, DLT in India).

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Experience: 15+ years of experience in Product Management, with at least 5+ years in a senior leadership role managing other Product Managers.
* Domain Expertise: Proven track record in CPaaS, cloud communications, telecom infrastructure, SaaS APIs, or B2B developer platforms.
* Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, webhooks, cloud architecture, and telecom protocols (SMPP, SIP, WebRTC) to credibly partner with engineering leadership.
* Scale & Growth: Demonstrated success scaling B2B products from mid-market to enterprise adoption, with direct ownership of P&L or revenue-impacting metrics.
* Analytical & Customer-Centric: Deep experience using product analytics to drive decisions, paired with a habit of engaging directly with enterprise customers and developers.
* Communication: Exceptional executive presence with the ability to influence board members, enterprise clients, telecom partners, and cross-functional teams.

**Key metrics**

* Revenue & Adoption: API consumption growth, Net Revenue
* Delivery & Quality: On-time roadmap execution, API uptime/latency benchmarks, and reduction in customer onboarding time.
* Team Health: Retention, career progression, and velocity of the 15-person product organization.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - WhatsApp India
jobs.description:
About the TeamMore than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done - people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next.About the RoleThis PM and Market Leader of India will oversee the newly announced pillar for WhatsApp, treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks, and build as we go. Staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp pillar, from the very first day. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live in India since 2020 and growing; the existing WhatsApp payments team moves across as the pillar's foundation.As a Product Leader at WhatsApp, you will use your experience building products from early concept through launch in fast-moving environments and your full range of product development skills to produce intuitive, user-friendly features. You’ll be expected to push the boundaries of what’s possible in a mobile app, while sharing in our commitment to quality and attention to detail. This is a role for someone who can hold both the ceiling and the floor: sets an ambitious long-term vision for what WhatsApp can become in India.
  
  
Director, Product Management - WhatsApp India Responsibilities:
  
  

* Drive product strategy and development for one of the highest-priority initiatives across WhatsApp and Meta
* Establish a shared vision across the company (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger) and ensure that all teams are clear on the overall strategy, the problem to be solved, timeline, and required contributions
* Ability to move fast to drive alignment and execution – Turn high volumes of different actions into repeatable processes and playbooks, and get alignment within and across teams through both influence and framing clear escalations when team priorities conflict
* Manage multiple products and priorities, scale teams, and ensure org is effective, healthy and set up for success by establishing clear and measurable goals – Collaborate, navigate and influence product teams across WhatsApp
* Consumer, Business, Privacy, Growth and Messaging Services, and the broader Meta organization (including Instagram and Facebook)
* Drive executional excellence and analytical rigor across teams – Drive internal and external process improvements across multiple teams and functions to reduce operational overhead, streamline decision-making and accelerate overall execution
* Manage business reviews (i.e., weekly/monthly business reviews, functional reviews, and other key meetings), staff meetings, and all hands meetings
* Lead reviews of dashboards and reports for stakeholders and team members to drive transparency and track improvements
* Proactively identify issues and needs, escalate as needed, and devise processes to resolve them
* Coordinate working groups for areas of ownership that we need to establish, but which cut across organizational lines
* At times, you may be specifically tasked to own a workstream, or to dive deep into different parts of the organization
* Lead org-wide projects to create business value, aligning multiple stakeholders across Meta, including various product teams, go-to-market, Finance, Operations, Research, and Family of Apps

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* 15+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years leading PM teams (managing managers)
* Strong technical judgment and ability to partner with ML/ranking teams on signal quality, bidding systems, and delivery optimization
* Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of bets at different maturity stages — from 0-to-1 incubation to billion-dollar scaled products — simultaneously
* Exceptional cross-functional leadership: ability to drive alignment across engineering, data science, design, sales, partnerships, and policy
* Experience applying analytical rigor and data-driven decision-making, including defining and optimizing product metrics and data-driven decision-making, with experience in defining and optimizing metrics

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* B.A. or B.S. in Computer Science or a related field (Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Business)
* Experience in building and scaling early-stage growth efforts
* Proficiency in using AI tools as part of day-to-day product development and general productivity workflow
* Track record of successfully executing the strategy in the APAC region
* Experience working with payment infrastructure in emerging markets

About Meta:
  
  
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

jobs.description:
**Director (C15) - Head of Product and Engineering**
**Location:**
Pune (Hybrid)
  
  
**Line of Business:**
Compliance Technology / Enterprise Technology
  
  
**About The Role**
Are you a product engineering leader who excels at driving massive platform consolidations, leading high-performing global teams, and solving complex distributed systems challenges? Do you believe in solving complex problem through technology simplification and modernisation?
  
  
At Citi, we are executing a bold, multi-year technology modernisation strategy. A critical pillar of this transformation is the unification of our global compliance enterprise workflow and case management systems. As the
**Head of Product and Engineering**
, you will be the strategic engineering leader and product visionary responsible for driving the consolidation, modernisation, and scaling of our global compliance case management platforms.
  
  
In this dual-hatted role, you will:
  
  
**Lead Global Case Management & Workflow Platforms:**
Direct a globally distributed engineering organisation tasked with building and scaling our unified, high-throughput enterprise workflow and decisioning platforms.
  
  
**Serve as the India Site Lead:**
Act as the senior technology executive for our regional engineering hub in India, driving talent strategy, engineering culture, and operational excellence across the site.
  
  
This is a high-visibility, executive-level role reporting directly to the Managing Director, Global Head of Product and Engineering.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Strategy ,Platform Unification and Product Management
* Drive Platform Consolidation: Define and execute the technical strategy to consolidate disparate legacy workflow and case management systems into a single, modern, global platform.
* Architectural Modernization: Lead the transition of core platforms to a cloud-native, microservices-based, and event-driven architecture capable of processing millions of complex events daily with sub-second latency.
* AI & Automation Integration: Partner with AI/ML research teams to embed intelligent routing, automated document processing, and machine learning-driven decision support systems into the core workflow engine.
* Technical Governance: Establish and enforce robust architectural standards, API designs, and data schemas that ensure long-term platform extensibility and maintainability.
* Product leadership: Thought leader and ability to wear the product hat. Ability to drive strategic product decision along with key stakeholders
* Global Engineering Leadership & Execution
* Manage Globally Distributed Teams: Lead, inspire, and scale a multi-disciplinary engineering organization(75+)
* Foster Engineering Excellence: Establish rigorous standards for code quality, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability (monitoring, tracing, logging) to ensure 99.999% platform availability.
* Operational & Financial Management: Oversee financial planning, resource allocation, vendor management, and operational budgets for your global engineering organisation.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Operations, Risk, and senior business executives to align engineering roadmaps with business outcomes.
* India Site Leadership
* Site Strategy & Growth: Act as the senior executive and site lead for the regional engineering hub in India. Drive local talent acquisition, retention, and career development programs.
* Culture & Collaboration: Build a vibrant, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture that mirrors the best practices of top-tier product technology companies.
* Local Governance: Ensure compliance with local regulations, operational standards, and corporate policies.

**Our Target Tech Stack & Architecture**
We are actively migrating our platforms to a modern, cloud-native stack:
  
  

* Backend & Microservices: Go, Java (Spring Boot), Python, gRPC, REST APIs
* Frontend & Workflows: React, Angular, TypeScript, Modern BPMN/Workflow Engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda, Flowable)
* Data & Event Streaming: Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, AWS, Service Mesh (Istio)
* AI/ML & Analytics: Multi-LLM integrations via secure internal gateways, Vector Databases, Python-based ML pipelines

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**
**Basic Qualifications:**

* Experience: 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 5+ years in an engineering leadership role (Director, Senior Engineering Manager, or equivalent) at Product-Engineering first setup
* Platform Unification: Proven track record of successfully leading large-scale platform consolidations, legacy migrations, or enterprise-wide system unifications.
* Distributed Systems: Deep expertise in designing and operating high-availability, low-latency, and highly secure distributed systems at massive scale.
* Global Leadership: Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams of 80+ engineers, including direct management of engineering managers and principal architects.
* Site Leadership: Proven experience leading a regional engineering site or hub, with a strong track record of building local talent pipelines and fostering a strong engineering culture.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Domain Knowledge: Experience in compliance, sanctions, transaction risk, anti-money laundering (AML), fraud detection, or high-scale transactional risk systems is highly desirable but not mandatory. We value core engineering leadership and platform-building capabilities above specific domain experience.
* Workflow & BPMN Expertise: Familiarity with modern workflow orchestration engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda) and complex state-machine design.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

**Why Join Citi?**

* Unprecedented Scale & Impact: We secure and facilitate the global financial system. The platforms you unify will protect trillions of dollars in daily transactions from financial crime and regulatory risk.
* True Autonomy: You will have the mandate, budget, and executive backing to make critical architectural and organizational decisions to achieve our platform unification goals.
* Modern Developer Ecosystem: Leverage Citi's state-of-the-art internal developer platforms, including our secure GenAI gateway and modern serverless application frameworks, to accelerate delivery.

**And many more reasons…**

jobs.title: Mgr Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem
  
ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.
  
  
As a Mgr Software Engineering in Pune, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!
  
  
Job Summary:
  
Manages the activities of one or more software systems development function or software applications development function. Selects, develops and evaluates personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function.
  
Job Responsibilities:
  
- Manages and directs ACI's development resources in accordance with corporate and division goals and objectives. Instructs and guides staff to maximize their technical, managerial, and corporate growth and development. Provides feedback and completes performance appraisals. Develops annual staff salary, training plans, and reports on the status of the staff and projects.
  
- Works with senior management to set the technical direction for company products and services. Leads and guides the development and maintenance products and services ensuring that they align with the company’s strategic and business plans.
  
- Manages product security including product risk reduction, compliance, product security training, product security software development lifecycle, and security architecture.
  
- Leads interaction with internal and external organizations and individuals to ensure appropriate information exchange, with the goal of properly developing the staff and successfully completing assigned projects.
  
- Perform other duties as assigned
  
- Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.
  
  
Knowledge, Skills and Experience required for the job:
  
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
  
- 12+ years of software development and/or design experience.
  
- 5+ years of direct management or leadership experience, including staff performance management and development.
  
- Proven ability to set technical direction and align development efforts with business and strategic goals.
  
- Experience managing multiple concurrent software development projects and competing priorities.
  
- Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including secure development practices.
  
- Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and their application in software development (e.g., AI-assisted coding tools, intelligent automation, or AI-driven product features).
  
- Ability to evaluate and guide adoption of AI-based tools and technologies to improve team productivity and product capabilities.
  
- Demonstrated experience with budgeting, resource planning, and staff development (training plans, performance appraisals).
  
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with experience interacting with both technical staff and senior leadership.
  
- Ability to guide, mentor, and grow technical talent within a team.
  
  
Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Experience needed for the job:
  
- Experience managing software development teams in the payments, fintech, or financial services industry.
  
- Working knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices, product security architecture, and risk/compliance frameworks.
  
- Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and managing distributed or cross-functional development teams.
  
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern software architecture (microservices, APIs).
  
- Strong track record of managing staff performance, career development, and succession planning.
  
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience liaising between technical teams and senior leadership.
  
- Prior experience contributing to or owning technical roadmaps aligned with business strategy.
  
  
AI-Enabled Engineering & Delivered AI Projects (Must-Have)
  
- Lead delivery of AI-enabled initiatives in two dimensions:1. AI-accelerated SDLC (planning, code review, test generation, documentation, defect reduction), and
  
2. AI/ML/GenAI solution delivery where AI is part of the shipped product or operational capability.
  
  
- Establish responsible AI usage practices: teams are encouraged to use AI, but remain accountable for outputs; validate correctness, security, and maintainability before merging.
  
- Enforce safe prompting and data handling: never place secrets/credentials/PCI/PII into prompts; use placeholders and abstractions.
  
  
Work Environment:
  
- Standard work environment
  
- Some limited Travel required, may be domestic or international
  
  
Core Capabilities:
  
We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities — these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together:
  
- Ensure Accountability: holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
  
  
- Drives Results: consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  
  
- Customer Focus: building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
- Cultivate Innovation: creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful.
  
  
- Collaborates: building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
  
  
- Courage: stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.
  
  
  
In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.
  
  
Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com

**Lead Associate,Institutional Client Strategy & Insights.**
============================================================

Req ID: 128715

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.

**About the Role**

The Client Insights & Solutions (CIS) team develops actionable insights and solutions that help priority Institutional clients achieve their strategic objectives and manage challenges. The team supports ANZ Institutional to originate higher-returning transactions, improve cross-sell and deepen senior client engagement, and to differentiate ANZ as a leading relationship bank.

  

The Lead Associate is a senior member of the Bengaluru CIS team with team leadership responsibilities. The role leads complex client analyses and initiatives, acts as a subject matter expert in capital structure, liquidity, M&A, credit and risk management, and manages, mentors and develops Senior Associates (Group 4.4) and Associates (Group 5.1) in the team.

  

The Lead Associate works closely with the Head of CIS Bengaluru, the onshore CIS teams and senior stakeholders, relationship bankers and product partners to deliver the broader goals of the CIS team.

  

The role contributes to ANZ 2030 priorities: customer-first propositions, simplicity and productivity, resilience and strong risk management, and higher-returning growth. It does this through high-quality, insight-led work for Institutional clients, efficient delivery through the global operating model, building team capability, and strong quality and risk discipline

Role Location: Bengaluru

---------------------------------

As a Lead Customer Insights Associate, you will have the opportunity to:

* Translate complex data into clear, client-ready insights that support origination, cross-sell opportunities and senior client engagement.
* Review financial models and client materials to ensure accuracy, quality and relevance.
* Develop client presentations and industry campaigns that support relationship banking and product teams.Partner with Relationship

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* 8+ years in a similar or related role, preferably in Institutional Banking or Financial Services
* Experience managing, mentoring or supervising analysts or associates, through direct line management or project-based team leadership
* Capital structuring, risk assessment and credit-rating or shadow rating experience (S&P Global, Moody's, Fitch methodologies)
* Exposure to Debt Capital Markets and risk management products, including advising on FX, interest rate and commodity price risk

**So why join us?**
-------------------

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.

  

We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.

Portage Point is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States and an office in Gurugram.

The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm's platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.

The AI & Technology function serves as the strategic and operational core of the firm AI platform, building the enterprise-grade infrastructure, AI product platform and data foundation that power Portage Point's AI-enabled service delivery model. The Head of Platform role is the technical backbone of this function, directly owning the design, build and operation of the multi-tenant Portage Point Platform and the Enterprise Data Vault that underpins all AI products. The platform hosts a growing portfolio of AI solutions across practice lines and is architected from day one to support future client access optionality as the firm's AI offering matures.

The Head of Platform reports to the CTO and is the principal hands-on solution architect of the AI Platform. The Head of Platform designs the platform architecture, produces Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and provides the technical depth that enables the firm's AI-enabled service model. The role builds and operates a multi-tenant, cloud-native platform that hosts, scales and governs firm's AI product portfolio and simultaneously architects the Enterprise Data Vault, the firm's proprietary data moat built from anonymized, indexed engagement data across mandates. Build and operationalise the platform and data vault as per roadmap timelines.

The Head of Platform operates within architectural guardrails set by the CTO, with autonomy over reversible engineering decisions and a defined escalation path for irreversible architectural choices. If you are a hands-on architect and have built platforms that power AI products at scale and want to build and operate one of the most ambitious AI platform builds in middle-market advisory, this is the right role for you.

### **Responsibilities**

* Serve as principal hands-on solution architect for the AI Platform, personally designing multi-tenant data flows, compute topology, API contract standards, security boundaries and deployment patterns
* Partner with the Head of Innovation and Product Manager on the platform roadmap, product intake from practice lines and release readiness
* Produce ADRs for all material technical decisions for CTO review and approval
* Design the shared RAG infrastructure layer (vector store, embedding pipeline, retrieval optimisation) used across all LLM-based AI products
* Build and operate the Enterprise Data Vault including design and implement the full data engineering pipeline (ingestion, change data capture, dbt transformation, Airflow orchestration, data quality monitoring, lineage tracking)
* Own the multi-tenant data architecture with per-client isolation, RBAC and audit logging
* Build and maintain Knowledge Graph & Ontology Engine (sector taxonomy, deal-size buckets, lifecycle stages, market benchmarks)
* Host, monitor and scale the AI solution portfolio on the platform
* Own the MLOps layer (model registry, experiment tracking, A/B testing, versioning, rollback, performance monitoring) and LLM cost governance model (per-product token budgets, prompt caching strategy, model-swap protocols)
* Manage vector database infrastructure
* Oversee full-stack development and client API layer (TypeScript / React, Python FastAPI, REST / GraphQL)
* Design and enforce API contract standards including versioning, authentication, rate limiting, client-specific namespacing, enabling independent distribution or licensing of each AI solution
* Own DevML Ops and platform reliability – CI / CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), automated testing gates, security scanning (SAST / DAST), platform SLAs and incident response
* Maintain zero manual cloud console deployments in production
* Build and lead a team of 10-15 engineers (Lead Data Engineering & Architecture, Lead Full Stack Dev, Lead DevML Ops), define hiring profiles with the CTO, lead technical assessments
* Mentor leads on architectural thinking and ADR production
* Work with Head of IT / Infra / Security to embed security-by-design and jointly own SOC 2 Type II technical controls at the application and data layer
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Lead technical trainings on architecture, data engineering and AI infrastructure
* Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required

**Product Manager, Input Zone**

  

**About our Team:-**

DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

  

**About the Role:-**

The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

  

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.

* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.

* Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.

* Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).

* Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.

* Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

**Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle**

* Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders.

* Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes.

* Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope.

* Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow.

* Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria.

* Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD).

* Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering.

* Participates in product discovery and process improvement, and contributes to prototypes (for example, content provider manifest ingestion and PDF identification).

* Is familiar with SDLCs identified by management, for example agile processes.

**Strategy & Commercial Acumen**

* Understands the operating cost and effort involved in onboarding a new content provider or source.

* Makes links between personal goals and the team and business strategy.

* Uses technologies to assist day-to-day tasks (Excel, SQL, Jira, Confluence; familiarity with Salesforce/Snowflake rights data flows and sFTP/S3 publisher landing zones).

* Has working experience with generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows (for example prompt design, specification-to-code generation, AI-supported testing) and understands their limitations, including accuracy, data confidentiality, and publisher-content handling.

The role requires strong industry knowledge, proven sales capabilities, excellent communication skills and the ability to independently engage with business owners, company directors and senior financial decision-makers.

4. Key Roles and Responsibilities

A. Business Development and Client Acquisition

Identify prospective corporate clients, startups, MSMEs, entrepreneurs and business organizations requiring financial advisory or funding solutions.

During this assessment, candidates will be required to demonstrate their practical capabilities in the following areas:

1. Financial Expertise: Demonstrate sound knowledge of business loans, corporate funding, financial products and funding procedures.

2. Client Identification: Identify suitable prospective business clients and prepare a structured prospect pipeline.

Stage 2: Professional and Technical Interview

jobs.title: Director - Credit Product Lead, CEMEA
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Director, Credit Product Lead for CEMEA will define and lead Visa’s regional credit product agenda across Central Europe, Middle East and Africa. The role will work closely with Regional and market leadership, Product, Advisory, Analytics, Risk and other cross-functional partners to accelerate sustainable credit growth across a highly diverse set of markets.
  
  
Credit growth is a key pillar of Visa’s 2030 strategy, and CEMEA represents one of the high potential regions for credit growth. This role will help determine where and how Visa captures that opportunity by identifying the priority markets, customer segments and product propositions for the next three to five years. With global credit card issuance continuing to expand, Visa is positioned to capture a disproportionate share of that growth if the right strategic, commercial and capability foundations are established now.
  
  
The role holder will translate this ambition into a practical regional strategy and market-level execution plans, combining Visa’s network, data, products, advisory capabilities and partnerships to expand responsible access to credit and strengthen client economics.
  
  
Directors in Product Development/Management at Visa are responsible for leading the development, commercialization, and optimization of technology products within the payments ecosystem. This role requires deep expertise in product strategy, design, and execution, with a focus on delivering innovative solutions that address customer needs and drive business growth. Directors operate in complex, matrixed environments, collaborating across functions to define product goals, manage lifecycles, and ensure successful launches and ongoing enhancements.
  
  
The position demands strong analytical and problem-solving skills, the ability to navigate ambiguity, and a proven track record of recruiting, growing, and retaining technical talent. Directors are expected to drive consensus in cross-functional teams, forecast business trends, and translate insights into agile technology solutions. Exceptional communication and leadership skills are essential for influencing stakeholders and building credibility across regional and functional lines.
  
  
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and drive the CEMEA credit product strategy, including market prioritization, segment choices, product roadmap and commercial model with a three-to-five-year growth agenda.
* Drive multiple levers of credit growth across diverse CEMEA markets, spanning countries with established/ mature credit businesses as well as emerging but high potential markets.
* Accelerate credit adoption across emerging markets by enabling new-to-credit consumers and issuers through innovative and non-traditional credit products and propositions. This may include instalment-led, secured, ecosystem-based and alternative underwriting models that broaden access to responsible credit.
* Support clients with the capabilities required to build, launch and scale sustainable credit businesses, including proposition design, acquisition, underwriting and portfolio strategy driving usage and risk-adjusted profitability.
* Develop structured client upskilling programs that combine Visa expertise, data, advisory support, playbooks and market best practices, tailored to the maturity and regulatory context of individual CEMEA markets.
* Build market-level opportunity assessments and business cases using consumer research, Visa data, competitive intelligence, portfolio economics and regulatory insights; convert these into clear investment and execution priorities.
* Partner with Country Management, Sales, Product, Visa Consulting and Analytics, Risk, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Government Engagement and regional product teams to secure alignment and deliver coordinated execution.
* Engage senior client stakeholders at financial institutions/fintechs, regulators and ecosystem partners to identify barriers to credit expansion and develop scalable solutions.
* Establish performance metrics and governance for the regional credit agenda, track pipeline and portfolio outcomes, and provide regular updates and recommendations to CEMEA leadership.
* Act as a trusted advisor and subject-matter expert on card and payments-linked credit, sharing global and regional best practice and representing CEMEA in global credit product forums.

**Qualifications**

* 12 or more years of experience including 5+ years building and managing cards and payments-linked credit businesses, with accountability for strategy, product development, portfolio performance and commercial outcomes.
* Deep understanding of the credit value chain, including customer segmentation, proposition design, acquisition, underwriting, portfolio and line management, pricing, activation, engagement, collections, risk and profitability.
* Strong knowledge of payments economics and lending business P&L; experience across multiple CEMEA markets or comparable emerging and developed markets is highly desirable.
* Proven ability to translate strategy into market-level execution. This would include prioritization, business-case development, product launch, client commercialization and performance management.
* Strong client leadership and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders across different cultures and market contexts.
* Strategic thinking, strong analytical capability and financial acumen, with confidence using data to frame opportunities, make trade-offs and measure outcomes.
* Track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in a matrixed organization and delivering against demanding timelines.
* Self-directed, collaborative and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a broad regional remit.
* Bachelor’s degree required; an MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
