* Identify, map and approach accounting, bookkeeping and tax advisory practices serving UAE SMEs. **Build relationships with practice owners, partners, directors and client-facing teams; explain the OxyX partner proposition clearly.** Position accounting firms as trusted referral partners who can introduce OxyX to suitable SME clients while retaining their own client relationships. **Arrange partner meetings, briefings, demonstrations and follow-ups; maintain a structured pipeline of prospective and active firms.** Equip partners with approved presentations, product information, referral processes and client onboarding support. **Identify client needs with partner firms and coordinate introductions with the SME's consent.** Maintain partner engagement, track referred opportunities and support partner activation and retention.

*2. Direct SME acquisition and sales*

* Identify and approach SMEs across relevant sectors, including retail, trading, professional services, hospitality and other suitable business categories. **Understand each prospect's business model, current ERP/accounting setup, payment and collection processes, operational pain points and growth priorities.** Conduct needs-based discussions and demonstrate relevant OxyX capabilities rather than delivering generic product presentations. **Explain how OxyX works as an intelligence and action layer alongside the SME's existing systems, subject to connector availability, permissions and supported data.** Develop proposals, manage objections, follow up opportunities and progress prospects through evaluation, decision and onboarding. **Build relationships with business owners, finance managers, operations managers and other decision-makers.**

*3. SME onboarding, activation and account management*

* Coordinate onboarding with the SME, accounting firm and internal implementation/support teams. **Ensure the SME understands agreed use cases, onboarding requirements, connector prerequisites and each party's responsibilities.** Support initial setup, user orientation and first-use milestones; escalate technical or integration issues promptly. **Monitor engagement, identify underused capabilities and recommend relevant steps to improve adoption and business value.** Maintain regular account reviews, resolve relationship issues and identify opportunities for expansion, renewal and referral. **Capture customer feedback and share product, integration and service improvement suggestions internally.**

*4. Product and market understanding*

* Develop working knowledge of OxyX's SME cockpit, business controls, AI-assisted insights, collections and payment-related workflows, rewards, expense-related capabilities and e-invoicing integrations where available. **Understand the distinction between OxyX technology/workflows and services delivered by banks, payment service providers, acquirers and accredited e-invoicing service providers.** Keep up to date with SME operating challenges, accounting practice needs, market developments and competitor propositions. **Translate customer feedback and market observations into clear inputs for product, marketing, operations and management.**

*Performance expectations*

Performance will be assessed on the quality and consistency of partner development, SME acquisition, successful onboarding, active usage, customer retention and value created for SMEs and accounting partners.

* Qualified accounting firms engaged and converted into active referral partners. **Qualified SME opportunities generated through partner referrals and direct acquisition.** SMEs successfully onboarded and activated, with agreed first-use milestones achieved. **Ongoing product adoption, account engagement, retention and expansion.** Quality of customer relationships, partner feedback and resolution of escalations. **Accurate CRM records, pipeline forecasts, meeting notes and sales reporting.**

*Skills, experience and attributes*

* Experience in B2B sales, key account management, merchant services, payments, fintech, banking, SaaS or SME business solutions. **Ability to sell through relationship-based channels, referral partners, professional firms or business ecosystems.** Confidence engaging business owners, accounting practice partners, finance leaders and operational decision-makers. **Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, follow-up and account-management skills.** Ability to understand business workflows and explain technology in clear, practical, non-technical language. **Comfortable conducting field visits, meetings, product demonstrations and structured follow-ups.** Organised, self-driven and capable of managing a pipeline and multiple partner/customer relationships. **Good written and spoken English; additional languages commonly used in the UAE SME market are an advantage.** Working knowledge of UAE SME business practices and the payments/accounting ecosystem is preferred.

*Working relationships*

The role will work closely with the Sales / Business Head, accounting practice partners, SME owners and finance teams, product and implementation teams, customer support, and relevant external payment or technology partners.

*Professional conduct and role boundaries*

* Represent OxyX accurately and use only current, approved product descriptions, pricing, proposals and marketing materials. **Do not promise product features, integrations, settlement timelines, rewards, savings or business outcomes that have not been confirmed.** Do not present OxyX as a bank, payment service provider, acquirer or accredited e-invoicing service provider. Regulated payment and e-invoicing services are provided by relevant authorised partners. **Follow company policies for customer consent, data confidentiality, information security, onboarding and record keeping.** Do not collect, store or share customer credentials, banking passwords, OTPs or sensitive payment credentials. **Escalate complaints, suspected fraud, data incidents, compliance concerns and requests outside approved authority promptly.**

*What success looks like*

A successful Key Account Manager builds a dependable network of accounting practice referral partners while independently developing SME relationships. SMEs understand the practical value of OxyX, complete onboarding, use the capabilities relevant to their business and continue to engage. Accounting firms see OxyX as a way to strengthen their client service and create additional value—not as a threat to their role. This role is a senior role qualifying for the ESOPS as well. You may choose to apply at: **reach@OxyTech.ae**

jobs.title: Technical Program Management/ Software Engineering/ Program Management
Lead AI Engagement Specialist
jobs.description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD | Redzone is building an enterprise AI platform to support AI-enabled and agentic workflows across the organisation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) is accountable for turning that ambition into deployed, measured, production workflows across priority business functions.
  
  
The CoE is small, senior and high-leverage. It combines architecture and engineering with a set of functional AI Engagement Specialists who own the demand side: what gets built, why it is worth building, whether anyone uses it, and whether it actually works once live.
  
  
**Job Description**
The
**Lead AI Engagement Specialist**
owns a portfolio of AI workflows within one or more business functions, end to end. You will identify where AI genuinely changes how the work is done, redesign that work, write the PRD, drive the build with the architect and engineers, land the adoption, and then manage the performance of the agents in production as a product you are accountable for.
  
  
This is a product and transformation role, not a business analysis role. The distinction matters and we mean it: you will own a roadmap, write specifications precise enough to build from, make scope calls, and be measured on realised value rather than on delivered documentation. If a workflow does not clear its quality bar or nobody uses it, that is your problem to solve, not to report.
  
  
**Where this role sits**
**Reports to:**
Head of the AI Centre of Excellence
  
  
**Alignment:**
Dotted line to the leadership of the business function you cover
  
  
**Works with:**
AI Engagement specialists, Lead AI Architect and Senior AI Engineer daily; external implementation partners; Security, GRC, Legal and Data teams as required
  
  
**Owns:**
The prioritised workflow pipeline, PRDs, roadmap, adoption and live agent performance for one function. Lead & manage other AI Engagement specialists.
  
  
**Accountable for:**
Realised, measured business value — not deployment count
  
  
**What You Will Own**
**Opportunity identification and prioritisation**

* Own the AI workflow pipeline for your function — a ranked, evidence-based view of where AI creates value, refreshed as the business and the technology move.
* Distinguish rigorously between work that AI genuinely changes and work that merely looks automatable in a demo — and be willing to argue that a well-sponsored idea is not worth building.
* Prioritise on value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and time to impact, in partnership with the architect.

**Process discovery and workflow redesign**

* Map the current state properly: volumes, cycle times, cost to serve, exception paths, decision points, systems and data touched, and where the work actually breaks — grounded in observation and data, not in what the process document claims.
* Redesign the work, not just the tool. Decide what the agent does, what the human does, where the handoff sits, what the escalation path is, and what changes in roles, policies, SOPs and controls as a consequence.
* Design the human-in-the-loop model with the architect: where review is mandatory, where an agent may act autonomously, and how a wrong action is caught and reversed.

**Business case and value ownership**

* Build the business case: baseline metrics, benefit hypothesis, quantified target, build and run cost, payback and sensitivity — and the honest version of it, including the case against building.
* Establish the baseline before launch. A benefit that cannot be measured against a pre-existing baseline will not be believed, and should not be.
* Own benefits realisation after go-live — report the real number, including when it is below target, and recommend iterate, rebuild or retire accordingly.

**Product specification and roadmap**

* Write the PRD: problem, users, scope and non-scope, target workflow, acceptance criteria, quality bar, data and system dependencies, non-functional expectations, risks, and success metrics — detailed enough that the architect and engineers can design and build from it without a translation layer.
* Own the roadmap for your function: sequencing, dependencies, release planning, and a defensible view of what comes next and why.
* Partner with delivery daily — make scope calls, resolve ambiguity, unblock, test, and accept. Be available to engineers at the pace they work.

**Agent performance management**

* Define the quality bar in measurable terms with engineering — what a correct output is, what an acceptable error rate is, and what failure mode is unacceptable at any rate.
* Build and curate the evaluation datasets for your workflows, drawing on real cases from your function.
* Review live agent output on an ongoing basis and run the feedback loop back into engineering.
* Monitor production performance — accuracy and quality, containment or deflection, escalation rate, latency, cost per transaction, and user satisfaction — and drive the iteration cycle.
* Treat a live agent as a product under active management, not a project that was completed.

**Adoption and change**

* Own adoption as an outcome you are measured on: enablement, training, communications, champions, policy and SOP updates, and management routines.
* Instrument usage and act on what it shows — including the uncomfortable finding that a well-built workflow is being avoided.
* Engage with resistance seriously. Where people are working around the agent, understand why before attempting to change the behaviour.
* Work with function leadership on role definition, capacity and performance expectations as work is redesigned.

**Governance and CoE contribution**

* Ensure workflows meet responsible AI, data handling, privacy and approval requirements, working with Security, GRC and Legal.
* Feed reusable patterns back into the CoE so that a solved problem in one function does not get re-solved from scratch in another.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years in product management, business or digital transformation, operations strategy, or top-tier consulting — with a track record of change that shipped and stuck, not recommendations that were accepted.
* Demonstrable ownership of product specifications or PRDs that engineering teams built from. We will ask to discuss one in detail.
* Strong process redesign capability. Lean, Six Sigma, service design or similar training is welcome; evidence of redesigned work in production matters more than certification.
* Business case and value modelling — comfort with baselines, unit economics, cost to serve and payback, and the intellectual honesty to model the downside.
* Data literacy: able to interrogate data, work with BI tooling, and define and track metrics that hold up to scrutiny.
* Working fluency in what current AI systems can and cannot do — retrieval, agents, hallucination and grounding, evaluation, human-in-the-loop, and cost. Enough to scope realistically with engineers and to push back on hype and on pessimism with equal confidence. Coding is not required.
* Change management and adoption experience with real end users, including users who did not ask for the change.
* Strong influence at senior levels without formal authority, and the standing to tell a function leader that their favourite idea is not the right first build.
* Excellent written communication — clear specifications, clear reasoning, clear status.
* Deep functional expertise in the business function this opening covers — the specific requirements are set out under “Functional depth” below.

**Functional depth**
This role requires credibility with practitioners and leaders inside the function from the first week. We are looking for someone who understands how the work is genuinely done — its operating rhythm, its systems, its economics and its performance measures — well enough to challenge how it is done today rather than to describe it.
  
  
**Strongly Preferred**

* Enterprise B2B SaaS experience.
* Manufacturing, supply chain or ERP domain kn

jobs.description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
**QAD**
is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.
  
  
Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.
  
  
**ERA — QAD's Enterprise Resource Allocation platform —**
is the domain intelligence layer that sits between any ERP and any AI agent. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable.
  
  
**Job Description**
This role owns a key pillar of ERA — the Manufacturing Data Fabric & Intelligence layer. This is the foundational intelligence core: the semantic layer that encodes what manufacturing data means, the metric registry that governs how business outcomes are measured, and the AI Insights and conversational analytics capabilities that surface intelligence to users and agents alike. Without this layer, the rest of ERA cannot function. It is the prerequisite for every downstream agent action, every governed decision, and every autonomous workflow ERA enables.
  
  
As Director of Product for Data, AI, Reporting & Analytics, you will report directly to the Head of Platform Product and lead a team of Product Managers and Technical Product Owners. Your scope is the intelligence core — not the integration layer, not the governance engine, not the developer API. You will partner closely with the Directors leading those pillars, but your mandate is singular: make manufacturing data meaningful, queryable, and AI-ready at enterprise scale.
  
  
This is a high-visibility, high-leverage role. The semantic layer is ERA's primary moat — the hardest layer to build and the one no horizontal AI platform will invest in replicating. Your roadmap decisions will compound over years and directly determine QAD's competitive positioning in the era of autonomous manufacturing.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Foundation Exists — The Mandate Now Is To Build ERA's Intelligence Core Into The Definitive Manufacturing Ontology Platform. You Will Have The Scope To
  
  

* Define and own the manufacturing semantic layer — encoding supplier criticality, lead time patterns, quality thresholds, and operational constraints in a form AI agents can reason from
* Build the contextual intelligence layer that passes metric definitions, data distributions, and business rules to LLMs for accurate, anomaly-aware narrative generation
* Drive QAD's conversational analytics strategy — enabling non-technical manufacturing users to query operations in natural language without SQL or BI expertise

* Evolve the platform from reactive reporting to proactive, agentic intelligence — where the system surfaces recommended actions, not just data

* Own the multi-year product roadmap for ERA's Manufacturing Data Fabric & Intelligence layer — from raw data pipeline to user-facing AI insights
* Define the manufacturing semantic layer: encoding metric definitions, operational constraints, supplier relationships, and business rules into a governed ontology that AI agents can reason from
* Translate QAD's ERA vision into concrete, sequenced product bets for the intelligence core — partnering with Directors leading the Integration, Governance, and API pillars to ensure the full platform coheres
* Lead the evolution of AI Insights capabilities: contextual anomaly detection, plain-language narrative generation, and agentic root cause analysis

**AI & Conversational Analytics**

* Drive the conversational analytics product — ontology design, knowledge graph, context graph, and intent detection for natural language querying
* Establish and own the AI evaluation framework: latency, accuracy, relevancy gates, LLM-as-judge, and human-in-the-loop oversight
* Architect the contextual layer that passes metadata, data distributions, and business rules to LLMs for accurate, enterprise-grade output
* Define QAD's approach to agentic AI — moving from reactive Q&A to proactive, action-triggering intelligence within ERP workflows

**Enterprise Self-Service Reporting**

* Own the product strategy for self-service report building — enabling business users across manufacturing, finance, supply chain, and operations to create, customise, and share reports without engineering dependency
* Define the RBAC model for reporting: row-level and column-level access controls, report sharing permissions, data scoping by plant, region, and business unit — ensuring enterprise customers can safely deploy self-service capabilities across large, complex org structures
* Lead the go-to-market and rollout strategy for self-service reporting across B2B industry verticals — working with Customer Success and Solutions Engineering to drive adoption, define onboarding playbooks, and reduce time-to-value for enterprise deployments
* Set the product bar for enterprise-grade report authoring: scheduling, export, embedding, white-labelling, and audit trails that meet the compliance and operational needs of regulated industries
* Establish feedback loops with enterprise customers to continuously refine the self-service experience — tracking adoption metrics, identifying capability gaps, and prioritising the roadmap against real user workflows

**Data Infrastructure & Intelligence**

* Partner with Engineering to define the data lake, pipeline, and event architecture that underpins ERA's intelligence layer — optimising for AI-readiness, scale, and cost efficiency
* Own the metric registry and semantic data model — ensuring consistent, governed definitions of manufacturing KPIs across all ERA consumers
* Collaborate with the Governance & Compliance pillar to ensure intelligence outputs meet enterprise compliance requirements; own the data quality and freshness standards within your layer
* Define monetization strategy for intelligence platform capabilities including governed data exports, delta sharing, and partner integrations

**GTM, Sales & Market Enablement**

* Act as the product authority for Sales and Marketing on ERA's Data, AI, and Analytics capabilities — providing positioning, messaging, and competitive differentiation across the full intelligence layer, not just reporting
* Partner with GTM teams to develop selling motions for AI Insights, conversational analytics, and self-service reporting — translating platform capabilities into clear business value narratives for manufacturing buyers

* Work with Solutions Engineering and Pre-Sales on complex enterprise deals — providing product depth in discovery, RFP responses, and proof-of-concept engagements where the intelligence layer is a key differentiator

jobs.title: Technology Director - Digital Platform Engineering (Production Support)
jobs.description:
**About This Role**
At Wells Fargo, a Technology Director directs engineering organizations that deliver secure, resilient, and scalable technology solutions aligned with enterprise priorities. You will translate strategy into actionable roadmaps, oversee engineering practices and risk management, and align people and financial resources with delivery commitments.
  
  
The Technology Director within the Digital Technology & Innovation (DT&I) Platform Engineering organization is responsible for defining and executing the strategic vision for mission-critical enterprise platforms that support external and internal customers. This role provides executive leadership across RunOps, DevOps, Shared Services, Cloud Efficiency Engineering functions through Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, AIOps practices ensuring platform stability, reliability, security, scalability, and operational excellence across production and non-production environments for the Digital Platform capabilities including online banking, mobile banking, authentication, authorization, payments, messaging, digital account opening, content and customer engagement platforms, fraud and operational support capabilities, and enterprise machine learning and artificial intelligence platforms.
  
  
The role leads to multidisciplinary engineering teams through engineering managers, senior managers, and technical leads to delivering technology outcomes aligned with enterprise priorities. The role directs organizational priorities rather than personally performing routine engineering or operational tasks and is responsible for ensuring that subordinate leaders and their teams execute daily delivery, support, monitoring, deployment, remediation, and operational activities effectively to improve operational resilience, service availability, performance, efficiency and customer experience.
  
  
The Technology Director serves as a senior command center leader during major incidents, releases, and business-critical events, translating complex technical challenges into business impact assessments and actionable recommendations for executive stakeholders, ensuring informed decision-making, operational continuity, and successful delivery of enterprise objectives.
  
  
The Technology Director partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to define platform roadmaps, establish execution plans, and drive adoption of strategic technology capabilities across the enterprise and accountable for the strategy and execution of data center, infrastructure, cloud, and application modernization programs, ensuring enterprise platforms evolve to meet current and future business demands.
  
  
The position owns financial planning, capacity management, vendor governance, and resource allocation for complex technology portfolios. It establishes risk management frameworks, governance controls, and operational decision-making processes for mission-critical environments, including go/no-go decisions, blameless postmortem, risk acceptance, release management for different deployments methods, incident response, and rollback execution.
  
  
The Technology Director fosters a high-performing engineering culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, talent development, succession planning, and employee engagement. Leveraging deep expertise in large-scale platform engineering, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and enterprise operations, the role integrates cross-functional initiatives and influences senior leadership to achieve measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Manage managers and senior professionals responsible for delivering technology services, solutions, and capabilities aligned with strategic priorities
* Develop and implement technology strategies, roadmaps, and plans in partnership with business and technology leaders
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve technology capabilities, processes, service delivery, and operational effectiveness
* Provide oversight of technology solutions and services to support security, stability, availability, resilience, scalability, and business needs
* Develop and implement risk management strategies and partner with stakeholders to address technology and enterprise risk
* Direct complex technology initiatives and promote innovation and modernization to achieve business and technology objectives
* Collaborate with and influence professionals and experienced managers and interact with third-party providers, regulatory bodies, or industry groups, as applicable
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources and develop a culture of talent development aligned with business objectives

**Platform Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and execute the enterprise platform management and engineering strategy, aligned with business and technology objectives.
* Establish multi-year platform roadmaps covering modernization, resilience, scalability, automation, cloud adoption, and technology lifecycle management.
* Translate business and product strategies into platform capabilities and investment priorities.
* Establish clear measures for platform availability, reliability, performance, adoption, engineering productivity, and cost efficiency.

**Platform Engineering & Modernization**

* Provide leadership for enterprise platform engineering capabilities supporting application and product teams.
* Drive modernization of legacy platforms and adoption of cloud-native, API-driven, automated, and self-service engineering capabilities.
* Promote reusable platform services and engineering patterns to reduce complexity and accelerate application delivery.
* Champion automation across provisioning, deployment, configuration, testing, monitoring, recovery, and operational processes.

**Reliability, SRE & Production Engineering**

* Establish and mature Site Reliability Engineering practices, including service-level objectives, availability, capacity, observability, performance, and resilience.
* Drive proactive identification and remediation of platform reliability risks.
* Provide executive leadership for critical production incidents and ensure effective incident, problem, and root-cause management.
* Ensure corrective and preventive actions address systemic issues and reduce recurring incidents.

**DevOps & Engineering Enablement**

* Advance DevOps and CI/CD capabilities to improve software delivery speed, quality, security, and reliability.
* Simplify developer experiences by providing standardized tools, reusable capabilities, automation, and self-service platforms.
* Reduce manual operational activities and engineering toil through automation and intelligent operations.
* Partner with application development organizations to identify and eliminate platform-related delivery bottlenecks.

**Drive Innovation to improve Efficiency**

* Enable AI strategy-forward adoption by using approved AI capabilities to materially improve stability, speed, reliability of analysis, design, development, and operational execution to create an AI-native organization.
* Drives innovation through continuous improvement and explore advanced technologies such as machine learning and AI to automate solutions, reduce the toil through Toil Reduction/Automation initiatives to improve efficiency.
* AI adoption showcases to demonstrate successful use cases, share best practices, and promote enterprise-wide adoption.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning by encouraging teams to learn from industry best practices and peer successes, driving innovation and operational excellence.

**Cloud & Technology Efficiency**

* Drive effective utilization of cloud, compute, storage, network, middleware, and platform resources.
* Establish governance around capacity, utilization, consumption, licensing, and technology costs.
* Identify opportunities to optimize infrastructure and cloud spend without compromising resilience or customer experience.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are building an agentic banking platform for large enterprise banks. Multi-modal AI converts business intent into autonomous agents that orchestrate processes, integrate data, and make intelligent decisions — turning weeks of manual work into hours.
  
  
You will lead AI agents and intelligent automation — building capabilities that deploy autonomous agents to solve complex banking problems at enterprise scale. This is not a pillar-specific role. You'll work across three interconnected pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents), collaborating with peer PMs to architect and ship agentic solutions end-to-end.
  
  
You'll report directly to the Product Director and own the complete journey: from defining what agentic capabilities matter most, to shipping them, to measuring their impact. This role is for a PM who understands how AI agents fundamentally change enterprise automation, who can navigate technical and business complexity, and who ships with both ambition and rigor.
  
  
Strategic ownership
  
  

* Define the AI capability roadmap — which features move the needle, which delight customers, which drive competitive advantage
* Make the hard calls: what ships in Year 1, what comes after, what's out of scope
* Own the quality bar — "enterprise grade" means reliable, explainable, compliant, and safe. Set and enforce that standard.
* Shape how AI surfaces across the platform — consistency in UX, tone, and behavior across copilot, solution builder, and other capabilities

Execution leadership
  
  

* Lead cross-pillar alignment — work with peer PMs to define integration points and success metrics
* Conduct customer discovery: what AI capabilities matter most, what fears do they have about AI, what use cases are most valuable
* Make data-driven decisions: usage patterns, LLM cost, inference latency, customer sentiment all inform roadmap
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical feasibility isn't clear (cost, latency, quality), you synthesize information and move forward decisively

Partnership with platform PMs
  
  

* Collaborate with peer PMs who own the platform pillars
* Establish clear integration contracts: where AI surfaces in their UIs, how data flows from their features to your LLM calls, how they measure success

**Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following**
AI-native products or features that users love
  
  

* Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on)
* Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization
* Cross-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas
* Experiences that balance power with usability.

Core capabilities
  
  

* AI fluency, not just enthusiasm – You understand LLM capabilities and limits. You know the difference between a prototype and a production system. You think about cost, latency, hallucination, and compliance from day one.
* Systems thinking across pillars – You see how an AI feature in one pillar impacts the others. You optimize for platform coherence, not local feature wins.
* Customer reality grounding – You spend time with users and understand their AI skepticism. You don't oversell; you deliver reliably.
* Quality obsession – You know that "enterprise grade" is non-negotiable. Explainability, compliance, reliability, and safety are as important as feature velocity.
* Technical depth without being an engineer – You read research, understand prompt engineering tradeoffs, can discuss model selection and fine-tuning. You think rigorously about technical problems.

Nice to have
  
  

* Shipped copilot or AI-assisted features in a production SaaS product
* Experience with LLM cost optimization, latency budgeting, or inference infrastructure
* Familiarity with enterprise workflow, process automation, or BPM domains
* Track record of shipping cross-functional initiatives with competing stakeholders

The role combines leadership in data engineering, data product development, advanced analytics, machine learning and GenAI to ensure trusted, high-quality, secure and scalable data products power analytics and AI use cases across the organization. * Drive robust ELT/ETL frameworks with embedded data quality, metadata, lineage, observability and governance controls in order to improve reliability and trust in data products.

**Operational Efficiency:**

**Learning and Development:**

* Develop team and individual capabilities through coaching, feedback and learning opportunities in order to strengthen technical depth and leadership capability.
* Promote knowledge sharing across teams in order to advance reusable practices in data engineering, data products and AI delivery.

* As a manager of people, this job must ensure all employees within the business unit comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines and controls.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Leads multiple teams of data engineers, AI scientists and technical leaders; direct and indirect span of control

jobs.description:
**Description**
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. Serving over 200M customers globally, our Customer Service (CS) organization is at the forefront of shaping how customers experience Amazon. Our team enables Amazon CS’ frontline teams to deliver seamless, consistent, convenient, and delightful customer service to all our customers (including our consumers, businesses, and drivers) across every interaction.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to serve as the Service Delivery organization’s single threaded leader for CS Security. This role is responsible for owning the relationships with CS Security teams and the charter to empower associates whilst safeguarding customer data. You closely partner with CS Security in identifying and mitigating information security risks across all Customer Service systems, data, people, assets, and capabilities. The role consults and executes CS Security's strategy from the evolution of customer and agent authentication, creation and enforcement of security policy, to development of multi-layer security from servers to devices.
  
  

* An ideal candidate will combine product management depth in customer service operations or security with a demonstrated ability to implement AI-driven automation and modern project management tooling across distributed teams.
* You will partner with CS Security and Tech teams to define and design the end-to-end experience of associate and frontline leaders when security guardrails are applied. You will evaluate and improve existing tooling and processes and support the creation of new tech and AI driven solutions, consistently enhancing associate experiences and empowering our teams. You will work backward from security risks and associate pain points to design solutions and processes and define product requirements. Partnering with CS Security, engineering, operations, and stakeholder teams you will deliver solutions at scale. You will balance short-term tactical improvements with long-term strategic bets to continuously raise the bar on the associate experience and empowerment.
* The ideal candidate combines strong product and program management capabilities, business acumen in operations and/or security and deep associate empathy. You are equally comfortable diving into data and anecdotes to identify opportunities, writing PRFAQs, vision docs and BRDs, and influencing without authority to align cross-functional teams on a shared vision. You thrive in ambiguity, are biased toward action, and have a track record of delivering products that meet their customers’ needs. Disrupting the status quo by challenging mental models, organizational focus, and technology will be part of your day to day.

This role can be located in Hyderabad.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the end-to-end CS Security partnership for Service Delivery
* Own the security-related strategy and associate empowerment charter for Service Delivery
* Lead strategic planning processes, working with leaders across the organization to set goals, define priorities, and allocate resources.
* Write product requirements (PRFAQs, vision docs, BRDs, user stories) working backward from customer needs for both new launches and existing experience improvements.
* Collaborate with CS Security and Tech to influence strategy, drive prioritization, create operational plans, roadmaps and vision docs
* Define and own success metrics and KPIs; use data to measure success and ongoing portfolio health, informing roadmap prioritization
* Define and own framework and mechanisms as Service Delivery's single CS Security POC
* Translate associate and frontline leadership insights, data signals, and business requirements into actionable security process and product improvements and scalable solutions.
* Partner with CS Security, Tech, data science, and operations teams to deliver CS Security solutions features from concept through launch and iteration.
* Influence and align senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders on direction and strategy through compelling narratives and data-driven recommendations
* Apply analytical rigor to frame trade-offs and enable leaders to make well-informed decisions.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 5+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience owning global programs

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership

If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Manager, Product Managment
jobs.description:
**About ModMed**

At ModMed®, we are transforming healthcare through technology. Our mission is to empower healthcare providers with innovative, specialty-specific software solutions that simplify clinical and administrative workflows, improve operational efficiency, and enable better patient care.

Our solutions combine deep healthcare expertise with modern technology to address the complex challenges faced by medical practices. We are a global team of innovators, engineers, product leaders, and healthcare professionals passionate about making a meaningful difference in healthcare.

Join us and help shape the future of healthcare technology!

**About Our Practice Management Product**

ModMed's Practice Management solutions help healthcare practices streamline their administrative, operational, and financial workflows. From scheduling and patient registration to billing, claims management, and revenue cycle operations, our technology helps practices operate more efficiently and manage the business of healthcare.

We continuously evolve our products by leveraging modern technologies, intelligent automation, and AI-driven capabilities to simplify complex workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve financial and operational outcomes for healthcare providers.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on, people-first
**Manager – Product Management**
to lead and develop a team of Product Owners responsible for our Practice Management product portfolio.

This role combines people leadership, product execution, customer engagement, and AI-driven product innovation. You will be responsible for building a high-performing Product Owner team, establishing strong product discovery and requirements practices, and ensuring initiatives deliver measurable value to customers and the business.

A key focus will be defining and validating requirements for AI-powered features and intelligent automation, translating complex healthcare and financial workflows into clear product specifications, and partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders to bring these capabilities to market.

You will own outcomes across the product lifecycle, from problem discovery and prioritisation through development, customer validation, release, and adoption.

**What You'll Do**

**Product & People Leadership**

* Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Product Owners.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, performance expectations, and development plans across the team.
* Coach Product Owners on product discovery, requirements definition, prioritisation, stakeholder management, and execution.
* Allocate initiatives based on business priorities, team capacity, and individual strengths.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

**Product Strategy & Initiative Ownership**

* Drive execution of the Practice Management product roadmap in alignment with business objectives and customer needs.
* Ensure every initiative has a clearly defined problem statement, expected business outcome, scope, success criteria, and ownership.
* Balance competing priorities and make informed decisions on resource allocation and initiative sequencing.
* Maintain visibility into product progress, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.
* Ensure initiatives move efficiently from discovery through development, release, and customer adoption.

**AI-Driven Product Requirements & Automation**

* Establish standards for defining, analysing, documenting, and validating requirements for AI-driven features and intelligent automation.
* Translate complex business logic, operational workflows, and automation triggers into clear functional specifications.
* Ensure requirements include detailed workflows, business rules, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and expected system behaviour.
* Partner with Engineering and AI teams to validate technical feasibility, model accuracy, scalability, and reliability.
* Drive appropriate validation of AI-generated outputs, including accuracy, consistency, and compliance considerations.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to simplify workflows, reduce manual intervention, and improve operational efficiency.

**Data-Driven Decision Making & Product Prioritisation**

* Leverage product analytics, operational data, and customer insights to identify workflow inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Use data to prioritise automation initiatives that reduce manual effort, improve productivity, and deliver measurable financial outcomes for customers.
* Define and track product success metrics, including feature adoption, workflow efficiency, time saved, automation rates, and financial impact.
* Use SQL for data validation, root-cause analysis, and investigation of product and operational issues.
* Establish a metrics-driven approach to product prioritisation and continuous improvement.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Architecture, AI, and business stakeholders to drive successful product outcomes.
* Work with technical teams to address complex workflows, business rules, edge cases, scalability, and system dependencies.
* Ensure alignment between product requirements, technical implementation, and intended business outcomes.
* Communicate product decisions, priorities, and trade-offs effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Bring together cross-functional teams to resolve challenges and maintain momentum across initiatives.

**Customer Engagement & Release Management**

* Lead customer discovery sessions, product demonstrations, and feedback discussions to understand real-world challenges.
* Oversee alpha and beta programs to validate new capabilities and incorporate customer feedback into product decisions.
* Ensure product functionality meets customer expectations and delivers the intended operational and financial value.
* Drive release readiness, ensuring product documentation, training materials, and communication plans are in place before general availability.
* Monitor feature adoption and customer feedback post-release to identify opportunities for further improvement.

**What You'll Bring**

**Experience & Domain Expertise**

* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or related product leadership roles.
* At least 2 years of experience leading and developing Product Owners or Product Managers.
* Strong experience working in SaaS or cloud-based product environments.
* Deep understanding of healthcare technology, Practice Management, medical billing, and revenue cycle management workflows.
* Proven experience owning product initiatives from discovery and requirements definition through development, release, and adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to build and develop product talent while managing multiple initiatives.

**Product & AI Capabilities**

* Strong ability to identify the problem worth solving, define the desired outcomes, and translate business needs into actionable product requirements.
* Expertise in developing high-quality functional specifications, workflow diagrams, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
* Practical understanding of AI-driven products, intelligent automation, and AI-assisted workflows.
* Ability to evaluate AI capabilities and limitations and establish appropriate validation approaches for accuracy, reliability, and compliance.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve product discovery, requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation.
* Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in SQL for data validation and problem investigation.
* Experience defining product KPIs and measuring adoption, operational efficiency, and business impact.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and empower Product Owners to take ownership of product outcomes.
* Strong prioritisation and decision-making skill

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Commercial Services
jobs.description:
**About Tide**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Team**

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Commercial Services. You will report to the CDTO and partner with Product and Design leadership as one leadership team accountable for the outcomes of the domain.

Commercial Services is where Tide extends from helping members run their business to helping them grow it. You will shape how quickly every member becomes discoverable, how much of their buying and selling runs through Tide, and how far AI can turn that into a lasting advantage across every market we serve.

Sell gives every member a live, discoverable presence, from the Tide Business Pages we are launching for 2 million members across the UK and Europe, to Own Website, catalogue, bookings, CRM and lead capture, and embedded fulfilment through Delivery as a Service.

Buy turns that member base into a two-sided marketplace through the Tide Online Network, alongside Tide Promotions (gift cards, cashback and personalised offers), business supplies from partners, and Vendor Hub for e-procurement.

You will be the single owner accountable for engineering delivery, architecture and people across both.

**About The Role**

This role sits at the intersection of SME commerce, marketplaces and banking. Our members sit on both sides of the marketplace, our partners extend what we can offer them, and our banking platform lets us layer payments, credit, insurance and rewards into the experience at the point of need, which few commerce players can do. We need someone who can bring both streams onto one consistent engineering bar, ship quickly and build the platforms that turn Commercial Services into a material recurring revenue line for Tide.

As Director of Engineering you will

* Set the engineering strategy and technical direction across the Sell and Buy value streams, from launch through to scale.
* Lead the Heads of Engineering for Sell and Buy, build the leadership bench underneath them, and own headcount planning, hiring and organisation design.
* Partner with Product and Design leadership on one shared plan, jointly owning delivery and outcomes, including members activated through real sales and purchases, engagement and recurring revenue.
* Scale the Tide Business Pages and Tide Online Network into a trusted, high-traffic marketplace, including search, listings, member-to-member leads, chat and buyer requests.
* Build the partner integration platform behind our website, gift card, business supply and logistics partners, enabling new partners and offers to be onboarded quickly and safely.
* Work with Payments, Acquiring, Credit, Insurance and Wealth to embed payments, credit, insurance and rewards into commerce journeys at the point of need.
* Build trust into the marketplace in partnership with Ongoing Monitoring and Risk, from verified seller status to initial and ongoing monitoring of listings and member-to-member communication.
* Set a consistent engineering practice and quality bar across architecture, delivery health measured through DORA metrics, reliability and security.
* Lead our move towards AI-assisted and agentic commerce, where a member describes what they need and Tide finds, compares and sources it.
* Apply our OnePlatform principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Director engineering leadership of a multi-team organisation of around 50 engineers across backend, frontend, data and analytics, led through at least one layer of engineering leaders.
* Domain experience in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, CRM or procurement platforms, including the trust and safety controls they need, with fintech or SME banking experience a plus.
* Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable product and commercial outcomes.
* Experience building partner and third-party integration platforms at scale.
* Strong product and design partnership instincts.
* Comfortable setting direction through ambiguity and launching new products into multiple markets.
* Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, architecture and technical quality.
* Experience bringing AI or agentic experiences into customer-facing commerce products would be a bonus.

**Our Tech Stack**

* Backend: Java, Spring/Spring Boot, microservices architecture
* Mobile/Web: Flutter / Angular
* Infrastructure: AWS (SNS+SQS), PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora, GCP (BigQuery, Vertex)
* Observability: Coralogix (OpenTelemetry
* Claude for agentic ways of working

**What You’ll Get In Return**

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

* Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a
**flexible workplace**
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transpare

jobs.title: Engineering Leader – Digital Experience & Portals
jobs.description:
**About Chubb**

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com.

**About Chubb India**

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow.

With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape.

We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.

**Position Details**

**Job Title:**
Engineering Manager – Digital Experience & Portals

**Function / Department:**
Technology

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Bangalore

**Reports To:**
Head of Digital Engineering – NA CI

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an Engineering Manager who owns the Experience Pillar — the layer of technology that customers, agents, and partners see and touch. You will unify Chubb's portal applications across distribution, policy servicing, and digital channels, bringing consistency, speed, and AI-enhanced experiences to every interaction point. This is not a role for someone who manages backlogs from a distance. You lead from the front: you understand the frontend stack, you have opinions on API design, and you have shipped portal products that real users depend on at scale. Candidates from eCommerce, Retail, Banking, and Insurtech environments are strongly encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and grow a team of engineers building digital portal applications and API-backed experience platforms serving customers, agents, and distribution partners.
* Define and own the engineering roadmap for the Experience Pillar, consolidating portal applications into a unified, scalable, and consistent architecture.
* Drive AI-native development practices across the team — AI-assisted coding, intelligent test generation, automated code review, and agentic developer workflows as standard practice.
* Architect and deliver API-first, mobile-ready portal experiences across web and partner-integrated channels.
* Establish and maintain engineering standards for frontend, BFF (Backend for Frontend), and API gateway layers.
* Partner with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Solution Architects to translate experience requirements into delivered, high-quality features.
* Own sprint quality, release velocity, and technical debt trade-offs across the pillar.
* Embed DevSecOps practices — CI/CD pipelines, security scanning, performance observability — as default engineering behaviour.
* Hire, develop, and retain engineering talent; build a high-trust, high-accountability team culture with psychological safety.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT US:**

Who we are

ProductSquads was founded with a bold mission: to engineer capital efficiency through autonomous AI agents, exceptional engineering, and real-time decision intelligence.

We're building an AI-native platform that redefines how software teams deliver value - whether through code written by humans, agents, or both. Our stack combines agentic AI systems, ML pipelines, and high-performance engineering workflows.

This is your chance to build not just models, but systems that think, decide, and act-AI fabric tools, domain-intelligent agents, and real-time decision systems that power the next generation of product delivery.

**THE ROLE:**

What you'll do

We are looking for a visionary and hands-on Head of UX Design to strengthen the user experience of our digital products and establish a high standard for future product development.

This is a player-coach leadership role for someone who combines strategic thinking, creative problem-solving, and hands-on design execution. The ideal candidate will have a strong product mindset, the ability to independently identify opportunities, challenge conventional approaches, and translate innovative ideas into intuitive, scalable, and user-centric product experiences.

The role requires an experienced UX leader who can define and communicate a compelling design vision while remaining actively involved in user journeys, workflow optimisation, wireframing, interactive prototyping, and front-end implementation where appropriate.

The objective is not to redesign the platform from scratch, but to optimise existing workflows, simplify complex user interactions, and establish consistent UX standards for new product development.

We are looking for a proactive, articulate, and innovative design professional who can work independently with minimal supervision, influence stakeholders, and bring fresh, out-of-the-box ideas to product development.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Your scope

1. Strategic Ownership

→ UX vision and roadmap: Define and maintain a multi-year UX roadmap aligned

with product strategy. Ensure the product suite works as one connected experience

through shared patterns, consistent navigation, and workflows that hold up across

products.

→ Turn requirements into UX: Shape requirements from each roadmap initiative into flows, interactions, and designs that work for real users. Push back constructively where a requirement would create a poor experience.

→ Multi-persona design: Design for multiple user personas together, and make the tradeoffs between their needs explicit to Product Managers.

→ Usability validation: Own usability testing and design validation, and partner with PMs on discovery research so user insight shapes requirements early.

2. Hands-on UX Design and Product Development

→ Contribute directly to user flows, information architecture, wireframes, interaction design, high-fidelity screens, and interactive prototypes.

→ Simplify complex workflows and improve navigation, usability, and task completion across existing products.

→ Develop rapid prototypes to validate ideas, communicate design intent, and support faster product decisions.

→ Collaborate with Engineering to ensure designs are technically feasible and implemented accurately.

→ Contribute front-end code where appropriate, based on project requirements and technical capabilities.

→ Maintain a user-first design approach throughout the product development lifecycle, from ideation to implementation and refinement.

3. Innovation and Independent Problem-Solving

→ Bring fresh ideas, emerging design practices, and innovative approaches to product challenges.

→ Challenge assumptions constructively and explore alternative solutions rather than relying solely on existing patterns.

→ Take ownership of ambiguous problems, develop recommendations independently, and drive solutions through to completion.

→ Identify opportunities to reduce user effort, eliminate unnecessary steps, and simplify complex product experiences.

→ Encourage experimentation, rapid prototyping, and evidence-based decision- making.

→ Stay informed about emerging UX trends, AI-enabled design capabilities, and evolving product design practices.

4. Design System Alignment and Experience Consistency

→ Work within the existing design system and established brand guidelines maintained by Engineering.

→ Improve usability and functionality while preserving the product’s visual identity and design consistency.

→ Recommend enhancements to reusable components, interaction patterns, and design guidelines in collaboration with Engineering.

→ Establish scalable UX standards for new features and future product development.

→ Ensure that innovation strengthens the existing product ecosystem without creating unnecessary design fragmentation.

5. Communication and Stakeholder Management

→ Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills, articulating design concepts and decisions clearly.

→ Present UX strategies, prototypes, recommendations, and trade-offs confidently to senior leadership, Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders.

→ Explain complex design problems in simple, structured, and business-oriented language.

→ Influence stakeholders through clear reasoning, user insights, prototypes, and practical recommendations.

→ Ask the right questions, challenge requirements constructively, and establish alignment before execution.

→ Proactively communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations without requiring repeated follow-ups.

→ Facilitate productive design discussions and manage differing viewpoints with confidence and professionalism.

6. User Research and Continuous Product Improvement

→ Use customer feedback, stakeholder insights, usability testing, and product data to identify improvement opportunities.

→ Validate design concepts through prototypes and user feedback wherever appropriate.

→ Collaborate with Product teams to understand user pain points and prioritise meaningful improvements.

→ Define relevant measures of success, including usability, task completion, user adoption, and workflow efficiency.

→ Continuously refine product experiences based on evidence, feedback, and business outcomes.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

What you'll bring

→ Significant experience in UX Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, or a related discipline within a product development organisation.

→ Demonstrated experience defining UX strategy and translating it into tangible product improvements.

→ A strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design, workflow optimisation, innovative solutions, and interactive prototypes.

→ Experience designing complex digital products, enterprise platforms, or B2B SaaS applications.

→ Strong understanding of user-centred design, information architecture, interaction design, usability, accessibility, and responsive design.

→ Experience working with established design systems and collaborating closely with Product Management and Engineering.

→ Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

→ Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and the ability to solve ambiguous problems independently.

→ Proven ability to manage priorities, make decisions, and deliver outcomes with minimal supervision.

**Nice to have**

**→**
Proficiency in Figma, FigJam, prototyping tools, and collaborative design platforms.

→ Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or modern front-end frameworks.

→ Experience with usability testing, product analytics, and research-driven design decisions.

→ Familiarity with AI-assisted design tools and emerging product design practices.

→ Experience establishing UX standards and scalable design practices in a growing product organisation.

**COMPETENCIES:**

→ Product Mindset: Connects user experience, product functionality, customer value, and business outcomes.

→ Innovation and Creativity: Generates original ideas and

jobs.company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
jobs.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are seeking an enthusiastic, analytical, and resourceful product manager to join our Investment Services Technology team, partnering closely with the Compliance team, based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. This position offers the opportunity for broad exposure to the firm’s trading, operations, and software development groups, as well as the chance to manage real-time issues related to the firm’s expanding suite of global investment products in a dynamic, constantly evolving regulatory environment. The role offers an inclusive and dynamic environment, with a focus on improving technology for efficiency, control, and scalability. The ideal candidate will bring exceptional product management fundamentals, experience in process optimization and workflow automation, and the judgment to operate effectively in a highly regulated and confidential environment with diverse stakeholders.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will drive technological solutions that support critical compliance functions across the firm, collaborating with cross-functional teams — engineering, design, business, and other front- and back-office partners — to develop and launch new products and features. You will develop and maintain a strategic product roadmap that aligns with the firm's overall goals and evolves continuously based on user feedback, prioritization, and other factors while working with senior leadership in Compliance. You will also partner closely with the business to understand their needs, define product requirements, scope open-ended projects, and conceptualize effective solutions across a broad range of functional areas, including pre-trade compliance and trade-restriction management, position-limit monitoring, trade surveillance, and regulatory and transaction reporting. Additionally, you will conduct technical design and architecture reviews to ensure alignment with the roadmap and end-user needs and partner with engineering to address technical challenges and deliver on time and to specification. You will evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, replace legacy and vendor systems with scalable in-house platforms, and develop AI- and data-enabled tools for monitoring, detection, and reporting — balancing near-term regulatory and operational needs against long-term strategic and architectural objectives, often building scalable infrastructure in areas with limited existing technology while serving as a senior point of coordination for compliance technology transformation. Furthermore, you will monitor product usage and feedback to identify areas for improvement and address technical debt in a timely manner, maintain product documentation (requirements documents, user guides, and more), conduct training and enablement as a subject-matter expert for the product suite, and manage product launches and backlogs — prioritizing features and enhancements based on end-user feedback and business needs.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, a related field, or an MBA, with 8+ years of product management experience, preferably within the financial services or investment management industry
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and operational concepts clearly, influence decision-making through both meetings and written artifacts, and engage effectively with diverse stakeholder groups
* Excellent analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities, with proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques to generate product insights, prioritize initiatives, measure outcomes, and guide product strategy
* Proven adaptability in managing changing priorities, with robust project and delivery management skills in dynamic environments
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and business teams, translating nontechnical needs into clear requirements while balancing competing stakeholder priorities, building consensus, and delivering customer-focused outcomes
* A high degree of attention to detail and structured problem-solving abilities, with a consistent focus on quality, risk awareness, and operational excellence
* Hands-on experience owning and delivering technology products end-to-end in Agile environments, from product vision and discovery through backlog management, iterative delivery, launch, scaling, and ongoing maturation
* Demonstrated expertise in workflow automation and process optimization, applying structured approaches and tools to improve efficiency, transparency, and control
* A solid understanding of operational workflows within hedge funds and investment management firms, including how controls, data integrity, and regulatory considerations shape technology and product design

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Exposure to the investment management or hedge fund domain, with familiarity with pre-trade compliance, trade restrictions, position limits, trade surveillance, or regulatory and transaction reporting
* Experience partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk, or other control functions to define requirements and deliver workflow-driven, compliant technology solutions

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PMComplyTechOct26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers
  
  
Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.
