jobs.title: AVP- Continuous Improvement
jobs.description:
Date live: 11/27/2026

Business Area: Group Economic Crime COO

Area of Expertise: Change

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000115256

  

Step into the role of AVP- Continuous Improvement at Barclays, where you'll provide first-class support by conducting in-depth due diligence, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and safeguarding our clients and organization with expertise and care.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:

* Proven experience leading **business transformation, change, and process re-engineering** within large, complex financial services organizations, with the ability to challenge the status quo and drive innovation.

* Strong expertise in **Business and Process Architecture, Process Engineering, process mapping and modelling**, with a track record of redesigning and optimizing end-to-end processes.

* Experience mobilizing and delivering **large- and small-scale, global transformation programmers**, including regulatory and time-bound change.

* Strong understanding of **banking products, operations, and processes**, including Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Treasury, Trade Finance, Risk, Compliance, Reconciliations and Settlements.

* Knowledge of **AML and Financial Crime processes and lifecycle**, with an understanding of associated risk and control requirements.

* Strong understanding of the relationship between **Business, Process, Data and IT Architecture**, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable solutions.

Desirable Skillsets:

* Demonstrated experience applying **Lean, Six Sigma, Agile and Continuous Improvement methodologies** to simplify processes, eliminate inefficiencies and improve operational performance.

* Experience identifying and delivering **automation and digital transformation opportunities**

* Proven ability to operate effectively across **Operations, Technology, Change, Risk and Control functions** in a complex matrix environment.

* Strong leadership and change-management capability, including **leading teams through change, driving adoption and embedding a culture of continuous improvement**.

* Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, influencing, and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with **senior executives, MDs and Directors across geographies**.

* Strong strategic and business acumen, with the ability to connect **process, technology, customer, risk and commercial outcomes**.

* Self-driven and delivery-focused, with the ability to manage **multiple priorities and deadlines**, work independently and maintain high standards.

* High levels of **adaptability, creativity, and problem-solving**, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving operational inefficiencies.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based out of Pune.

**Purpose of the role**

To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by ensuring the business is ready to receive the agreed change (address business problems and opportunities), ensuring that change initiatives are successfully assessed and implemented to enable them to be embedded in the organisation.

**Accountabilities**

* Identification and analysis of business impact and opportunities that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business readiness strategies that will help to ensure the successful implementation of change initiatives.
* Communication with stakeholders, including senior management, project teams, and external partners, to ensure that they are informed about change initiatives and that their needs and expectations are being met.
* Collaboration with Client Readiness, Operational Readiness & Tech Delivery to ensure business, sales, operations, client servicing and functional partners are prepared for a smooth transition of technology delivery into BAU (including Target Operating Model, Training, Communications, Service Agreements.) .
* Management of resistance to change, ensuring that stakeholders are engaged and that their concerns are addressed.
* Review of business readiness plans and status reports in conjunction with change delivery managers to ensure business readiness activities completed on time including newly identified risks, issues and dependencies.
* Collaboration with project teams to ensure that change initiatives are aligned with project objectives and that change management activities are integrated into project plans.
* Provision of guidance and support to business stakeholders, ensuring that they have the necessary skills and knowledge to implement change initiatives successfully.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Job description:

Job Description – Business Development Manager (Field Sales)

**Position:** Business Development Manager (BDM) – Field Sales  
**Experience:** 2–8 Years  
**Job Location:** Mumbai (Open to candidates across Mumbai and nearby locations)  
**Salary:** ₹40,000 – ₹50,000 per month (based on experience and interview)  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Only  
**Employment Type:** Full-time | Field-Based Role

About the Role

We are looking for dynamic and target-driven Business Development Managers to drive business growth by connecting with founders, business owners, entrepreneurs and decision-makers. The role involves field sales, client acquisition, relationship building and converting qualified prospects into customers.

**Note:** This is a field-based role, not an office-based job. Candidates are not required to visit the office every day. You will manage your daily field activities, client meetings and follow-ups independently.

Key Responsibilities

* Meet business owners, founders, directors and decision-makers through daily field visits.
* Generate leads through market visits, networking, references and follow-ups.
* Identify businesses that require funding-readiness support.
* Explain the services, programme fees, deliverables and terms transparently.
* Convert qualified prospects into paying clients.
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline.
* Maintain daily records of leads, client visits, follow-ups and conversions in the CRM.
* Submit daily sales and activity reports.
* Coordinate with the internal team after successful client onboarding.

Target Audience

You will primarily connect with:

* Manufacturers, distributors and wholesalers.
* Traders and exporters.
* Retail and restaurant businesses.
* Clinics, laboratories and healthcare businesses.
* Education businesses.
* D2C and e-commerce brands.
* Technology startups and entrepreneurs.
* Logistics, textile and other business sectors.

Candidate Requirements

* 2–8 years of experience in target-based sales.
* Experience in Banking, NBFC, Loans, Credit Cards, Insurance, Financial Products or B2B Field Sales preferred.
* Proven track record of achieving monthly sales targets.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and client-handling skills.
* Comfortable with daily field visits and meeting business owners.
* Self-driven, proactive and capable of independently managing sales activities.
* Honest and transparent approach towards client acquisition.
* Immediate joiners only.

Monthly Targets

* **During Probation (First 3 Months):** 5 verified paid clients per month.
* **After Confirmation:** 10 verified paid clients per month.

A client is counted only after the agreement is signed, payment is received and settled, and onboarding is completed.

Salary & Incentives

**Monthly Salary Package: ₹40,000 – ₹50,000**

Incentive structure:

* 0–4 verified paid clients: No incentive.
* 5–9 verified paid clients: ₹20,000 incentive.
* 10 or more verified paid clients: ₹40,000 incentive.

Salary consists of base wages and a target-linked component, as specified in the written offer.

**Travel Allowance:**

* During probation: ₹3/km for bike and ₹2/km for scooty, based on field kilometres recorded in the CRM.
* After probation: ₹3,000 per month.

Training & Joining Process

* 7-day online training programme before employment.
* Training starts: 1 December 2026.
* Certification is mandatory.
* Shortlisted candidates will complete joining formalities on 7 December 2026.
* Certified candidates who complete training and join will receive a training completion bonus equivalent to 7 days of their monthly salary package, along with

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience you have in field sales ?
* How many years of experience you have in NBFC?
* Can you work from Pune?
* Please mention your current CTC
* Please mention your expected CTC
* Please mention your notice period?

jobs.title: Associate Director - Product Development
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Custody Product Manager**
**The opportunity & role purpose**
Emirates NBD Capital Custody is building a larger, more connected custody franchise combining high-touch local service, regional and international market access, the wider Emirates NBD ecosystem and institutional-grade control. We are seeking a commercially minded Product Manager to turn this ambition into a prioritized, scalable and profitable product roadmap.
  
  
**Role purpose**
Own the end-to-end Custody product agenda across strategy, proposition, commercial performance, governance and delivery. The role will optimize existing services, expand the product set and support new business across priority client segments.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
Product strategy and proposition
  
  

* Define and maintain a three-year product roadmap based on client demand, commercial value, strategic fit, delivery complexity, risk and scalability.
* Monitor market, competitor, regulatory and technology developments across local and global custody, sub-custody, funds, collateral and digital assets.
* Lead new-product development from concept through business case, approval, operating model, pricing, launch and adoption.
* Evaluate build, buy, partner and network options, ensuring solutions are commercially viable and operationally deliverable.

Commercial and business development
  
  

* Partner with Business Development, Relationship Management and the wider Emirates NBD franchise to convert client needs into viable solutions.
* Support pitches, RFPs, due diligence, pricing and solution design for new and existing clients.
* Create segment-led propositions, identify appropriate target clients and build profitability models for new products.
* Own product performance across Assets under Custody, revenue, pricing, yield, linked cash, FX, ancillary income and fee leakage.

Delivery, technology and client experience
  
  

* Act as product owner for priority change, defining scope, requirements, milestones, acceptance criteria, risks and benefits.
* Work with Technology and Operations to increase automation and straight-through processing across onboarding, settlement, corporate actions, reporting, reconciliations, billing and service quality.
* Advance client connectivity through portal, SWIFT, API, SFTP and configurable reporting; maintain a transparent backlog and escalate blockers early.

Governance and market engagement
  
  

* Ensure propositions meet product approval, legal, regulatory, tax, financial-crime, data, cyber-security and operational-risk requirements.
* Maintain a robust product-control framework with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Operations and Internal Audit.
* Manage relationships with exchanges, CSDs, ICSDs, global custodians and vendors; represent Emirates NBD Capital in relevant client and industry discussions.

**First 12 months**

* Diagnose - Validate the current product perimeter, client needs, operating constraints, economics, control gaps and in-flight change.
* Prioritize - Agree a funded three-year roadmap and decide what to accelerate, partner for, defer or stop.
* Deliver - Progress the highest-value capabilities, focusing on market connectivity, institutional and sub-custody readiness, digital servicing, reporting and automation.
* Commercialize - Package propositions by segment, equip client-facing teams and embed product-level pricing and profitability disciplines.
* Measure - Establish a monthly scorecard covering assets, revenue, profitability, linked cash, activity, adoption, delivery, service health and realised benefits.

Measures of success:
  
  

* Roadmap delivery against agreed milestones, budget and benefits.
* Incremental Assets under Custody and revenue enabled by new or enhanced products.
* Improved product yield, linked cash, ancillary wallet capture and pipeline conversion.
* Greater adoption of portal, SWIFT, API, SFTP and automated reporting.
* Reduced manual touchpoints, exceptions, service issues and operational risk.
* Timely product approvals, control remediation and effective change governance.

**Essential**
**Experience and capabilities**

* Minimum five years' relevant experience in custody, securities services, post-trade, transaction banking, market infrastructure or a related institutional financial-services business.
* Proven product-management experience across strategy, business cases, governance, requirements, delivery, launch and performance.
* Working knowledge of safekeeping, settlement, corporate actions, cash, FX, tax, reporting, reconciliations and custody operating models.
* Strong commercial judgement, linking client needs and product choices to pricing, profitability, assets, revenue and wider relationship value.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and work across Operations, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Sales and Relationship Management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Highly desirable
  
  

* UAE or GCC custody experience and familiarity with SCA, UAE exchanges, CSDs and regional institutional clients.
* Knowledge of global-custody networks, ICSDs, sub-custody, fund settlement, collateral, securities financing or custody-linked lending.
* Exposure to TCS BaNCS, SWIFT, APIs, SFTP, client portals, institutional reporting, Agile delivery or digital-asset propositions.

The person we are looking for
  
  
You combine product depth with commercial energy. You can navigate operational details and bank governance while maintaining pace and ambition. You are credible with clients, precise with control functions, pragmatic with technology and comfortable presenting investment cases to senior management.
  
  
If you do not meet every requirement but believe you can materially contribute to our ambition, please apply with a covering letter explaining the value you would bring.
  
  
There’s never been a better time to join Emirates NBD.
  
  
We’re one of the region’s most recognizable brands. We’re banking innovation leaders. We’re growing across both the UAE and our global offices. We offer a huge range of professional development opportunities to accelerate your career. It also goes without saying that we provide extremely competitive rewards, benefits and perks too, like our flexible work policy so you can work from home whenever it suits.
  
  
At ENBD, we encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for positions that match their skills and capabilities.

Job description

About us

We're building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East: fast, scalable, and deeply customer-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. noon.com is our core marketplace and one of the region's leading e-commerce platforms. We're building at scale across categories from electronics to fashion, connecting millions of customers with sellers and brands every day. Fast-moving, data-driven and constantly evolving, it's where we test, learn and grow the business across the region.

**What you'll do**

Team noon has some of the fastest, smartest, and hardest-working people we've encountered. With a young, aggressive, and talented team, we're driving major missions forward. We are looking for a world-class Director of Product to lead a team of engineers, designers, analysts, researchers, and marketers to innovate and continuously reinvent our consumer product. This person will work with our Head of Product across multiple squads with a focus on improving category discoverability, increasing engagement on the platform, and driving critical projects.

**Scope & responsibilities**

* Lead a cross-functional agile team of engineers, product design, and application support to deliver a world-class customer experience.
* Customer Focus: Collect and analyze feedback from customers, stakeholders, and internal teams to define product requirements, features, and end products. Champion a data-driven approach to customer experience, leveraging qualitative and quantitative research. Understand customers deeply through interviewing, surveying, and user testing.
* Product Development & Strategy: Partner with growth, engineering, creative, and design teams to bring product visions to life. Lead a cross-functional agile team to deliver a world-class customer experience. Lead the ideation, technical development, and launch of innovative products aimed at improving the full customer lifecycle (acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, reengagement). Identify trends and challenges within the customer journey and develop relevant product solutions. Drive product development with world-class engineers and designers.

jobs.title: Applied Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning- Markets Operations - Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
As an Applied AI & ML Lead in the Market Operations team, you will drive the design and delivery of AI agents and ML solutions that enhance and transform Market Operations. You will lead a team of scientists and engineers, partner with business stakeholders and technology leaders, and ensure the successful implementation and scaling of AI-driven tools. You will identify opportunities, set technical direction, and deliver measurable impact by automating and augmenting complex operational workflows with reliable, auditable agents.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Agent Development and Delivery

+ Lead the end-to-end design, development, and delivery of LLM-based agents and advanced ML models for Market Operations.
+ Design and own the agent harness: orchestration loop, tool and API interfaces, context and memory management, multi-agent coordination, human-in-the-loop escalation, and guardrails.

* Evals and Prompt Improvement

+ Build and run the evaluation program for agents: task-level benchmarks built from real operational cases, regression gates in CI, and online monitoring tied to business outcomes.
+ Lead systematic prompt and program improvement using automated optimization techniques (e.g., GEPA, DSPy, AutoPrompt), driven by execution traces and failure analysis.

* Scalable AI/ML Architecture & Deployment

+ Partner with AI Engineering to design scalable agent and model serving on cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes, Bedrock/SageMaker), with orchestration, model gateway routing, versioned prompt/model registries, sandboxed tool execution, and rollouts gated by eval regressions.
+ Define and enforce SLOs for task success, latency, and cost per task, using distributed tracing, caching, and tiered model routing to meet them.

* Team Management & Mentorship following Agile Practices

+ Lead and mentor a team of AI/ML data scientists, guiding iterative experimentation and tracking progress to deliver measurable outcomes in an agile manner.

* Drive Model Methodology Documentation

+ Champion documentation of methodologies, results, and best practices for knowledge sharing

* Execution Excellence and Stakeholder Engagement

+ Align design and delivery across partner teams to maintain execution velocity, and drive clarity on prerequisites for AI/ML development.
+ Engage stakeholders in an agile manner to develop, demo, and iterate on deliverables. Work closely with Operations, Technology, and Transformation teams to solve complex problems with AI.

**Required Qualifications**

* MSc/PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
* Significant proven experience building and deploying AI applications, including LLM-based agents, in large-scale production environments.
* Hands-on experience building production agents, including the harness (function calling, context and memory, planning, orchestration, human-in-the-loop controls), rigorous evals for multi-step systems, and systematic prompt optimization (GEPA, DSPy, or AutoPrompt) with measured production gains.
* Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Strong understanding of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and evaluation techniques and experience working with large, complex datasets and applying statistical analysis
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience managing data science teams and couching team members
* Problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and as a leader within cross-functional teams
* Strong communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in financial services, particularly investment banking operations.
* Experience with agent safety and security: prompt injection defense, permissioning, sandboxing, audit logging, and adversarial testing of autonomous workflows
* Publications, patents, open-source contributions, or conference talks on agents, evals, or LLM optimization.

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. jobs.title: Solution Architect, VP
jobs.description:
Join us as a Solution Architect
  
  

* We’ll look to you to lead the solution architecture definition for your assigned change programme, in addition to delivering business outcomes for both customers and colleagues

jobs.description:

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
The Product Control GBS is accountable for delivery of the end-to-end product & valuation control functions in GBS and lead different strategic initiatives for Treasury Product Control (PC) and Valuation Control (VC) including Balance Sheet Substantiation controllership. The successful candidate will act as lead running the Treasury Product and Valuation Control, working closely with Technical Accounting, Treasury, Markets, IRRBB, Liquidity, Capital, and other key stakeholders to deliver best-in-class accounting solutions across the Group.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Processes**

* Manage a team covering treasury product categories and regions. (Asset classes: Securities and MM products, Funding, Funds Transfer Pricing, Capital, Hedge Accounting etc.)
* Monitor and implement business model assessments and hedge accounting processes based on IAS 39 and IFRS 9 for new and existing strategies
* Ensure appropriate controls and reviews are maintained for Daily P&L production, core reconciliations, month end close and balance sheet substantiation.
* Ensure the teams are performing timely lockdown of daily and monthly P&L.
* Should be able to substantiate daily and monthly adjustments held in P&L and control accounts.
* Review monthly balance sheet, with substantiation and potential financial exposure.
* Review various reconciliation reports, management packs and adhoc reports.
* Review of month end journals for accrual, provision and true up.
* Take responsibility for the quality of work submitted and ensure that the highest standards are maintained.
* Ensure adherence to SLA's, KPI's , Internal metrics & Finance wide policies.
* Identify/ manage risk and control breakdowns.
* Develop & maintain effective and standard processes. Maintain KOP's/DI's.
* Support change project initiatives and conduct User Acceptance Testing for enhancements to current systems or migration to new system.

**Risk Management**

* Support effective compliance by embedding an effective Operational Risk Framework (ORF) within the PC-VC process universe to ensure all areas manage operational risks in a proactive, risk based and disciplined manner.
* Support functioning of day-to-day controls, by performing periodic assessment and monitoring activities (CST & KCI) as well as timely identification, escalation, and resolution of risk issues
* Support and monitor compliance with Operational Risk policies, procedures, and applicable regulations within PCVC and advice wherever changes are required.
* To actively support exercising of direct Risk Control Ownership / Process ownership for Operational Risk to ensure risks of processing failure are being actively owned and resolved on an end-to-end basis

**Governance and Stakeholder management**

* Regular face off with Traders, Product Control Management, Regional finance team and various internal stakeholders within GFS.
* Act as a point of reference for team members and internal clients.
* Manage relationship with internal stakeholders, take regular feedback, anticipate and understand issues and escalate appropriately for timely resolution
* Manage strong relationship with support teams (IT, Operations and Risk) and bring synergies by interacting and integrating with cross functional teams.

**Qualifications**

* MBA, CA, CFA, ACCA with a minimum of 10+ years experience (post qualification) in a financial service industry with at least 2+ years of People Management experience.
* Strong leadership skills and ability to manage teams
* Control mindset and ability to identify and mitigate and control gaps
* Good understanding of financial market products
* Ability to develop, implement and maintain effective and standard operational processes.
* Excellent people and resource management skills.
* Excellent Interpersonal skills. Should be able to communicate at all levels.
* Strong planning, negotiation and analytical skills.
* Excellent business writing and verbal English communication skills
* Ready to travel & work in shifts.

**About Standard Chartered**

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, POM Product Owner to join our Payments Enablement Platform Data Services Group. This role is located in Pune.
  
  
**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**

* Focus on detailed business, system, and process analysis within the Payments Enablement Platform Data Services Group. Data Services’ mission is to be the single authoritative source of payments information to internal and external clients that is simplified, stable, controlled and scalable.
* Partner closely with a Data Services Product Owner and support the Product Manager as needed—to translate product intent, regulatory needs, and operational requirements into clear, testable analysis and backlog‑ready stories. This role is accountable for improving story quality, reducing ambiguity and rework, and supporting audit‑ and operations‑ready delivery.
* Elicit, analyze, and document functional and non‑functional requirements (including regulatory, control, resiliency, data, and operational considerations) for Payments Data Services.
* Create and maintain analysis artifacts: current‑ and future‑state process flows, user journeys, decision tables, data mappings, and traceability.
* Support backlog readiness and refinement with the Product Owner; clarify scope, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and downstream impacts for delivery teams.
* Conduct impact analysis across adjacent workflows, systems, and controls; surface risks, dependencies, and operational constraints early.
* Partner with testing to validate requirements and acceptance criteria; support UAT and defect triage from a business‑process perspective.
* Maintain regulatory and audit traceability from requirements through release, ensuring required evidence and documentation are complete.
* Contribute to launch and BAU handover by preparing process updates, standard operating procedures/work‑instructions, RACI updates, and training materials in partnership with Product and Operations.
* Surface when analysis complexity, regulatory risk, or cross‑pod dependencies exceed pod scope and require support.

**To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:**
*Education & Experience*

* Bachelor’s degree or work experience equivalent
* 5+ years of overall experience, some of which was in transaction banking, with at least 2 years in a Product Owner, or Business Analyst role.

*Domain Expertise*

* Payments Data Domain Knowledge

+ Strong grasp of payment processing workflows, including instruction enrichment, validation, and routing logic.
+ Knowledge of transaction classification, foreign exchange determination, and cut-off/value date logic.
+ Awareness of messaging standards (e.g., ISO 20022, SWIFT MT) and regulatory frameworks (e.g., AML, PSD2, FATF).

* Data Architecture & Platform Familiarity

+ Experience working with data lakes, cloud-based data platforms, and enterprise data warehouses.
+ Understanding of ETL/ELT processes, event-driven architectures, and streaming data pipelines.
+ Ability to collaborate with engineering teams on data modeling, schema design, and data integration.

* Data Stewardship & Collaboration

+ Proven ability to work with cross-functional teams to define data requirements, prioritize datasets, and resolve data gaps.
+ Experience in data lifecycle management, including ingestion, transformation, and distribution.
+ Comfort with data audit processes, critical control identification, and risk mitigation.

* Analytics & Decision Support

jobs.title: VP - Data & Analytics Tech Lead (KDB) - Equity Technology
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Innovation Hub Overview**
Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate.
  
  
**IT Equities Technology**
Jefferies’ Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum—cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed & OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front-office workflows end-to-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting.
  
  
Operating in a 24x7 follow-the-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C++/C#, cloud, modern visualization, low-latency messaging, and in-memory data stores.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Global Equities Data & Analytics team is seeking a Tech Lead in Pune to lead technology delivery, development and production support for the Global Equities Data & Analytics Platform.
  
  
The platform provides real-time and historical market data and analytics services to more than 10 global trading desks, including Cash Equities, Listed and OTC Derivatives, Electronic Trading, Algo Trading, Index Rebalance, ETFs, Delta One, Central Risk Book and Securities Finance.
  
  
The VP Tech Lead will oversee the India development and support team, working closely with global stakeholders across Hong Kong, London and New York. The role requires strong hands-on technical expertise, leadership capability, capital markets knowledge and experience working with large-scale financial datasets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Pune-based development and support team for the Global Equities Data & Analytics Platform.
* Partner closely with global technology teams across Hong Kong, London, New York and other locations.
* Own delivery of key platform components across real-time and historical market data.
* Support and enhance large-scale low-latency data platforms used by global trading desks.
* Lead onboarding of historical datasets, including large-scale historical tick data and vendor datasets such as Barra, MSCI and other market/reference data sources.
* Design and implement robust, scalable and reusable software components.
* Implement functionality based on defined APIs and platform architecture.
* Develop and maintain library-grade software used across global applications.
* Drive clean, efficient and maintainable coding practices.
* Review technical designs and ensure alignment with global platform standards.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to AVP and Associate developers/support analysts.
* Collaborate with QA, DevOps, production support and global development teams.
* Improve data quality, platform reliability, performance and operational resilience.
* Participate in production support coverage across Asia, EMEA and partial US time zones.
* Contribute to cloud development initiatives involving Python, Iceberg, Parquet and related technologies.
* Write and maintain technical documentation, runbooks and support guides.
* Bring critical thinking and new ideas to improve platform design, analytics and operational processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience working with large financial datasets, including market data, order/execution data, positions data and/or reference data.
* 6+ years of hands-on KDB+/Q experience.
* Strong experience working in Unix/Linux environments.
* Strong programming experience in Python, preferably with cloud data technologies such as Iceberg and Parquet.
* Java experience is preferred.
* Experience designing and supporting real-time and historical data platforms.
* Strong understanding of large-scale financial database design and data management.
* Experience building scalable, efficient and high-quality software solutions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interact confidently with global developers, QA teams, production support teams and business stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced front-office technology environment.
* Ability to learn new technologies and business domains quickly.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies.

**Highly Valued Skills**

* Capital markets experience across Equities, Derivatives, ETFs, Index, Delta One, Algo Trading or Electronic Trading.
* Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Experience with high-performance messaging, in-memory databases and distributed systems.
* Proven delivery track record in a global financial services technology environment.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to lead end-to-end delivery.
* Ability to mentor team members and promote engineering best practices.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capability.
* Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills.

jobs.title: Vice President, Data Management & Quantitative Analysis
jobs.description:

* Demonstrated track record delivering executive-grade dashboards and reporting at enterprise scale based on understanding of user journeys
* Proficiency with SQL, data warehousing/data lakes, streaming, orchestration, and observability tools; familiarity with Python and ML pipelines is advantageous.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills—able to translate technical concepts into business outcomes and influence senior leaders.
* Intellectual curiosity, enthusiasm, and adaptability to rapidly assimilate new information and operate with a strong delivery focus in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor's degree required; advance degree in a quantitative areas like business, finance, engineering, or related disciplines; relevant industry certifications or qualifications are a plus.

jobs.title: Vice President, DataDesk – Vendor Onboarding & Automation
jobs.description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

MSCI's DataDesk team owns the onboarding of new vendor datasets into MSCI's data ecosystem — ensuring new sources are integrated quickly, validated rigorously, and governed well from day one. We're looking for a Vice President to lead and scale this function by embedding AI and automation into the onboarding lifecycle, while bringing genuine technical fluency with data to work credibly alongside Research content, Products, engineering and AI teams.

Your Key Responsibilities:

**Vendor Onboarding & Due Diligence**

* Own end-to-end onboarding of new vendor datasets — from initial due diligence and scope assessment through integration and go-live
* Define and enforce onboarding standards: identifier mapping at ingestion, full scope pre-onboarding assessment, QA assessment and fit for purpose qualification, formal SLAs definition with clear escalation ownership
* Conduct vendor due diligence and maintain trusted relationships with data providers
* Assess onboarded datasets to identify coverage gaps and quality issues, and partner with the vendor to remediate them
* Lead root-cause analysis on onboarding delays or quality gaps, and drive process fixes (as opposed to one-off fire-fighting)

**AI & Automation-Led Scaling**

* Identify and implement AI/automation opportunities across the onboarding pipeline — e.g., automated identifier/field mapping, validation rule generation, matching and reconciliation logic
* Partner with engineering/AI teams to build or adopt tooling that automates QA diagnostic and certification, reduce manual onboarding effort and turnaround time, acting as the functional expert who validates outputs against real onboarding scenarios
* Continuously evaluate emerging AI techniques and apply them to reduce onboarding cycle time and error rates
* Track and report onboarding efficiency metrics (cycle time, automation coverage, error/rework rates) to leadership
* Incorporate AI-based data usage/rights validation into the data collection process, ensuring new vendor sources are governance-compliant before integration
* Enrich and expose AI powered catalogue of data, QA / Diagnostic and other DataDesk Services

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Define validation rules and quality benchmarks for newly onboarded vendor data
* Ensure onboarded datasets meet MSCI's data standards for accuracy, consistency, and compliance before integration
* Collaborate with product and downstream teams to assess data fit and flag risks early in the onboarding process
* Conduct a quarterly assessment of MSCI's vendor data risk across product lines and single points of failure, identify possible remediations or alternatives, and present findings to senior leadership to inform operational planning and investment decisions

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of analysts/associates involved in onboarding and vendor evaluation
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders to align on onboarding priorities, resolve escalations, and ensure timely, transparent communication throughout the onboarding lifecycle
* Partner with global stakeholders across product, research, technology, and operations to align onboarding priorities and standards
* Present onboarding pipeline status, risks, and automation roadmap to senior leadership

Your skills and experience that will help you excel:

**Experience:** 10+ years in data operations, vendor management, or data onboarding, ideally in financial data/index/analytics

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong understanding of data structures, formats, and identifiers (LEI, DUNS, CUSIP/ISIN) sufficient to assess vendor data fit and define validation logic
* Working proficiency in SQL and Python — able to review/write validation and matching logic, not just specify requirements
* Experience applying AI/ML or automation tools to data matching, validation, or process acceleration
* Comfort working directly with engineering/AI teams as a technical counterpart, not just a requirements source

**Domain Knowledge:**

* Familiarity with vendor data landscape (e.g., FactSet, LSEG/EJV, ICE, EDI) and cross-vendor field mapping challenges
* Understanding of financial reference data concepts (entities, securities, classifications) as they relate to onboarding validation

**Soft Skills:** Strong stakeholder and vendor relationship management, project management, and the ability to translate operational pain points into automation opportunities

  
About MSCI:

**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer - Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title: Lead AI Engineer - Vice President**

**Location: Bangalore, India**

**Role Description**

* The AI Technology Vice President is a senior, hands-on individual contributor who turns high-value banking use cases into secure, scalable and measurable AI solutions. Embedded within Corporate Functions Technology, the role works directly with delivery teams and business stakeholders to design, prototype, engineer and productionise AI capabilities, while ensuring that implementation choices are aligned with enterprise architecture, data governance, model risk, security and regulatory expectations.
* The role connects grassroots experimentation with top-down strategy. It contributes practical implementation insight to the AI Centre of Excellence and translates approved tooling, roadmaps and ways of working into reusable engineering patterns that delivery teams can adopt. The position has no dependency on formal people management; influence is achieved through technical depth, demonstrable delivery, coaching and trusted partnership.
This is an individual contributor role with senior technical accountability. The role may lead workstreams, guide engineers and coordinate multidisciplinary delivery, but its primary value comes from hands-on technical implementation, engineering judgement and influence rather than direct people management. Final ownership of business decisions, model-risk acceptance and control approvals remains with the relevant accountable functions.  

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

  

**Your key responsibilities**

**Hands-on AI solution engineering**

* Build and productionise: Design, code, test and deploy AI applications, services, agents and reusable components for banking and Corporate Functions use cases.
* Prototype with purpose: Develop rapid proofs of concept to test business value, technical feasibility, control implications and operational readiness before scaling.
* Own the engineering pathway: Translate business problems into solution architecture, data flows, model or service choices, APIs, integration patterns and production acceptance criteria.
* Integrate enterprise systems: Connect AI capabilities with approved data platforms, workflow tools, document repositories, APIs and user channels without bypassing established controls.
* Engineer for reliability: Implement automated testing, versioning, observability, evaluation, deployment and rollback mechanisms across the solution lifecycle.
Troubleshoot deeply: Diagnose data, model, prompt, retrieval, integration, performance and production issues and drive them through to resolution.  

  

**Generative AI and applied machine learning**

* Generative AI: Implement solutions using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, tool use, structured output and agentic workflows where justified.
* Model selection: Compare hosted models, enterprise AI services and conventional machine-learning approaches against accuracy, explainability, latency, cost, privacy and control requirements.
* Evaluation: Define repeatable evaluation datasets and measures for quality, groundedness, robustness, safety, bias, latency and business usefulness.
* Prompt and context engineering: Develop maintainable prompt templates, context strategies, guardrails and model interaction patterns, with appropriate version control and test coverage.
Classical AI/ML: Apply supervised or unsupervised learning, NLP, document intelligence, forecasting or anomaly detection when these approaches are better suited than generative AI.  

  

**Data, platform and MLOps/LLMOps implementation**

* Data readiness: Assess source quality, lineage, entitlement, retention and fitness for AI use; design data preparation and retrieval pipelines with accountable owners.

* Production lifecycle: Establish CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, release controls, monitoring and operational support patterns.

* Platform engineering: Use approved cloud, on-premises or hybrid platforms and contribute reusable reference implementations, accelerators and paved-road components.

* Performance and cost: Optimize token usage, compute, caching, retrieval, throughput and service design while maintaining required quality and controls.

Operational resilience: Design for availability, failure handling, auditability, recoverability and human intervention in business-critical workflows.  

  

**Banking controls and responsible AI**

* Control by design: Embed privacy, confidentiality, information security, data minimisation, records management, access control and segregation of duties into solution design.
* Responsible AI: Implement explainability, human oversight, fairness assessment, traceability, content safety and appropriate usage boundaries.
* Risk partnership: Work with Model Risk, Compliance, Legal, Data, Architecture, Cyber Security and Operational Risk stakeholders to evidence design decisions and address findings.
* Audit evidence: Maintain clear documentation covering data sources, design rationale, evaluation outcomes, limitations, approvals, change history and production controls.
Third-party risk: Assess external models, libraries and services for security, licensing, concentration, data handling, lock-in and ongoing support considerations.  

  

**Technology leadership without line management**

* Technical influence: Set a high bar through working code, design reviews, engineering standards and pragmatic decision-making.
* Community of Practice: Create and nurture peer learning through demonstrations, code walkthroughs, implementation clinics, reusable examples and lessons learned.
* Coaching: Support engineers, analysts and product teams in adopting approved AI techniques and resolving difficult implementation problems.
* Strategic feedback loop: Maintain continuous collaboration with the AI Centre of Excellence so delivery experience informs enterprise tooling, roadmaps and ways of working, and strategic direction is translated into execution.
External awareness: Track relevant developments in AI engineering and banking technology, then assess them against real business value and risk appetite rather than novelty alone.  

  

**Use-case delivery and stakeholder partnership**

* Shape demand: Partner with business, product and technology stakeholders to frame the problem, users, expected outcomes, constraints and measurable value.
* Prioritize pragmatically: Distinguish use cases suitable for experimentation from those ready for production investment, using evidence rather than technology enthusiasm.
* Deliver iteratively: Work in multidisciplinary teams, demonstrate progress early and incorporate user, control and operational feedback throughout delivery.
* Communicate clearly: Explain complex AI design choices, limitations and trade-offs in language suitable for engineers, senior management, control functions and business users.
Adoption: Design for usability and changed ways of working so approved AI capabilities are used safely and generate sustained value.  

  

**Your skills and experience**

**Essential Experience**

* Relevant professional experience designing and implementing production technology solutions, including recent hands-on delivery of AI, machine-learning or generative-AI capabilities.
* Demonstrable evidence of moving AI use cases from discovery and prototype through engineering,

Join us as Business Oversight Compliance Specialist where you will lead the Financial Crime framework for India IB, ensuring compliance with Financial Crime Policies and Standards, as well as applicable Indian legal and regulatory requirements. Provide oversight of the India IB Financial Crime team in Mumbai, including the transaction monitoring function and responsibility for local alert closure. Ensure appropriate local Financial Crime controls and procedures are in place across Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC), KYC and transaction monitoring. Provide advice and guidance to India IB businesses on Financial Crime risks, including customer onboarding queries, new product initiatives and other regulatory matters, while providing effective second-line check and challenge. Manage Financial Crime-related regulatory and audit enquiries for the Mumbai branch, working closely with Compliance and relevant regional and global stakeholders. Support regulatory requests, submissions, inspections, risk assessments, compliance reviews and timely submission of applicable regulatory reports. Monitor regulatory developments and consultations relevant to the India business, assess their impact and support implementation of required changes. Partner with regional and global Financial Crime teams across AML, Sanctions, ABC Advisory, Intelligence & Investigations and Compliance Assurance. Support testing and quality assurance programmes to assess the effectiveness of controls in mitigating Financial Crime risk. Develop effective reporting and communication routines and support senior leadership with key Financial Crime and regulatory matters. Participate in industry and firm-wide regulatory committees and contribute to policy development, control enhancement and identification of potential Financial Crime risks. Ensure employees receive appropriate Financial Crime training aligned with their roles and responsibilities.

  
  

To be successful in this role, you should:

* Have extensive experience managing Financial Crime and Compliance risks within the Indian financial services environment.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of Indian Financial Crime laws, regulations and regulatory expectations, particularly those applicable to foreign banks.
* Have hands-on expertise across AML, Sanctions, Anti-Bribery & Corruption and Anti-Terrorism regulatory requirements.
* Be able to provide pragmatic and well-reasoned Financial Crime advice while maintaining the independence and challenge expected from a second-line-of-defence function.
* Have strong analytical and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to understand complex compliance matters, identify control weaknesses and respond appropriately.
* Be a confident communicator and relationship builder capable of engaging with senior business leaders, regulators and regional/global stakeholders.
* Demonstrate ownership, sound judgement and the ability to escalate and resolve Financial Crime and regulatory issues promptly.
  

  

Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications:

* Relevant Financial Crime and Compliance experience in India.
* Minimum University degree.
* Extensive risk, compliance and/or legal experience within financial services.
* Experience in a Compliance role covering Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Sanctions and Anti-Terrorism regulations.
* Detailed understanding and practical familiarity with Indian Financial Crime laws and regulations.
* Strong knowledge of the Indian regulatory environment for foreign banks.
* Good understanding of the products and services offered by the India business.
  

  

Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications:

* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced and complex environment and engage confidently across different levels of an organisation.
* Hands-on approach with demonstrated execution and process-management capabilities.
* Strong organisational skills with a clear focus on delivering results.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to manage senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across regional, global and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to exercise sound judgement, take ownership and respond to issues promptly and appropriately.
* Experience interacting with regulators and supporting regulatory reviews, inspections, submissions or enquiries would be advantageous.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as:

Financial Crime Risk Management, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC), KYC, Transaction Monitoring, Indian Financial Crime Regulations, Regulatory Compliance, Risk & Controls, Second Line of Defence Oversight, Regulatory Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Analytical Thinking, Decision Making, Communication and Leadership.

  
  

Job location is Mumbai.

**Purpose of the role**

To provide data-led expert oversight and check and challenge on business and compliance matters to evidence that the organisation is operating in a compliance with Barclays legal, regulatory and ethical responsibilities.

**Accountabilities**

* Identification and assessment of compliance risks through thorough reviews of business activities, changes, processes, testing and systems to.
* Identification and investigation of potential market abuse, including but not limited to, Insider Dealing, Unlawful Disclosure, Market Manipulation or Anti-Competitive Conduct.
* Conduct investigation of compliance risk events or breaches. Oversight and check and challenge of corrective actions and preventative measures to avoid future occurrences.
* Implementation of compliance policies and procedures in line with regulatory requirements and ensuring that the bank’s internal policies are aligned with international standards, including jurisdictional requirements.
* Collaboration with 1LOD, other relevant Compliance teams and legal, and relevant risk management functions to facilitate a comprehensive approach to compliance and risk management.
* Identification, investigation and oversight of potential money laundering, terrorist financing or other financial crime.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..

jobs.title: Business Senior Analyst - Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Citi enables clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.

  
  

The Derivatives Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions to Citi’s Risk organization which manages Citi’s exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software used to compute metrics that help mitigate Citi’s exposure to counterparty default. These include computation of optimal Margin Allocation for Portfolios and Trades, Haircut for Security and Cash Collateral, Trade and Collateral Liquidity, Collateral Concentration Levels and Wrong Way Risk, amongst others.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  
  

* Liaise with stakeholders across the Risk and Front Office Technology, Counterparty Risk Management, Finance and Front Office business organizations, and external Market Regulators to assemble business requirements for Counterparty Risk Technology projects.

* Manage expectations of various stakeholder groups and help negotiate solutions to complex problems.

* Project manage complex Counterparty Credit Risk projects end to end. Accurately record, maintain, and report Program/Project management tracking data such as milestones via Citi’s internal project tracking systems.

* Help assemble/manage detailed documentation covering Counterparty Risk calculations and other processing, to be used to discuss technology implementation details with the Business users and Market Regulators in various countries/regions. Create flow diagrams, structure charts, and other types of system or process representations when appropriate.

* Facilitate and drive project meetings with both business and technology teams.

* Develop and review test scripts with business users as well as technology teams for System, User and Impact testing.

* Understand, analyse, and explain counterparty mark-to-future exposures on Derivatives books to users. Investigate Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA and related calculations for internal risk management and BASEL regulatory capital reporting based on the exposure profiles generated by the systems.

* Ability to trace changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and or legal agreements.

* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to demonstrate and analyse risk calculations.
  

  

**Knowledge/Experience:**

  
  

* 8-12 years related experience in Business Analysis and Project Management in Capital Markets domain.

* SDLC awareness including knowledge of quality issues in software development.

* Excellent understanding of the mechanics and life cycle of derivatives products, including Options, Futures, Forwards and Swaps. Knowledge of Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) products an advantage.

* Excellent understanding of Counterparty Credit Risk

* Potential Future Exposure, Margin (ISDA MNA and CSA), Collateral Haircut, Liquidity and Period of Risk, Settlement Risk.

* Understanding of Basel III/IV and any other relevant Risk Regulations and measures including PSE, RWA, EAD.

* Knowledge of Market Risk an advantage including Credit Value Adjustment (CVA).

* Extensive project management experience, including co-ordination across remote global teams.

* Where required supervise day-to-day staff management issues, work allocation but especially mentoring/coaching.

* Data Analysis capabilities (Database or Spreadsheet), with extensive experience using Excel required.
  

  

**Education:**

  
  

* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree an advantage.

* Graduate in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) or Finance disciplines.

* FRM/CFA or other Financial mathematics degree or certification is an advantage.

*Exceptional candidates who do not meet these criteria may be considered for the role provided they have the necessary skills and experience.*

  
  

**Competencies:**

  
  

* Excellent verbal and written English.

* Ability to collaborate effectively in a large global team.

* Ability to take ownership and proactively follow up on issues.

* Ability to work well under pressure, to agreed and often challenging deadlines.

* Strong organization skills.

jobs.title: Data Information Manager - Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

**Overview**:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.

Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

  
  

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

**Assistant Vice President (IC) - Data\Information Management** will be part of QATV team within Citi AIM vertical, a global community driving data-driven transformation across Citi. AIM's objective is to generate actionable intelligence for business leaders. In this role, the Analyst will support the QATV function by maintaining dedicated testing data marts, consolidating validation outcomes, identifying data inconsistencies, and assisting in the drafting of detailed narrative reports and metrics for final publication to key stakeholders.

Working in close collaboration with team leads, the Analyst will also support testing delivery governance and resource management. This includes monitoring sprint cycles to track milestone adherence, maintaining capacity planning models to ensure balanced workload distribution, and assisting with skills-matrix assessments to align team capabilities with testing demand across all phases of regulatory validation.

  
  

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* Assist in organizing and maintaining dedicated testing data marts and data pipelines.
* Expertise in data management principles, SQL, SAS programming for data extraction, manipulation and validations. Guide and mentor junior members in team in this area.
* Use of data warehousing concepts, ETL processes, and experience working with Business Intelligence platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). To act as SME in this area and go-to person for the team.
* Research and identify data inconsistencies, trends, or reporting gaps to support root-cause analysis.
* Automate current process to remove manual effort
* Develop workflows and automation logic using SAS, SQL, Workflow tools
* Conduct in-depth analyses of current operational processes to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement.
* Continuously improve processes and strategies by exploring and evaluating new data sources, tools, and capabilities
* Work closely with internal and external business partners in building, implementing, tracking and improving decision strategies
* Support your team and help them accomplish their goals with empathy. You act as a facilitator and remove blockers and create a positive atmosphere for them to be innovative and productive at work
  

  

**Qualifications:**

* Work experience: 8+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Technical Skills: Expertise in data management principles, SQL, SAS , Python programming for data extraction and manipulation, and database management systems. Including Tableau, and other BI tools.

* Strong coding expertise in SAS & SQL, Autosys package.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Key responsibilities include applying AI/ML techniques to detect complex data anomalies, automating test narrative generation, predicting testing cycle risks, and optimizing testing sprint capacity and resource allocation.

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* **Predictive Defect & Risk Modeling:** Build predictive analytics and forecasting models to project test execution cycle times, identify recurring defect patterns, and anticipate regulatory reporting risks before filing deadlines.
* **Testing Intelligence & Metrics:** Analyze historical test execution data to uncover systemic data quality trends, derive actionable quality scores, and provide data-driven recommendations to strengthen internal control frameworks.

* **Automated Narrative Generation:** Design, build, and deploy Generative AI solutions (using LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG architectures) to automate the drafting of complex, audit-ready narrative test summaries and executive readouts.
* **Agentic AI & Workflow Automation:** Experiment with and develop Agentic AI workflows (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph) to automate multi-step validation checks, intelligent test result consolidation, and autonomous exception routing.
* **AI Evaluation & Guardrails:** Establish robust benchmarking tools, validation frameworks, and guardrails to evaluate the accuracy, hallucination risks, consistency, and performance of deployed AI/GenAI models.

* **Resource & Capacity Modeling:** Develop quantitative models and optimization algorithms to enhance sprint capacity planning, workload balancing, and skill-to-task allocation across multi-phase testing cycles.
* **Sprint Analytics & Tracking:** Build automated intelligence pipelines and interactive dashboards (Power BI / Tableau) to track sprint velocity, defect burn-down rates, and milestone adherence in real time.
* **Automated Test Script Generation:** Leverage Generative AI and LLM-powered pipelines to automate the creation, synthesis, and maintenance of standardized regulatory test scripts, validation rules.

* **Control, Risk & Governance:** Ensure all data science and AI applications comply with Citi Model Risk Management (MRM), Responsible AI guidelines, and data governance policies. Appropriately assess risk when developing solutions, ensuring transparent escalation and adherence to all supervisory standards.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in QATV by managing expectations and ensuring alignment on project goals and deliverables. Communicate project status, risks, and issues to stakeholders timely manner
* **Team Player & Mentor:** Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior team members. Mentor and coach team members on best practices in data analysis, reporting, and data infrastructure management

**Qualifications:**

* Work experience: 8+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

* Programming & ML Frameworks: Strong programming skills in Python with proficiency in data science and ML libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Transformers).

* Generative AI & LLMs: Hands-on experience developing GenAI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Chroma, Milvus), and API integration.

* Agentic Frameworks & MLOps: Practical exposure to agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or AutoGen, along with foundational knowledge of MLOps and model deployment pipelines.

* Data Engineering & SQL: Advanced SQL skills with experience querying, manipulating, and transforming large datasets from relational databases and testing data marts (e.g., Oracle, Snowflake, PostgreSQL).

* Data Visualization & BI: Experience building interactive analytics dashboards using Tableau or Power BI.

* Banking Knowledge: Good understanding of the banking domain, banking products and Operations in banking is preferred.

* Soft Skills: Ability to multi-task effectively and efficiently in a fast-paced environment. Excellent interpersonal skills and a positive, proactive attitude. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
