jobs.title: Corporate Credit Underwriter - Senior Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.

Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise.

Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

ICM Underwriters manage a portfolio of relationships, being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with Business and Risk.

**In this role, you’re expected to:**

Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting, including, but not limited to:

* Adoption of leading practices in credit analysis, underwriting, and monitoring, including the end-to-end underwriting process, from early origination discussions to development of credit approval memos, and senior approval forums

* Detailed review of financial analysis, due diligence, projection modeling, stress testing, risk ratings and other in-depth analysis performed by junior resources

* Review and approval of Credit Approval Memos (CAM) packages

* Partner with Front Office on structuring and production of term sheet for new transactions

* Facilitate relationships with key clients in Banking and Risk and with key Regulators, Internal Audit, and control functions

* Support ICM Underwriting organization on strategic initiatives / projects as required

**Risk Management Experience:**

* Senior credit approval authority covering large and complex underwritings, capital commitments, derivatives with multi-industry experience
* Experience in and exposure to global credit risk management standards
* Ability to understand capital markets products and complex financing and product structures
* Ability to provide strategic insights and strong sensitivity to macro and regulatory issues
* Able to discuss and address issues associated with the allocation of risk assets and risk capital in partnership with banking and product organizations

**Client Relationships / Business Partnership:**

* Proven ability to understand nuances of local markets, local regulation, and the capabilities and practices of competitors
* Navigates organizational complexity and breaks silos
* Creates and sustains a network of strong partnerships with the business in all segments geographies and other risk functions
* Provides well-reasoned, balanced assessments of risk/return trade-offs associated with transactions and client relationships
* Proven track record of partnering with global peers in leveraging and implementation of best practices

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

* 12+ years risk/risk-related credit work experience in banking/financial institutions
* Proven ability to effectively engage with regulators and internal control functions including Internal Audit and Fundamental Credit Risk as well as with external audit
* Demonstrates strong ethics and integrity
* Ability to see the ‘big picture’ in a complex environment
* Can make decisions under pressure and short timeline
* Excellent verbal & written communication skills. Active listening skills.
* Excellent presentation skills – adept at presenting effectively to audiences of various sizes and various constituencies

**Job Summary / Introduction**

* Drive the development of the FAB Asset Management product range across all asset classes and product types, grounded in market analysis, client demand and competitive positioning.
* Own product ideation and design - investment proposition, target segment, vehicle and share class design, fee structure and commercial positioning - with legal documentation, regulatory filing and implementation executed by the relevant departments.
* Own product pricing and economics, including fee grids, margins, distribution economics and profitability, ensuring products are competitive in the market and commercially viable for FAB AM.
* Manage the product lifecycle end-to-end, from pipeline and business case to launch readiness, post-launch review, range rationalisation, mergers and closures.
* Contribute directly to the commercial effort alongside the sales and distribution teams, in particular on RFPs, due diligence questionnaires and client proposals.
* Live and demonstrate the FAB AM values.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Market and competitive analysis: Analyse market trends, flows, client demand and regulatory developments across all asset classes and product types, and maintain systematic benchmarking of competitor ranges, structures, fee levels and commercial propositions.
* Pricing and product economics: Define and own the pricing architecture - management and performance fees, share classes, distribution economics, breakpoints and discounts - and model revenue, margin and profitability per product.
* Product design and structuring: Design the product: investment proposition, mandate and benchmark, vehicle and domicile, share classes, currency and hedging, distribution model and target investor base; structuring here is design, not legal implementation.
* Business case and pipeline: Build the business case for each new product and prepare the papers required by the relevant committees; own the product pipeline and the multi-year roadmap, aligned to the commercial strategy and distribution capacity.
* Commercial positioning: Define the positioning, differentiation and value proposition of each product, and equip the commercial teams with the content, arguments and competitive comparisons needed to sell effectively.
* RFPs and commercial proposals: Contribute actively to the commercial effort with the sales and distribution teams by drafting and reviewing the product, strategy and competitive sections of RFPs, DDQs and client proposals, and by maintaining a reusable library of approved product content and Q&A.
* Lifecycle management: Monitor the performance, flows, profitability and relevance of the existing range, and drive rationalisation, repositioning, mergers and closures where appropriate.
* Cross-functional delivery: Act as design authority and business owner through the delivery of each product, working with Investments, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Technology and external counsel who execute documentation, filing and implementation.
* Regulatory awareness and reporting: Maintain a solid understanding of the ADGM and CMA product frameworks and their implications for product design and distribution, and report to management on pipeline, launches, pricing and product economics.

**Requirements / Qualifications**

* Experience: 5 to 10 years in product development, product management or product strategy within asset management or regulated financial services.
* Market, competition and pricing: Hands-on experience analysing markets, client demand and competitor ranges using industry databases, and defining or challenging fee structures and product profitability.
* Product knowledge: Solid understanding of investment products, strategies and vehicle structures across all asset classes and product types, including share class and distribution mechanics, and sufficient familiarity with product documentation to direct the teams executing it.
* Commercial support: Practical experience responding to RFPs and due diligence questionnaires and producing client-facing proposal content, with excellent written English and the ability to meet tight commercial deadlines.
* Regulatory and stakeholder skills: Working knowledge of the regulatory environment applicable to product design and distribution; proven ability to lead multi-stakeholder workstreams and manage timelines and dependencies.
* Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
* Capabilities: Analytical rigour, commercial judgement, initiative and the ability to turn market insight into a credible, differentiated and profitable product proposition.

**Preferred / Beneficial**

* Regulatory and stakeholder skills: ADGM and CMA an advantage.
* Qualifications: CFA, CAIA or equivalent professional qualifications are advantageous.

The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and document negotiation and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all Credit & Lending (C&L) tasks, creating a single control point. * Responsible for the delivery of BCO tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs

• Own the end-to-end Credit & Lending servicing journey, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for customers and internal stakeholders• Participate in deal discussions and meetings with clients or credit risk

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

jobs.title: Senior Vice President Marketing
jobs.description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:**

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.

As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.

If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.

**About the Role:**

At CoinDCX, brand and growth are one system. Brand earns trust, and trust brings in users who stay, trade and recommend us. As
**SVP – Growth & Marketing**
, you will own both sides and make them work as one.

Your mandate is not to promote crypto, but to normalise it and make it trusted. You will shape how millions of Indians understand, assess and use this new asset class. You will own the full path from first awareness to a loyal customer: brand trust, recall, acquisition, activation, retention, win-back, product-led growth and consumer understanding.

You will work at the meeting point of cultural narrative, regulatory nuance, reputation and capital discipline. We need a leader who plans in multi-year horizons, stays steady under public scrutiny and builds systems that hold up through market cycles.

You will lead the full marketing organisation (Brand, Creative, Content, Social and Community, PR), the Growth teams (Retention, Resurrection, PLG, Product Marketing, SEO and Digital Marketing) and Consumer Insights. You will partner closely with the Business unit, which owns CLM, and with Product, Policy, Analytics and Leadership, so that what we build, say and stand for stays aligned.

If building one of India’s most consequential financial brands, and the growth engine behind it, excites you, this role will both challenge and reward you.

**What You'll Do:**

* You are the
  **DRI (Directly Responsible Individual)**
  for the full Growth & Marketing budget across ATL, BTL, digital media, performance, social, content and PR. You are accountable not just for outcomes, but for the reasoning behind every spend decision.
* **Metric & Budget Ownership:**
  Own the brand KPIs (brand health, social media metrics, organic acquisition) and the growth KPIs (new users, activation, retention, blended CAC, LTV). You are accountable for full funnel marketing and building brand trust.
* **Brand Strategy:**
  Own the multi-year brand roadmap. Turn complex VDA (Virtual Digital Asset) topics into simple, education-led stories that enhance trust while keeping technical accuracy.
* **Growth Strategy:**
  Own the plan from first install to long-term customer, with one shared view of the funnel across marketing and growth.
* **Retention & Resurrection:**
  Keep active users coming back, and bring lapsed users back, through product-led and marketing-led programmes.
* **PLG & Product Marketing:**
  Build referrals, in-product loops and organic acquisition with Product. Own positioning, launches and go-to-market for each product line.
* **SEO & Digital Marketing:**
  Own organic search and paid digital channels. Manage CAC, ROAS and cost per activated user, and direct media buying and budget allocation.
* **Consumer Insights:**
  Lead the insights team. Use research, user behaviour data and brand tracking to guide decisions across marketing, growth, product and business.
* **Org Design:**
  Lead and grow the full team, from creatives to analysts to performance specialists. Build a strong layer of second-level leaders so day-to-day execution does not depend on you.
* **Reputation Systems:**
  Design and own proactive PR and “Issue Readiness” playbooks to protect institutional credibility during market volatility.
* **Product & Policy Partnership:**
  Work with Product and Policy so the brand promise of “Responsible Education” shows up in the app experience and in all advertising, and stays compliant.
* **Experimentation & Measurement:**
  Run a steady pipeline of growth and brand experiments with Product and Analytics, and set one trusted set of numbers for the whole function.

**You’ll Excel in This Role If You Have:**

* **Think in First Principles:**
  You look for the real reason users do not trust us or do not stay, rather than applying standard marketing frameworks.
* **Act as an Owner:**
  You treat company capital and reputation as your own, and make hard trade-offs to protect long-term brand value over short-term “hacks.”
* **Are Equally at Ease with Story and Numbers:**
  You can judge a brand film and read a funnel or cohort chart with the same confidence.
* **Translate Strategy:**
  You turn disruptive technology into simple, trusted, mass-market stories without losing technical accuracy.
* **Build Systems:**
  You build scalable content, PR and growth engines instead of managing individual tasks.
* **Lead Leaders:**
  You have led large, mixed teams of creatives, analysts and performance specialists, and earned the respect of each.
* **Decide Under Scrutiny:**
  You are comfortable being the final decision maker in moments of reputational, regulatory or public pressure.

**You’ll Know You’re Winning When:**

* **Trust & Recall:**
  “Institutional Trust” scores and “Responsible Education” recall rise in a measurable way.
* **Growth:**
  More new users complete KYC, make a first deposit and place a first trade, and retention and win-back rates improve.
* **Efficiency:**
  Blended CAC falls as organic acquisition and brand-led conversion improve.
* **Market Share:**
  CoinDCX’s share of the total Indian crypto user base grows.
* **Evidence-Led Decisions:**
  Consumer Insights visibly shapes major campaign, product and business decisions.
* **One Plan with Business:**
  Growth, Marketing and CLM run to shared targets without friction.
* **Independence:**
  Your leadership bench runs high-impact campaigns and growth programmes with little intervention from you.

**Why This Role Matters & What’s In It For You:**

You will bring brand and growth together under one leader at a $2.45B unicorn, and shape how a nation learns to trust a new financial system. You will work side by side with the founders to drive the company’s mission, and you will see first-hand how a brand and a user base scale from 10 → 100 in one of the world’s fastest-evolving industries. Very few roles offer this. This is one of them.

**Hiring Process:**

Here’s what your journey with us looks like:

* **Application Review**
  – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* **Recruiter Connect**
  – A short conversation to understand you better
* **Functional Round(s)**
  – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving
* **Assignment / Simulation Round**
  –A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* **Culture & Values Discussion**
  – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
* **Founder Conversation (Optional)**
  – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

**Where We Work:**

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.

With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our
**Bangalore**
office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.

**Perks That Empower You:**

We believe great people deserve great experiences.

* **Design Your Own Benefits:**
  Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* **Unlimited Wellness Leaves:**
  Rest and recharge as you need
* **Mental Wellness Support:**
  Access to therapy and wellness resources
* **Learning Sessions:**
  Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About
**Bright Money**

Bright Money
is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi’s Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India.

**What is the role about?**

Bright is looking for a Director - Engineering to lead and scale a core part of our engineering organisation in Bengaluru, reporting to the CTO. You will own delivery and technical direction for the systems behind Bright’s consumer app, credit decisioning, and AI products, and you will build the leadership layer that runs them.

This is a leader-of-leaders role. You will manage engineering managers and leads, shape architecture and platform strategy for your area within the CTO’s technical direction, own headcount, budget, and cloud spend for your teams, and partner with Product, Data Sciences, and the wider leadership team on what gets built next.

Bright is profitable, scaling fast in the U.S. market, and building AI into both the product and how the company runs. The systems are distributed, data-heavy, and carry real money and credit decisions, so engineering quality is a business outcome here, not an internal metric.

**What will you do?**

* Lead your organisation: Own and scale a multi-team group, with engineering managers and leads reporting to you; set the operating rhythm, standards, and performance bar across your teams.
* Build the leadership layer: Hire, coach, and retain senior engineers, leads, and managers, and develop the next line of engineering leadership beneath you.
* Technical strategy: Shape and execute architecture and platform strategy across services, data, and developer tooling for your area, in line with the CTO’s technical direction, and make the build-versus-buy and platformisation calls that shape how fast your teams can ship.
* Delivery at scale: Own end-to-end delivery of distributed, data-heavy systems - roadmap commitments, release predictability, and the trade-offs between speed and durability.
* Reliability & risk: Own availability, performance, security, and the engineering side of compliance obligations for the systems your teams run in a U.S. consumer-lending business.
* AI & ML in production: Partner with Data Sciences to productionise ML and Gen AI systems-serving, monitoring, and retraining - and raise engineering leverage through AI tooling across the org.
* Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Data Sciences, Infrastructure, and business teams on priorities, sequencing, and the commitments engineering makes to them.
* Planning & budget: Own annual and quarterly planning for your area - headcount, vendor decisions, cloud cost and TCO, and the resourcing choices behind them.
* Reporting & visibility: Report clearly to the CTO and the wider leadership team on progress, risk, capacity, and investment, and contribute to leadership reviews as needed.

**Ideal candidate profile**

**Experience & Background:**

* Experience: 12+ years in engineering, with 5+ years in engineering leadership and at least 2 years managing managers or leads.
* Organisation scale: Has led a multi-team group of 20+ engineers, and has grown a team through a period of rapid scaling.
* Systems depth: Deep hands-on background in distributed, high-throughput, data-heavy systems; still able to go deep in a design review and hold a credible technical argument.
* Architecture & platform: Proven ownership of architecture, platformisation, and developer tooling, with evidence of the delivery gains those investments produced.
* ML & AI in production: Experience productionising ML or Gen AI systems in partnership with data science teams.
* Commercial ownership: Experience owning engineering budgets, cloud cost and TCO, vendor decisions, and resource planning.
* Hiring record: A strong track record of hiring and developing senior engineers and engineering managers.
* Domain: Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or another regulated, high-reliability consumer business is a strong plus.
* Location: Based in Bengaluru, or willing to relocate.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Ownership: Takes accountability for outcomes beyond their own remit, not only for their teams’ deliverables.
* Technical credibility: Earns the respect of senior engineers through judgment and depth, not position.
* Strategic thinking: Connects technical choices to business outcomes and can defend the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.
* Builder of leaders: Measures success by the strength of the managers and engineers they develop.
* Pace: Thrives in a high-growth environment where structure is still being built, and brings clarity rather than waiting for it.

**Non-Fit Profiles**

* Individual contributors or architects without sustained people-leadership experience.
* Managers who have led a single team, without experience managing managers or leading a group through scale.
* Leaders who have moved fully away from technical depth and cannot hold their own in architecture and design discussions.
* Candidates from large, process-heavy environments who need established structure, and are uncomfortable in a fast-moving, ambiguous setting.
* Delivery or programme managers without hands-on engineering ownership.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale - liquidity potential at $1-3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You own delivery and technical direction for a core part of the platform, with a direct line to the CTO.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Benefits: Excellent benefits package in line with sector best practice.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is responsible for establishing, implementing, operating, monitoring, and continuously enhancing OneFin’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) across all product lines and enterprise infrastructure.

This leader will own end-to-end information security strategy, cloud security governance (AWS), regulatory compliance (RBI guidelines for digital lending and IT governance), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standards, and client-facing security assessments for institutional banking partners. Implement zero trust security architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Information Security Governance & Strategy**

* Define, maintain, and enforce OneFin's Level-1 ISMS policies, standards, and guidelines in alignment with business goals.
* Report security posture, risk profiles, and incident metrics directly to the CEO, C-suite, and Board of Directors.
* Lead the annual risk assessment framework across all business units, maintaining the enterprise Risk Register and tracking remediation strategies.
* Establish annual security objectives, measurable parameters, and operational security targets.

**2. Regulatory, Compliance & Client Audit Management**

* Direct compliance for ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certifications, surveillance audits, and internal security audits.
* Ensure strict adherence to Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines regarding digital lending, data localization, outsourcing, and cloud management.
* Act as the executive point of contact for financial institution (FI) client audits, managing Information Security Group (ISG) checklists, VAPT review points, and security questionnaires.
* Oversee Data Protection and Privacy compliance, protecting Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Sensitive Personal Data or Information (SPDI).
* Oversee source code audits, and conduct internal security audits of codebase.

**3. Cloud Infrastructure & Product Security**

* Oversee security configuration across AWS environments, ensuring AES-256 encryption at rest (S3, RDS, ECR) and enforced TLS/HTTPS in transit.
* Enforce secure architecture models for single-tenant / dedicated client deployments on Financial Institution AWS infrastructure.
* Direct Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies, IP/URL whitelisting, geo-blocking, and network perimeter controls.
* Maintain DevSecOps rigor within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), ensuring automated peer reviews, static analysis, code coverage thresholds, and container image vulnerability management.

**4. Threat Management & Security Operations (SecOps)**

* Lead the Incident Response Team; ensure end-to-end management, SLA tracking, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for all P1/Critical incidents.
* Oversee centralized logging, Database Activity Monitoring (DAM), and integration capabilities with Bank SIEM systems.
* Mandate periodic Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) across applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
* Enforce robust Access Control & Identity Management (IAM), including mandatory multi-factor authentication (MFA) across email, code repositories, and cloud portals.

**5. Third-Party Risk & Business Continuity**

* Enforce Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) guidelines, ensuring mandatory MSAs and NDAs across all vendors.
* Manage annual Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) drills, validating Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Conduct annual enterprise-wide security awareness training programs and specialized DevSecOps workshops.

**Candidate Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related engineering fields.
* **Experience:** 12+ years in Information Security and Technology Risk, with at least 4+ years in a leadership role (CISO, Head of Security, or Director of InfoSec).
* **Domain Background:** Prior experience in Fintech, B2B SaaS, Banking, or Financial Services ecosystems is strictly required.

**Technical & Professional Competencies**

**Cloud Security**- Deep expertise in AWS Security Hub, WAF, KMS, CloudTrail, IAM, RDS/S3 encryption, and containerized deployments (ECS/ECR).

**Frameworks**- Hands-on mastery of ISO/IEC 27001:2022, NIST CSF, OWASP Top 10, and SOC 2 Type II compliance.

**Regulatory Knowledge**- In depth knowledge of RBI Cybersecurity Framework, RBI Digital Lending Directions, and Indian Data Protection laws.

**Application Security**- Expertise in DevSecOps, API security, automated code scanners, tesseract/OCR pipeline security, and LLM/AI model deployment governance.

**Leadership**- Exceptional stakeholder management, board-level reporting, and experience negotiating security requirements with Tier-1 Bank CISOs.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer

Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹3,500,000.00 per year

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Global Process Owner Support (GPOS) role exists to strengthen first-line-of-defence risk management and governance across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes within Client Coverage. It supports Global Process Owners in embedding applicable policies, standards and controls into day-to-day business activities, helping the business manage operational and process risks consistently across markets. The role delivers oversight of control effectiveness, coordinated remediation of control gaps and exceptions, and clear reporting and escalation of material risks to support informed governance decisions. Working with business, country teams and second-line stakeholders, it also supports process simplification and the implementation of change with appropriate risk assessments and controls. Its primary focus is to maintain effective, consistent and efficient credit processes that support business delivery while operating within established risk tolerances.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

The role holder is an individual contributor with no formal people-management accountability. The role leads and coordinates assigned risk, control and process-improvement activities through stakeholder collaboration, supporting the Global Process Owner / delegate and GPOS Lead across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes. The role holder is accountable for the quality and timely delivery of assigned assessments, assurance oversight, reporting and remediation coordination; designated action owners remain responsible for completing their actions.
  
**Risk assessment and control implementation**  
• Implement applicable control requirements and procedures, and support each stage of the RCSA, from process and risk identification to monitoring implemented controls, at least annually and when trigger events occur, to maintain a current view of process and residual risks.
  
**Timely risk treatment**  
• Coordinate and track agreed elevated residual-risk actions and treatment plans with designated action owners, maintain records in the Group operational risk management system, and escalate delays to support timely completion.
  
**Learning from risk events**  
• Initiate Root Cause Reviews for in-scope material risk events and, where required, aggregate smaller events with similar root causes to identify recurring weaknesses and support corrective action.
  
**Controlled change delivery**  
• Identify delivery risks and dependencies, assess impacts on critical processes and residual risk, and review and support Operational and Change Risk Assessments and process-impact assessments before go-live, including minor changes where required.

**Broad Accountabilities**  
**Strategy**  
• Targeted Improvements: Work with internal stakeholders to identify gaps and improvement opportunities in credit processes, and lead assigned change and remediation activities to make processes more effective and streamlined.
  
• Support the GPO’s credit transformation agenda by translating agreed priorities into implementation activities and delivering assigned work within agreed timelines.
  
• Automation and Streamlining: Review operational efficiency, effectiveness and quality against changing business and customer needs, and identify actions to improve process performance.
  
• Drive continuous improvement and automation, and remove or simplify unnecessary process steps to improve efficiency and consistency across systems and processes.

**About Us :-**

*In a short span of 2.5 years since inception, Birla Pivot has evolved into a comprehensive B2B e-commerce platform offering integrated procurement and financial solutions that help businesses become efficient and grow. We offer products across 35 categories, 40,000+SKUs from 300+ brands across* ***Building Material, Chemicals & Metals****. We launched private labels in 3 categories : Tiles, Ply and Bath ware. With a robust network of suppliers and transporters, we have delivered to 4,000+ pin codes across 375 cities. Our customer base now spans top-tier EPC companies, civil contractors, real estate developers, OEMs, fabricators, manufacturing companies, dealers, and retailers. We connect Sellers, Buyers, Logistics service providers, Lending partners, Payment solution providers on a unified digital backbone thereby creating end to end visibility and providing a B2C like fulfilment experience for the B2B ecosystem.*

*The evolution of B2B ecommerce is expected to mirror the B2C ecommerce journey, where technology transformed discovery, pricing, fulfilment, and customer experience at scale. Digital penetration today in B2B ecommerce is still under* ***2%****, indicating massive headroom for scalable digital-first platforms. As the Aditya Birla Group, we are uniquely positioned to transform and shape the way commerce is done across these verticals by leveraging our deep industry expertise and scale. We have built a unique Quote based, Credit linked commerce journey that solves for the needs of B2B commerce with a diverse team that is a mix of deep industry expertise and experience of building complex technology platforms from the ground up. Our goal is to drive this digital adoption and create a distribution platform that can become* ***the most trusted B2B ecommerce platform in the country.***
  
  
***Why is this role exciting?***
  
  
***As our Security Engineer, you are the single hands-on owner of security operations and governance for Birla Pivot's cloud native B2B commerce platform —keeping every security KRI Green and closing audits with no major findings. In this role you get to:***
  
***?Own both sides of security —vulnerability, cloud posture, detection and access controls, and the policies, evidence and cadence that audits and the DPDP Act require.***
  
***?Shape how a high-growth business adopts AI securely, from the AI usage policy to reviews of every AI use case.***
  
***?Work closely with the Head of Cybersecurity, InfoSec & Cloud, the ABG central security team, legal and our vendors.***
  
  
***What will you do?***
  
  
***Security Operations & Incident Response***
  
  
***?Triage SIEM and EDR alerts daily; act as first responder for security incidents.***
  
***?Run incident response playbooks; prepare CERT-In reports within 6 hours of a reportable incident.***
  
***?Run tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews.***
  
  
***Vulnerability & Exposure Management***
  
***?Run vulnerability scanning across cloud, containers, code and endpoints; track remediation against SLA (Critical 7 days, High 30 days).***
  
***?Coordinate VAPT and red team engagements and drive findings to closure.***
  
***?Maintain WAF rules and virtual patching for internet-facing apps.***
  
  
***Endpoint, Patching & Resilience***
  
  
***?Keep EDR healthy on all endpoints and servers; validate patch compliance monthly.***
  
***?Verify backup restore tests and support DR drills.***
  
  
***Cloud Security (AWS)***
  
  
***?Monitor posture with Prisma Cloud, Security Hub and Prowler; fix critical misconfigurations within 72 hours.***
  
***?Review IAM, security groups, network ACLs and firewall rules weekly.***
  
***?Enforce encryption, logging, key rotation, MFA and least privilege.***
  
  
***Identity & Privileged Access***
  
  
***?Integrate IAM with the HR system for joiner-mover-leaver; disable leaver accounts within 24 hours.***
  
***?Run the monthly manager certification of off-role and contractor IDs, and quarterly access reviews.***
  
***?Onboard servers, databases and admin accounts to PAM; deploy LAPS and domain-only login.***
  
  
***ISO 27001, Policies & Audits***

***?Maintain the ISMS document set: policies, procedures, risk register, Statement of Applicability.***
  
***?Draft policy amendments for approval; keep the policy register current.***
  
***?Collect audit evidence for internal, external and ISO audits; track findings to closure.***
  
  
***Data Privacy & Vendor Risk***

***?Maintain the personal-data inventory and DPDP records with legal; implement technical controls (encryption, logging, erasure).***
  
***?Run vendor risk assessments and keep all vendor contracts in the central repository***
  
  
***Cadence, Reporting & Awareness***

***?Run the Friday SPOC and vendor ticket review; issue and close monthly, quarterly and half-yearly checklists.***
  
***?Prepare the monthly KRI pack and feed the central security dashboard (SIEM, VAPT, patching, DPDP, change, PAM).***
  
***?Publish the weekly infosec mailer; run trainings and phishing simulations.***
  
  
***AI Security & Governance***

***?Maintain the AI usage policy and the approved AI tools list —enterprise or ABG central accounts only, and no new AI initiative live without review.***
  
***?Run a security and privacy review for every AI use case: data shared, model and vendor, prompt injection, output handling, access rights.***
  
***?Detect and block unapproved AI tools through Zscaler logs; apply DLP so confidential and personal data stays out of public AI tools.***
  
***?Secure AI integrations against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications: least-privilege API keys, guardrails, logging, human approval for high-impact actions.***
  
***?Keep an AI use-case register for audit.***
  
  
***What success looks like in your first 6 months***

***?EDR coverage 98%; leaver accounts disabled within 24 hours, 100% of the time.***
  
***?No Critical vulnerability past its 7-day SLA. ?Critical log sources in SIEM with 180-day retention ( 95%).***
  
***? 95% of privileged accounts in PAM. ?Internal audit for ISO 27001 closed with no major technical findings.***
  
***?All monthly and quarterly checklists closed on time; weekly mailer running every week.***
  
***?AI usage policy published; every AI use case in the register with a completed risk review; no unapproved AI tools in use.***

***A Day In Life of a Security Engineer at Birla Pivot***

***Your day moves fast —from triaging the morning's SIEM and EDR alerts and chasing a Critical finding to closure, to fixing a cloud misconfiguration, reviewing a new AI use case with the product team, and pulling audit evidence together. At Birla Pivot, you operate at the pace of a high-growth business where every control counts.***

**What makes you a great fit?**

?3–5 years in security operations, vulnerability management or cloud security (at least 2 in cloud, AWS preferred).
  
?Hands-on AWS security: IAM, VPC, security groups, CloudTrail, GuardDuty or Security Hub, KMS.
  
?Working knowledge of SIEM, EDR, WAF and vulnerability scanners (e.g. Qualys, Prisma Cloud, Snyk).
  
?Understanding of ISO 27001 controls and audit evidence.
  
?Scripting in Python or Bash for automation.
  
?Experience preparing audit evidence, writing policies and running review cadences.
  
?Clear written communication for incident reports and audit responses

**Good to have**

?Certifications: AWS Certified Security –Specialty, CompTIA Security+, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor.
  
?Exposure to PAM (BeyondTrust, Arcon), Zscaler, Kubernetes security, DevSecOps pipelines (SAST, SCA, DAST).
  
?Knowledge of the DPDP Act 2023 and CERT-In directions.
  
?AI security: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, securing LLM APIs and AI agents.

Many businesses need funding to grow, manage cash flow or pursue new opportunities. Private credit can provide an alternative source of finance for companies whose needs are not fully met by traditional lenders.

We believe trust is earned over time through integrity, strong relationships and consistently delivering value.

In private credit, that means understanding borrowers’ needs, assessing risk carefully and building responsible, long-term relationships with both clients and capital partners.

You will lead the business, with access to experienced business builders, domain experts and capital across the Hamilton Bradshaw MENA ecosystem.

jobs.title: Head of Organic Growth, Kraken Pro
jobs.description:
**Building the Future of Open Finance**
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
  
  
**The team**
Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world’s longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. Offering spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
  
  
Kraken Pro is where serious traders live. Millions of them. But a great product only wins if the right traders find it, trust it, and actually fund an account. Right now, our organic engine isn’t pulling its weight.
  
  
You’re going to fix that.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re seeking a hands-on Head of Organic Growth to own how Kraken Pro gets discovered and how curious traders become active ones. At Kraken, understanding our brand ethos, mission, and the traders we serve is essential. Organic is where brand and acquisition meet.
  
  
We’re looking for a player-coach who moves fast but thinks long-term, gets in the weeds while leading from the front, and knows that traffic means nothing if it doesn’t convert. This role demands sharp B2C acquisition instincts, a product-first mindset, an obsession with UX, and a self-starter attitude.
  
  

* Own organic acquisition. Build and run the strategy across SEO, content, social, community, referrals, and partnerships to bring high-intent traders to Kraken Pro.
* Find out if people convert. Map the funnel from first touch to first trade, report on it clearly, and figure out where traders drop off and how to win them back.
* Make UX your edge. Work with Product and Design to audit and improve landing pages, sign-up flows, onboarding, and in-product moments. Great acquisition dies in bad UX, and you know it.
* Acquire through brand. Make every growth channel a brand-building one. Reach is easy to buy; trust is what makes traders stay.
* Know the product cold. Use Kraken Pro like a trader would, understand what makes it better, and turn those strengths into growth levers.
* Lead a lean, scrappy team. Set direction, coach, and unblock a small team, while staying hands-on enough to ship, test, and fix things yourself.
* Test and learn. Run experiments across channels and funnel steps, double down on what works, and kill what doesn’t.
* Report what matters. Build clear dashboards and insights that show leadership what’s driving growth, what isn’t, and what to do next.
* Ship responsibly. Partner with Legal/Comms to ensure compliant, accurate, and aligned messaging across regions and platforms.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 5+ years in B2C acquisition or growth marketing, ideally in fintech, crypto, trading or gaming with experience in a player-coach role leading a small team.
* Product savvy. You understand how products work, why people use them, and how to turn features into growth.
* UX instinct. You can spot friction in a flow from a mile away and brief Product and Design on how to fix it.
* High AI competency. Enabling you to multiply your impact and keep up with demand.
* Analytical rigor. Comfortable with funnels, cohorts, attribution, and experimentation, and able to turn data into decisions and clear stories.
* Speed under pressure. Markets don’t wait for approval cycles and neither do you.
* Range as a marketer. SEO, content, social, lifecycle, partnerships. You know enough about each to direct the work, and you can roll up your sleeves when needed.
* Taste. Knowing which channels and tactics not to pursue is as valuable as knowing which to scale.
* Familiarity trading culture, and the language traders use.
* Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to align cross-functional teams around a shared growth goal.

*Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.*
*Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.*
*We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.*
**Our commitment**
Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.
  
  
We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.
  
  
As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Marketing Campaign Lead
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose:**

The
**Marketing Campaign Lead**
is responsible for translating du Pay's commercial and product strategies into integrated, measurable customer campaigns that drive activation, engagement, retention and cross-sell. The role owns end-to-end campaign planning and execution across performance, paid and owned media, CRM, affiliates, influencers, SEO, content and offline channels, including agency coordination, marketing-budget allocation and campaign-performance optimisation. Working closely with
**Commercial, Product, Marketing Strategy, Analytics and other internal teams, the role uses customer segmentation, campaign data, experimentation and performance insights to continuously improve conversion from onboarding to active usage, retain customers and increase adoption of multiple du Pay products**

**Onboarding → activation | Retention | Cross-sell**

**Key Accountabilities for the Role**

**Campaign Planning and Go-to-Market Execution**

* Own the end-to-end campaign calendar and launch plans, translating agreed commercial, product and marketing strategies into executable campaigns.
* Define campaign objectives, target audiences, messaging requirements, channel mix, budgets, timelines and success measures.
* Coordinate campaign and launch readiness across Commercial, Product, Analytics, Technology, Operations, Legal and Compliance.
* Manage multiple product and customer campaigns simultaneously, prioritising activity against agreed commercial objectives.

**Integrated Multi-Channel Campaign Execution**

* Execute acquisition, activation, engagement, retention and cross-sell campaigns across paid and owned digital media, in-app placements, push notifications, email, SMS and landing pages.
* Coordinate ATL and BTL activities, including outdoor, broadcast, retail and field activations, where relevant.
* Manage performance marketing activities across relevant paid digital channels and coordinate affiliate, influencer, SEO and content-led activation.
* Adapt campaigns to relevant customer segments, languages, communication preferences and channels.

**Customer Activation, Retention and Cross-Sell**

* Develop and execute campaigns that improve conversion from customer onboarding to active usage.
* Design engagement and retention campaigns that increase active customer participation and reduce preventable churn.
* Drive cross-sell and upsell campaigns that encourage customers to adopt additional du Pay products and services.
* Use approved customer segments, behavioural data and campaign insights to define audiences, targeting and personalisation.
* Develop lifecycle campaigns that move customers from onboarding through activation, repeat usage, multi-product adoption and retention.

**Campaign Performance, Experimentation and Optimization**

* Define campaign KPIs and measurement requirements prior to launch.
* Track performance across conversion, activation, engagement, retention, cross-sell and relevant commercial measures.
* Apply campaign attribution, funnel analysis and A/B testing to evaluate audience, channel, offer, messaging and creative performance.
* Test campaign variations and optimise live campaigns based on performance data.
* Conduct structured post-campaign reviews and apply learning to future campaigns and launches.
* Share campaign and customer-response insights with Marketing Strategy, Product and Commercial teams to support future proposition and product decisions.

**Marketing Budget and Commercial Performance**

* Manage an annual marketing and campaign budgets in millions, including campaign planning, allocation, forecasting and spend tracking.
* Allocate investment across performance marketing, paid media, affiliates, influencers, content, ATL, BTL and other campaign channels based on agreed commercial priorities.
* Monitor budget utilisation, campaign effectiveness and return on marketing investment, recommending reallocation of spend based on performance.
* Track campaign results against agreed KPIs, with particular focus on onboarding-to-activation conversion, customer retention and cross-sell.
* Use campaign attribution, funnel analysis and performance data to identify underperforming activity and optimise investment.
* Partner with Commercial, Analytics and Finance on campaign performance reporting, budget governance and commercial outcome.

**Creative, Agency and Content Delivery**

* Lead campaign briefs for external agencies in coordination with du Group Marketing and Communications.
* Translate agreed audience, proposition, positioning and messaging into actionable creative, media and content briefs.
* Review campaign concepts, customer communications and creative executions against campaign objectives and audience requirements.
* Manage agency deliverables, production schedules, campaign assets and deadlines.
* Ensure campaign communications are adapted appropriately for customer segments, languages, communication preferences and channels.

**Governance, Brand and Cross-Functional Delivery**

* Coordinate with du Group Marketing and Communications to ensure campaigns align with brand standards, communication requirements and relevant du channels.
* Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics, Technology and Operations to deliver campaigns against agreed priorities.
* Work with Legal, Compliance and relevant control functions to validate campaign offers, claims, terms, conditions and disclosures before release.
* Maintain campaign governance, approvals and delivery milestones from campaign brief through launch and post-campaign review.

**Must have required Qualifications**

* Minimum bachelor’s degree (psychology is preferred) or any other business marketing and communication.
* MBA is preferred.

**Must have required Experience**

* Proven experience of at least 5 years in growth marketing, customer segmentation, and retention, preferably in the fintech, e-commerce, or other consumer digital business, or mobile wallet industry.

**Must have Skills**

* A track record of leading multi-channel product launches spanning paid digital, CRM or in-app marketing, and offline activations.
* Strong understanding of acquisition and activation funnels, campaign attribution, and A/B testing.
* Able to manage multiple launches and coordinate effectively across commercial, product, creative, and compliance teams.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis and interpretation.
* Excellent understanding of mobile wallet technologies and the fintech landscape.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive results.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
* Proficiency in data analytics tools and marketing.

The CTO is a senior executive responsible for defining and governing the company’s overall technology strategy, ensuring alignment with business growth, regulatory requirements, and investor expectations. This role operates at the enterprise level, owning strategic direction, technology risk mitigation, organisational performance and delivery outcomes through accountable senior leaders.

The CTO is a core member of the executive leadership team, reporting to the CEO and working closely with the executive team, with regular engagement with the Board, regulators and investors. Success in this role is defined by long-term platform scalability, resilience and commercial value creation.

This is a strategy-first executive role with accountability for delivery and production outcomes through senior leaders, requiring technical judgement and leadership at Board and regulator level. Day-to-day coding and engineering execution sit with the engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technology Strategy & Executive Leadership**

* Define and maintain a multi-year technology strategy aligned with company growth, product expansion, and geographic scale.
* Own the technology roadmap at executive level, ensuring clear prioritisation aligned to commercial outcomes.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the CEO, Board, and investors.
* Translate complex technology topics into clear business decisions for non-technical stakeholders.
* Lead company-wide AI governance and adoption, shape AI and data strategy with business leaders and specialists, and own the supporting technology delivery.

**Architecture Governance & Technical Accountability**

* Maintain governance frameworks for platform architecture, ensuring scalability, resilience, and future readiness.
* Challenge and approve major architectural decisions and investment trade-offs, holding architecture and engineering leaders accountable for sound design and implementation.
* Ensure technology standards are defined and adhered to across all engineering and platform teams.

**Regulatory, Risk & Compliance Ownership**

* Own technology risk identification, mitigation and reporting, working with the CRO, who owns the enterprise risk register.
* Act as the primary interface with regulators (e.g., central bank authorities) on all technology-related matters.
* Ensure full compliance with regulatory technology requirements, including timelines, audits, and controls.
* Be accountable for cybersecurity posture, operational resilience and technical data custody, supporting enterprise data governance with the accountable business owners.

**Commercial & Financial Accountability**

* Own technology financial planning, including budgeting, cost optimisation, and investment prioritisation.
* Establish and maintain platform cost models (e.g., cost per transaction, cost per user) and ensure alignment with unit economics.
* Partner with the CFO to ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
* Lead technology input into investor discussions, due diligence processes, and funding activities.

**Technology Organisation and Sourcing Leadership**

* Build on and strengthen the established technology organisation, delivering through a lean internal team and external engineering partners, with further organisational changes driven by demonstrated business needs.
* Lead engineering, architecture, delivery, technology operations, DevOps/SRE and cybersecurity through accountable senior leaders.
* Set performance expectations and accountability frameworks across senior technology leaders.
* Build a culture of ownership, governance, and execution discipline at leadership level.
* Own build-versus-buy decisions, engineering-partner performance and controlled supplier transitions.

**Governance & Operational Oversight**

* Maintain and strengthen enterprise governance frameworks covering change control, incident management, and operational risk.
* The CTO is accountable for technology delivery, production performance and transformation outcomes through senior leaders, without personally coding, managing sprints or owning team backlogs.
* Ensure organisational readiness for scale, audits, and external scrutiny.

**Investor & Board Engagement**

* Present technology strategy, risks, and investment cases directly to Board members and investors.
* Ensure the technology function is fully prepared for external due diligence.
* Provide transparency on risks, trade-offs, and investment requirements.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* Established CTO, or CIO with equivalent scope, with substantive executive accountability in regulated fintech or financial services, and a proven record of independently leading the full technology function, including software engineering, through growth and transformation.
* Proven experience leading regulated wallet or payments platforms, with sound judgement across transaction integrity, reconciliation, settlement and partner integrations.
* Proven experience protecting live payments while building and safely migrating to new platforms, delivering through internal teams and external partners, with measurable improvements in reliability, delivery speed and cost.
* Demonstrated track record of scaling technology platforms through significant growth phases.
* Experience operating at Board and investor level, including direct engagement on strategy and risk.
* Strong understanding of regulatory environments and technology compliance obligations.
* Experience leading the full technology function through senior leadership teams, with accountability for delivery, operations, architecture and security.

**Skills and Characteristics**

* Executive-level thinker with the ability to connect technology decisions to commercial outcomes.
* Strong governance and risk management mindset.
* Ability to operate effectively with ambiguity at enterprise scale.
* Clear and confident communicator at Board and investor level.
* High level of accountability and ownership for outcomes.
* Technically credible across platform architecture, payments and engineering, able to challenge designs, make sound decisions, and hold engineering to account, without being hands-on.

**What This Role Is**

* A C-suite CTO role with executive ownership of strategy, governance, business alignment and technology outcomes.
* An executive leadership position, driving outcomes through accountable senior leaders and intervening where material decisions, risks or performance require it.
* A role with executive accountability for technology risk, technology-related regulatory compliance and transparent Board and investor reporting.

**What This Role Is Not**

* This is not a hands-on engineering or architecture role.
* This role does not involve direct coding, sprint management, or backlog ownership.
* This is not an engineering manager or individual contributor position.

**Key Stakeholders**

* CEO
* CFO
* CPO
* COO
* CRO
* Board of Directors
* Investors
* Regulatory Authorities

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer, SC Ventures (MyZoi)
jobs.description:

myZoi is an exciting fintech start-up aiming to promote financial inclusion globally. Our vision is to provide a level playing field to the unbanked and the underbanked in accessing essential financial services in an affordable, convenient, and transparent fashion. We are looking for smart, ambitious, and purpose driven individuals to join us in this journey.
  
  
This is an opportunity to join myZoi as a Chief Technology Officer. The role will be based in the UAE.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business**

* Working with the CEO, CPO, Product Owners, and partners to lead technology build, evaluate technology trade-offs, oversee vendor engineering engagements, and deliver features and capabilities aligned to the business model to build on the minimum viable product (MVP) to successful global rollout.
* The Chief Technology Officer will discuss with partners, fintechs, co-creation clients, and business to expand the Company’s product offering and geographical footprint.

**Skills And Experience**

The role holder is authorised to manage and operate within the scope of the roles and responsibilities outlined above. Role holders are not authorised beyond the scope of this job description unless they have a formal delegation of authority.

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager - HAL
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
**About SC Ventures**
**SC Ventures is Standard Chartered ’s innovation, fintech investment and ventures arm. We were established to reinvent banking, as the significant technological disruptions to the industry was impacting its ability to serve clients and customers, in the ways they needed to be served. We are a unique ecosystem of innovators, banking experts, business builders and partners who are focused on rewiring the DNA in banking and bringing breakthrough ideas to scale, together. We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy & Lifestyle, SMEs & World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability & Inclusion. We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates**
**About HAL**
**HAL is a B2B domestic and cross border marketplace being built for SMEs in the UAE. Incubated by SC Ventures, the ventures arm of Standard Chartered Bank, the platform will enable digital commerce and access to financial & value-added services. HAL’s vision is to act as a super glue connecting multiple partners & ecosystems by bringing together buyers, sellers, financial institutions, logistics partners under one roof. We are building this as an agentic AI native stack along with several strategic partners in the UAE who bring different capabilities into the platform.**
**SMEs are the backbone of the UAE economy and vital for economic growth and diversification. We want to help SMEs grow profitably, safely and with ease. Hal is being built for scale with the latest technologies and with a vision to truly become the one stop shop for SMEs. We are looking to launch later in the year.**
**The Senior Marketing Manager will lead HAL's marketing function, working closely with the CEO and the commercial, product and partnerships teams. This is a commercially driven role: success is measured by the qualified B2B leads you generate (sellers, buyers and SMEs looking for finance), the revenue they bring in, and HAL's growing share of the UAE SME market. You will be hands-on and highly experimental, testing new channels and ideas quickly, doubling down on what works, and doing whatever it takes to help HAL win in the market.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Develop and own HAL's go-to-market marketing plan, turning business targets for sellers, buyers and finance referrals into lead generation goals, channel priorities and budget.
* Run a structured test-and-learn approach: set clear hypotheses, launch quick experiments across channels, measure results, and scale what works.
* Build simple, reliable full-funnel reporting covering leads, cost per lead, conversion to onboarded users and revenue, and share insights and recommendations with leadership regularly.
* Plan a rolling quarterly marketing calendar aligned to HAL's launch milestones and key UAE moments (e.g. Ramadan, National Day, major trade exhibitions).
* Lead, coach and develop the marketing team, working as one team with sales, product and partnerships to hit shared growth targets.

**Business**

* Own B2B lead generation for HAL: build a predictable pipeline of qualified sellers, buyers and SMEs needing finance (e.g. trade finance, working capital, invoice discounting), and ensure smooth handover to the commercial team.
* Agree with the sales team on the ideal customer profile, lead qualification criteria, and a shared process for lead handover and follow-up.
* Drive seller and buyer acquisition for the marketplace launch, and support activation campaigns so that new users start trading on the platform.
* Partner with banks, logistics, payments and other strategic partners on co-marketing campaigns and joint lead generation.
* Manage the marketing budget with discipline, tracking cost per lead and return on spend and moving budget to the best-performing channels.

**Processes**
**Lead Generation & Performance Marketing**

* Plan, launch and optimise paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, Meta and regional platforms, owning cost per lead, conversion rates and return on ad spend.
* Continuously experiment with new acquisition channels, such as WhatsApp campaigns, outbound email sequences, account-based marketing for high-value accounts, partner referrals and B2B directories.
* Build landing pages, lead forms and email and WhatsApp nurture journeys that turn interest into qualified leads.
* Set up and manage the core marketing tools (e.g. CRM and marketing automation such as HubSpot) and tracking so every lead can be traced back to its source.
* Grow HAL's organic visibility through SEO and content, including in AI-assisted search.

**Events & Field Marketing**

* Plan and deliver HAL's events programme: launch events, SME workshops, roundtables, webinars and networking sessions.
* Represent HAL at relevant trade shows and industry events across the UAE, making sure every event produces qualified leads with clear follow-up.
* Build relationships with chambers of commerce, trade associations, free zones and SME programmes to reach SMEs at scale.

**Thought Leadership, Content & PR**

* Build a thought leadership programme that positions HAL and its leaders as trusted voices on SME growth, B2B trade and trade finance in the UAE.
* Manage leadership's LinkedIn presence and secure speaking slots, panels and media interviews.
* Create content that educates and converts, such as articles, guides, case studies, newsletters, short videos and webinars, in English and Arabic where needed.
* Manage PR and media relations for launches and milestones, working with agencies where needed.

**Brand & Sales Enablement**
  
  

+ Establish HAL's brand positioning, key messages and visual identity, and keep them consistent across all touchpoints.
+ Create sales materials, such as pitch decks, one-pagers and case studies, that help the commercial team convert leads.
+ Gather customer and market insights (feedback, competitor moves, win/loss reasons) to sharpen messaging and targeting.

**Risk Management**

* Continuously evaluate agency roster to ensure that right agencies are onboarded while accommodating within the budget requirements

**Governance**

* Ensure compliance with all SCB and venture governance frameworks.
* Manage the function within budgetary constraints, seeking operational efficiencies

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Internal: CEO, CCO, COO, Head of digital commerce, Head of Financial Services, Head of partnerships.
* External: Relevant external regulator

**Other Responsibilities**

* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the business and SC Ventures;
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.

**Skills And Experience**

* Marketing
* Branding
* Marketing Channels
* Planning : Tactical & Strategic
* Marketing Strategy & Positioning
* Brand Management

**Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of marketing experience, including at least 3 years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing.
* Highly commercially driven, with a proven track record of generating B2B leads and pipeline and a clear link to revenue (e.g. lead volume, cost per lead, conversion, revenue impact).
* Strong startup or scale-up background, with experience building marketing from the ground up in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
* Experimental minds
