jobs.title: Product Manager I
jobs.description:
Take a step forward and let Edenred surprise you.

Every day, we deliver innovative solutions to improve the life of millions of people, connecting employees, companies, and merchants all around the world.

We know there are hundred ways for you to grow. With us, you will expand your skills in a multicultural, challenging, and dynamic environment.

**Dare to join Edenred and get ready to thrive in a global company that will offer you endless opportunities.**

Edenred is all about meritocracy. You come as you are, and you contribute. Indeed, the Edenred Group recognizes, recruits and develops all talents and singularities.

We are committed to preventing all forms of discrimination and to providing all our candidates with equal opportunities regardless of their gender and gender expression, disability, origin, religious belief and sexual orientation or any other criteria.

**About Edenred**

Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.

Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.

Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.

True to the Group's purpose, “Enrich connections. For good.”, these solutions enhance users' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.

Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.

In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.

Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.

  

**The UAE CONTEXT**

Edenred UAE is a fast-growing payroll service provider serving more than 20,000 businesses and more than 2.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions.

We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll, and for employees to receive their salaries and use them in the simplest way — through multiple value-added services in our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge, card services and more).

  

**THE ROLE**

Most of our users receive their salary on a card we issue, send money home through our app, and pay for their week with a product our team built. For a large share of them, we are their first and only financial relationship. That raises the stakes on every decision — and makes this one of the more interesting product jobs in the region.

You will own product strategy and delivery for a product area inside an organisation that has the autonomy of a startup and the reach of a multinational. You set direction for your area, shape its strategy, and make day-to-day calls that are demonstrably aligned to a clear product vision — with the coaching and air cover to get it right.

Depending on where the business needs you most, you might begin in financial crime and compliance — making onboarding fast without weakening controls, catching fraud earlier, turning regulatory requirements into changes engineering can actually build. Or you might begin on the consumer side — remittance, cards, wallet, lending — working acquisition, activation, retention and monetisation problems for 2.2 million people.

The PMs who do best here are the ones who can hold a regulatory constraint and a growth funnel in their head at the same time.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own a product area. Identify the levers and problems that matter, build a now / next / later roadmap you can defend against real resource constraints, and treat company resources as your own.

* Set and evangelise a vision. Make sure your decisions and your squad's decisions stay aligned to it, and that everyone can explain the “why” without you in the room.

* Lead discovery. Decide independently what to ask and who to ask, know when research is and isn't needed, and turn what you learn into decisions rather than decks.

* De-risk deliberately. Define the riskiest assumptions behind an initiative, prioritise them, and pick the right test for each — balancing speed against certainty instead of defaulting to trial and error.

* Use data properly. Judge which metrics matter, read experiment results honestly, and make confident scale-or-pivot calls. You self-serve across Excel, CleverTap and SQL.

* Ship with engineering. Write crisp PRDs, mitigate feasibility risk early, hold the bar on specifications, and clear blockers before they bite.

* Drive outcomes, not output. Take initiatives, objectives and key results to completion on time, and be honest about what moved and what didn't.

* Work the room. Frame ambiguous problems, facilitate strong problem-solving discussions, manage stakeholder expectations, and pull in senior leaders when that's what unblocks the outcome.

* Communicate top-down. Present a cohesive narrative to data, design, engineering and senior business audiences, and make the trade-offs legible.

Stay close to a unique customer. Our users are underbanked, often first-time app users, sending money to families across several corridors. Every decision comes back to what they're trying to achieve.  

  

**YOUR PROFILE**

* 3+ years in product management - with a track record of independently owning a product or product area and shipping.

* Evidence you moved the numbers - KPIs and OKRs that mattered, not just features that launched.

* Range - Comfort operating in a regulated environment and appetite for consumer growth problems. Experience in payments, fintech, fraud, compliance or high-scale consumer products is a plus, not a requirement.

* Strong analytical instincts - You can set sensible thresholds, spot risk in data, size an opportunity, and check whether something is actually working.

* Technical fluency - Enough to discuss APIs, automation and trade-offs with engineers and be taken seriously.

* Excellent organisation, judgment and attention to detail - you can operate without direction.

* Communication and influence - You drive consensus, articulate recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, and write specs engineers can build from without guessing.

Beyond the craft, we care a lot about how you work:

* Ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, speak up when something looks wrong, and follow through on what you commit to.

* Collaboration — you listen actively, build trust across teams, and bring people along rather than pushing work over the wall.

* Problem solving — creative and structured, using both data and judgment to land on an answer.

* Drive — proactive and entrepreneurial; you clear your own obstacles and ask for help early when you're stuck.

* Curiosity — genuinely interested in users, and in how the product works under the hood.

Senior candidates will also be expected to coach and mentor junior product managers, review their work, and contribute to hiring.

  

**REPORTING STRUCTURE**

Reporting to: Product Lead / Senior Product Manager, depending on the area you join.

Working with: Engineering, Design, Data, Compliance,

jobs.title: Executive Manager - Technology Modernisation
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Executive Manager – Technology Modernisation
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
ASB is one of New Zealand’s leading banks and a wholly owned subsidiary of the Commonwealth Bank of Australia. This role sits within CBA India and is dedicated to ASB — you will build and lead ASB’s India-based engineering capability, working shoulder to shoulder with ASB Technology leaders in NZ. ASB is mid-flight in a generational modernisation of its technology, data and digital estate. The agenda is set and owned by ASB’s leadership in New Zealand; India’s job is to bring the engineering depth that accelerates it. The portfolio spans migrating the core to SAP TRBK and simplifying the legacy HOST estate, modernising cards across issuing and acquiring, the full payments technology agenda, scaling Pega across decisioning, workflow, lending and financial crime, modernising the data estate onto a cloud data platform, and re-platforming integration.
  
  
Underpinning all of it are CBA Group engineering foundations — cloud-first architecture, Golden Pathways and DevSecOps, automation-first testing, and AI-powered engineering at scale. This is not a support function. It is real engineering accountability, delivered from India.
  
  
You will lead ASB’s India-based engineering capability — engineers, platform and architecture specialists, testing, data and delivery talent — organised into squads that sit inside ASB’s tribes and into chapters that hold the engineering craft. The teams operate as a genuine extension of ASB, not a resource pool: named outcomes, shared tribe governance and cadence, common engineering standards, and direct partnership with ASB tribe leads, product owners, architecture, risk and operations across both geographies.
  
  
**Impact & Contribution:**
As Executive Manager – Technology Modernisation, you lead the India engineering capability that delivers across ASB’s modernisation portfolio — SAP TRBK core migration and legacy simplification, Cards Modernisation, the payments technology agenda, and the Pega estate — together with the cloud, integration, data and quality engineering that make them land. You will work in genuine partnership with the ASB New Zealand leaders who own the modernisation agenda, translating their roadmaps into executable engineering plans, mobilising squads inside ASB tribes, setting and holding the engineering bar, and carrying delivery, operational and regulatory risk for what India commits to.
  
  
Success is a world-class engineering capability across these domains — one that measurably accelerates ASB’s modernisation journey, delivers to committed timelines, holds the compliance and regulatory bar without exception, takes risk out of complex migrations, and does it at materially better cost. Alongside the immediate commitments, you will build the longer-term edge: automation-first quality engineering, AI-powered engineering, and the engineering depth that lets ASB retire legacy with confidence.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Lead India’s engineering capability across core banking, cards, payments, Pega, data and integration, translating ASB New Zealand’s modernisation roadmap into clear, sequenced delivery plans with measurable outcomes.
* Build outcome-led engineering squads and chapters integrated with ASB tribes, with clear accountability across software, platform, cloud, data and quality engineering.
* Set and uphold engineering excellence, embedding cloud-first architecture, API-led and event-driven integration, Golden Pathways, DevSecOps, CI/CD automation, security controls and measurable engineering standards.
* Make automation and quality engineering a core strength, establishing reusable test frameworks and large-scale migration testing to reduce manual regression, accelerate delivery and protect customer outcomes.
* Drive major modernisation programmes, including SAP TRBK core migration, legacy HOST transformation, Cards Modernisation and enterprise Pega, while managing complex migration, cutover and cross-platform dependencies.
* Build a resilient, always-on payments capability spanning domestic and cross-border payments, real-time processing, switching, settlement, reconciliation, observability and incident readiness.
* Lead AI-powered engineering adoption, using generative and agentic AI for software development, testing, legacy comprehension, migration, knowledge discovery and operational support, with strong governance, responsible-use guardrails and measurable benefits.
* Own the India engineering operating model, including resilience, security, regulatory readiness, cost, risk, talent and capability building, while creating a high-performance culture and strong partnership across India and New Zealand.

**Essential Skills:**

Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony, led by the Head of IAM reporting to the CISO, oversees key security functions. Direct reports specialize in authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This structure ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will be a direct report into the Head of IAM.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Synchrony Identity and Access Management (IAM) team is seeking an experienced IAM End User Operations leader to oversee and drive the operations and support of End User IAM Services. This role will lead a team responsible for delivering secure, efficient, and seamless identity and access management experiences for our end users across the organization. Acting as a critical bridge between technology, security, and business stakeholders, you will ensure operational excellence of IAM solutions, streamline user lifecycle processes, and enhance service delivery aligned with our digital transformation goals.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The ideal candidate for this role will embrace the exciting blend of technical expertise, program management, engagement ability and leadership that is required to be successful.
  
  
Specifically,
  
  

* Lead and manage the IAM End User Operations team focused on End User Services, including IAM automation engineers, administrators, and support specialists.
* Oversee day-to-day operations of user identity lifecycle management, access provisioning/de-provisioning, access reviews, self-service workflows, and password management tools.
* Drive continuous improvement in IAM operations by optimizing automation, workflows, and integration with IT service management (ITSM) platforms.
* Collaborate closely with IAM Solution Architects, Security, IT infrastructure, and business partners to ensure operational readiness, platform health, and scalability of IAM solutions.
* Develop and enforce operational standards, SLAs, and KPIs to monitor service performance and user experience quality.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and problem resolution efforts related to end-user identity and access issues.
* Ensure compliance with security policies, privacy regulations, and audit requirements (SOX, GDPR, PCI, NIST).
* Champion adoption of best practices around zero trust, privileged access, and identity governance in daily operations.
* Provide leadership, mentorship, and professional development opportunities for the operations team.
* Partner with automation and DevSecOps teams to deploy and maintain infrastructure-as-code and automated IAM provisioning processes.
* Facilitate communication and training for end-users and support teams to improve IAM awareness and compliance.
* Stay current with emerging IAM operational technologies, tools, and industry trends to continuously enhance the IAM service portfolio.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 10+ years of IT experience with a minimum of 8 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.
* Proven experience leading or managing teams responsible for IAM service delivery, identity lifecycle management, and end-user access support.
* Strong communication skills and executive presence needed.
* Knowledge of IAM tool platforms used for standard and privileged access management as well as authentication (ie. Delinea, Okta, SailPoint IIQ)
* Strong working knowledge of IAM tools such as SailPoint, Okta, Beyond Identity, Delinea, Microsoft Entra ID, and directory services like Active Directory.
* Experience managing identity provisioning, password resets, authentication services, and access governance activities at scale.
* Solid understanding of identity protocols (SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, LDAP, SCIM) in operational contexts.
* Familiarity with cloud IAM models (AWS, Azure, GCP) and integrating hybrid IAM ecosystems operationally.
* Knowledge of automation tools and DevSecOps principles applied in IAM environments (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD).
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with proven stakeholder management experience.
* Demonstrated commitment to exceptional customer service and continuous operational improvement.
* Experience working within regulatory frameworks affecting IAM operations such as SOX IT-404, GDPR, PCI, and financial industry controls.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, Okta Certified Administrator, SailPoint IdentityIQ Engineer, or similar.
* Experience managing large-scale IAM operational teams in financial services or regulated industries.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust principles as applied to IAM operations.
* Self-starter, able to adapt and thrive in a fast-changing, dynamic environment.

**Eligibility Criteria**

**Job Title: AI Migration Lead**
If you’re looking to take an exciting new direction with your HSBC career, an internal move can open the door to many opportunities, allowing you to take on a new challenge, and develop your skills. Bring your knowledge of our brand to a new role and grow yourself further.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of ‘AI Migration Lead’ -
**this role may be based in Bangalore, Gurgaon, Hyderabad or Kolkata.**
This is a pivotal leadership role at the heart of the R&C AI agenda, turning strategy into action and accelerating the delivery of AI-driven outcomes across the organisation. As AI Enablement Lead, you’ll lead the central AI Migration team, connecting deep business expertise with agentic AI delivery and enabling Value Streams to move from ambition to impact at pace.
  
  
A move across the business allows you to continue to access tailored professional development opportunities, and our fantastic benefits packages.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own the R&C AI portfolio strategy and prioritisation, working closely with the R&C CAIO to translate top-down strategy and target outcomes into an executable, portfolio-level roadmap. Aggregate value and delivery progress from across Value Streams to portfolio level, and instrument the relevant benefit metrics (efficiency & capacity, adoption & maturity) feeding the R&C CAIO's overall benefit-tracking framework.
* Own the prioritisation and escalation mechanism across Value Streams: chair a regular portfolio prioritisation forum with Value Stream Product Owners and Value Stream AI Leads, and escalate unresolved conflicts to the R&C CAIO. Lead the AI Migration team: a central, flexible technical pool deployed into Value Streams on a solid-line basis to this role, with a dotted-line working relationship into the Value Stream while deployed.
* Ensure the AI Migration team operates as the bridge between business SMEs and agentic architecture translating and migrating manual or semi-manual tasks into governed, agentic and automated workflows. Partner with Group Technology and the Group AI Platform function, including the Architecture Lead capability, to ensure portfolio delivery aligns to Group tooling, platform and architecture standards.
* Partner with the Re-engineering team and the Knowledge Management Enablement Lead as shared capabilities supporting the migration agenda. Enable, R&C Value Streams Product Owners and Leads to deliver against set targets.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Technical leadership: Background in analytics, data, engineering, AI or a closely related technical discipline, with credibility to lead multidisciplinary technical delivery teams. Able to challenge technical approaches, delivery plans, dependencies and trade-offs with credibility.
* AI-enabled process transformation: Demonstrable experience re-engineering complex business processes and translating them into automation or AI-enabled solutions, ideally within Risk, Compliance, Financial Crime or Controls. Scaled technical delivery: Proven experience leading multiple technical pods across concurrent delivery streams, bringing together engineering, product, data/AI and business SMEs to deliver complex outcomes. Portfolio ownership and prioritisation: Experience owning and prioritising a portfolio of AI, automation or technology opportunities, making decisions across competing demands based on value, feasibility, risk, dependencies and delivery capacity.
* Agentic AI delivery: Strong practical understanding of agentic AI delivery models, with experience translating business problems into AI use cases and working with engineering teams to move solutions from concept into delivery and adoption. Forward-deployed engineering: Experience of, or strong exposure to, forward-deployed engineering approaches, where technical teams work directly with business SMEs to understand complex workflows and rapidly translate problems into deployable solutions.
* Risk & Compliance: Strong experience operating with senior stakeholders in Risk & Compliance or a comparable regulated financial services environment, with an understanding of the governance, risk and control considerations surrounding AI delivery. Strategy through execution: Demonstrable ability to operate at both portfolio and technical delivery level, translating AI strategy into a prioritised delivery agenda while remaining sufficiently close to execution to challenge, unblock and accelerate delivery.

**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Senior Manager, IT Delivery leads globally distributed technology teams responsible for delivering and operating business-critical platforms, products, and digital experiences supporting Financial Advisor Services. The role partners with Product, Business, Architecture, Operations, and Technology leaders to shape demand, establish priorities, and translate strategy into reliable, scalable business outcomes.
  
  
This leader is accountable for end-to-end software delivery, engineering excellence, operational resilience, security, talent development, and vendor performance. The role will support the continued evolution of advisor and model-portfolio capabilities while preparing teams to adopt modern cloud, automation, data, and AI-enabled engineering practices.
  
  
As the organization evolves, the role is expected to expand its leadership scope across advisor-facing digital experiences, including modern front-end technologies and Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). Experience in this area is preferred and strongly recommended.
  
  
**Leadership opportunity:**
Build high-performing teams, modernize advisor-facing technology, and help shape the next generation of scalable digital and AI-enabled capabilities within FAST.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, develop, and inspire high-performing engineering and technology teams responsible for delivering business-critical platforms, products, and services supporting advisor and investment solutions.
* Drive execution of strategic technology initiatives, ensuring alignment with business priorities, modernization objectives, client outcomes, and long-term platform roadmaps.
* Oversee end-to-end delivery across the software development lifecycle, ensuring solutions are delivered with quality, reliability, scalability, accessibility, and strong operational readiness.
* Partner with Product, Business, Architecture, User Experience, Operations, Risk, and Technology leaders to shape demand, establish priorities, manage dependencies, and deliver measurable business value.
* Establish and monitor delivery, service-health, reliability, security, and engineering-effectiveness measures while driving continuous improvement across teams.
* Build and manage globally distributed teams by hiring, coaching, mentoring, and developing technology professionals while fostering accountability, inclusion, innovation, and continuous learning.

* Guide the evolution of modern front-end and content-management capabilities, including future expansion into Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), in partnership with architecture, product, design, and engineering leaders.
* Drive operational excellence by improving controls, reducing technology risk, strengthening release readiness, managing vulnerabilities, and ensuring compliance with security, privacy, risk, and governance expectations.
* Provide oversight for incident response, production health, root-cause analysis, and sustainable corrective actions for business-critical services.
* Manage vendor and third-party relationships, ensuring clear accountability, effective capacity planning, quality execution, knowledge transfer, and delivery against contractual commitments.
* Identify opportunities to apply Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven capabilities to improve engineering productivity, operations, and business outcomes.
* Communicate strategy, delivery progress, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to senior technology and business leaders.

**Must Have Qualifications**

* Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
* Progressive technology leadership experience, including responsibility for engineering teams, software delivery, production operations, and complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience leading globally distributed teams and developing technical talent across multiple roles and experience levels.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, cloud platforms, APIs, distributed systems, DevSecOps, observability, resiliency, and secure development practices.
* Experience partnering with product and business leaders to shape technology strategy, manage priorities, and deliver measurable outcomes in a complex enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage delivery risk, cross-team dependencies, organizational change, and vendor or third-party relationships.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders at multiple levels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading modern front-end and digital-experience technology teams, with exposure to Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with modern web frameworks, content-management platforms, design systems, accessibility standards, and scalable digital-experience architectures. This capability is strongly recommended because the role is expected to expand into the AEM and front-end technology space within FAST.
* Experience delivering client- or advisor-facing digital products in financial services or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience with AWS or comparable cloud platforms, serverless architecture, API-led integration, data platforms, and modern CI/CD practices.
* Experience applying AI, Generative AI, or intelligent automation within software engineering, operations, or digital product delivery.
* Experience leading platform modernization, operating-model evolution, or transformation across multiple products and teams.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

We are seeking a highly driven, experienced, and results-oriented Senior Account Executive to accelerate new customer acquisition and enterprise business growth across India. This is a pure hunter role focused on identifying, developing, and closing high-value enterprise opportunities, with a primary emphasis on Banking & Financial Services (BFSI), Capital Markets, and FinTech.

The role will also target strategic industry verticals such as Digital Natives, E-commerce, AdTech, Gaming, and Telecommunications.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of selling complex enterprise software and technology solutions, building relationships with senior technology and business leaders, and consistently exceeding revenue targets. Candidates with established relationships and enterprise sales experience in the BFSI sector will be preferred.

This position requires a proactive sales professional who can generate opportunities, challenge the status quo, navigate complex enterprise buying processes, and successfully close competitive deals.

**Requirements**
----------------

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. New Customer Acquisition & Revenue Growth**

* Own the complete sales lifecycle for acquiring new enterprise customers across assigned accounts and territories in India.
* Develop and execute strategic territory plans to generate a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities.
* Identify, qualify, develop, negotiate, and close new business opportunities while consistently achieving or exceeding revenue targets.
* Generate opportunities through executive networking, strategic prospecting, industry relationships, channel partners, and account-based engagement.
* Maintain a healthy and predictable sales pipeline with strong opportunity qualification and forecasting accuracy.

* Build and nurture relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, Chief Architects, Heads of Engineering, Infrastructure Leaders, and senior business stakeholders.

* Navigate complex enterprise buying processes involving technology teams, procurement, legal, finance, and executive leadership.
* Develop compelling business cases and executive-level proposals demonstrating measurable business value and ROI.

### **3. Technical & Solution-Led Selling**

* Collaborate with Solution Architects and technical teams to identify customer requirements and develop relevant technology use cases.
* Position enterprise data platform solutions across high-value workloads, including real-time payments, fraud detection, customer 360, personalization, recommendation engines, high-performance caching, AI-driven applications, and real-time analytics.
* Understand competitive database technologies and effectively position solutions against alternatives such as Redis, Oracle, DynamoDB, ScyllaDB, and other NoSQL platforms.
* Lead customer evaluations, proof-of-concepts (POCs), and technical validation processes, ensuring successful commercial outcomes.
* Translate complex technical capabilities into clear business and financial value propositions.

### **4. Account Strategy & Sales Execution**

* Develop comprehensive account plans, stakeholder maps, competitive strategies, and deal-closing plans for strategic opportunities.
* Apply structured enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or equivalent frameworks.
* Maintain sales discipline through effective opportunity management, CRM hygiene, pipeline reviews, and accurate forecasting.
* Work closely with marketing, business development, solution engineering, alliances, and leadership teams to accelerate opportunity generation and deal progression.
* Engage senior leadership strategically to strengthen customer relationships and advance critical opportunities.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
------------------------------------

* 10–15 years of experience in enterprise technology sales, including significant experience in direct enterprise software sales within India.
* Proven track record of acquiring new enterprise customers and consistently achieving or exceeding revenue quotas.
* Strong experience selling databases, data infrastructure, cloud platforms, middleware, or other mission-critical enterprise technologies.
* Established relationships with senior technology decision-makers across large Indian enterprises.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and close high-value enterprise software deals.
* Strong business acumen, commercial negotiation skills, and executive communication capabilities.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and perform effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT architecture, cloud adoption, digital transformation, and modern application infrastructure.

**Good-to-Have Skills & Experience**
------------------------------------

* Proven experience selling enterprise technology solutions to Banking, Financial Services, Capital Markets, or FinTech organizations.
* Established relationships within the BFSI ecosystem.
* Experience selling database technologies, NoSQL platforms, distributed systems, or real-time data platforms.
* Previous experience with enterprise technology providers such as MongoDB, Redis, Confluent, Couchbase, Databricks, Snowflake, Oracle, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience displacing incumbent technologies and winning competitive enterprise transformation deals.
* Familiarity with cloud consumption models, enterprise subscription models, and marketplace-based commercial transactions.
* Experience working with global technology organizations in high-growth, entrepreneurial environments.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
---------------------------

The ideal candidate is a results-oriented enterprise sales professional with strong hunting capabilities, deep technology sales expertise, and an established network of senior decision-makers. They should be comfortable engaging with C-suite executives, understanding complex technical environments, building strategic account relationships, and driving enterprise deals from initial prospecting through closure.

Must-Have Skills: Enterprise Software Sales, Technical Sales

Good-to-Have Skills: NoSQL Platforms, Distributed Systems, Real-Time Data Platforms

this pursuit. We are a global classroom technology company empowering educators and institutions in

If you’re excited by the idea of building smart, scalable, and meaningful solutions in education, come

create with us.

**Learn more: http://teachmint.com**

**About the Role:**

As an Associate - Legal, you will support the legal and compliance function of the organization by

assisting in contract management, legal documentation, compliance monitoring, and day-to-day legal

operations. The role requires a detail-oriented and proactive individual who can work closely with

cross-functional teams to ensure smooth legal processes and minimize business risks.

**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------

* Addresses a current bandwidth and experience gap: the function head is presently pulled into nearly every matter, including routine and operational issues, leaving limited capacity for proactive, higher-value work.
* Creates a genuine delegation layer, so routine and operational legal/compliance matters can be owned end-to-end at this level — freeing the Function Head to focus on strategic priorities and matters requiring deeper attention.
* Supports the Company's expansion into Dubai, Philippines, Singapore and the US (alongside India), where legal and compliance support already spans almost every function — agreement drafting/vetting/negotiation, routine operational and HR matters, legal cases and responses, corporate secretarial and statutory compliance, and regulatory certifications, licences and registrations.
* Builds a structured, stable and scalable Legal, Secretarial & Compliance function able to keep pace with the Company's growth and support its journey toward an IPO.

**Key Responsibilities – Company Secretarial**
----------------------------------------------

* Independently oversee all statutory compliances under the Companies Act and rules thereof, labour and industrial laws, and other applicable corporate statutes.
* Conduct AGMs, EGMs, Board Meetings and Committee meetings as required under the Companies Act – issuing notices, drafting agendas, recording minutes, drafting the annual report, and coordinating with Board Members on related assignments.
* Represent the organization before local statutory authorities and State/Central Government bodies, managing assignments related to the MCA/ROC, RBI, and similar regulators.
* Partner with administrative departments across the organization to identify applicable legal requirements and ensure ongoing compliance.
* Maintain strong working knowledge of FEMA, ODI, FDI regulations and other corporate laws.
* Track regulatory amendments and ensure timely compliance as laws evolve.

**Key Responsibilities – Corporate Legal**
------------------------------------------

* Handle all legal matter including drafting of various submissions on behalf of the company in any legal proceedings before courts.
* Draft and vet legal documents and agreements, including documentation for bank borrowings.
* Engage external counsel for legal opinions as needed, and manage that relationship end to end.
* Own the full lifecycle of all agreements – review, negotiation, external review and securing leadership buy-in.
* Provide day-to-day legal and compliance support across functions, including routine operational and HR matters, as new legal and commercial issues surface regularly in a fast-growing startup environment.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

jobs.description:
**IINSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT**

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

**Role summary**

Lead the evolution and operational excellence of Chalhoub's Finance technology landscape on SAP S/4HANA, acting as a key partner to Finance and Technology leadership. Ensure stability, SLAs, and continuous improvement across the live SAP Finance and Procurement estate, enabling Finance to operate with greater agility, insight, and efficiency across all Middle East locations.

**What you'll be doing**

* Define and drive the Finance technology roadmap on SAP S/4HANA aligned with Finance priorities, enabling AI, intelligent automation, insight, and operational excellence across the finance function.
* Build and maintain a Finance AI and automation roadmap, identify opportunities for embedded SAP AI, AI-assisted reporting, anomaly detection, reconciliation automation, invoice automation, and finance service productivity improvements.
* Own core accounting and close technology (Record-to-Report) across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Advanced Financial Closing, Controlling, and Management Accounting and Profitability Analysis (PAPM), ensuring alignment with financial reporting standards.
* Own group finance and planning technology across Consolidation and Group Finance (Group Consolidation, Group Reporting) and Financial Planning and Analysis (budget planning and forecasting, EPM tools), enabling group-wide management reporting.
* Identify and prioritize high-value AI and intelligent-automation use cases across Finance (close, reconciliation, invoice processing via Open Text VIM, and intercompany reconciliation/ICMR), establishing frameworks for safe, controlled, and compliant AI use and maintaining a forward-looking adoption roadmap.

* Own treasury and bank technology across Cash and Liquidity Management, Banking and Payments, Advanced Payment Management (APM), Bank Account Management, Bank Communication Management, Multi-Bank Connectivity, and Market Rate Management.
* Own technology for Credit, Collections and Dispute Management, Intercompany Processes (Intercompany Transactions and Reconciliation / ICMR), expense management (Concur integration), Vendor Invoice Management (Open Text VIM), Real Estate Leasing (RE-FX), and Project Systems.
* Own procurement and vendor management technology across SAP Ariba (SLP, Guided Buying, Buying, Sourcing, Commerce Automation), Materials Management (non-inventory), Procure-to-Pay, E-Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), and supplier data management.
* Run scalable BAU processes across incident, change, enhancement, and user support with tight SLAs and minimal business disruption and lead the Major Incident Management (MIM) on a rotating basis (approximately one week every 8 to 10 weeks).
* Own end-to-end management of Finance technology enhancements in the SAP ecosystem through a structured SAFe Agile delivery model, embedding controlled backlog management, ROI thresholds, and full visibility on change investment decisions.
* Deliver scalable Finance data and BI support model built on a single, authoritative set of finance data, self-service reporting, and standardized, real-time financial reporting (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) for the Chief Financial Officer and Finance leadership, using automation and embedded AI capabilities within SAP, AI-assisted insights, anomaly detection, and intelligent real-time reporting, to improve accuracy and efficiency.
* Ensure rigor in ROI analysis, cost transparency, and financial governance, and ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards (IFRS, SOX, GDPR) with auditability and data traceability across the SAP estate; own portfolio delivery and corporate systems rollout across corporate Finance, as well as owning responsible-AI standards for AI applied to financial data, including accuracy validation and auditability of AI-assisted outputs.
* Build and lead a high-performing Finance technology team, integrating Finance-aligned IT talent under central Technology standards, developing capability across tax tech, automation, and data, and managing Finance and Technology stakeholders (including the Chalhoub Family Office) and external SAP vendors.
* Support Finance and Finance Technology requirements for the Chalhoub Family Office, ensuring appropriate reporting, controls, data access, and governance in line with Group Finance and Technology standards.

**What you’ll need to succeed**

* 12+ years of experience across Finance technology, enterprise SAP systems, or Finance systems leadership, including significant experience leading Finance technology teams and services at a Head or senior leadership level.
* Deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance, with strong functional understanding across Record-to-Report (R2R), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), and Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A).
* Understanding of AI and machine learning applied to Finance. Embedded/native SAP AI, intelligent automation, RPA, and anomaly detection and how to apply it to real finance processes.
* Working knowledge of responsible-AI and AI-governance practices: reviewing and challenging proposed AI use cases, risk classification, control definition, and sign-off for AI applied to financial data.
* Ability to translate AI and data-governance policy into Finance-specific guidance and controls, and act as an escalation point for responsible AI use across the finance function.
* Broad SAP Finance module knowledge across General Ledger, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Controlling, Advanced Financial Closing, Group Reporting and Consolidation, PAPM, Cash and Liquidity, Advanced Payment Management, Bank Account and Communication Management, Tax and DRC, RE-FX, Project Systems, Intercompany (ICMR), and Open Text VIM.
* Procurement technology expertise across SAP Ariba (SLP, Guided Buying, Buying, Sourcing, Commerce Automation), Materials Management, Procure-to-Pay, E-Sourcing, and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM).

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.

In Private Wealth Management, we help our clients pursue their wealth management goals through careful advice & astute investment management. PWM Engineering plays a pivotal role in building the tools and applications our business needs to effectively manage and support our client’s diverse requirements. We support the entire user experience starting with onboarding through to trading, reporting, as well as providing clients access to their portfolios online via native iOS and Android apps. We also build and support numerous applications for our Business and Operations users to help them effectively manage risk and provide the best white-glove service possible to our clients.

The Data Distribution team supports PWM's Quantum data distribution platform which is considered the primary source of data relating to Client Holdings, Transactions, Taxlots and reference data like Accounts, Products and Prices in PWM. Several teams/projects requires this data and our team has built several distribution channels for different usage patterns.

We are currently enhancing our platform based on new business requirements as well as increasing stability and scalability needs to support a growing business. The platform will be required to manage very high volumes of requests with varying time sensitivities and prioritizing across multiple tenants via an event based framework.

**Your Impact**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Cloud Database Specialist** to join our core data platform team. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise in managing and optimizing modern cloud data stacks, specifically focusing on **Snowflake**, **Databricks**, and/or **SingleStore Helios**. You will be responsible for architecting scalable data environments, implementing robust performance tuning strategies, and ensuring the seamless integration of high-performance analytical and operational workloads.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of Data Engineering and Cloud Infrastructure, driving the evolution of our global data platform. You will serve as a technical authority, mentoring junior engineers and influencing the strategic direction of our multi-cloud data architecture to support mission-critical business intelligence and AI/ML initiatives.

**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**

* You will develop financial products with direct impact on millions of consumers
* Systems under your watch will be the primary sources of revenue for the organization
* You build it: engineers are in control of decisions about systems they own from the first line of code written
* You run it: engineers with assistance from global SRE guild are responsible for operation of systems they built
* You own it: engineers do not wait for orders here. They do research, pitch projects. Great ideas are valued and implemented
* Professional network: you will meet and collaborate with very influential people within the global organization and the entire industry

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Back-End Development:*

* Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using Java , Spring Boot etc.
* Implement business logic, database interactions, and integrations with third-party services.
* Optimize application performance and ensure scalability.

*Front-End Development:*

* Develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces using modern front-end frameworks (e.g., Angular, React, or Vue.js).
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement designs and ensure a seamless user experience.
* Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.

*Database Management:*

* Design and manage relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB).
* Write efficient queries and optimize database performance.

*DevOps and Deployment:*

* Collaborate with DevOps to deploy applications in cloud environments

*Testing and Debugging:*

* Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality.
* Debug and resolve application issues in a timely manner.

**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Between 1-3 years experience
* B.S. or higher in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent work experience)
* Expertise in Java, React JS, HTML5
* Familiar with one or more of the following:

  + Distributed systems
  + NoSQL and relational databases
  + Distributed messaging
  + Transactional services
* Experience integrating with Restful web services
* Ability to establish trusted partnerships with product heads, and executive level stakeholders
* Comfortable with Agile Operating Models

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Experience with microservice based architecture
* Experience with Kafka, MongoDB, Spring, vert.X

**Goldman Sachs Engineering Culture**

At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don’t just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a world of opportunity at the speed of markets.

Engineering is at the critical center of our business, and our dynamic environment requires innovative strategic thinking and immediate, real solutions. Want to push the limit of digital possibilities? Start here!

**About Us**
Retail operations are being reshaped by customers who expect convenient, consistent and relevant interactions wherever they choose to shop. Based in Dubai, this organisation is focused on serving retail customers through connected physical and digital channels, with continued scope to improve online commerce, channel integration and the end-to-end customer journey. Its growth agenda depends on translating changing customer expectations into practical, commercially effective experiences across the retail ecosystem.
  
  
The business is seeking to strengthen the relationship between e-commerce, stores, customer engagement and digital service. Based in Dubai, the successful leader will establish clear performance measures, strengthen operating discipline and create the conditions for faster, more coordinated delivery. * Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

**About Us**

Emirates NBD, the leading Banking Group in the MENAT region, was formed on 19 June 1963, when H.H. Late Sheikh Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum signed the Charter of Incorporation of the National Bank of Dubai (NBD) which became the first National Bank established in Dubai and the United Arab Emirates (UAE). jobs.title: SOC Analyst
jobs.description:
**Date Posted:** 27 November, 2026

**Industry:** IT Services and IT Consulting

**Location:** VAPORVM IT SERVICES DMCC

  

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Department:** Cybersecurity / Information Security

**Position:** Security Operations Centre (SOC) Analyst

**Experience:** 3 + years of experience

**Reporting To:** SOC Manager / Head of Cybersecurity

**Location:** UAE

  

**1. Job Summary**
------------------

The Senior SOC Analyst is responsible for managing and strengthening the organisation’s security monitoring, threat detection, incident investigation, and response capabilities. The role involves monitoring enterprise IT infrastructure, networks, endpoints, cloud environments, and applications to identify, analyse, and mitigate cybersecurity threats.

The position requires strong hands-on experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, threat intelligence, incident response, and vulnerability management. The successful candidate will also contribute to SOC process improvement, detection engineering, threat hunting, security reporting, and mentoring junior SOC analysts.

The role ensures that security operations are aligned with organisational security policies, industry best practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.

  

**2. Key Roles and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------------

  

### **A. SOC Monitoring and Threat Detection**

* Monitor and analyse security events and alerts across enterprise networks, servers, endpoints, applications, and cloud environments.
* Operate and administer SIEM, SOAR, and EDR platforms to ensure effective security monitoring and threat detection.
* Analyse security logs, network traffic, endpoint activities, and authentication events to identify suspicious behaviour and potential security incidents.
* Develop, implement, and continuously optimise SIEM correlation rules, detection use cases, and alerting mechanisms.
* Perform proactive threat hunting using MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, and threat intelligence indicators.
* Identify indicators of compromise (IOCs), anomalous activities, and advanced persistent threats (APTs).
* Improve detection coverage and reduce false-positive alerts through continuous tuning and optimisation.
  

### **B. Security Incident Response and Investigation**

* Lead and coordinate security incident investigation, triage, containment, eradication, and recovery activities.
* Investigate malware infections, ransomware, phishing, suspicious network activities, privilege escalation, unauthorised access, and potential data breaches.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and identify the attack vectors, affected systems, and business impact.
* Coordinate incident response with infrastructure, network, application, cloud, and IT teams.
* Conduct digital forensic investigations, preserve security evidence, and maintain incident documentation.
* Develop and maintain incident response playbooks, escalation procedures, and response workflows.
* Ensure timely incident resolution in accordance with defined MTTD and MTTR targets.
  

### **C. SOC Operations and Team Coordination**

* Oversee daily SOC monitoring activities and ensure effective security event management and incident escalation.
* Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and operational support to L1 and L2 SOC analysts.
* Coordinate incident prioritisation, investigation assignments, shift handovers, and escalation processes.
* Monitor SOC operational performance through defined KPIs, SLAs, and management reports.
* Identify opportunities to improve SOC efficiency through automation, orchestration, and process optimisation.
* Conduct periodic reviews of SOC procedures, detection capabilities, and operational effectiveness.
  

### **D. Vulnerability Management and Security Assessment**

* Coordinate vulnerability assessment and remediation activities across servers, endpoints, network devices, and applications.
* Identify, assess, prioritise, and track vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, and business risk.
* Work with infrastructure and application teams to ensure vulnerabilities are remediated within agreed SLAs.
* Monitor remediation progress and validate closure of identified vulnerabilities.
* Support vulnerability management using tools such as Rapid7 InsightVM and other enterprise vulnerability assessment platforms.
* Identify recurring security weaknesses and recommend preventive security controls.
  

### **E. Threat Intelligence and Proactive Security**

* Monitor emerging cyber threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and threat intelligence feeds.
* Analyse IOCs and correlate threat intelligence with internal security telemetry.
* Map detected threats and attack patterns against MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
* Conduct proactive threat hunting to identify potential compromises that may not trigger conventional security alerts.
* Develop and enhance detection use cases based on emerging threat intelligence.
* Prepare threat analysis reports and recommend preventive and corrective security measures.
  

### **F. Security Technology and Infrastructure Monitoring**

* Monitor and investigate security events generated by NGFW, IPS/IDS, VPN, NAC, email security, endpoint protection, and identity security solutions.
* Analyse network security events involving technologies such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, and Cisco.
* Monitor identity-related threats, including suspicious logins, compromised accounts, privilege misuse, and unauthorised access.
* Support security monitoring across Microsoft Azure, AWS, Oracle Cloud, and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Coordinate with infrastructure teams to strengthen security configurations and improve endpoint and network protection.
  

### **G. Compliance, Reporting and Governance**

* Ensure SOC operations comply with organisational security policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support security compliance with ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, and CIS Controls v8.
* Support UAE NESA/IAS and Saudi NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC) requirements, where applicable.
* Maintain SOC operational documentation, incident reports, investigation records, and audit evidence.
* Prepare periodic SOC performance reports, incident trend analysis, vulnerability reports, and management dashboards.
* Participate in internal and external audits and support the closure of identified security findings.
  

**3. Required Technical Skills**
--------------------------------

* **SIEM:** IBM QRadar, LogRhythm, Splunk or equivalent enterprise SIEM platforms.
* **SOAR:** Security automation, orchestration, incident workflows, and response playbooks.
* **EDR/XDR:** Endpoint monitoring, threat investigation, detection, and response.
* **Network Security:** Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, Cisco, IDS/IPS, VPN and network segmentation.
* **Threat Detection:** MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, IOC analysis, threat hunting, and detection engineering.
* **Incident Response:** Incident triage, malware analysis, forensic investigation, containment, and recovery.
* **Vulnerability Management:** Rapid7 InsightVM, Nessus, Qualys, or equivalent tools.
* **Cloud Security:** Microsoft Azure, AWS, Oracle Cloud, and hybrid infrastructure monitoring.
* **Identity Security:** Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, SSO, and privileged access monitoring.
* **Security Frameworks:** ISO 27001, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, and CIS Controls.
  

**4. Education and Professional Certifications**
------------------------------------------------

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.

**Preferred Certifications:**

* CISSP – Certified Information Systems Security Professional.
* CISM – Certified Information Security Manager.
* CEH – Certified Ethical Hacker.
* CHFI – Computer Hacking Forensic Investigator.
* GIAC GCIH / GCIA / GCFA.
* CompTIA Security+ or equivalent

jobs.title: Manager, AI Strategy & New Ventures
jobs.description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY**
AI is fundamentally changing how businesses operate, make decisions and create value. Entire industries are rethinking business models and processes that have remained unchanged for decades.
  
  
Some of the most exciting questions in AI today are business questions. Which problems can now be solved that couldn't be solved before? How will industries evolve? What new products and businesses can be built around these possibilities?
  
  
At AbleCredit, you will work at the intersection of these questions.
  
  
Having established our AI capabilities in financial services, we are expanding into new industries and global markets. You will help determine where we go next, what we build and how we turn technological possibilities into commercially successful businesses.
  
  
If you have spent the first few years of your career understanding how businesses work and now want to shape what they could become, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Discover the next frontier for AI
* Develop a first-principles understanding of industries, business models and enterprise workflows to identify opportunities for AI-led transformation.
* Evaluate markets through bottom-up market sizing, customer urgency, competitive dynamics and AbleCredit's ability to win.
* Define market-entry strategies, priority customer segments and differentiated value propositions.
* Turn possibilities into products and businesses
* Engage with industry leaders to uncover unmet needs, decision bottlenecks and problems customers are willing to pay to solve.
* Develop solution hypotheses and commercial business cases, assessing proprietary AI advantage, data availability, implementation feasibility and customer ROI.
* Partner with product and AI engineering teams to shape solutions and prioritise opportunities that can become scalable, repeatable products.
* Take ideas from zero to market
* Own the journey from hypothesis to customer discovery, proof of concept and commercial validation, with measurable success criteria.
* Lead and develop the market development team, building qualified enterprise opportunities and a repeatable GTM engine.
* Assess product-market fit, conversion, delivery economics and scalability to recommend which opportunities to pursue, refine, scale or discontinue.

**What You Will Deliver**

* Market-entry strategies: Prioritised industries and customer segments, backed by market sizing and commercial business cases.
* Validated product opportunities: A pipeline of AI solutions supported by customer evidence, willingness to pay and delivery feasibility.
* Commercial validation: Customer-backed pilots with measurable outcomes and clear pathways to production deployment.
* Repeatable GTM playbooks: Validated customer profiles, value propositions and market development strategies.
* Investment recommendations: Evidence-backed decisions on where AbleCredit should invest, scale or discontinue its efforts.

**What You Bring**

* 5–9 years of experience in management consulting, business strategy, Founder's Office, new ventures or B2B technology businesses.
* Exceptional structured problem-solving, market research, financial modelling and commercial judgement.
* Ability to translate complex business problems into actionable product and commercial opportunities.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management and team leadership skills.
* Intellectual curiosity, entrepreneurial ambition and comfort operating in ambiguous environments.

Experience in AI, enterprise SaaS, regulated industries or international markets is advantageous, but not mandatory. Your ability to learn, question and build matters more.
  
  
**WHY THIS COULD BE A DEFINING CHAPTER IN YOUR CAREER**

* Build from zero: Experience the journey from discovering an opportunity to building a commercially viable AI business.
* Develop cross-industry expertise: Understand how AI is reshaping industries, business models and global markets.
* Influence what gets built: Work directly with business leadership, product teams and AI engineers to shape new solutions.
* Become a business builder: Develop the strategic, technological, commercial and leadership capabilities required to lead businesses in an AI-first world.

**We are looking for someone who wants to do more than understand the future of AI. We are looking for someone who wants to help build it.**

jobs.title: Director of Product, Global Tax Platform
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from investors including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil, and Goldman Sachs, and was named one of America’s best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
Tax is where trust is won or lost. Every calculation, filing, and payment is a promise to our customers and to the agencies they answer to. As Rippling scales into the enterprise and expands globally, the Tax Platform is mission-critical infrastructure: it must be accurate, explainable, and reliable at a level most payroll systems were never designed for.
  
  
We’re looking for a Director of Product, based in Bangalore, to lead Rippling’s Global Tax Platform team. You’ll own the end-to-end system that calculates, files, and pays taxes globally — across employees and contractors, across every country we operate in, and across federal, state, and local jurisdictions.
  
  
The scope covers:
  
  

* Calculation engine, including the multi-year effort to build Tax Foundry — an AI-enabled tax calculation and policy engine that replaces our third-party dependency.
* Filings and agency communications across all jurisdictions globally.
* Tax payments and reconciliation — accurate, on-time, and fully traceable.
* Upstream data audits and self-serve resolution so issues are caught before they block filings.
* In-product explainability so every tax value can be traced to its source inputs and rules.
* Enterprise readiness — multi-entity, multi-country, equity comp, and complex tax structures at scale.

The goal is simple: no surprises. Customers should never be caught off guard by their tax data, and the team should never be pulled into reactive firefights during filing season.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the vision and execution for the Tax Platform across calculation, filing, payments, and reconciliation globally.
* Lead a team of Senior Product Leads across calculation, filings, payments, data quality, and enterprise tax.
* Drive measurable improvements in filing accuracy, on-time payment rates, weekly data accuracy, customer self-serve, and enterprise escalations.
* Make the call on Tax Foundry while maintaining a credible third-party backup plan.
* Build opinionated, configurable workflows that reduce reliance on Tax Ops and CX.
* Partner with Engineering, Tax Ops, CX, Payroll, Compliance, Legal, and GTM to align expansion with platform architecture.
* Serve as a Senior Product Leader in Bangalore, operating tightly with leadership in San Francisco.

**What You Will Need**

* Serve as a senior product leader in Bangalore, operating tightly with leadership in San Francisco.
* 12+ years of Product Management experience.
* Proven experience leading senior IC PMs across multiple teams.
* Experience owning complex, multi-surface platforms with regulatory, tax, or financial complexity.
* Strong systems thinker — you see primitives, not just features.
* Track record of shipping both 0-to-1 launches and scaled products used by large customer bases.
* Comfortable operating at multiple altitudes: strategy, architecture, UX, and execution rigor.
* Strong cross-functional leadership across engineering, tax/compliance, operations, and GTM.
* High ownership mindset — accountable for outcomes, not output.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication in a highly cross-functional, globally distributed role.
* Payroll, tax, accounting, or fintech experience is a strong plus.
* Strong alignment with our leadership principles: in particular, Go and See, and Are Right, a Lot.

If you don’t necessarily meet all of the requirements listed here, we still encourage you to apply because skills can be used in lots of different ways, your life experience is equally important sometimes.
  
  
**The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors, including but not limited to, location, experience, education, training, and business need. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, commissions, and/or equity, subject to applicable plan documents and company policy. Successful candidates hired for this role may also be eligible to participate in the company's benefits programs, which may include, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement benefits, and/or paid time off, as determined by company policy.**

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
#### **Job Description**

**Location:** Bengaluru, with regular travel to our Raipur head office. **Reports to:** CEO. **Type:** Full-time.

### **About Elxer**

Elxer has connected Chhattisgarh since 2014. We run fibre broadband for homes and businesses, enterprise connectivity (leased lines, managed Wi-Fi and security), a data centre, and Elxer Solar for rooftop solar installations. We build much of our own technology in-house, including our customer app, field and sales app, HR system and a new operations platform, and we use AI across the business. We are now creating a product function, and we are looking for the leader to own it.

### **The role**

You will own what Elxer builds and sells, and why: the software our teams and customers use every day, and the services we add on top of a connection, a rack or a solar installation. You will turn business problems into clear, prioritised products, take them to real users and prove they work with measured results. You will not be judged on documents or features shipped alone.

You will work directly with the CEO. You will partner with the Software team, which owns architecture and delivery, and with Sales, Operations, Network, Support, Marketing, Finance and HR as business owners. An AI product assistant will support analysis, requirements drafting and reporting.

### **Key responsibilities**

**Portfolio and roadmap**

* Own one product portfolio across the new operations platform, the in-house systems that run the business today (customer and field apps, HRMS, billing and ticketing integrations) and our experimental tools.
* Build and run the idea register, scoring and quarterly roadmap. Decide with the CEO what to build, improve, retire or stop.
* Set clear rules for when an experimental tool becomes a supported product or is retired.

**Discovery and requirements**

* Spend regular time with field engineers, NOC, support agents, sales teams and customers to find the problems worth solving.
* Write problem statements, user journeys, acceptance criteria and non-goals that the Software team can estimate and build against.
* Make sure each business owner confirms the need before work starts and accepts the result before it counts as done.

**Commercial products and services**

* Shape the add-on and complementary products for home, enterprise, wholesale and solar customers, such as managed Wi-Fi, managed security, CCTV with cloud storage and solar maintenance.
* For each one, define the offer, SLA, pricing inputs, billing, fulfilment, support model and compliance checks, then hand over a launch-ready package to Sales and Marketing.
* Work with Finance on margin and with legal advisers on licence scope before anything is sold.

**Delivery and quality**

* Track each product slice from idea to production, and raise blockers early.
* Keep product data honest: correct metric definitions, complete records and dashboards management can trust.
* Plan releases with the Software lead, so changes reach users safely and with training.

**Measurement**

* Define and report product measures: active users by function, adoption, idea-to-production lead time, add-on attach rates and ARPU, churn and support tickets per customer.
* Present a monthly product review to the CEO.

**Team**

* Build the product function over time, starting with yourself and the AI assistant, and later product analysts or owners.

**Compliance**

* Make sure products follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, TRAI and DoT licence conditions, CERT-In directions and labour-law requirements where they apply.

### **What success looks like in the first year**

* One product register and roadmap in use across all software and services, reviewed every quarter.
* At least one platform slice used daily by real business users, with acceptance recorded by its business owner.
* Trusted definitions and dashboards for tickets, attendance and leads.
* At least two complementary products launched with measured attach rate and margin.
* A shorter, measured idea-to-production lead time.

### **Must have**

* 8+ years in product management, with 3+ years owning a roadmap and outcomes for an internal platform, a B2B product or a service business: ISP or telecom, SaaS, logistics, fintech, energy or a similar operations-heavy category.
* Has shipped products used by field or operations teams, not only web or consumer apps.
* Strong in discovery and requirements: can turn a messy workflow into clear acceptance criteria.
* Analytical: comfortable with SQL or BI tools, funnels, unit economics and product metrics.
* Works well with engineers. Understands APIs, data models, mobile apps and release processes well enough to make sound trade-offs.
* Excellent Hindi and English; clear writing.

### **Good to have**

* Experience with broadband or telecom systems: billing, Radius/AAA, ticketing, GIS or network inventory.
* Experience pricing and launching a service product, including SLAs and margins.
* Familiarity with HR, field-workforce or CRM systems.
* Uses AI tools in everyday product work.
* Engineering degree; MBA a plus, not a requirement.

### **What we offer**

* A leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, with the mandate to build the product function from scratch.
* Real influence over what a growing regional technology group builds and sells.
* In-house engineering, our own data and AI tools to work with.
* Competitive compensation based on experience.

### **How to apply**

Apply on this page, or email your CV and a short note on a product you led, the problem it solved and the measured result, to **hr@elxer.com** with the subject "Head of Product".
