jobs.title: Director - Visa Direct Business Strategy & Planning
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

The Visa Direct CEMEA - Business Strategy and Planning - Director is the Business Planning & Strategy lead for Visa Direct in CEMEA, based in Dubai. The role works closely with the head of Strategy and Business Planning for CMS, as well as the VP, Head of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA, as strategic and planning partner on all internal and external initiatives. This role will help drive the strategy and transformation of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA while collaborating with key members of the CEMEA Leadership Team, Global Visa Direct Team, and other stakeholders.

This role encompasses:

Strategy**:**

* Own the end-to-end Visa Direct CEMEA strategy, and translate Visa 2030 priorities into sub-regional and country plans with clear owners and milestones.
* Set product and use-case priorities by market with Regional and Global Visa Direct Commercialization and Product teams; prioritise opportunities through market sizing, whitespace, competitor and market-share analysis.

jobs.title: Head of MarTech & Personalisation
jobs.description:
**Head of MarTech & Personalisation**
=====================================

The **Head of MarTech & Personalisation** makes sure every inDrive user sees the right service, offer and communication at the right moment - and, as a result, uses more of the app’s verticals, more often.

inDrive grew out of ride-hailing and is becoming a super app: rides, delivery, intercity, food, groceries and financial services. Most users still live in a single vertical. The SuperApp platform owns multi-vertical growth and frequency, and personalisation is its main lever; MarTech is the layer that makes personalisation run at scale.

The role sits in SuperApp Platform and reports to the Product Director. The Head defines the strategy for the domain, builds and leads a team, and is accountable for the impact of personalisation on multi-vertical growth.
  
  
It is a role at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Data, with a clear split of ownership:

* **Owns:** the orchestration layer (which user sees what, where and when), personalisation of the main screen and cross-sell placements, the communications platform, the MarTech stack strategy, and the experimentation that proves impact.
* **Influences:** campaign content and promo budgets (Marketing), offer business rules (vertical and loyalty owners), ads inventory rules (Ads), predictive models (Data Science).

Department

SuperApp and Growth Businesses Product

Employment Type

Full Time

Location

United Arab Emirates

Address Abu Dhabi, Emirate of Abu Dhabi

Workplace type

Hybrid

Requisition ID

6911

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Set the strategy:** Define the personalisation and MarTech strategy, from the user segments and intents we act on to which service, offer or message each user gets, where, and through which channel.
* **Build the orchestration layer:** Create one system that decides who sees what, where and when, with frequency caps to avoid overload. Offer and ads owners set their own rules. You own how those rules are combined and delivered.
* **Personalise the main screen and cross-sell:** Replace one-size-fits-all layouts with ones that adapt to each user, so more users try new verticals and use current ones more often.
* **Shape the MarTech stack:** Map current tools, set build-vs-buy criteria, and consolidate onto one platform, so teams launch communications without manual integrations.
* **Grow the communications platform:** Own triggered and segmented scenarios, channels (push, in-app, email, messengers), opt-outs and delivery quality.
* **Build and lead the team:** Grow a team focused on strong discovery, rigorous experimentation and outcomes over feature launches.

**What success looks like**

* Personalised surfaces and communications drive more multi-vertical users and higher order frequency.
* All offers and messages go through one orchestration layer, with proven lift and controlled communication load.
* Marketing and the verticals launch segmented communications without engineers.

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
-----------------------------------

* **Product Experience:** 8+ years of product management experience in large-audience consumer products (Marketplace, Super App, E-commerce, FoodTech, or FinTech).
* **Leadership:** 3+ years leading and developing product managers.
* **Platform Products:** Proven track record of building scalable, platform-based product solutions in data-rich environments.
* **MarTech & Personalisation:** Deep expertise in MarTech ecosystems, personalisation, and customer data.
* **Strategy:** Strong ability to define product strategy and roadmap, and to turn business goals into product capabilities.
* **Data & Experimentation:** Data-driven mindset with a solid understanding of analytics, experimentation, and data governance.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Experienced in leading alignment across Marketing, Tech, and Data teams and leadership.
* **Communication:** Business-fluent English proficiency (B2/C1+ or equivalent).

**Why join us**
---------------

* Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 47 countries.
* Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs.
* Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program.
* Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects.
* Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow.
* Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs.

Final benefits may vary depending on the location.

**About inDrive**
-----------------

inDrive is a global tech company on a mission to challenge injustice through fair choices. We started in 2012 in the coldest city on Earth, when a group of friends created a way for people to agree on fair ride prices. That idea grew into one of the world’s top ride-hailing apps, now with 400M installs across 47 countries.

  
  

Today, we offer more than rides: from freight and delivery to intercity travel and financial services, all designed to put people first. We are committed to having a positive impact on people’s lives both through our core business, which supports local communities via a fair pricing model; and through the work of our impact programs.

Ready to ignite your inner drive?

jobs.title: PR & Communications Manager
jobs.description:
OneAsset is a Dubai-based real estate tokenisation and digital asset platform currently undergoing VARA licensing review. Combining institutional-grade real estate with regulated blockchain infrastructure, OneAsset is building its presence across financial services, commercial real estate, and digital asset markets.

### **The Role**

OneAsset is seeking a strategic, resourceful, and hands-on PR & Communications Manager to drive its media relations and external communications.

Working closely with the Head of Marketing and senior leadership, you will own narrative development, secure high-impact earned media coverage, and strengthen OneAsset's credibility across financial, commercial real estate, and digital asset audiences. This role requires an independent operator who takes ownership, thinks beyond day-to-day execution, and translates communications strategy into measurable commercial outcomes.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Media Relations & PR Strategy**

* Develop and execute proactive PR and media relations strategies aligned with OneAsset's business and communications objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, and key media stakeholders across financial services, business, commercial real estate, and digital assets.
* Identify, pitch, and secure meaningful earned media opportunities, including interviews, features, expert commentary, and contributed articles.
* Develop differentiated, newsworthy story angles informed by industry developments, market research, and editorial trends.
* Evaluate media opportunities based on outlet credibility, audience relevance, and strategic value, continuously refining outreach through performance monitoring.

**Corporate & Executive Communications**

* Draft and refine press releases, media pitches, op-eds, executive commentary, briefing notes, and external communications.

* Partner with marketing, research, product, and leadership stakeholders to ensure accurate, consistent messaging across all channels.

**Industry Relations & Speaking Opportunities**

* Identify and assess relevant speaking engagements, conferences, industry panels, and networking opportunities for OneAsset executives.

**Planning, Execution & Performance**

* Manage PR activities end-to-end—from planning and research through execution, follow-up, and reporting.

jobs.title: Director, Commercial Payments, Visa Government Solutions - CEMEA
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Government Solutions (VGS) brings Visa’s consumer, commercial, money movement and value-added solutions to public sector clients globally. In this regional Director role, you will lead the commercial payments agenda for VGS in CEMEA, helping governments and public sector organizations modernize expenditure across procurement, travel, fleet, employee benefits, lending and related payment flows.

You will work closely with regional VGS sales teams, Visa Commercial Solutions (VCS) team, the Regional Head of GTM & Commercialization and the Global Head of VGS Commercial Payments to develop growth strategies, partnerships and go-to-market plans that position Visa as a leading partner for Government-to-Business (G2B) payments.

This is an opportunity to combine deep commercial payments expertise with strategic thinking, market insight and cross-functional influence. You will turn regional opportunities, client needs and ecosystem trends into practical solutions that accelerate VGS growth and support Visa’s broader 2030 roadmap.

The role offers a broad and varied remit. You will build understanding of regional market dynamics, regulatory considerations and economic drivers, while helping shape cross-functional plans for large ecosystem opportunities involving technology enablers, marketplaces, ERPs, system integrators, travel management companies, e-invoicing providers, issuers and acquirers.

As Visa moves from planning to execution of its 2030 roadmap, you will contribute to a strategic priority: deepening penetration of B2B and G2B spend. Your work will help shape regional go-to-market strategies, expand acceptance, strengthen market execution and unlock a share of the global addressable opportunity.

We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded payments leader who enjoys building relationships, connecting market insight to client need, and working through teams across the region and wider Visa organization. You will bring sound judgement, curiosity and the ability to turn complex opportunities into clear commercial strategies.

In this role, you will:

* Drive regional growth for VGS Government-to-Business (G2B) commercial payment solutions in partnership with dedicated VGS sales teams.
* Develop and own segment and vertical strategies that use Visa capabilities, enhanced propositions and external partnerships to position Visa competitively and grow share.
* Partner with the Global Head of Commercial Payments, VGS and regional/global VCS teams to identify product, software and capability gaps, and build prioritization cases for enhancements.
* Shape two-sided go-to-market strategies that serve both government buyers and industry sellers, improving client outcomes and driving incremental Visa revenue.
* Identify and evaluate external commercial enabler partnerships, including technology providers, marketplaces, ERPs, system integrators, TMCs, e-invoicing providers, issuers and acquirers.
* Work with local, regional and global Visa teams to address solution, pricing, rules, regulatory or acceptance challenges that may limit competitiveness.
* Maintain a strong understanding of relevant Visa capabilities across commercial solutions, acceptance, money movement, value-added services and emerging technologies.
* Explore how AI and other emerging technologies can improve public sector commercial payment strategies and support regional sales effectiveness.
* Develop thought leadership and sales enablement materials that build market understanding and strengthen the VGS commercial payments narrative.
* Equip CEMEA VGS sales teams with the technical knowledge, tools and messaging needed to identify and convert commercial payments opportunities.

Skills/competencies:

* Deep commercial payments expertise is essential, along with the ability to understand complex client processes, identify where Visa solutions can add value and communicate that opportunity clearly to senior stakeholders.
* The ideal candidate will bring curiosity and passion for payments, fintech and public sector transformation, combined with strong client relationship skills, executive presence, resilience and the ability to execute against ambitious goals.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

What we are looking for:

* 12+ years of experience in commercial cards, B2B payments, commercial issuing or related payment solutions.
* Proven background in a card scheme, global issuer, travel or ERP platform, B2B fintech, payments technology provider or equivalent environment.
* Deep knowledge of the global payments industry, with strong regional market understanding relevant to CEMEA.
* Strong understanding of commercial payment flows, two-sided network economics, acceptance, issuer dynamics, solutioning, commercialization and go-to-market models.
* Experience developing strategies across multiple markets, ideally within a regional or matrixed global organization.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders, build internal networks and translate complex payment concepts into clear commercial narratives.
* Comfort working without direct authority across sales, product, strategy, partnerships, commercialization and VCS teams.
* Experience working with issuers or ecosystem partners to develop, commercialize or scale commercial payment solutions.
* Familiarity with government procurement, public sector sales cycles, compliance requirements or public-sector go-to-market approaches.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Executive Finance
jobs.description:
**Department: Finance & Accounts**

**Function: ESPL – Finance & Accounting Operations**

**Designation: Executive– Finance & Accounts**

**Reporting To: Head – Finance / Management**

**Location: Corporate Office**

**1. JOB PURPOSE**

To ensure effective, accurate and timely management of Finance and Accounting operations

for ESPL and its associated schools. The role is responsible for vendor accounting and

payments, employee reimbursements, statutory tax compliance, banking and cash

reconciliations, travel management, accounting operations, audit closure and accounts

receivable.

The position will also drive process standardisation, automation, centralisation of

accounting activities and continuous improvement in financial controls, ensuring adherence

to organisational policies and timely resolution of stakeholder queries.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Finance & Accounting Operations**

1. Manage and ensure accurate accounting of all vendor bills and payments in **Zoho**

Books.

2. Ensure timely processing of vendor payments on a weekly basis.

3. Conduct vendor account reconciliations every six months (August and February).

4. Maintain and regularly update the Vendor Payment Tracker.

5. Process employee reimbursements through Zoho Expense with accuracy and within

the defined timelines.

6. Ensure timely processing of approved employee reimbursement payments every

Friday.

7. Address and resolve reimbursement-related queries and discrepancies raised by

**ESPL** employees.

8. Calculate and account for GST and TDS liabilities accurately and within applicable

timelines.

9. Ensure timely bank account reconciliation and resolution of discrepancies.

10. Monitor and reconcile petty cash and prepaid card transactions on a fortnightly

basis.

11. Coordinate with **Tally** support teams and assist schools in resolving accounting

software-related issues.

12. Ensure accurate day-to-day accounting entries and maintenance of financial records

in Zoho Books.

**B. Travel & Hotel Management**

1. Manage employee travel and hotel-related payments.

2. Ensure timely uploading and maintenance of travel balances wherever required.

3. Manage employee additions, deletions and modifications in the Travel Portal.

4. Address travel-related queries and provide timely support to employees.

5. Ensure proper reconciliation of travel and hotel accounts.

6. Maintain accurate records of travel-related expenses and payments.

**C. Statutory Compliance & Audit Management**

1. Ensure accurate accounting and maintenance of statutory financial records.

2. Monitor GST and TDS calculations and ensure timely accounting of applicable

liabilities.

3. Coordinate and manage statutory audit activities for ESPL.

4. Ensure availability and accuracy of supporting documents and financial records

required for audits.

5. Coordinate with auditors and internal stakeholders for timely closure of audit

observations.

6. Ensure audit closure within the prescribed TAT with minimal audit queries and

observations.

7. Take corrective action on audit observations and ensure that issues are not

repeated.

**D. Accounts Receivable & Revenue Accounting**

1. Raise tax invoices for revenues earned by Edunation in a timely and accurate

manner.

2. Ensure proper accounting of revenue transactions inZoho Books.

3. Monitor outstanding receivables and maintain accurate accounts receivable records.

4. Conduct regular follow-ups with concerned stakeholders for outstanding payments

and collections.

5. Ensure timely resolution of discrepancies relating to invoices and receivables.

**E. People Excellence & Operational Continuity**

1. Develop effective backup arrangements for all critical finance and accounting

activities.

2. Ensure continuity of operations during planned and unplanned absences.

3. Acquire knowledge of additional processes and cross-functional responsibilities.

4. Improve individual and team efficiency through learning and process familiarisation.

5. Ensure proper documentation and knowledge transfer of critical processes.

**F. Process Excellence, Automation & amp; ERP**

1. Identify opportunities for automation and ERP implementation across Finance and

Accounting operations.

2. Suggest and implement improvements to existing accounting processes.

3. Drive the implementation of centralised accounting processes across all schools.

4. Ensure strict adherence to the organisation's Finance Policy without deviations.

5. Identify process gaps and recommend corrective measures to strengthen internal

financial controls.

6. Standardise accounting practices and reporting processes across schools.

**G. Stakeholder Management & Service Delivery**

1. Respond proactively to feedback and queries received from schools and REN

employees.

2. Ensure timely resolution of finance-related issues within the defined turnaround

time.

3. Provide accurate and quality resolutions to improve stakeholder satisfaction.

4. Maintain professional and responsive communication with all internal stakeholders.

5. Ensure recurring issues are identified, analyzed and addressed to prevent repetition.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Mahatma Gandhi Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Operations - Executive Director - CTB
jobs.description:
**Company Profile**

  

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.

  

As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethics. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.

  
  

**Department Profile**

  

Since 2007 Morgan Stanley has been expanding its own fully owned premier investment banking and sales & trading platform in India, providing a full range of investment banking, sales & trading, equity, fixed income, commodities and derivative products, as well as research services. Building on this existing platform in India, we are looking to invest in establishing a Derivative Operations division that will continue to recognize and match the global need of our clients.

  
  

**Background on the Team**

  

The Equity Confirmation Operations team is responsible for preparing, reviewing, and finalizing trade confirmations for equity products such as equity derivatives, options, swaps and structured equity transactions. The team ensures that all trade details agreed upon between Morgan Stanley and the counterparty(s) are accurately documented and compliant with internal policies, market regulations and legal standards.

  

As an Executive Director leading Transformation Projects within Morgan Stanley’s Equity Confirmation function, the role is centered on driving strategic, operational, and technological change across the firm’s global equity post-trade infrastructure. This position focuses on modernizing the equity trade confirmations workflow enabling robust control framework, timely dispatch of confirmations to counterparties and increasing process efficiency.

  

The functional ops teams’ responsibilities include:

* Drafting and issuing trade confirmations based on executed deals
* Verifying trade terms with traders, sales teams and operations
* Coordinating with counterparties to resolve discrepancies or disputes
* Ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry documentation standards (e.g., ISDA for equity derivatives)
* Maintaining accurate records and supporting post-trade lifecycle events
  

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

  

**Scope and Purpose of the Role:**

  

This is a critical leadership role responsible for driving strategic change initiatives across the Equity Confirms Ops Group under the Derivations Operations umbrella. The ED will spearhead the design, implementation, and management of transformation programmes that align with Morgan Stanley’s global business objectives, ensuring continuous improvement, operational excellence, and robust risk management.

  

Specific Tasks:

* Develop and implement a transformation strategy to streamline workflows, optimize operations, and enhance service delivery within Equity Confirmations Operations.
* Lead cross-functional teams to identify, design, and deliver key projects focused on automation, digitization, and regulatory compliance.
* Collaborate with senior stakeholders—including business unit heads, technology, legal, and compliance—to align transformation initiatives with organizational objectives.
* Oversee large-scale projects from initiation to completion, ensuring timely delivery, budget compliance, and measurable results.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement by mentoring team members, promoting best practices, and encouraging innovation.
* Championing user led Business Intelligence tools within the wider team

**Senior Financial Controller**  
Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Department: Finance | Reports to: CEO / CFO

**About the Company**

Our client is one of India's fastest-growing workspace and business infrastructure companies, offering Managed Offices, Coworking Spaces, Enterprise Workspace Solutions, Build-to-Suit Offices, Design & Build Services, and Business Infrastructure Solutions.

Founded with the vision of transforming how businesses experience workspaces, the company partners with startups, SMEs, large enterprises, GCCs, and multinational corporations by providing scalable, technology-enabled workplace solutions across India.

Today, it operates across multiple cities with a rapidly expanding footprint and manages millions of square feet of commercial real estate through long-term strategic partnerships. As it scales nationally through organic growth, strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and new business ventures, the company is looking for a strong, hands-on finance leader to own the controllership backbone of the organization while partnering closely with the CFO on strategic finance initiatives.

**Business Ecosystem**

The Senior Financial Controller will drive financial control and reporting discipline across the group's ecosystem, which includes multiple business verticals and associated entities involved in workspace development, operations, technology, and business services. The role operates in a multi-entity, high-growth environment and requires strong governance, process ownership, and financial discipline across:

* Managed Office Solutions
* Coworking Spaces
* Enterprise Workspace Solutions
* Commercial Real Estate
* Design & Build
* Infrastructure Development
* Facility & Workplace Operations
* Technology-enabled Workplace Solutions
* Business Support Services

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Financial Controller will own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, Compliance, Taxation, and MIS Reporting across the organization, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and control at every stage of the financial close and reporting cycle. As a senior member of the Finance leadership team, the role will work closely with the CFO and business heads to translate financial strategy into disciplined execution, and will step in on select strategic finance, treasury, and fundraising-support responsibilities that a growing multi-entity business demands.

This is a controllership-first role with meaningful exposure to strategic finance, ideal for a finance leader who wants to build and run the core finance engine of a fast-scaling company while growing into broader CFO-level responsibilities over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Finance & Accounting Operations (Core Ownership)**

* Own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, Fixed Assets, and Payroll Accounting.
* Lead timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing across all entities.
* Prepare and review Consolidated Financial Statements for the group.
* Own MIS Reporting and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of management reports.
* Build and maintain scalable accounting processes and standard operating procedures across a multi-entity structure.

**Taxation & Regulatory Compliance (Core Ownership)**

* Ensure full compliance across GST, Income Tax, TDS, and Companies Act requirements.
* Oversee Secretarial Compliance and ROC filings in coordination with company secretarial support.
* Lead Statutory Audits and Internal Audits, and act as the primary point of contact for auditors.
* Strengthen Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and overall financial governance.

**Treasury & Working Capital**

* Manage day-to-day cash flow planning and working capital optimization.
* Maintain and strengthen banking relationships across the group.
* Support debt servicing, liquidity management, and treasury operations.

**FP&A and Business Finance**

* Support the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), budgeting, forecasting, and rolling forecasts.
* Track financial KPIs and business intelligence reporting for leadership review.
* Partner with business leaders to evaluate profitability, support pricing decisions, and improve operational efficiency.
* Recommend and drive cost optimization initiatives across business units.

**Strategic Finance Support (Partnering with CFO)**

* Support financial due diligence for M&A, investments, and joint ventures as needed.
* Assist in preparing financial models, investor presentations, and materials for lender / PE / VC interactions.
* Contribute financial insights to Board-level and leadership reporting.
* Support post-merger financial integration for acquired businesses.

**Risk Management & Governance**

* Strengthen internal controls and enterprise risk management practices.
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies across all entities.
* Identify and mitigate financial and compliance risks proactively.

**Team Leadership**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Unlock your potential to shape valuation rigor and reporting that improves controls, transparency, and investment decision-making across private markets.

As a Private Asset Valuation Vice President in the Global Special Situations team, you own periodic valuations across a range of private credit and private equity assets and deliver reporting to a broad stakeholder base. You serve as the primary point of coordination between external valuers, the investment team, the finance team, and the Chief Investment Officers to ensure accuracy, robust controls, and timely delivery in line with fund governing documents and fair value standards. You partner with the Head of Finance, the Chief Operating Officer, deal support, and marketing to translate portfolio activity into clear financial insights.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead end-to-end periodic valuations across the private asset portfolio, spanning private credit (performing, stressed, and distressed) and private equity investments
* Coordinate the valuation process across external valuers, the investment team, the finance team, and the Chief Investment Officers to ensure timely and accurate delivery aligned to fund governing documents and fair value standards
* Direct preparation and reconciliation of quarterly net asset values, financial statements, income and expense accruals, commitments, and related fund accounting activities
* Oversee accounting for portfolio companies, including wholly owned fund subsidiaries and operating companies
* Review fund administrator work outputs to confirm quality standards and delivery timelines are met
* Produce daily reporting covering profit and loss, cash, and expenses, highlighting key drivers and trends
* Partner with the broader team and key stakeholders to deliver portfolio and investor information that supports decision-making
* Prepare materials for valuation and risk committees and support fund board meetings, including board packs and minute-taking
* Support audit coordination and completion, including resolution of open items and alignment to annual audit timelines

* Hold a recognised professional accounting qualification or demonstrate active progress toward qualification

* Evidence ability to coordinate multi-party valuation processes involving external valuers, investment professionals, and senior leadership

JOB DESCRIPTIONAREA MANAGER – CREDIT & OPERATIONS

**Industry:** NBFC- Gold Loan  
**Location:** Thiruvananthapuram / Assigned Area  
**Department:** Credit & Operations  
**Reporting To:** Regional Manager / Head of Operations

1. Job Purpose

The Area Manager – Credit & Operations will be responsible for managing credit operations, customer visits, loan appraisal and approval, branch performance, business development and portfolio quality across assigned branches.

The position requires an experienced professional who can balance credit discipline with business growth, regularly visit branches, motivate employees, support customer acquisition and ensure efficient branch operations.

The Area Manager will play a key role in improving business performance across Gold Loan, Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan products.

2. Duties & Responsibilities

**A. Branch Visits & Business Development**

* Visit every assigned branch at least once a week.
* Review branch-wise business performance, loan disbursements, outstanding and collection efficiency.
* Motivate Branch Managers and employees to improve business sourcing and achieve assigned targets.
* Conduct regular meetings with branch teams to review performance and business plans.
* Identify local business opportunities and support branches in acquiring new customers.
* Participate in important customer meetings and assist branch teams in converting high-value loan proposals.
* Identify operational and business challenges and provide suitable solutions.
* Monitor staff productivity and provide guidance to improve individual performance.
* Develop strategies to improve branch business across Gold Loans, Business Loans and Commercial Property Loans.
* Submit weekly branch visit reports with observations, business updates and action plans.

**B. Customer Visits & Credit Assessment**

* Conduct regular customer visits for Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan proposals.
* Visit business premises, commercial establishments and properties to assess customer credentials and business activities.
* Evaluate customer repayment capacity, business operations and financial position.
* Independently verify information provided in loan applications and identify discrepancies.
* Meet prospective and existing customers to understand their financial requirements.
* Support branch teams in handling high-value and critical loan proposals.
* Ensure proper field verification and due diligence before recommending loan proposals.

**C. Credit Appraisal & Loan Approval**

* Review and evaluate loan applications across assigned branches.
* Assess customer eligibility, repayment capacity, income documents and credit history.
* Ensure proper assessment of collateral, property valuation and legal documentation.
* Review and approve or recommend loan proposals within delegated authority.
* Ensure adherence to credit policies, lending norms and product-specific eligibility criteria.
* Identify potential credit risks and take preventive measures.
* Ensure proper documentation and verification before loan disbursement.
* Improve credit processing turnaround time without compromising lending standards.

**D. Gold Loan Operations**

* Monitor gold loan appraisal procedures and ensure adherence to company guidelines.
* Ensure accuracy in gold purity testing, weight assessment and valuation.
* Monitor Loan-to-Value (LTV) compliance and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct surprise inspections and verification of gold packets and vault procedures.
* Ensure proper custody, security and reconciliation of pledged gold ornaments.
* Monitor gold loan renewals, closures, overdue accounts and auction procedures.

**E. Business Loan & Commercial Property Loan Operations**

* Supervise credit evaluation and processing of Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan applications.
* Review financial statements, bank statements, income documents and business cash flows.
* Ensure proper property valuation, legal scrutiny and title verification for property-backed loans.
* Coordinate with legal, technical and credit teams for timely processing.
* Ensure compliance with approved lending policies and sanction conditions.
* Monitor documentation, disbursement and post-disbursement compliance.

**F. Branch Operations & Process Control**

* Monitor daily branch operations and ensure operational discipline.
* Conduct periodic branch inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure proper cash management, document custody and record maintenance.
* Review daily transactions, disbursement reports and operational MIS.
* Identify process gaps and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and operational guidelines.

**G. Portfolio Monitoring, Collections & Recovery**

* Monitor branch-wise portfolio performance and overdue accounts.
* Track NPA, delinquency and collection efficiency.
* Identify early warning signals and potentially stressed accounts.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers for recovery and overdue reduction.
* Ensure timely follow-up of maturing and overdue loan accounts.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve portfolio quality.

**H. Team Management & Motivation**

* Guide, supervise and motivate Branch Managers and branch employees.
* Train branch teams on credit policies, documentation and operational procedures.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and operational training.
* Ensure accountability and adherence to defined responsibilities.
* Support branch teams in achieving business and collection targets.
* Build a customer-focused and result-oriented working culture.

**I. Compliance, Risk Management & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with applicable RBI regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor KYC, AML and customer due diligence requirements.
* Coordinate internal, concurrent and statutory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Report operational irregularities, fraud indicators and policy violations to management.
* Ensure effective implementation of risk management practices across branches.

**J. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare and review branch-wise credit and operational performance reports.
* Monitor loan sanctions, disbursements, outstanding, collections and overdue positions.
* Submit periodic reports to Regional Management / Head Office.
* Analyse operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Prepare weekly branch visit reports and follow up on pending action points.
* Support management in implementing business growth and risk management strategies.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Branch Visits:** Minimum one visit to every assigned branch every week.
* **Business Growth:** Improvement in branch-wise sourcing and loan disbursements.
* **Customer Visits:** Regular field visits for customer verification and credit assessment.
* **Credit Approval:** Timely appraisal and decision-making.
* **Branch Motivation:** Regular performance meetings and staff engagement.
* **Credit Quality:** Effective control over NPA and overdue accounts.
* **Gold Loan Operations:** Accuracy in appraisal, LTV compliance and gold security.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Audit scores, process adherence and documentation quality.
* **Collections:** Improvement in recovery and collection efficiency.
* **Reporting:** Timely submission of weekly and monthly MIS reports.

4. Candidate Profile

* Graduate / Postgraduate in any discipline; finance or banking qualifications preferred.
* 8–15 years of experience in Banking or NBFC operations.
* Strong experience in credit appraisal, loan operations and branch administration.
* Exposure to Gold Loans, Business Loans and Loan Against Property / Commercial Property Loans.
* Experience in handling multiple branches or geographical areas preferred.
* Good knowledge of RBI regulations, KYC, AML and credit risk management.
* Strong customer relationship, business development and team leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

The Program Director is a senior leadership role responsible for driving large-scale, complex IT transformation programs across multiple business units and client organizations. The role focuses on end-to-end program ownership, C-suite stakeholder management, business transformation, financial performance, and revenue growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Executive Client & Stakeholder Management
* Act as the primary strategic advisor to client leadership and C-suite executives.
* Build strong long-term client relationships and drive executive alignment.
* Lead steering committees, governance reviews, and transformation discussions.
* Communicate program risks, issues, and progress proactively.
* Translate technical initiatives into business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value.
* Program Strategy & Delivery
* Own the complete program lifecycle from presales through delivery and benefits realization.
* Manage multiple interconnected projects, workstreams, and delivery teams.
* Drive large transformation initiatives involving cloud, enterprise applications, AI/GenAI, and digital transformation.
* Ensure delivery aligns with contractual commitments, milestones, and scope.
* Establish and execute strategic roadmaps and transformation agendas.
* Financial & Commercial Leadership
* Manage large program P&L, budgets, revenue, and profitability.
* Lead scope, budget, and contract negotiations.
* Identify account expansion opportunities and drive additional revenue.
* Contribute to business growth through consulting and services opportunities. Required Experience
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA/Master's preferred.
* PMP/PgMP certifications are advantageous.
* 20+ years of IT program management experience.
* 5+ years with a leading IT services/provider organization.
* Proven track record in delivering large, multi-year enterprise transformation programs.

* Key Skills
* Digital & IT Transformation
* Cloud, Enterprise Architecture, Data & Analytics
* AI/GenAI awareness
* Agile & DevOps methodologies
* Executive communication & storytelling
* Strategic business consulting
* Stakeholder management & negotiation
* P&L ownership and commercial management
* Business development and revenue growth
* Leadership of large global teams

jobs.title: Vice President - Technology- Transformation
jobs.description:
Job Purpose
  
Senior Transformation Office Portfolio Leader is responsible for governing the technology projects portfolio of change across agreed Mashreq’s groups.
  
- Own and govern the technology change portfolio for one or more assigned Mashreq Groups, acting as the senior Transformation Office partner to Group leadership across investment planning, delivery governance, portfolio performance, value realization and forward forecasting.
  
- Provide an accurate, decision-oriented view of the portfolio from demand and budget formulation through initiation, execution, closure and benefits realization, maintaining a single source of truth and ensuring adherence to Mashreq project Methods.
  
- Act as a trusted advisor to Group Heads and senior stakeholders, proactively identifying portfolio risks, dependencies, delivery constraints and value leakage; drive resolution and escalate material concerns through the appropriate governance forums.
  
- Provide Project Quality Assurance across the assigned portfolio and strengthen project-management capability by assuring PM competence and Method compliance, coaching and training project managers, and directly leading selected critical projects where required.
  
- Works with the respective Owners within Groups to ensure that all transformation initiatives are aligned with Mashreq's strategic goals and objectives, by providing active support and coordination during the budgeting, initiation and planning cycles,
  
- Fosters close collaboration with senior leadership to ensure buy-in support, and effective decision-making throughout the transformation journeys.
  
- Agrees, establishes and applies prioritization criteria to the transformation initiatives to support the execution of the overall bank strategy and growth aspirations, leveraging on synergies where possible, ensuring a balanced focus on achieving short-term improvements while building long-term value for sustainable growth,
  
- Acts as Initiation Lead, either directly or by identifying resources to hold this role, and coordinate the activities related to initiation, planning, estimations, articulations of the benefits and business case to be included in the request for budgets in the form of the Executive Summary.
  
- Review Executive Summaries, make best effort to check for completeness of the estimates and be one of the mandatory signatories,
  
- Monitors and reports on the transformation initiatives roadmap at the Mashreq and Group levels, and escalates concerns as necessary,
  
- Ensures transparency and access to accurate information by maintaining the single source of truth on the transformation initiatives,
  
- Defines and implements a communication strategy to regularly disseminate and communicate progress updates and outcomes of transformation initiatives to the right stakeholders, ensuring transparency,
  
- Works with key stakeholders to optimize allocation of resources, including talent, technology, and finances, for efficient utilization toward delivery excellence.
  
- Leads projects managers in the management of projects within the Portfolio. Assures that the execution of projects is done in accordance with Mashreq’s Methods.
  
- Provides training and knowledge transfer as required on TO approved ways of working.
  
- Contributes to the development of Mashreq’s Delivery Methods.
  
- Work towards continuously improving Mashreq’s delivery capabilities thus maximizing the opportunities for business value creation from transformation initiatives.
  
  
Key Result Areas: --
  
A. Portfolio Strategy, Demand & Investment Planning
  
- Partner with assigned Groups to translate strategic priorities and change demand into an integrated technology portfolio and multi-year roadmap.
  
- Lead/support annual and in-year budget formulation for CAPEX and OPEX projects, challenging scope, estimates, sequencing, dependencies, resource needs, benefits and delivery readiness.
  
- Coordinate initiation, planning, estimations, benefits articulation and business-case / Executive Summary preparation; review submissions for completeness, quality and decision readiness and provide required Transformation Office sign-off.
  
- Apply agreed prioritization criteria and advise Group leadership on investment trade-offs, capacity constraints, synergies and sequencing.
  
  
B. Portfolio Execution, Control & Reporting
  
- Maintain an accurate portfolio inventory and single source of truth, clearly distinguishing projects not yet initiated, initiated/in planning, in execution, live/delivered, on hold and closed.
  
- Track projects against approved scope, schedule, cost, milestones, resourcing, risks, dependencies and benefits baselines; identify variance and require credible recovery actions.
  
- Produce concise, evidence-based Group portfolio reporting highlighting performance, exceptions, decisions required and forward outlook.
  
- Provide timely and accurate inputs into bank-wide Technology Projects reporting, ensuring consistent definitions, data quality and traceability across Groups.
  
- Forecast portfolio performance, delivery milestones, financial utilization, emerging risks and likely year-end outcomes; identify potential slippage, under-utilization or value leakage early.
  
C. Delivery Assurance & Mashreq Methods
  
  
- Act as Project Quality Assurance lead for assigned Groups, performing structured health checks against Mashreq project Methods, governance standards, mandatory artefacts and control gates.
  
- Assess whether project plans and baselines are credible, governance is operating effectively, RAID items and dependencies are actively managed, and executive decisions are captured and actioned.
  
- Escalate material non-compliance, delivery risk and control weakness, and track agreed remediation to closure.
  
- Assure that onboarded Project Managers understand and apply Mashreq Methods; provide coaching, training and targeted knowledge transfer.
  
- Where specifically required, act directly as Project Manager / recovery lead for selected critical or complex initiatives without diluting independent assurance across the wider portfolio.
  
- Contribute lessons learned and practical enhancements to Mashreq delivery Methods and Transformation Office standards.
  
D. Issue Resolution, Stakeholder Leadership & Advisory
  
  
  
- Work with Group Heads, project sponsors, business/technology owners and Project Managers to remove delivery blockers and resolve cross-project or cross-functional issues.
  
- Serve as trusted advisor on change demand, portfolio composition, prioritization, execution choices, dependencies, delivery risk and value creation.
  
- Create fact-based escalation paths for issues requiring senior leadership intervention, with clear options, impact and recommended action.
  
- Build effective working relationships across Technology, Business, Functions, Finance, Procurement, Technology GRC, ISG, ORM, Internal Audit, Compliance and other relevant functions.
  
E. Benefits & Value Realization
  
  
- Work with accountable business owners to define measurable financial and non-financial benefits, establish baselines, ownership and realization timelines.
  
- Ensure approved benefits are recorded, tracked and periodically validated through the delivery lifecycle and after go-live where applicable.
  
- Challenge gaps between investment cases, delivered capabilities, adoption and realized outcomes; escalate material benefit shortfalls and agree corrective actions.
  
  
  
F. Project Manager Leadership & Capability
  
- Provide functional leadership to Project Managers supporting assigned portfolios, setting expectations for delivery discipline, transparency and escalation.
  
- Assess PM onboarding/readiness, coach performance and reinforce consistent application of Mashreq Methods and reporting standards.
  
- Support assignment of appropriately skilled Project Managers to initiatives based on complexity, risk and critica

jobs.title: Associate Director/Director - GenAI Business Strategy & Transformation
jobs.company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
jobs.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a GenAI Business Strategy & Transformation Lead to anchor the DESIS GenAI-for-Business ("GAIBiz") effort. Depending on the candidate’s location preference, the position is open for either of our Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram offices in India. This person will be responsible for translating the firm's GenAI strategy into tangible adoption and measurable outcomes across the DESIS environment, working in close partnership with the strategy and transformation core based in the firm's global offices. This is a role largely built around execution and adoption. The strategy setting and transformation agenda is driven centrally; the mandate here is to land that agenda well within DESIS, shaping it for the local context, driving uptake, and delivering results on the ground. There will be real opportunities to influence direction and expand scope over time, but a candidate who thrives will be one who is energized by making things happen, not solely by setting up the agenda. This role will offer a good mix of strategy formulation and hands on delivery experience, tilting more towards later.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will drive GenAI adoption across DESIS by moving initiatives from pilot to production use; conceptualizing and executing novel ways to increase adoption; and owning the associated logistics and change-management scaffolding (enablement, incentives, communications, feedback loops) needed to turn well-designed programs into genuine, sustained uptake. You will partner with the global strategy and transformation core, acting as the DESIS anchor for firmwide GenAI strategy, ensuring initiatives are contextualized, sequenced, and executed effectively in and for the DESIS environment. You will engage credibly with technical teams, working shoulder to shoulder with engineering and data teams, understanding architecture, model capabilities, and tradeoffs well enough to challenge, prioritize, and unblock. You will embed risk, compliance, and data governance, ensuring GenAI initiatives meet the firm's standards for data protection, model risk, regulatory expectations, and responsible-AI practice from the outset, not as an afterthought. Finally, you will measure and communicate impact by defining the metrics that matter, tracking adoption and value realization, and reporting progress clearly to senior stakeholders across DESIS and the global firm.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* 15 or more years of progressive experience leading technology transformation, including recent hands-on leadership of Generative AI initiatives
* Sound instincts on when to buy, when to build, and when a middle path serves best, with the commercial sense to weigh cost, speed, and control (Strategic and commercial judgment)
* A demonstrated track record of driving uptake, not just designing programs. Evidence of moving organizations from intent to embedded behavior (Change management and adoption)
* Deep enough understanding of GenAI and modern data/ML systems to engage engineers credibly and make informed trade-offs. You need not be a builder, but you must be conversant (Technical literacy)
* Experience in or adjacent to market finance, hedge funds, or investment management, with enough fluency to earn the trust of demanding stakeholders (Domain credibility)
* Practical familiarity with the risk, regulatory, and data-governance considerations that shape how AI can responsibly be deployed in a financial-services setting (Risk, compliance and data governance)
* Pragmatic and outcome-obsessed approach, with a high tolerance for ambiguity and rapid change. Ability to influence without authority across a distributed, matrixed organization, and comfort in operating primarily in a delivery-focused capacity within a globally driven agenda (Temperament and influencing skills)
* Creativity, critical thinking with excellent written and verbal communication skills and an entrepreneurial mindset to take on challenging, high-impact projects

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/ADGenAIOct26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers
  
  
Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Enterprise Transformation (India)
jobs.description:
Osfin.ai is a fast-growing transaction intelligence platform for Financial Services firms globally. Osfin.ai helps Financial Services firms automate payments and ledger reconciliation, disputes and chargebacks management, payouts automation, and more. Osfin.ai's customers have been able to transform their 100+ complex and resource-intensive FinOps processes smoothly.
  
  
**Who Is an Ideal Fit for Us?**
As Osfin scales, we are building a bench of enterprise-level subject-matter experts who can lead transformation and modernisation for large organisations and help us enter new finance domains. This is a high-ownership, client-facing role for someone who combines deep domain authority with a strong instinct for AI & automation and the commercial sense to turn expertise into product and growth.
  
  
**What Will You Get to Work On?**
As Director, Enterprise Transformation at Osfin.ai, you will look after:
  
  

* Transformation Roadmap: Define and own the enterprise transformation roadmap across finance, operations and technology.
* Process & Operating Model Redesign: Redesign end-to-end processes (Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash) and the operating model to improve speed, scale and control.
* ERP & Platform Modernisation: Lead ERP and enterprise platform modernisation (SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite or similar).
* Automation & AI: Identify and deliver automation and AI opportunities across accounting and finance operations.
* Programme Governance: Set up programme governance, KPIs and value-realisation tracking, and report progress to executive leadership.
* Investment & Delivery Management: Prioritise investments and manage budgets, capacity and cross-functional delivery.
* Controls & Compliance: Strengthen internal controls, audit readiness and compliance (SOX, Ind AS/IFRS).
* Executive Partnership: Partner with the CFO, CTO, Legal, Risk and Procurement to align strategy with execution.
* Team Leadership: Build, mentor and lead high-performing teams.
* Executive relationship leader partnering with COO, CTO, business executives, Legal, Risk, Technology, and Operations to develop transformation strategies, modernize operating models, and deliver enterprise technology, AI, and process optimization initiatives aligned to firm priorities.
* Lead enterprise portfolios spanning digital transformation, business process management (BPM), risk & compliance, automation, AI enablement, contracting, and operational transformation, driving investment prioritization, executive decision-making, and measurable business outcomes across global teams.
* Build trusted partnerships across Executive Leadership, Engineering, Tech, Governance, Procurement, Legal, and business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into scalable technology roadmaps and cross-functional delivery plans.
* Responsible for driving governance, portfolio management, and executive reporting for complex, multi-million-dollar transformation initiatives, establishing KPIs, value realization metrics, and leading capacity management to improve transparency and accelerate decision-making.
* Serve as the liaison between front-line professionals, operations, and technology organizations, aligning AI, automation, and digital capabilities with operational priorities to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and enable sustainable organizational change.

**What Do We Expect From You?**
*Must-Have*

* Core Experience: 10+ years in enterprise transformation, finance/accounting transformation or ERP modernisation.
* Consulting Leadership: Leadership experience at a Big 4 or leading consulting firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG, Accenture, etc.).
* Delivery Track Record: Track record of delivering large transformation or automation programmes with measurable results (cost savings, cycle-time reduction).
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Strong executive stakeholder management and portfolio governance.
* Accounting Knowledge: Working knowledge of accounting processes, controls and standards.
* Location: Based in Bengaluru.

*Good-to-Have*

* Qualifications: CA / CPA / CISA / MBA.
* Regulated Exposure: Exposure to GRC, SOX, and regulated industries.
* AI Transformation: Experience with AI/GenAI-led process transformation.
* Workflow Tools: Familiarity with BPM and workflow tools (e.g., ServiceNow).

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

* A clear transformation roadmap approved by leadership.
* Two to three high-impact automation or modernisation programmes delivered.
* Governance and KPI framework running with regular executive reporting.
* Visible gains in cycle time, cost, or control quality.

**Why Join Us?**

* Shape how Osfin works and scales, alongside the founders and senior leadership.
* Work with a high-calibre team of industry experts and solve complex problems at scale.
* Build capabilities that serve leading customers across banking, fintech, e-commerce, and other industries.
* Drive the next phase of platform and operational development, with significant ownership and impact.
* Competitive compensation and ESOPs aligned with your contribution and impact.
* A collaborative environment that encourages innovation, learning, and meaningful ownership.

Location: Bengaluru
  
  

* Experience: 10+ years
* Reports to: CEO / COO

**Notice period:**
Immediate joiners preferred (up to 30 days considered)
  
  
Interested? We'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Reach out to us at careers@osfin.ai.

jobs.title: Oracle FDI - Director
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As an Oracle FDI - Director you will lead client work in Oracle data and analytics, helping organizations use Oracle tools to collect, cleanse, transform, model, and visualize data for clearer business insight. As a Director you will set strategic direction, drive business growth, shape client engagement direction, and mentor future leaders while upholding quality, integrity, inclusion, and a commercial mindset. * Setting strategic direction for Oracle FDI client engagements and aligning analytics solutions with business objectives

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree

jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering - Java/Python, Data Platform/Databricks, Risk Domain
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
If you are looking for a game-changing career, working for one of the world's leading financial institutions, you've come to the right place.
  
  
As a Director of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within Corporate Technology, you lead multiple technical areas, manage the activities of multiple teams, and collaborate across technical domains. Your expertise is applied cross-functionally to drive the adoption and implementation of technical methods within various teams and aid the firm in remaining at the forefront of industry trends, best practices, and technological advances.

jobs.title: AVP- Continuous Improvement
jobs.description:

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:
  
  
  

* Proven experience leading business transformation, change, and process re-engineering within large, complex financial services organizations, with the ability to challenge the status quo and drive innovation.
* Strong expertise in Business and Process Architecture, Process Engineering, process mapping and modelling, with a track record of redesigning and optimizing end-to-end processes.
* Experience mobilizing and delivering large- and small-scale, global transformation programmers, including regulatory and time-bound change.
* Strong understanding of banking products, operations, and processes, including Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Treasury, Trade Finance, Risk, Compliance, Reconciliations and Settlements.
* Knowledge of AML and Financial Crime processes and lifecycle, with an understanding of associated risk and control requirements.
* Strong understanding of the relationship between Business, Process, Data and IT Architecture, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable solutions.

**Desirable Skillsets**

* Demonstrated experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, Agile and Continuous Improvement methodologies to simplify processes, eliminate inefficiencies and improve operational performance.
* Experience identifying and delivering automation and digital transformation opportunities
* Proven ability to operate effectively across Operations, Technology, Change, Risk and Control functions in a complex matrix environment.
* Strong leadership and change-management capability, including leading teams through change, driving adoption and embedding a culture of continuous improvement.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, influencing, and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior executives, MDs and Directors across geographies.
* Strong strategic and business acumen, with the ability to connect process, technology, customer, risk and commercial outcomes.
* Self-driven and delivery-focused, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, work independently and maintain high standards.
* High levels of adaptability, creativity, and problem-solving, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving operational inefficiencies.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by ensuring the business is ready to receive the agreed change (address business problems and opportunities), ensuring that change initiatives are successfully assessed and implemented to enable them to be embedded in the organisation.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Identification and analysis of business impact and opportunities that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business readiness strategies that will help to ensure the successful implementation of change initiatives.
* Communication with stakeholders, including senior management, project teams, and external partners, to ensure that they are informed about change initiatives and that their needs and expectations are being met.
* Collaboration with Client Readiness, Operational Readiness & Tech Delivery to ensure business, sales, operations, client servicing and functional partners are prepared for a smooth transition of technology delivery into BAU (including Target Operating Model, Training, Communications, Service Agreements.) .
* Management of resistance to change, ensuring that stakeholders are engaged and that their concerns are addressed.
* Review of business readiness plans and status reports in conjunction with change delivery managers to ensure business readiness activities completed on time including newly identified risks, issues and dependencies.
* Collaboration with project teams to ensure that change initiatives are aligned with project objectives and that change management activities are integrated into project plans.
* Provision of guidance and support to business stakeholders, ensuring that they have the necessary skills and knowledge to implement change initiatives successfully.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
