HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Management Specialist

**Why HSBC**

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

**The Opportunity**

As Strategic Reporting Lead within IWPB IT you’ll create a clear one-stop view of technology and capability health for senior leadership, bringing together DORA and other delivery metrics, governance reporting and decision tracking. Based in Pune this role shapes how CIO/CTO and domain leaders see performance, risk and progress across multiple teams. Success means executive-ready packs that prompt decisions and action closure rather than status updates. You’ll help set an effective governance cadence, standardise inputs and strengthen the quality and timeliness of management information. You’ll also move reporting from manual collation to automated dashboards and repeatable processes with strong control discipline. The outcome is consistent audit-ready reporting that improves transparency and follow-through across the technology estate.

**What you'll be doing**

* Own end-to-end strategic reporting and insight, providing a one-stop view of technology and capability health for senior leadership
* Mobilise stakeholders across Technology, PMO/Transformation, Finance and Risk/Compliance to define decision needs, success measures and governance cadence
* Deliver executive-ready governance packs and QBR materials that support decisions and track action closure
* Establish structured action tracking across domains with clear ownership, follow-through and timely closure

Keep global markets moving by leading critical payments foreign exchange operations during European business hours from Mumbai. You will run day-to-day execution, lead incident response, and ensure clear, timely escalation across regions. This is a high-impact opportunity to partner with operations, product, technology, front office, and control teams to deliver resilient outcomes. You will also drive strategic change, including same-day currency settlement readiness and currency migration and insourcing.

Job summary

You will set the standard for resilient execution, own incident command for the region, and partner with product, technology, front office, and controls to manage risk and raise service quality. You will lead the operational delivery of the firm's same-day currency settlement program and its currency migration and insourcing agenda, and serve as Information Owner for designated FX applications — governing access, entitlements, and associated controls.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Service Management

**The Opportunity**

This role engineers and operates the trusted data and retrieval layer powering the enterprise Knowledge Graph and its AI-enabled consumers. You’ll build production-grade pipelines that transform structured and unstructured enterprise data into high-quality entities, relationships and retrieval-ready representations with strong controls for provenance, security, quality and operability. The focus is on creating traceable data that links back to authoritative source records and remains reliable as sources and AI use cases grow. Success means dependable graph construction and retrieval datasets that support graph traversal, semantic and vector retrieval and GraphRAG/RAG patterns. You’ll help embed automated testing, observability and recovery across environments so delivery is repeatable rather than bespoke. The outcome is a reusable engineering foundation that reduces one-off integrations and keeps critical knowledge within the permanent team.

**What you'll be doing**

* Design, build, test and operate batch, incremental and event-driven pipelines from enterprise sources into the Knowledge Graph
* Implement graph construction logic including node and edge creation, canonical identifiers, relationship derivation, provenance capture and temporal handling
* Engineer entity resolution, record linkage, de-duplication and reconciliation across heterogeneous sources to prevent conflicting identities and relationships
* Build AI-ready pipelines for structured and unstructured data including extraction, cleansing, chunking or segmentation, and metadata enrichment
* Implement embedding generation and vector indexing pipelines where required, including model and version metadata and repeatable re-indexing processes
* Develop retrieval data services and query patterns for graph traversal, vector or semantic retrieval and hybrid or GraphRAG use cases
* Embed automated data-quality and graph-quality controls covering completeness, validity, freshness, duplicate entities, broken relationships and reconciliation to source
* Establish test frameworks and regression testing for mappings, transformations and retrieval datasets as schemas, ontologies, models and feeds evolve
* Implement end-to-end observability with alerts and recovery runbooks for pipeline health, ingest latency, load failures, indexing status and data freshness
* Optimise loads, transformations, indexing and retrieval performance for scale, latency and cost while maintaining integrity and auditability

**What we're looking for**

* Demonstrate advanced Python and SQL with strong software engineering practice including modular design, automated testing, Git, code review and performance optimisation
* Bring substantial ETL and ELT pipeline engineering experience across APIs, relational data, semi-structured formats and large enterprise datasets
* Apply hands-on graph engineering experience including property graph concepts, schema or ontology implementation and graph query languages such as Cypher or equivalent
* Build data preparation and indexing layers for AI retrieval patterns including embeddings, vector search, semantic or hybrid retrieval and RAG or GraphRAG
* Implement entity resolution and data matching using deterministic and probabilistic approaches with canonical identifiers and source reconciliation
* Establish data quality, metadata, lineage, provenance, schema evolution and data contract practices in production environments
* Deliver CI/CD, containers and platform engineering patterns with production support and infrastructure-aware troubleshooting
* Apply secure data engineering controls including IAM or service identities, secrets management, encryption and auditability suitable for a regulated enterprise

**Building trusted retrieval at scale**

If you want your work to shape how AI systems retrieve and ground information across an enterprise this role offers the scope to do it with rigour. You’ll build pipelines and controls that keep the Knowledge Graph reliable, traceable and ready for real production use cases. The work spans ingestion, graph construction, quality, observability and retrieval services and it’s designed to scale as adoption grows. **Role Summary:**

We are looking for an experienced and strategic Senior Director - Finance to lead the finance function, oversee financial operations, and drive financial governance across the organization.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing financial reporting, accounting, controllership, taxation, audit, and regulatory compliance, with strong expertise in both Indian Accounting Standards (IGAAP / Ind AS) and US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP).

This role will serve as a strategic finance partner to senior leadership and global stakeholders, ensuring financial accuracy, operational efficiency, compliance, and alignment with global finance policies and business objectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Financial Reporting & Controllership**

* Lead end-to-end financial reporting, accounting, and controllership functions.

* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing processes.
* Manage financial consolidation, reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and reporting.
* Ensure consistency between local statutory reporting and US GAAP reporting requirements.
* Establish robust internal financial controls, accounting policies, and governance frameworks.

* **US GAAP & IGAAP Compliance**

* Provide technical accounting guidance on complex accounting matters under US GAAP and IGAAP / Ind AS.

* **Audit, Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Monitor foreign exchange exposure and implement appropriate risk mitigation measures.

* Act as a key finance business partner to US-based leadership and global finance teams.
* Drive standardization of financial processes, reporting frameworks, and controls across geographies.
* Present financial performance, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
* Ensure effective coordination between India finance operations and US corporate finance.

* **Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing finance and accounting team.
* Build a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Drive automation, process optimization, and digital transformation across finance operations.
* Establish KPIs and performance metrics for the finance function.

Requirements:

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) with 15+ years of post-qualification experience (PQE) in Finance and Accounting, including significant experience in senior finance leadership roles.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations
jobs.description:
Portage Point is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States and an office in Gurugram.

The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transaction, transitions and transformations.

Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm's platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.

The Technology function serves as the strategic and operational core of the firm's AI platform – building the enterprise-grade infrastructure, AI product platform and data foundation that power Portage Point's AI-enabled advisory model. The team architects and operates the multi-tenant Portage Point Platform, the Enterprise Data Vault and a portfolio of 15 AI products spanning all practice lines. Working directly with US leadership and practice line leaders, the team translates the firm's ambition – a digital AI version of every advisory capability – into a governed, scalable and commercially deployable technology platform.

The Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations will report directly into the CTO, and holds unified accountability for Portage Point corporate technology environment and security posture. As firm scales, there is a need for robust IT operations, security and infrastructure planning and management. This Director ensures the firm's IT foundation is reliable, secure and audit-ready, integrating network and endpoint operations, Microsoft 365 governance, ITSM delivery, Zero Trust security architecture, SOC 2 Type II compliance and AI-specific security controls under a single point of ownership. The role approves IT operations and service management designs, security architecture decisions, vendor engagements and infrastructure implementation decisions within CTO-approved standards.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design and operate enterprise network infrastructure (for e.g. Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, dual-ISP failover, next-gen firewall) and Microsoft 365 environment (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft Purview) — covering tenant governance, licensing optimisation, DLP, retention and compliance features; manage the endpoint platform (Intune / Autopilot) including device enrolment, configuration, patch management and Conditional Access compliance enforcement
* Partner with the Head of Innovation and Product Manager on the platform roadmap, product intake from practice lines and release readiness
* Own the ITSM framework (ServiceNow or Jira Service Management) across incident, change, problem, service request and asset management; operate the IT service desk with P1–P4 SLA tiers, CSAT measurement and self-service knowledge base; personally own IT onboarding (Day 1 device, accounts and access) and offboarding (account revocation and access audit) within defined SLAs
* Design and enforce end-to-end security architecture with Zero Trust Network Access, micro-segmentation, Azure AD / Entra ID PIM, Conditional Access, application-layer security (OWASP Top 10 controls for all AI products), encryption, key management (Azure Key Vault) and AI-specific controls covering prompt injection defenses, model access controls and audit trails for all LLM interactions
* Own the SOC 2 Type II program – map platform and corporate IT controls to AICPA Trust Services Criteria, manage gap remediation, coordinate the external audit and produce the SOC 2 report for client and PE sponsor review; maintain TPI's information security policy suite; ensure compliance (personal data mapping, legal basis documentation, breach notification); manage the third-party and vendor risk assessment program
* Design and operate the vulnerability management program (Tenable.io or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management) with automated scanning and enforced remediation SLAs; deploy and operate SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel) for identity, data exfiltration and AI-specific threat detection; own the Incident Response Plan and personally lead all P1 and P2 security incidents
* Lead and develop the combined IT and security team of engineers and analysts; own IT procurement (TCO analysis, with CTO) and the full vendor portfolio; design and test IT BCP and DR procedures; produce monthly ITSM performance review and quarterly security dashboard for the CTO and COO
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Lead technical trainings on architecture, data engineering and AI infrastructure
* Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required
* 11 plus years in IT leadership with demonstrated ownership of both corporate IT operations (infrastructure, service management) and cybersecurity (architecture, compliance)
* Experience as the senior IT and security lead in a professional services, advisory or GCC environment; Big Four or comparable advisory GCC experience a strong differentiator
* Located in or willing to relocate to Gurugram, India
* ITIL 4 Managing Professional (or above) and CISSP, CISM or equivalent cybersecurity certification required; must have designed and operated a live ITSM framework and personally owned a SOC 2 Type II program
* Production experience with the Microsoft security stack at scale (500+ users): Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, Intune, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Purview; enterprise network infrastructure (Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, NGFW); ZTNA implementation experiences a differentiator
* ServiceNow or Jira Service Management administration — must have built incident, change and asset management workflows from scratch; hands-on PAM (HashiCorp Vault or CyberArk) and secrets management program ownership; vulnerability scanning and CI / CD security integration (SAST / DAST) experience
* Prior exposure to private equity, M&A, or restructuring transaction environments preferred; ability to collaborate across US and India time zones and willingness to flex working hours for cross-border stakeholder engagement
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Emirates NBD is a market leader across the MENAT (Middle East, North Africa and Türkiye) region with a presence in 13 countries, serving over 9 million customers. Emirates NBD is the leading financial services brand in the UAE with a Brand value of approximately USD 4 billion. As a
**Customer Journey Optimization Lead**

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary:
  
  
The Visa Direct CEMEA - Business Strategy and Planning - Director is the Business Planning & Strategy lead for Visa Direct in CEMEA, based in Dubai. The role works closely with the head of Strategy and Business Planning for CMS, as well as the VP, Head of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA, as strategic and planning partner on all internal and external initiatives. This role will help drive the strategy and transformation of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA while collaborating with key members of the CEMEA Leadership Team, Global Visa Direct Team, and other stakeholders.
  
  
**Strategy**
This role encompasses:
  
  

* Own the end-to-end Visa Direct CEMEA strategy, and translate Visa 2030 priorities into sub-regional and country plans with clear owners and milestones.
* Set product and use-case priorities by market with Regional and Global Visa Direct Commercialization and Product teams; prioritise opportunities through market sizing, whitespace, competitor and market-share analysis.
* Lead analysis and recommendations on Visa Direct pricing, incentives and IRF changes, and support M&A, investment and partnership opportunities with due diligence and business cases.
* Scan market, regulatory and ecosystem trends (e.g. real-time payments, stablecoins, fintech disruption) and provide insights on impact to strategy and key initiatives; coordinate with the VCS BPO Director on topics spanning CMS.

**Business Planning & Performance**

* With Finance and key business partners, lead the annual operating plan (AOP) and multi-year outlook, target setting, OKR planning and review, scorecards and business reviews; track quarterly Opex and investment.
* Maintain one consolidated view of revenue, net revenue, AANR and other KPIs, flag gaps and risks early, and reuse CMS Data, Analytics & AI and global dashboards rather than duplicating reporting.
* Drive AANR-to-net-revenue conversion by tracking signed agreements through launch to live volume; run pipeline and AANR governance with sub-regional sales leaders and shape priority deal strategy with CMS Deals Management.

**Sales And Account Management Excellence**

* Support the sales and account management center of excellence (COE): manage sales and implementation pipelines, share sales goals with partnering client segment units and define the optimal client coverage model.
* Plan sales targets in line with the AOP; provide inputs to incentive design (SIP) and recognition programs; monitor team performance against targets.
* Optimize sales processes, tools (MS Dynamics) and funding programs (e.g. VIK, MDF), with training to improve the team's skills.
* Orchestrate account planning to identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities, and drive the annual Global Client Engagement Survey (GCES) and corrective actions.

**Communications**

* Maintain internal communications (all-hands, newsletters) and share success stories across the CEMEA Money Movement organization.
* Lead materials for key cadences (MBRs, QBRs, all-staffs, Global and CEMEA LT sessions, client councils) and run the leadership operating rhythm with clear agendas, decisions and actions.
* Liaise with Global Money Movement, Investor Relations and Communications for Visa CEO, CFO, President and investment community forums.

**Execution**

* As a strategic partner to the CEMEA CMS head of BPO and head of Money Movement, organize and prioritize critical information and data for efficient decision-making and manage time-sensitive senior requests.
* Deliver strategic initiatives, from spinning up cross-functional teams to deal due diligence, and build the program management function to drive execution of key CEMEA Money Movement initiatives.
* Coordinate planning cycles with Global Visa Direct and Global CMS BPO, bring global best practice to the region and reuse CMS BPO and Centers of Excellence capabilities rather than rebuilding them.
* Work as one team with the other CMS functional BPOs and CoE to share best practices from Visa Direct with the wider team

This role sits at the intersection of multiple functions, so organizational savvy and interpersonal skills are critical. It works with Product groups, AEs, Merchant Sales, Regions, Operations, Technology, Risk, Data Science, Marketing, Communications, Legal, Corporate Strategy, Interchange/Pricing and Finance. About 60% of the role is the recurring operating rhythm (planning, OKRs, MBR/QBR, pipeline and performance reviews, Opex) and 40% strategic, project and ad-hoc work. The individual will be a thought leader in strategy and business growth with a proven track record in fast-paced environments with demanding timelines.
  
  
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, MD, PhD).
* Prior experience in management consulting or corporate strategy.
* Proven track record in annual and multi-year planning, OKRs and executive business reviews; strong financial acumen, including business cases and financial modeling.
* Financial/payment industry knowledge mandatory (money movement, cross-border flows); experience across emerging, multi-country markets such as CEMEA.
* Excellent problem-solving skills, customer-centric mindset and thought leadership, with evidence of tangible business results.
* Excellent communication, collaboration and influence skills; able to explain complex concepts to broad audiences and lead cross-functional teams to obtain buy-in.
* Strong sense of urgency and experience driving to successful commercialization; takes prompt, decisive action after analyzing relevant information.
* Ability to explain complex business and technical concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way.
* Experience leading and developing people; inclusive, learning-agile, with a real interest in the fintech ecosystem and a technology / digital-first approach; English required, Arabic, Russian or French an advantage.
* High levels of learning-agility with a real interest in the fintech ecosystem and a ‘technology / digital-first’ approach.
* Diversity of thought and experience. Continually seeks new perspectives and feedback, takes an inclusive approach, and engages diverse points of view.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

We are looking for an experienced technology leader to drive the strategy, architecture, implementation, and continuous enhancement of CRM and Cognitive Technology solutions.

The role will focus on leveraging enterprise CRM platforms, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, automation, and intelligent technologies to enhance customer engagement, streamline business processes, and improve overall customer experience.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in enterprise technology, CRM transformation, solution architecture, and emerging cognitive technologies, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable and innovative technology solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. CRM Strategy & Transformation**

* Lead the development and implementation of enterprise CRM strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Drive CRM transformation initiatives to improve customer relationship management, engagement, and service delivery.
* Oversee CRM platform implementation, customization, integration, and optimization.
* Ensure CRM solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

**2. Cognitive Technology & AI**

* Drive the adoption of Cognitive Technologies, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI across CRM platforms.
* Identify opportunities to implement AI-powered customer engagement, intelligent automation, chatbots, virtual assistants, and predictive analytics.
* Explore emerging technologies to improve customer insights, personalization, and operational efficiency.
* Lead the integration of AI-driven solutions into existing enterprise applications and CRM ecosystems.

**3. Enterprise Architecture & Technology Integration**

* Define and oversee CRM solution architecture, system integration, and technology roadmaps.
* Ensure seamless integration between CRM platforms, core banking systems, APIs, enterprise applications, and data platforms.
* Work closely with infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, and application development teams.
* Ensure technology solutions comply with enterprise architecture, security, and regulatory requirements.

**4. Project & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead large-scale CRM and digital transformation projects from planning through implementation.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, senior management, and technology teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
* Manage technology vendors, implementation partners, budgets, and project timelines.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to cross-functional teams.

**5. Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate emerging CRM and Cognitive Technology solutions.
* Establish technology standards, best practices, and governance frameworks.
* Monitor technology performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Drive innovation initiatives that enhance customer experience and business value.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 15+ years of experience in IT, enterprise technology, CRM, solution architecture, or digital transformation.
* Strong experience in enterprise CRM strategy, implementation, customization, and integration.
* Hands-on exposure to Cognitive Technologies, AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, APIs, system integration, and cloud technologies.
* Experience leading large-scale technology transformation projects.
* Strong stakeholder management and leadership capabilities.
* Experience within banking, financial services, or other regulated industries is an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* Enterprise CRM platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, or equivalent.
* Cognitive Technologies, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning.
* Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF.
* Cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.
* API management, application integration, and enterprise systems.
* Data analytics, automation, and intelligent workflow solutions.
* **Technology governance, security, and compliance.**

**Preferred Certifications**

* TOGAF or other Enterprise Architecture certifications.
* Microsoft Azure AI or relevant AI certifications.
* CRM platform certifications (Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Salesforce).
* Relevant certifications in AI, Machine Learning, or Cloud Architecture.

This role sits within our Fraud and Financial Crime solution and will focus on delivering technology-enabled transformation across Financial Services clients, with particular emphasis on AML, sanctions, fraud, and broader financial crime domains.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine deep Financial Services domain expertise, strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, and practical experience in data, analytics, and AI technologies to support clients in addressing complex regulatory and operational challenges. The role will span advisory, solution design, and implementation, driving innovative, scalable, and value-driven outcomes.
  
  
In addition to client delivery, the role will play a critical part in building KPMG’s market proposition, developing client relationships, and growing the practice in line with KPMG’s values and strategic priorities.

*Client Engagement & Business Development*

* Lead end-to-end bid processes, from opportunity qualification through to deal closure.
* Identify emerging client needs, market trends, and regulatory developments in financial crime and fraud.

* Lead the delivery of complex, technology-enabled transformation programmes, particularly those leveraging data, analytics, and AI.
* Oversee engagement quality, ensuring outputs meet KPMG standards and client expectations.

* Provide guidance on solution design, architecture, and implementation approaches across financial crime use cases.
* Drive innovation and development of reusable assets and solutions.

*People Leadership & Practice Development*

* Lead, coach, and develop high-performing, multidisciplinary teams across data engineering, data science, and domain specialists.
* Support recruitment, resourcing, and capability development initiatives within the practice.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance culture, aligned with KPMG values.
* Define and embed best practices, methodologies, and delivery standards to enhance quality and consistency.
* Contribute to the broader growth and strategic development of the Financial Crime and Fraud solution.

**Required Experience**

* Extensive experience within Financial Services, with a focus on Financial Crime, Fraud, or Forensics.

+ Sanctions
+ Transaction monitoring
+ Fraud detection and prevention
+ Financial crime technology and transformation

* Strong understanding of end-to-end data and analytics lifecycle
* Demonstrated ability to design and deliver technology-enabled solutions, including development of reusable assets and accelerators.
* Experience in building, mentoring, and scaling data and analytics teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience within Big 4 or leading consulting firms.
* Exposure to RegTech / FCC technology platforms.

* Define and execute the finance transformation vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned to organisational objectives.
* Lead large-scale finance and business transformation initiatives across multiple functions and stakeholders.
* Drive process optimisation across key finance areas including financial close, controllership, treasury, reporting, planning, tax, and governance.
* Partner with executive leadership to establish priorities, secure buy-in, and ensure successful programme delivery.
* Oversee transformation workstreams, ensuring delivery of business benefits, operational improvements, and performance targets.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Own the revenue cycle, cash and controls for UK healthcare organisations, lead the receivables and payables teams, and deputise for the Director, Finance (Healthcare). A senior role in Dubai with real ownership.

About Salvone

Salvone Technology Solutions FZCO is a Dubai technology consultancy that delivers end to end transformation for organisations in healthcare, hospitality and other highly regulated industries. We have deep roots in UK health and social care and a growing presence across the Middle East and Asia.

Our healthcare clients include mental health hospitals, residential and nursing care, supported living, children's services and specialist complex care. In hospitality and F&B, we support multi-location brands with ERP, supply chain and workforce systems built to scale. We own the full journey, from discovery to optimisation, and design every solution around how our clients really operate.

The role

We are hiring a Financial Controller to own the revenue cycle and day-to-day finance operations for the UK healthcare organisations our Finance Healthcare team supports. You will be accountable for cash, billing integrity and financial controls across receivables, payables and banking, lead the teams that deliver them, and deputise for the Director, Finance (Healthcare). It is a senior role with real ownership in a function that is building to a corporate standard.

Reports to

Director, Finance (Healthcare)

What you will do

- Revenue cycle: own it end to end for the UK healthcare entities, from funding and contracts to cash, with full accountability for results.

- Leadership: lead and develop the receivables and payables functions, and set their standards, priorities and performance rhythm.

- Billing integrity: run billing as a controlled monthly close in Odoo, with every variance explained and leakage fixed at source.

- Cash and working capital: improve cash conversion and the aged debt profile, and handle escalated disputes with NHS bodies, ICBs and Local Authorities.

- Controls: own the control environment across receivables, payables and banking, to an audit-ready standard.

- Reporting: give the Director, Finance (Healthcare) a clear, timely view of cash, risk and the decisions needed.

- Deputy: act for the Director, Finance (Healthcare) within delegated authority.

What you bring

- Professionally qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CPA).

- 6 to 8 years in finance, including at least 2 years leading a team.

- Proven ownership of a revenue cycle or receivables function in a multi-entity business, with measurable impact on cash.

- Strong control and close discipline; comfortable leading audit work.

- Advanced ERP capability (Odoo preferred), including process and reporting design.

- Senior stakeholder presence: credible with senior stakeholders, funders and banks.

Nice to have

- UK health and social care funding (NHS, ICBs, Local Authorities, Continuing Healthcare, self-funders); we teach this during induction.

- Experience with healthcare billing or practice management systems.

- GBP accounting and supporting UK operations from overseas.

- External audit support and building finance processes from scratch.

Working pattern and location

Full time, on site, Monday to Friday, 10:00 to 19:00.

Armada Tower 2, Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT), Dubai.

How to apply

Please apply through our careers page using this link:

https://careers.salvone.com/jobs/financial-controller-255?utm\_campaign=Job+Campaign&utm\_medium=Website&utm\_source=Indeed+-+paid+ad

We review every application and will contact you about next steps. Questions? Email careers@salvone.com.

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Dubai: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* Have you led a finance team for at least 2 years? Please give the team size and your role.
* Have you worked with Odoo? If yes, which versions and modules?

Experience:

* Finance: 6 years (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CPA) (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Implementation Director
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa is transforming the future of banking and payments through Pismo, Visa's cloud-native core banking and issuer processing platform. Built to help financial institutions modernize legacy infrastructure, launch innovative products faster, and scale securely in real time, Pismo is enabling the next generation of digital banking experiences across the globe.

As an Implementation Director, you will lead the successful delivery of some of Visa and Pismo's most strategic client transformation programs. Working with leading banks, fintechs, and financial institutions, you will be responsible for orchestrating large-scale platform implementations that redefine how clients issue cards, process transactions, manage accounts, and deliver modern payment experiences to their customers.

This is a highly visible leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, payments, and transformation. You will act as the executive sponsor for complex implementation programs, partnering with senior client stakeholders and cross-functional Visa and Pismo teams to drive delivery excellence, mitigate risk, and accelerate value realization.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, executive stakeholder management, and deep program leadership capabilities to guide clients through critical modernization journeys, helping them move from legacy platforms to cloud-native infrastructure that supports future growth and innovation.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

* Lead end-to-end implementation and transformation programs for strategic Pismo clients, from contract signature and mobilization through go-live and post-launch stabilization.
* Serve as the primary executive point of contact for client leadership teams, building trusted relationships with C-suite, business, operations, technology, and transformation stakeholders.
* Drive governance, delivery strategy, program execution, dependency management, and risk mitigation across complex multi-workstream initiatives.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Client Success, Information Security, Risk, and Commercial teams to ensure successful delivery against client commitments.
* Establish executive steering committees and governance forums, providing clear visibility into program progress, milestones, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.
* Navigate complex organizational environments to align stakeholders, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain momentum across large-scale transformation programs.
* Champion implementation excellence while ensuring clients achieve measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, and accelerated time-to-value.
* Support clients through change management, platform adoption, and operational readiness as they transition onto Pismo's cloud-native infrastructure.
* Capture lessons learned and implementation best practices to continuously strengthen Visa and Pismo's delivery frameworks.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD

  

* Over 15 years of experience in technology-driven financial services, with a strong focus on leading large-scale implementation and transformation projects for global fintech's and banks.
* Detailed technical knowledge of payments ecosystem in GCC countries, more specifically implementation and certification of Jaywan and AEP Switch in UAE
* Technical knowledge of payments and banking platforms operating in the cloud in a microservice architecture, with REST/JSON API’s and data streaming.
* Educational background in solutions architecture and software engineering. Cloud certifications are a plus.
* Having completed a core banking, payments transformation implementation from contract signature to production live.
* Expertise in building and scaling high-performing teams, with a hands-on leadership style that emphasizes mentorship, empowerment, and a culture of accountability.
* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-market projects on time and within scope, leveraging advanced project management methodologies (Agile, Lean, and hybrid models) and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
* Recognized for forging strong, trust-based relationships with C-level executives, clients, and cross-functional partners, ensuring alignment and transparency throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Adept at translating business strategy into actionable plans, optimizing processes, and driving continuous improvement through data-driven decision-making and KPI management.
* Russian speaker is highly desirable

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**About The Opportunity**

* Fintoo is a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser and fee-based financial planning firm offering holistic financial planning, investment advisory, global investing, and tax advisory services. * Own the Bengaluru business plan, revenue targets, growth strategy, and profitability.

* Translate annual objectives into actionable quarterly and monthly plans; track revenue, conversion ratios, paid customer acquisition, AUA growth, client retention, and individual productivity.
* Identify performance gaps early and implement corrective actions; balance growth investment, acquisition costs, team capacity, and profitability; build dashboards and repeatable processes for scale.

* Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience in building and scaling advisory businesses in competitive markets.

* Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with product, marketing, and operations teams.

* Opportunity to build a trusted, high-performing, and profitable advisory business in Bengaluru.
* Focus on establishing a strong local presence, creating a consistent acquisition engine, growing AUA and long-term advisory relationships.

**Company Description**
iLink Digital is a global technology services company that helps enterprises turn AI strategies into practical, production-grade solutions. As a Microsoft Azure Expert MSP with 13 Advanced Specializations, and key partnerships with Databricks, Salesforce, and AWS, iLink delivers complex AI, data, cloud, and digital transformations across industries such as healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, retail, telecom, and professional services. With 3,000 consultants in 25 locations, the company combines deep engineering expertise with proprietary platforms including iGentic, BEAK, and AgileXL to accelerate enterprise outcomes. iLink’s integrated practice areas cover Data.AI, Digital.AI, Cloud & Infrastructure, Security.AI, and AI Business Solutions, supported by an AI Hub for rapid experimentation to scaled deployment. We are looking for a techno-commercial leader for a VP-level role to drive Microsoft solutions sales, strategic customer relationships, and revenue growth across India and APAC.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 10–15 years of experience in enterprise technology sales, solution consulting, presales, or techno-commercial business development.

* Proven experience in consultative selling, product demonstrations, and solution-led sales.

* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working with cross-functional technical and business teams.

**Preferred Candidate Background**

* Established Microsoft ecosystem relationships and access to enterprise decision-makers.
* BFSI domain exposure or experience in other large enterprise segments.
* Strong technical understanding combined with business development and consultative sales capability.

A senior, hands-on techno-commercial professional who can build strategic customer relationships, demonstrate Microsoft solutions, engage C-level stakeholders, and independently drive revenue growth. jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Milestone Technologies is seeking a Director, Sales to lead client engagement efforts with an enterprise level bioscience organization from our offices in Hyderabad, India. Responsibilities will include driving revenue growth and expanding strategic relationships to capture larger scale technology programs that support a global pharmaceutical organization. This role serves as a senior client-facing leader, accountable for revenue acceleration, executive-level stakeholder management, and close partnership with both Milestone Client Executive and Delivery Leadership to ensure aligned growth, strong client satisfaction, and successful execution of strategic initiatives. Must have demonstrated experience selling and partnering with Life Sciences and Pharma India GCC’s.
  
  
The ideal candidate must have a proven record of closing high-profile deals, defining operating rhythms for a sales organization, and partnering with cross-functional teams to accelerate pipeline and sales growth. Passionate about revenue growth through experimentation and operating at the intersection of data, inbound and outbound sales development, and new GTM technologies – including the use of automation and AI. Most importantly, you set a high standard for performance, are analytically driven, intellectually curious, and lead with empathy.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Revenue Growth and Acceleration
  
  

* Own and drive revenue growth across the global pharma account.
* Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities that expand the client relationship.
* Build and execute account growth strategies aligned to client priorities and business objectives.
* Partner with internal teams to shape and pursue high-value opportunities at scale.
* Track pipeline, forecast revenue, and proactively identify risks and growth gaps.

Senior Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior leaders across the client organization.
* Engage executive stakeholders to deepen strategic alignment and uncover enterprise-wide opportunities.
* Serve as a senior point of contact for strategic discussions, escalations, and relationship development.
* Influence decision-makers through credible business insight, consultative selling, and value-based conversations.

Partnership with Global Milestone Leadership
  
  

* Collaborate closely with the Client Executive, Delivery Leadership, and ELT to align sales strategy with delivery execution.
* Ensure account planning, opportunity shaping, and solution design are coordinated across commercial and delivery teams.
* Support cross-functional collaboration to improve client experience and drive sustainable growth.
* Help balance near-term delivery priorities with long-term revenue and account expansion objectives.

Account Strategy and Execution
  
  

* Partner with Client Engagement and Milestone Executive Leadership to maintain a clear global account plan with accuracy of pipeline, actioned programs, and measurable growth targets.
* Identify whitespace opportunities, market trends, and client needs that can be translated into business opportunities.
* Lead pursuit strategy for strategic initiatives and large-scale programs.
* Ensure strong coordination across geographies, service lines, and internal stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of experience in sales, account management, business development, or client leadership, preferably within pharma, life sciences, or a related global enterprise environment.
* Excellent communication, strategic thinking, and relationship-building skills with a proven track record of supporting Global Enterprise level organizations
* Experience supporting transformation, innovation, or digital/AI-enabled solutions.
* Proven track record of driving revenue growth and closing complex deals with India GCC’s
* Strong experience managing senior and executive-level client relationships.
* Demonstrated ability to partner across sales, delivery, and operations teams.
* Deep understanding of global pharma client dynamics and enterprise buying processes.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working in global or matrixed client organizations.
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and long sales cycles.
* Strong commercial acumen and consultative selling capabilities.
* Collaborative leadership style with a focus on alignment and accountability.

Success Measures
  
  

* Revenue growth against account plan
* Expansion of strategic opportunities and pipeline
* Strength of senior stakeholder relationships
* Client satisfaction and retention
* Effective partnership with Milestone Client Executive and Delivery Leadership

**Additional Responsibilities And Requirements**

* Exceptional communication and presentation skills
* Bachelor's degree in a business or engineering-related field
* Ability to travel to client sites as needed
* Entrepreneurial energy, demonstrated by a passion to take on new challenges, ability to adapt to a changing competitive environment, and comfort with agile ways of working

**Title – Client Partner**

**Location:**
Hyderabad (Hybrid – 3 days per week in office)

**About TechBlocks**

TechBlocks is a global technology consulting and digital engineering firm headquartered in Toronto, with delivery centers across North America and India. We build modern, cloud-native, AI-enabled digital platforms for Fortune 500 and mid-market enterprises. Our engineering-led, design-thinking DNA drives innovation across industries like Retail, Energy & Utilities, Financial Services, and Industrial IoT.

Our clients include world's leading brands in retail, CPG, financial services, energy, utilities amongst other verticals.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly organized, hands-on, and strategic leader to serve as Client Partner, managing TechBlocks’ top enterprise clients in the Retail Domain. This person will combine exceptional relationship skills with program management discipline, ensuring client satisfaction, delivery excellence, and growth across multiple accounts.

The ideal candidate has deep experience in the Retail industry and technology professional services, operating within a U.S./Canada–India hybrid delivery model and is passionate about building AI- and cloud-native solutions that drive real business impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Leadership & Growth**

* Serve as the executive relationship leader across TechBlocks’ top enterprise clients in the FinTech/Utilities/Retail domain.
* Build deep, trusted partnerships with C-level and V-level executives (CIO, CTO, CDO, CPO, VP Engineering, CEO).
* Define and execute multi-year account strategies focused on digital transformation, AI, and cloud modernization.
* Identify growth opportunities within existing accounts and drive proposal development in collaboration with practice and delivery teams.

**Program Governance & Operational Execution**

* Be extremely organized and disciplined in managing complex enterprise programs with multiple workstreams.
* Own and manage delivery governance, including tracking budgets, milestones, resourcing, and customer satisfaction across accounts.
* Conduct regular health checks, QBRs, and governance reviews to maintain alignment with client business outcomes.
* Work closely with delivery leaders, HR, and resource management to ensure programs meet or exceed expectations.
* Stay hands-on — proactively track resource pipelines, hiring statuses, and utilization across global teams; manage risks and dependencies in real time.

**Global Delivery Collaboration**

* Operate seamlessly across onshore, nearshore, and offshore teams — leveraging TechBlocks’ Global Capability Center (GCC) model.
* Bridge delivery and strategy teams across Canada, the U.S., and India to ensure alignment and velocity.
* Champion a “One TechBlocks” culture rooted in transparency, collaboration, and innovation.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years in IT professional services or digital engineering firms; 5+ years in senior account or client partner roles managing large enterprise portfolios.
* Proven success managing $10M+ accounts with distributed delivery models (U.S./Canada + India).
* Strong understanding of digital transformation, AI/ML, data & analytics, and cloud-native software development (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Must have a background in technology services/software engineering, not in infrastructure, licensing, or product resale.
* Exceptional program management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple enterprise programs simultaneously.
* Hands-on leader with attention to detail, ability to dive into the trenches, manage resourcing and hiring risks, and drive outcomes proactively.
* Skilled at working with senior executives, influencing strategic agendas, and driving client success through operational excellence.
* Entrepreneurial mindset, growth-driven attitude, and strong business acumen.

**Why TechBlocks**

* Work directly with Fortune 500 executives and digital transformation leaders.
* Be part of a fast-growing, AI-native software engineering firm redefining global delivery through our GCC-as-a-Service model.
* Collaborate with global teams in Canada, the U.S., and India on cutting-edge cloud and AI initiatives.
* Competitive compensation, performance incentives, and a culture that values ownership, agility, and innovation.

jobs.title: Head - Hospital Partnerships & Enterprise Solutions
jobs.description:
**About Tapza:**

Tapza Technologies builds AI-powered software for pharmacies, clinics, diagnostic centres, and hospitals.

Our pharmacy platform is already commercially deployed. We are now preparing controlled hospital pilots around
**Revenue Cycle Management and Hospital Information Management Systems**
, with a focus on improving documentation, reducing preventable claim deductions, and simplifying hospital operations.

**The Role:**

We are looking for a hands-on leader to build and own Tapza’s hospital business across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.

This person will be responsible for the complete enterprise journey:

**Target account identification → Hospital leadership access → Discovery → Solution workshop → Pilot design → Commercial agreement → Implementation coordination → Reference account → Expansion**

This is not a role limited to introductions, relationship management, or team supervision. The selected person must personally lead strategic hospital opportunities and remain involved until pilots are implemented and converted into long-term commercial relationships.

**What You Will Own:**

* Build a qualified pipeline of medium and large hospitals across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
* Develop relationships with hospital promoters, CEOs, COOs, CFOs, CIOs, administrators, medical directors, insurance heads, and RCM teams.
* Understand existing hospital workflows, technology systems, revenue-cycle challenges, and implementation concerns.
* Lead enterprise discovery meetings, product demonstrations, solution workshops, proposals, and commercial negotiations.
* Design controlled RCM/HIMS pilots with clearly defined scope, stakeholders, success metrics, timelines, and conversion paths.
* Coordinate with Tapza’s product, engineering, implementation, security, and support teams.
* Stay involved through implementation, adoption, outcome measurement, and pilot-to-contract conversion.
* Build partnerships with hospital groups, healthcare consultants, TPAs, insurers, and system integrators.
* Help create Tapza’s first major hospital reference accounts and gradually build the hospital-enterprise team.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* 10+ years of experience in healthcare enterprise sales, hospital partnerships, healthcare IT, RCM, medical technology, or hospital business development.
* Demonstrated experience working with medium or large hospitals.
* Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise opportunities.
* Experience personally taking hospital accounts from the first conversation through pilot, negotiation, implementation, or commercial closure.
* Strong professional relationships within the hospital ecosystem in Telangana and/or Andhra Pradesh.
* Understanding of hospital procurement, IT and security evaluation, implementation risk, and enterprise contracting.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively and remain personally active in the field.
* Ability to operate effectively in an early-stage company where the hospital-enterprise playbook is still being built.

**Preferred Backgrounds:**

Direct experience selling or implementing any of the following is strongly preferred:

* HIMS, HMIS, or HIS
* EMR or EHR
* Revenue Cycle Management or claims platforms
* PACS, RIS, or LIMS
* Hospital ERP or clinical workflow software
* Healthcare AI or digital-health platforms

We will also consider exceptional candidates from medical technology, capital equipment, hospital digital transformation, TPA/provider-network partnerships, hospital administration, and hospital corporate business roles-provided they demonstrate hospital access, commercial ownership, and the ability to sell complex enterprise solutions.

**Location and Work Model**

* Hyderabad
* Full-time and on-site
* Extensive travel across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh

5–8 years

**Role Overview**

Drive growth of Vivriti Capital’s
**Supply Chain Finance (SCF)**
portfolio by acquiring new anchor relationships, deepening existing anchor ecosystems, and ensuring smooth onboarding, activation, utilization and portfolio quality across vendor, dealer, distributor and receivable financing programs.

This role is central to Vivriti’s mission to
**deliver high-quality, technology-enabled working capital solutions**
to mid-market corporates and their ecosystems, while maintaining best-in-class credit governance and risk standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1) Anchor Acquisition & Relationship Management**

* Identify, pitch and acquire anchor corporates suitable for Vivriti’s SCF programs (payables, receivables, dealer/channel finance).
* Build relationships with
  **CFOs, Treasury teams, Procurement, Commercial and Finance Operations**
  of anchor companies.
* Own end‑to‑end cycle: prospecting → requirements understanding → solution design → term sheet negotiation → documentation → go‑live.

**2) SCF Program Structuring & Implementation**

* Structure anchor-specific SCF programs involving:
* Vendor Financing (Payables)
* Dealer / Distributor Financing (Receivables)
* Anchor-backed Receivables Programs
* Drive alignment with
  **Credit, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Technology and Finance**
  .
* Ensure smooth onboarding workflows via
  **Vivriti’s digital platform**
  , including KYC, documentation, ERP/GSTN integration, invoice workflows, and escrows.

**3) Vendor/Dealer Onboarding & Ecosystem Activation**

* Scale the vendor/dealer ecosystem through targeted campaigns, joint meets, and anchor-driven engagement by supervising the dealer/ vendor on-boarding RMs.
* Ensure high activation rates, appropriate ticket sizes and program utilization.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth workflow.

**4) Portfolio Growth & Yield Management**

* Deliver
  **AUM growth, utilization, disbursements, fee income and yield targets**
  .
* Identify opportunities for cross-sell into other Vivriti products (term loans, working capital).
* Monitor seasonality and business cycles to optimize throughput and pricing.

**5) Credit Quality, Governance & Compliance**

* Monitor
  **DPD, payment behaviour, EWS, documentation hygiene and anchor payment discipline**
  .
* Ensure adherence to
  **RBI guidelines, AML/KYC norms, internal credit policy and operational controls**
  .
* Collaborate with Collections for early bucket recoveries, dispute resolution and anchor alignment.

**6) Internal Collaboration & Data Insights**

* Work closely with Product & Tech for improvements in SCF platform journeys and process automation.
* Maintain accurate MIS, dashboards and portfolio reporting for management reviews.
* Provide market intelligence and competition benchmarking to strengthen Vivriti’s SCF offerings.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong understanding of
  **Supply Chain Finance / Dealer & Vendor Financing**
  structures.
* Proven experience in managing
  **large & mid corporate (anchor) relationships**
  .
* Ability to structure and scale programs across Tier 1/2/3 geographies.
* Strong commercial, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Sound understanding of credit, risk, and portfolio dynamics.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 5–8 years of experience in
  **SCF / Corporate Banking / NBFC SCF businesses**
  .
* Prior experience handling
  **anchor-led SCF programs**
  is mandatory.
* Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth NBFC environment.
* Hands-on leader with strong ownership mindset.

**Education**

* MBA/PGDM (Finance/Marketing) or CA preferred.
* Additional certifications in Trade Finance/SCF are an advantage.

* Identify opportunities to expand client business and drive incremental account growth through cross-sell and broader solution engagement.

* Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across product, service, and coverage teams.
* Strong communication, presentation, and influencing skills.
* Fluency in English is required; Arabic language capability would be an advantage.
* Strong appreciation of local market dynamics and cultural nuances across the Middle East.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant work experience; advanced degree such as an MBA is preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working with asset owners, sovereign-related institutions, pension funds, financial institutions, or other large strategic clients within the asset servicing space.
* Experience operating in a regional or multi-market coverage role across the Middle East region.
* Established network and credibility within the Middle East institutional client market

**About Us**
At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.
  
  
Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.
  
  
**About The Team**
At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom & BNY LinkedIn
  
  
**Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards**

* America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
* World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
* “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

**Our Benefits And Rewards**
BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. jobs.title: Director Relationship Manager (FI)
jobs.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* Minimum 10 years’ enterprise sales or direct client coverage and relationship management of a broad spectrum of institutional clients: regional banks, central banks, sovereign wealth funds, insurance, asset managers
* Familiarity with Middle East, GCC and global markets, reflecting cross-border client engagement and product delivery
* Arabic language skills (spoken and written) are an advantage, supporting engagement with regional clients and senior stakeholders
* Strong knowledge of credit, risk, capital markets or regulatory workflows—and the ability to translate GCC regulatory requirements (such as those of the local Central Banks or Capital Monetary Authorities) into Moody’s solutions
* Working knowledge of Moody’s capabilities across KYC and customer onboarding, supplier and third-party risk, commercial and corporate lending, private credit and AI-enabled solutions, with the ability to position them to risk, compliance, credit and technology stakeholders
* Exceptional C-level relationship-building, consultative selling and contract negotiation skills, complemented by independent thought leadership and advisory sales expertise. Demonstrates the ability to generate impactful ideas for clients, influencing outcomes at the highest level
* Demonstrates a strong track record in building and leading high-performing sales teams, with a focus on cross-functional collaboration. Applies strategic planning, pipeline management and disciplined execution to consistently meet or exceed revenue targets
* Excellent communication—listening, presenting and writing—and the confidence to influence senior external and internal stakeholders
* High initiative, resilience and the ability to work independently while fostering teamwork in a matrix environment

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, applied finance, economics or a related field (post graduate finance or risk qualification advantageous)

**Responsibilities**

* Own and expand relationships with the GCC’s Tier 1 banks and a broad spectrum of institutional clients—including central banks, banks, sovereign wealth funds, insurance, asset managers —engaging board and C-suite stakeholders and setting multi-year account strategies aligned to client priorities
* Retain and grow revenue by cross-selling and up-selling the full Moody’s Analytics suite, leveraging advisory sales and innovative solutions across KYC and onboarding, supplier and third-party risk, lending and credit origination, private credit, AI-enabled solutions, credit, ESG, AML, regulatory reporting, data and analytics
* Partner with global product heads to position Moody’s insights in the context of local and regional regulatory and industry trends, including private credit, lending modernisation, AI adoption, automation, KYC and supplier risk management, climate risk and digitised credit workflows
* Travel (~30 %) across the GCC and wider Middle East and, when required, to regional hubs to strengthen senior relationships and align global strategy
* Build, lead and empower high-performing sales teams, fostering talent development and cross-functional collaboration with Product, Specialists, Finance and Legal to drive complex sales cycles, identify new use cases, negotiate commercial terms and close enterprise agreements
* Deliver accurate forecasting and client feedback to senior leadership, surfacing cross-business leads and supporting business growth objectives
* Participate in management and risk committees to support governance, conduct and best execution standards

**About The Team**
You will sit within the Moody’s Analytics Middle East Sales team, a high energy group of enterprise sellers, with this role based in Dubai and focused on the GCC. The team partners with the region’s biggest banks and FIs to deliver Moody’s data, analytics and workflow solutions. Collaboration is core: Relationship Managers lead opportunities while working hand in hand with Product Specialists, Solutions Consultants, Finance and Legal colleagues to solve complex client challenges, accelerate revenue growth and share best practices across the wider regional and global sales organisation.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.
