jobs.title: Custom Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Project Role :**
Custom Software Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
SAP for Banking
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
We are looking for experienced SAP Core Banking / SAP Transactional Banking professionals to join our banking transformation programme.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience working on SAP Banking solutions within the banking domain, preferably across implementation, configuration, integration, migration or production support engagements.
  
  
SAP Core Banking is an industry-specific solution for banking clients, with key capabilities across Deposits Management, Business Partner, Loans Management and Payments.
  
  
Candidates with experience in one or more of these areas are encouraged to apply, with preference given to candidates who have worked across multiple SAP Banking modules and have strong banking domain knowledge.
  
  
Key SAP Banking Areas
  
  
The candidate should have experience in one or more of the following:
  
  

* Deposits Management (DM)

Current Accounts and Savings Accounts
  
  
Term/Time Deposits
  
  
Banking product configuration
  
  
Account opening and lifecycle management
  
  
Interest calculation and processing
  
  
Charges, fees and related account operations
  
  
Deposit product migration and conversion
  
  
Integration with Business Partner and Payments
  
  

* Business Partner (FS-BP)

SAP Financial Services Business Partner
  
  
Customer / Business Partner creation and maintenance
  
  
Business Partner roles and relationships
  
  
Customer data migration
  
  
BP integration with Deposits, Loans and Payments
  
  
Understanding of customer lifecycle processes
  
  

* Loans Management (LM)

Retail/Commercial lending products
  
  
Loan account lifecycle
  
  
Loan creation and disbursement
  
  
Repayment and payment schedules
  
  
Interest and charges
  
  
Loan closure/payoff
  
  
Loan product configuration and migration
  
  
Integration with Payments and Business Partner
  
  

* Payments / Payment Central / Payment Engine

Payment processing and payment lifecycle
  
  
Payment initiation and processing
  
  
Payment routing and distribution
  
  
Payment exceptions and investigation
  
  
Payment-related configuration
  
  
Integration with core banking and external payment systems
  
  
Understanding of domestic/international payment flows
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Work with business and technology teams to understand banking requirements and translate them into SAP Banking solutions.
  
  
Configure and support SAP Core Banking functionality based on business requirements.
  
  
Participate in end-to-end SAP Banking implementation and transformation programmes.
  
  
Support product configuration across Deposits, Loans, Business Partner and Payments.
  
  
Analyse existing legacy banking processes and support their migration to SAP.
  
  
Support data migration, reconciliation and validation activities.
  
  
Work on integration between SAP Banking modules and external banking applications.
  
  
Analyse and resolve functional issues, defects and production incidents.
  
  
Support SIT, UAT, regression testing and production deployment activities.
  
  
Work closely with technical teams on interfaces, APIs, integrations and batch processing.
  
  
Prepare functional specifications, configuration documents, test scenarios and operational documentation.
  
  
Participate in design discussions and provide banking domain expertise.
  
  
Support release planning, implementation and post-go-live activities.
  
  
Collaborate with distributed teams across business, technology, vendors and banking stakeholders.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Must Have:
  
  
Hands-on experience in SAP Banking / SAP Core Banking / SAP Transactional Banking.
  
  
Strong understanding of banking products and processes.
  
  
Experience in at least one of the following:
  
  
Deposits Management
  
  
Loans Management
  
  
Business Partner / FS-BP
  
  
Payments / Payment Engine / Payment Central
  
  
Experience in SAP Banking implementation, migration, configuration or production support.
  
  
Good understanding of integration between SAP Banking components.
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Ability to work with business and technology stakeholders.
  
  
**Preferred Skills**
Candidates with experience across two or more of the following will be preferred:
  
  
SAP Deposits Management
  
  
SAP Loans Management
  
  
SAP Financial Services Business Partner
  
  
SAP Payment Engine / Payments
  
  
SAP Transactional Banking / TRBK
  
  
SAP Banking Services
  
  
Banking product configuration
  
  
Legacy-to-SAP banking migration
  
  
Large-scale banking transformation programmes
  
  
Retail Banking / Corporate Banking
  
  
Account and customer migration
  
  
Banking payments and settlement processes
  
  
Banking Domain Experience
  
  
Candidates should have a good understanding of one or more of the following banking processes:
  
  
Current and Savings Accounts
  
  
Term Deposits
  
  
Customer / Business Partner lifecycle
  
  
Loans and lending products
  
  
Account opening and closure
  
  
Interest and fee processing
  
  
Payments and payment processing
  
  
Account migration
  
  
Customer migration
  
  
Product migration
  
  
Banking reconciliation
  
  
Payment exceptions and investigations
  
  
Integration & Technical Exposure
  
  
Good understanding of integration between SAP Banking and surrounding systems is desirable.
  
  
Exposure to the following would be advantageous:
  
  
APIs / Web Services
  
  
REST / SOAP
  
  
Enterprise integration
  
  
Banking middleware
  
  
Batch processing
  
  
Data migration tools
  
  
Database / SQL
  
  
SAP integration frameworks
  
  
Legacy banking platforms
  
  
Payment systems
  
  
Experience in Transformation / Migration
  
  
Experience in large-scale banking transformation programmes will be highly valuable, particularly:
  
  
Legacy banking platform SAP migration
  
  
Customer and account migration
  
  
Deposit product migration
  
  
Loan migration
  
  
Payment migration
  
  
Data reconciliation and validation
  
  
Application decommissioning
  
  
Parallel run / cutover
  
  
Production deployment and hypercare
  
  
Candidate Profile
  
  
The ideal candidate will be a SAP Banking specialist with strong banking domain knowledge, rather than a generic SAP consultant.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant - Business Consulting Risk - Business Architect - FS - PAN India
jobs.description:
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
  
  
Senior Consultant - Business Consulting Risk - Business Architect - FS - PAN India
  
  
**FS :**
Finance fuels our lives. Banking, Insurance and Wealth management, create the foundations for growth, prosperity and peace of mind. No other Industry touches so many people or shapes so many lives.
  
  
Amid sweeping regulatory change, today’s financial services institutions are focusing on digital transformation, convergence and disruption from an array of nontraditional competitors — all while meeting greater demands for trust and transparency.
  
  
To address this delicate balance of issues, our competent team of business strategists, technologists and industry leaders bring fresh thinking and sector knowledge across banking and capital markets, insurance, and wealth and asset management. The results are seamless collaboration, innovative problem solving, breakthrough performance gains and sustainable value creation.
  
  
We recruit, train and nurture a diverse set of people who dedicate their minds to building the future of financial services. Together, we explore new perspectives with innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to deliver exceptional client service and ensure that what we do today, counts for tomorrow.
  
  
**CNS - Risk - Process & Controls :**
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
  
  
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
  
  
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
  
  
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
  
  
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**

* Drive Target Operating Model (TOM) design across People, Process and Technology dimensions
* Lead end-to-end customer journey and workflow mapping activities
* Strong business architecture experience with process and technology transformation in BFSI

**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**

* CA/MBA/ CFA/ Any Graduate

**Experience**

* 3+ years of expereince as Business Architect in Banking industry

jobs.title: Temenos - SME Business analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced T24 Technical Lead / Solution Architect to drive the end-to-end technical delivery of a core banking implementation. The role will be responsible for owning T24 application development, solution design, customisation, configuration, integration, and production readiness.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Temenos T24 application development, core banking architecture, system integrations, and end-to-end implementation delivery, including at least one full implementation from design through go-live. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, system integrators, and technology teams to ensure the solution aligns with banking requirements, regulatory standards, and approved architectural principles.

Key Responsibilities

1. Application and Development Ownership

* Take ownership of the T24 application build and customisation from project commencement until production go-live.
* Lead and govern the T24 design and development teams, interface teams, and system integrator developers, ensuring alignment with programme scope, plans, milestones, deliverables, risks, and testing from a technology standpoint.
* Establish quality standards for IRDs, IDDs, and FSD documents covering the incumbent bank's products, services, and configurations.
* Own end-to-end delivery governance across all phases and report progress to senior management and steering committees.

2. Solution Design and Architecture

* Coordinate and participate in detailed functional and technical deep-dive sessions with system integrators to validate architecture, scope, IRDs, IDDs, and FSDs against the bank's requirements.
* Lead design discussions with solution designers and bank stakeholders to ensure proposed solutions follow event-driven architecture principles and approved architectural patterns.
* Drive Low-Level Design (LLD) discussions covering T24 Chart of Accounts, customer and account structures, product setup, accounting entries, interfaces with SAS systems, and operational workflows.
* Conduct operational workshops with Finance, Compliance, Risk, Fraud, and Operations teams to finalise process flows and technology integrations.

3. Implementation and Configuration

* Oversee T24 environment setup, parameterisation, configuration, and development of standard and customised functionalities.
* Govern bank-specific configurations and Egypt-specific customisations, ensuring they are justified, documented, and upgrade-safe.
* Oversee DIT, SIT, UAT, performance testing, and Close of Business (COB) readiness.
* Drive cutover activities and ensure production readiness.

4. Integration and Middleware

* Own the T24 integration design with other system integrators and downstream applications, including DMS, Kafka, Camunda, Kong, CRM, AML/KYC, Sanctions, FRM, and Data Lake.
* Oversee Kafka event streaming and real-time messaging of T24 customer, account, and transaction events to SAS systems.
* Govern Camunda workflow orchestration for non-STP case handling, ensuring case outcomes are appropriately posted back to T24.
* Oversee Kong API Gateway integration, including API security and traffic management for T24 APIs.
* Ensure CRM integration supports non-STP workflows and customer interactions.
* Govern SAS system integrations covering customer and account data feeds, transaction screening, fraud checks, and posting of approved outcomes, including restrictions, blocks, and status changes, into T24 following Risk and Compliance clearance.

5. Regulatory and Compliance Alignment

* Ensure T24 configuration, General Ledger, and regulatory reporting meet Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) regulations.
* Ensure compliance with Egyptian AML/CFT requirements, data residency, and information security expectations.
* Apply relevant GCC and international banking compliance practices, including FATF recommendations and OFAC/EU sanctions requirements, while adapting them to the Egyptian regulatory context.
* Support regulatory inspections, audits, and technology-related evidence requests.

6. Stakeholder Management

* Engage and align senior business and technology stakeholders as required.
* Present project status, risks, dependencies, and action points clearly to executive leadership and steering committees.

Role Requirements and Qualifications

* Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in Temenos T24 application development, including at least one complete implementation from design to production go-live.
* Strong technical knowledge of T24 modules, architecture, configuration, customisation, Chart of Accounts, General Ledger, multi-currency processing, and core banking operations.
* Hands-on experience with T24 development tools and frameworks, including OFS, IRIS, REST/SOAP APIs, event and message frameworks, MQ, local routines, enquiries, COB configuration, and TAFJ.
* Strong understanding of core banking processes covering customers, accounts, deposits, payments, accounting, and day-end operations.
* Knowledge of banking integrations involving Kafka, Camunda, Kong, DMS, CRM, AML/KYC, Sanctions, FRM, and Data Lake.
* Understanding of AML/CFT, transaction monitoring, customer risk assessment, CDD/EDD, sanctions screening, and fraud management.
* Familiarity with Egyptian banking regulations, CBE reporting requirements, and data residency expectations.
* Experience in technical delivery governance, system integrator coordination, and stakeholder management.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in large-scale core banking transformation programmes.
* Exposure to Egyptian banking implementations and CBE regulatory requirements.
* Knowledge of GCC banking compliance frameworks and regulatory expectations.

jobs.title: Advisor, Software Architecture
jobs.description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Advisor, Software Architecture
  
  
**What does a successful Software Architecture Advisor do at Fiserv?**
We are looking for a Software Architecture Advisor to help shape the design and modernization of high-throughput payment processing and financial clearing platforms. In this role, you will define architecture patterns, guide engineering standards and support the delivery of highly available, fault-tolerant and scalable solutions across complex enterprise environments.
  
  
You will bring deep experience in software engineering, enterprise architecture, cloud-native design and payment domain integration. Success in this role means enabling strong technical decisions, improving platform resilience and scalability, and partnering across engineering, product and infrastructure teams to support modern, efficient and secure payment systems.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define and lead end-to-end architecture for transaction processing and payment clearing platforms
* Design highly available, fault-tolerant and low-latency systems that support high transaction volumes
* Establish architecture patterns, design standards and technical direction for cloud-native modernization initiatives
* Lead framework and engineering standards using modern Java, Spring Boot and reactive programming approaches
* Drive architectural decisions related to microservices design, service decomposition and governance
* Support integration with payment gateways, clearing houses and financial networks including ACH, SWIFT and RTGS
* Ensure architecture supports compliance, fraud detection and other risk control integrations
* Oversee containerization and orchestration strategies using Docker, Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure platforms
* Support deployment architecture across public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud
* Design and optimize relational and NoSQL data models, including document schemas aligned to application access and query patterns
* Provide hands-on guidance in the use of AI models and AI-assisted development approaches to support engineering productivity and solution design
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews and technical design sessions across engineering teams
* Mentor engineering squads and help resolve complex design, performance and delivery challenges
* Partner with product, engineering, DevOps and platform teams to align business needs with technical strategy
* Drive continuous improvement in architecture practices, scalability, resiliency and engineering quality

**What You Will Need To Have**

* 10 to 12+ years of experience in software engineering
* 4+ years of experience in enterprise or solution architecture roles
* Strong experience designing high-throughput, low-latency and fault-tolerant enterprise systems
* Strong hands-on experience with modern Java, including JDK 11, 17 or 21, and Spring Boot
* Experience with reactive programming and modern distributed application design patterns
* Experience designing microservices-based architectures and governance models
* Experience integrating with payment gateways, clearing houses and financial transaction systems
* Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud deployment across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud
* Strong experience with SQL and NoSQL technologies, including MongoDB
* Experience designing database schemas and query patterns for high-performance applications
* Hands-on experience working with AI large language models or other AI models for development-related use cases
* Strong communication, technical leadership and stakeholder collaboration skills

**What Would Be Great To Have**

* Experience in payment processing, clearing, settlement or financial transaction platforms
* Familiarity with ACH, SWIFT, RTGS and other payment network integration patterns
* Experience with event-driven architecture and streaming technologies
* Knowledge of compliance, fraud detection and security design considerations in financial systems
* Experience leading cloud modernization or platform transformation initiatives
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and guiding architecture across multiple teams
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments

**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**

* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
  
  
**Note To Agencies**
Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
  
  
**Warning About Fake Job Posts**

jobs.title: Change Management / Consultant Specialist
jobs.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**
Why HSBC
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
HSBC is establishing a Value Stream Optimisation (VSO) capability to operationalise an approved value stream operating model and connect strategy, Future State Architecture, roadmaps and delivery to measurable customer and business value. This role supports change delivery, readiness and adoption across VSO pilots and implementation waves so impacted teams can move to clear accountabilities, decision rights, governance and outcome-led ways of working. Working under the direction of the VS Change Lead you’ll translate operating-model designs into practical actions across communications, learning and stakeholder engagement. Success means implementation activity lands to the right quality and timescales with clear evidence of readiness and sustained use. You’ll keep stakeholders informed, surface risks and dependencies early and capture learning that supports controlled, repeatable scale-up.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Deliver assigned change, readiness and adoption activity across one or more value stream pilots or implementation waves
* Translate approved designs and milestones into practical actions for impacted teams including owners, dependencies and readiness criteria
* Complete impact assessments across roles, accountabilities, governance, processes, tooling and management information
* Engage day-to-day stakeholders across business, technology and enabling functions to gather feedback and address routine queries
* Prepare and deliver communications, briefings, learning sessions and practical guidance using agreed messages and materials
* Coordinate pilot mobilisation, workshops and implementation events including logistics, materials, action tracking and follow-up
* Collect and evaluate readiness and adoption indicators to surface barriers and propose follow-up actions to the Change Lead
* Maintain accurate logs and records for people and operational impacts, issues, dependencies and control considerations, escalating where needed

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring practical experience supporting change, readiness, communications, learning or adoption within a transformation, operating-model or technology-enabled programme
* Build and maintain impact assessments, change plans, stakeholder materials, readiness actions and adoption reporting with guidance from a change lead or programme manager
* Coordinate workshops, pilots and phased implementations across business and technology teams
* Organise feedback and data, identify straightforward themes and support follow-up actions through to completion
* Maintain action, issue, dependency and readiness logs and escalate risks and decisions clearly and promptly
* Apply working knowledge of Value Stream Management, product or portfolio operating models, Lean and agile delivery with deeper expertise developed in role
* Use tools such as Clarity, JIRA and Confluence or comparable platforms to support delivery and reporting
* Hold a change management qualification such as Prosci, APMG Change Management or equivalent certification, or bring equivalent demonstrable experience

Scaling change through VSO
  
  
If you want to help teams adopt a value stream operating model in a way that’s practical, evidence-based and repeatable this role offers the scope to make a visible impact. You’ll work alongside Optimisation Execution, Design, Future State Architecture, Maturity and Tooling & Insights teams while partnering closely with colleagues in pilots and implementation waves. The work is hands-on and grounded in delivery - turning approved designs into adoption that sticks. Apply to help shape how VSO is mobilised, measured and scaled across HSBC.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. jobs.title: Enterprise Implementations Advisor
jobs.description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Enterprise Implementations Advisor
  
  
Job Location: Pune
  
  
5 Days Work From Office
  
  
Shift Timing : 6:30PM to 3:30AM
  
  
**Enterprise Implementations Advisor**
**Job Title:**
Implementations – Sr. Professional I
  
  
**Job Grade:**
9
  
  
**Management Level:**
Individual Contributor
  
  
**About Your Role**
Provide implementation expertise and strategic guidance for complex enterprise client implementations to support successful onboarding, conversion, expansion, and deployment of payment processing products and services. Partner with Enterprise Implementation teams, clients, Sales, Product, Operations, Technology, Credit, Compliance, Product Support, and other stakeholders to develop implementation strategies, address complex requirements, identify and mitigate delivery risks, and resolve implementation challenges. Serve as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor who helps teams navigate highly complex implementations, improve delivery practices, and ensure enterprise clients are positioned for successful production launch and transition to ongoing support.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Serve as a subject matter expert and strategic advisor for complex, high-impact, or escalated enterprise implementations involving multiple products, platforms, locations, workstreams, integrations, and stakeholders.
* Advise implementation teams and client stakeholders on implementation strategy, sequencing, dependencies, delivery approach, readiness requirements, and potential risks throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Partner with implementation leadership and project teams to assess complex client requirements and develop implementation approaches that align client objectives with product, technology, operational, and organizational capabilities.
* Engage during critical stages of enterprise implementations to provide guidance, remove barriers, facilitate decisions, and help resolve complex delivery challenges.
* Provide expertise on implementation methodology, governance, project controls, risk management, escalation practices, readiness standards, and implementation best practices.
* Evaluate implementation risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery constraints and recommend mitigation strategies or corrective actions when project milestones, client expectations, or production readiness may be affected.
* Facilitate complex problem-solving sessions, implementation strategy discussions, readiness reviews, risk reviews, and cross-functional working sessions involving senior client and internal stakeholders.
* Partner with Sales and pre-sales stakeholders when needed to assess implementation complexity, identify delivery considerations, clarify implementation requirements, and support effective transition from sales into implementation.
* Collaborate with Product, Technology, Operations, Credit, Compliance, Product Support, and other teams to address complex requirements, clarify ownership, resolve cross-functional dependencies, and improve implementation outcomes.
* Review implementation plans, solution approaches, requirements, project controls, readiness criteria, and other key implementation deliverables for complex or high-risk engagements and provide recommendations to project teams and leadership.
* Support implementation teams in managing significant client escalations by helping identify root causes, developing recovery strategies, coordinating appropriate resources, and establishing clear paths to resolution.
* Identify recurring implementation challenges, delivery risks, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement and partner with leadership and cross-functional teams to develop scalable solutions.
* Develop, document, and promote implementation best practices, standards, tools, playbooks, templates, and repeatable approaches that improve consistency and effectiveness across Enterprise Implementations.
* Coach and mentor implementation professionals by sharing subject matter expertise, implementation practices, lessons learned, and approaches for managing complex client and project situations.
* Provide implementation insights and recommendations to leadership based on project trends, client feedback, recurring delivery challenges, emerging risks, and opportunities to improve the enterprise implementation experience.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives designed to increase implementation quality, predictability, scalability, client satisfaction, and speed to production.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

**Experience You'll Need To Have**

* 7+ years of experience leading or supporting complex enterprise implementations, payment processing implementations, technology deployments, client onboarding, conversions, or related implementation and delivery work.
* 5+ years of experience managing or advising complex projects involving multiple products, platforms, integrations, workstreams, dependencies, timelines, and internal and external stakeholders.
* Experience working directly with large enterprise clients throughout an implementation lifecycle, including requirements, planning, solutioning, testing, readiness, launch, and transition to ongoing support.
* Experience identifying and resolving complex implementation risks, issues, dependencies, escalations, and delivery challenges involving multiple cross-functional teams.
* Experience advising project teams or stakeholders on implementation strategy, project governance, risk management, readiness, and delivery best practices.
* Experience facilitating complex discussions and communicating implementation strategy, risks, recommendations, trade-offs, and decisions to client stakeholders, internal partners, and senior leadership.
* Experience applying project management and implementation methodologies to complex client engagements, including scope, schedule, risk, issue, dependency, change, and stakeholder management.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or an equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**

* Experience supporting large enterprise merchant, payment processing, merchant acquiring, fintech, or integrated payment implementations.
* Experience implementing solutions involving multiple payment products, platforms, processing environments, integrations, locations, or business units.
* Experience with Clarity, Salesforce, or similar project management, client relationship management, reporting, and support platforms.
* Knowledge of payment processing, merchant acquiring, merchant boarding, authorization, settlement, funding, interchange, chargebacks, reporting, compliance, certification, or related payment operations.
* Experience supporting complex conversions, portfolio migrations, platform transitions, product launches, or multi-workstream enterprise programs.
* Experience establishing implementation standards, developing playbooks or methodologies, performing project assessments, or leading implementation process-improvement initiatives.
* Experience mentoring implementation professionals, providing subject matter expertise, or serving as an escalation resource for complex client engagements.
* Project management or related professional certification such as PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, or Certified ScrumMaster (CSM).

**How You'll Work**

* This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.

Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
  
  
The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills - A simple process that we all are used to on a day-to-day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
  
  
Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
AVP, Solution Architect will be responsible for development and support of Web based digital applications and delivering high-quality solutions. The ideal candidate would be part of a major technology transformation team responsible for moving towards cloud platform in micro services architecture using
**Spring Frameworks, in memory data grid, micro-front ends, React JS, responsive design**
etc leveraging latest AI tools and capabilities.

* Own end-to-end architecture and technical direction for full stack web applications (UI, APIs, services, and data), aligning solutions to business goals and enterprise standards.

* Collaborate with product and delivery leadership on estimation inputs, sequencing, and release planning; support teams through complex technical decisions and trade-offs.
* Mentor engineers across the stack (Synchrony and vendor), promoting reusable components, reference implementations, and consistent patterns.
* Communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs to stakeholders; document decisions using ADRs and maintain architecture artifacts.
* Evaluate emerging technologies (including AI-assisted development and AI-enabled features) and recommend practical adoption with security/compliance guardrails.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience) with 8+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years in architecture/technical leadership roles on full stack solutions or in lieu of a degree 10+ years in software engineering
* Deep hands-on expertise in Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and building scalable APIs/microservices (REST, asynchronous messaging/eventing).
* Strong hands-on experience with React JS and modern front-end engineering (TypeScript preferred, component architecture, performance optimization, accessibility basics).
* Experience designing and governing end-to-end full stack architectures, including API contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, and integration patterns.
* Strong knowledge of security-by-design across UI and services: OWASP, secure coding, secrets management, SSO/OAuth2/OIDC, CSRF/XSS protections, and secure API design.
* Experience with AWS and cloud-native architecture (preferred): containerization, autoscaling, networking, observability, and cost/performance trade-offs.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD and DevSecOps practices (build automation, quality gates, security scans, release strategies) and ability to define engineering guardrails.
* Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL technologies, data modeling, query optimization, caching strategies, and transactional vs eventual consistency trade-offs.
* Familiarity with Micro-Frontends and front-end platform governance is a plus.
* Strong understanding of SDLC (Agile), release/change management, incident management, and production readiness expectations.
* AI-assisted development proficiency (e.g., GitHub Copilot/enterprise LLM tools) to accelerate design, coding, testing, and documentation—used responsibly with security, privacy, and IP considerations.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills; ability to lead cross-team design discussions and drive alignment.
* Flexibility to support critical releases/incidents as needed.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience) with 8+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years in architecture/technical leadership roles on full stack solutions or in lieu of a degree 10+ years in software engineering

If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.

**What CIBC India Offers:**

At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):**

This job leads the design and development of application and data solutions across EAML's technology landscape. It translates business, regulatory and user requirements into robust, auditable solutions that meet FINTRAC reporting requirements, internal audit standards and CIBC Project Management Methodology (PMM) controls. It oversees the development lifecycle and provides senior technical guidance to IT management and the technical team. It also evaluates emerging technology to improve detection accuracy, scalability, and operational efficiency, protecting the bank and its clients.

At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):**

**Design and Development:**

* Translate business and regulatory requirements (including FINTRAC LCTR, STR and EFTR) into system and application designs, so solutions align with the technology roadmap.
* Design and document technical functionality, data flow, infrastructure, interfaces, and integrations end-to-end, so solutions are clear and buildable.
* Lead the design of cost-effective, audit-ready solutions with data integrity, lineage, and traceability, so they meet FINTRAC, Internal Audit and PMM standards.
* Define precise processing logic across multiple platforms, so specifications meet reporting and control requirements.

**Strategic Planning:**

* Contribute to the EAML technology roadmap, so it aligns with the bank's vision, regulatory landscape, and risk strategy.
* Lead multiple complex initiatives while maintaining consistency across the platform, so delivery stays coherent and adopts best practice.
* Provide senior-level guidance to IT management on technology selection, so decisions are sound where requirements evolve with regulatory change.

**Leadership Skills:**

* Function as solution lead with the project team, compliance partners and oversight functions, so designs align with business requirements, regulatory expectations, and architectural direction.
* Drive and moderate design review sessions, so issues are resolved, and decisions are made.
* Mentor and support junior designers and developers through knowledge sharing and problem solving, so team capability grows.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Drive continuous improvement and adopt best practice across the platform, so quality and consistency increase.
* Champion control, reconciliation, and quality-by-design in every artifact, so solutions remain audit-ready.
* Evaluate and introduce emerging technology (cloud, AI/ML, automation, real-time data), so EAML's detection, reporting and operational capability improves.

**Operational Efficiency:**

* Introduce automation and modern data technology, so manual effort and operational risk are reduced.
* Evaluate AI/ML, cloud-native data platforms and advanced analytics, so detection accuracy, scalability and efficiency improve.
* Recommend improvements to business processes and designs, so operations are more efficient and effective.

**Learning and Development:**

* Build knowledge in financial crime, regulatory technology, and modern data architecture, so designs reflect current practice.
* Stay current with technology trends, particularly AI/ML for AML, real-time monitoring, and cloud-native data platforms, so solutions stay ahead of change.
* Adopt new tools and trends quickly, so the team can use them effectively.

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* Internal: Collaborates with the project team to deliver designs and solutions.
* Internal: Works with compliance partners and oversight functions to align designs with regulatory expectations and obtain design approvals.
* Internal: Partners with business and engineering teams to define and shape solution architecture.
* Internal: Advises IT management on complex decisions and technology selection.
* Internal: Mentors junior designers and developers to share knowledge and solve problems.

**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls.

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

* As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Guides and mentors’ junior designers and developers.
* EAML platforms covering FINTRAC reporting (LCTR, STR, EFTR), transaction monitoring, customer risk rating, sanctions screening (SLMS, AMPECS) and case management.

**Experience:**
7+ years of experience

**Who You Are (skills/qualifications):**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.

**Must Have Skills:**

* 7+ years' experience designing, developing, implementing, and supporting enterprise data and application solutions.
* AML/Financial Crime platforms (e.g., SAS AML, Actimize, Oracle Financial Services Analytical Applications, Quantexa or equivalent).
* Sanctions screening platforms: SLMS, AMPECS or equivalent watchlist filtering and name screening engines.
* FINTRAC regulatory reporting (LCTR, STR, EFTR), including report generation, validation, submission, and correction workflow.
* Databases: Oracle, SQL Server, Teradata, Snowflake.
* ETL/Data Integration: Informatica, SSIS, IBM DataStage, Apache Spark.
* Cloud platforms: Azure, AWS or GCP (data services, security, identity).
* Big Data and Analytics: Hadoop ecosystem, Dat

jobs.description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward‑thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting‑edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long‑term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.
  
  
From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.
  
  
**About The Department**

* The CashApp Money Movement team within Wealth Management Technology delivers critical payment processing capabilities for Franklin Templeton’s High Net Worth business. The platform supports ACH, wire, and check transactions, regulatory validations, settlement processing, and integrations with accounting, compliance, and cash management systems. Working in a collaborative Agile environment, the team partners with Product, Architecture, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and external vendors to ensure secure, reliable, and automated money movement capabilities. Team members gain exposure to enterprise-scale financial platforms, cloud technologies, AI-driven engineering practices, and business-critical payment systems.

***How You Will Add Value?***
**Core Responsibilities**

* You will lead design and development of CashApp platform components.
* You will own transaction processing and money movement capabilities.
* You will support ACH, wire, and payment workflows.
* You will review solutions with Architecture teams.
* You will troubleshoot production issues and perform root cause analysis.
* You will ensure platform reliability, scalability, and observability.
* You will mentor engineers and promote engineering best practices.

**Team & Collaboration**

* You will partner with Product Owners on roadmap delivery.
* You will collaborate with Architecture teams on solution reviews.
* You will work with QA teams to improve automation coverage.
* You will support Operations teams during releases and incidents.
* You will engage with Business, Compliance, and Risk stakeholders.
* You will collaborate with external vendors and CashAgent partners.
* You will participate in Agile ceremonies and governance reviews.

**Strategic Responsibilities**

* You will modernize applications using cloud-native microservices.
* You will improve API, regression, and integration automation.
* You will enhance integrations with payment and compliance platforms.
* You will strengthen monitoring, resilience, and operational controls.
* You will reduce manual intervention through intelligent automation.
* You will improve transaction accuracy and settlement processing.

**AI Fluency**

* You will leverage AI tools for coding and solution development.
* You will integrate enterprise applications with AI agents.
* You will use AI for debugging and transaction analysis.
* You will generate automation scripts and test cases using AI.
* You will validate AI-generated outputs before production use.

***What Will Help You Be Successful in This Role?***

* 8+ years of software engineering experience.
* Experience leading enterprise platform components and teams.
* Experience with money movement and payment processing platforms.
* Experience building high-volume, high-availability systems.
* Experience with ACH, wire, and transaction processing workflows.
* Understanding of AML, KYC, OFAC, and regulatory controls.
* Knowledge of NACHA and ISO 20022 standards.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.

**Technical Skills**

* Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices Architecture.
* REST APIs, distributed systems, and enterprise integrations.
* SQL Server, Snowflake, and NoSQL databases.
* Kafka, Service Bus, and messaging technologies.
* Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms.
* GitLab, Bamboo, Jira, ServiceNow, and CI/CD practices.
* Monitoring, observability, and production support tools.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage production-critical situations.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working across Agile and distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with payment orchestration platforms.
* Experience with distributed tracing and observability tools.
* Experience tuning enterprise transaction systems.
* Exposure to FinTech integrations and digital servicing platforms.

**Work Shift Timings - 2:00 PM - 11:00 PM IST**
At Franklin Templeton, we believe your benefits should support your life, your goals, and your future. That’s why we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to help you thrive both personally and professionally.

jobs.title: T&T- Customer- CS&D- Project Management | Mumbai | Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
**The team**

Customer is about much more than just the numbers. It’s about attesting to accomplishments and challenges and helping to assure strong foundations for future aspirations. Deloitte exemplifies what, how, and why of change so you’re always ready to act ahead. Learn more about Customer

  

**Your work profile**

* At Deloitte, we’re expanding our Telecom Consulting practice and looking for passionate & self-driven professionals for Senior Consultant role.
* Lead the end-to-end delivery of IWM program workstreams — developing detailed project plans, maintaining RAID logs, and managing scope, schedule, budget, and dependencies
* Prioritize delivery based on business impact, regulatory requirements, and operational risk, ensuring alignment with the IWM target operating model
* Coordinate across multiple teams — business, technology, vendors, and control functions — to drive execution and timely resolution of issues
* Apply strong product knowledge to steer scope and design decisions across the investment product lifecycle (asset capture, order and lifecycle management, settlements, and client/regulatory reporting obligations)
* Establish and maintain project management standards, processes, and best practices to ensure efficient, consistent delivery
* Proactively identify and manage risks and issues that may affect project health, escalating with clear mitigation strategies
* Provide regular updates to IWM leadership, working groups, and steering committees on progress, delivery metrics, risks, dependencies, and mitigation status
* Conduct post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement
  

**Key Skills Required**

* Previous experience working within Wealth Management (International/Private Banking preferred), Wholesale Banking, or Asset Management.
* Strong understanding of the International Wealth Management landscape, including client segments, advisory/discretionary models, and the front-to-back operating model.
* Strong knowledge of financial products (e.g., derivatives, structured products, funds) with hands-on exposure to the investment product lifecycle — from asset capture and order/lifecycle management through settlements and client/regulatory reporting.
* Exposure to Capital Markets, Managed Investments, and Private Assets product lifecycles.
* Proven experience managing transformation initiatives — creating project plans, maintaining RAID logs, and working across multiple functions in the firm.
* Strong experience engaging cross-functional domain SMEs, Business Management, and Control Functions (Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax).
* Expertise in conceptual modelling — able to see the big picture, envision solution options, and provide concise, precise, managerial answers across a wide range of business topics.
* Ability to engage stakeholders at all levels of seniority and manage cross-functional projects.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex problems simply to drive quick, effective decision-making.
* Previous experience with Jira, Confluence, Power BI, or similar tools.
* Ability to work under limited supervision (a "self-starter") in unstructured environments.
* Intellectual strength and flexibility to rapidly understand complex problems and rationalize them into deliverable solutions.
* High level of drive, commitment to outcomes, and ability to work under pressure.
* Familiarity with different delivery methodologies (particularly Agile).
* Experience working with technology teams to deliver complex solutions across multiple business areas, functions, and locations.
* Hands-on exposure to the Avaloq Core Platform.
* Project Management Certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2).
* Familiarity articulating requirements in the form of Use Cases and User Stories.
  

**Desired Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of relevant working experience.
* Education: MCA/ Mtech/ MBA/ B. Tech/ BBA/ BSC/ BE/ B.Com

* Base location: Mumbai
* Working from the office at least 3 days a week is mandatory, with a hybrid model tailored to each domain’s specific needs.

**Job Summary**
---------------

* Supply Chain Management (SCM) is responsible for the overall commercial and risk management with the bank’s external third-party suppliers. To meet increasing business demands, the SCM team is putting in place a new capability to support Contract Managers/Owners meet their obligations with regards to the management of the third-party contracts that they are accountable for.

• The Specialist, Contract Management Services (CMS) is responsible for delivering Contract Management Services that provide specialised support to Contract Managers/Owners of assigned contracts within respective categories or domains.
  
• This role serves as the subject matter expert with deep industry knowledge in the relevant sub-category/domain and ensures that Contract Managers/Owners receive the necessary support to meet their contract management and ownership obligations throughout the entire contract lifecycle.
  
• The Specialist, CMS will work closely with SCM Category Management stakeholders, SCM Category Leads/Managers, SCM Supplier Managers, SCM Cluster Leads and Contract Managers/Owners to drive continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Support the Manager, CMS in accelerating the delivery of efficiencies and advancing CMS services across the Bank and all applicable categories, ensuring alignment with the Bank’s overall procurement lifecycle objectives.
  
• Act as the subject matter expert for the assigned category or sub-category within CMS services and serve as the primary point of contact for Contract Managers/Owners.
  
• Represent the function when required to drive and support continuous improvement initiatives and participate in Refinement Forums. This includes requirements gathering, prioritization of SCM/business/function needs, adoption activities, ad hoc system testing, and collaboration with key stakeholders on initiatives related to digital transformation and enablement in line with Bank objectives.
  
• Contribute to the ideation and development of technology advancements (e.g., AI, automation, tooling) to strengthen CMS capabilities.

**Business**  
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with Contract Managers/Owners and SCM stakeholders.
  
• Play an advisory role in the development of the CMS framework and end-to-end contract lifecycle process starting with supporting Contract Managers with completing risk assessments, through to contract expiry together with the completion and delivery of all obligations.
  
• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, including legal, compliance, finance, and business units.
  
• Support problem resolution and act as the final escalation point for assigned category or domain of CMS inquiries and issues.
  
• Support the input of design and requirements for the platform and tools strategy for CMS.
  
• Play a role in driving the adoption of AI and automation, across the services suite within the capability to demonstrate efficiencies, standardisation, and digitization.

**Process**

* **Continuous Improvement**
* Support initiatives and identify use cases to optimise process and cost efficiency (e.g. Automation, AI, Process Simplification)
* Drive initiatives to optimize value creation through effective contract management.
* Monitor and improve end user experience.
* Document solutions and contribute to knowledge base to improve user experience.

* **CMS Day-to-day**

• Role Scope:
  
Transition from Day 1 into Day 2
  
• Support the Contract Manager/Owner through Contract Owner Training, Risk assessments are completed, and contracts documents are in order.
  
• Ensure Contract Compliance has been completed to enable the contracts to be operational.
  
Key Contracts Obligations
  
• Ensure that the key contract obligations are registered in the key obligations log; and
  
• Work with the Contract Manager to attest that the contract obligations are known and understood.
  
• Provide support for catalogue creation and maintenance

Spend Forecasting
  
• Ensure that the commercial obligations that relate to spend are recorded and logged with finance for forecasting purposes
  
Changes and Amendments
  
• Work with the Contract Managers/Owners to manage contracts changes, amendments, and updates.
  
• Assist Contract Managers/Owners in system meta data changes, include Contract Manager/Ownership changes
  
• Support regulatory driven contract change programs
  
Third Party Risk Management (TPRM)
  
• Support Contract Managers/Owners with Day 2 period risk assessments as required by TPRM standards.
  
• Support the resolution of risk exceptions
  
Contract Lifecycle Management
  
• Maintain a flight plan of key contract dates (a flight plan), that includes renewal notice periods, expiry dates and
  
• Provide exit management support to Contract Managers/Owners, including working with Legal for termination notices.
  
Data Quality
  
• Be accountable for data quality for any information produced and maintained within the responsibilities performed under assigned CMS categories or contracts.

**Risk Management**  
• Identify and work with key stakeholders where applicable to mitigate risks associated with CMS, including financial, operational, and reputational risks
  
• Ensure CMS activities comply with internal policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.
  
• Raise Identified potential risks in contracts and work with applicable stake holders to develop strategies to mitigate them.
  
• Work with applicable stake holders to manage and resolve any disputes or issues that arise during the sourcing to contract lifecycle.
  
• Monitor and manage supplier compliance with regulatory, legal and ethical standards
  
• Develop and implement risk management strategies to minimize potential disruptions in the supply chain.
  
• Own the internal and external audit support and related action plans.
  
• Establish and ensure that Data Quality is maintained to the required standards.

**Governance**

**Risk Modelling Development Specialist**
=========================================

Req ID: 128413

Department: Risk Metrics & Measurement - Credit Models

Division: Risk

**About Us**
------------

**Standard**  
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

This role is part of the Group Credit Risk Models - Retails function and is responsible for supporting the development, maintenance, and remediation of credit risk models across the retail banking portfolio.

The role plays a key part in the end-to-end model lifecycle, contributing to the design, implementation, validation support, monitoring, and performance assessment of retail credit risk models.

Key responsibilities include the development and maintenance of provisioning and regulatory capital models, including Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD), and Exposure at Default (EAD) models.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**  
**Work Hours: 8 AM to 5 PM**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

The incumbent of this role can expect to undertake the following activities that are deemed core to the role:

  

* Development of end-to-end statistically derived Credit Risk Models for retail portfolio in line with ANZ methodology standards for use
* Delivering model-related BAU activities across the credit life cycle, including credit metric computations, model monitoring, implementation support, remediation activities
* Support ad-hoc activities related to regulatory change requirements, portfolio management, and business decision-making, delivering robust data-driven solutions
* Contribute to the delivery of robust analytical solutions through data analysis, model development support, implementation testing, and issue resolution activities
* Assist in defining project scope and requirements, ensuring business objectives, modelling requirements, and stakeholder expectations are clearly understood and aligned across all stakeholders
* Support the planning, coordination, and execution of model development projects, including the design, development, testing, implementation, and monitoring of credit risk analytical solutions
* Collaborate effectively with Business Units, Retail Risk, Systems & Data, Model Validation and other stakeholders to maintain clear and effective communication throughout the project lifecycle
* Support stakeholder management activities by proactively managing expectations, providing regular progress updates, identifying potential risks and dependencies, and ensuring timely delivery against agreed milestones and project timelines
* Ensure all GRM documentation standards are adhered to across project

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* Strong expertise in Credit Risk Modelling, including the development, validation, and monitoring of statistical risk models and regulatory capital models (PD, LGD, EAD, Basel/IRB frameworks)
* Understanding of provisioning methodologies and regulatory capital estimation, supported by strong domain knowledge of Retail Banking portfolios
* Proficient in statistical and data analytics tools such as SAS, SQL, Python, with the ability to develop, automate, and optimize analytical solutions
* Extensive experience in data analysis, data manipulation, model debugging, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving within large and complex datasetsGraduate qualifications in
* Statistics, Operations Research, Mathematics or Quantitative Economics
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, manage multiple priorities
* Mentoring capabilities, providing technical guidance, coaching, and support to junior team members while contributing to overall team development and knowledge sharing
* Stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex modelling concepts into actionable business insights

  

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

-------------------

jobs.description:
Location: Gurugram, Haryāna, India
  
Date Posted: Nov 23, 2026

**Description**

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance

  

**How you will contribute**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Associate – ERP Implementation / Transformation Readiness to lead finance preparedness activities ahead of an ERP transformation. The role will assess and prepare the Finance organization, processes, data, master data, controls, reporting, and technology landscape for a successful ERP implementation. The role will work closely with Finance leadership, business process owners, ERP implementation teams, IT, data teams, and other functional workstreams to identify readiness gaps, define remediation actions, and establish the foundation required for a successful implementation.

The ideal candidate will have strong FICO functional knowledge, finance transformation experience, business process understanding, and program management capabilities.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

Expertise across one or more of the following areas

  
  

1. FI/CO Implementation Readiness Assessment

* Lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's readiness for ERP implementation.
* Assess current-state FI/CO processes, organizational structures, master data, transactional data, reporting, controls, integrations, and technology landscape.
* Identify key gaps, dependencies, risks, and prerequisites that need to be addressed before implementation.
* Develop a structured FICO readiness roadmap with priorities, owners, timelines, and remediation actions.
* Assess readiness against SAP/Oracle/MS Dynamics 365 capabilities and recommended leading practices.
  

  

2. Finance Process Readiness

* Assess current finance processes across: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Period-end and year-end close and Management reporting
* Identify process standardization opportunities before ERP implementation.
* Identify manual, spreadsheet-driven, highly customized, or non-standard processes that may create implementation risks.
* Define future-state process principles and readiness requirements.
* Assess the organization's ability to adopt SAP standard functionality and minimize unnecessary customizations.
  

  

3. Finance Master Data & Chart of Accounts Readiness

* Assess the quality, consistency, ownership, and governance of key finance master data.
* Lead readiness assessment for: Chart of Accounts, General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, Customers and Vendors, Fixed Assets, Banks and bank accounts
* Evaluate opportunities for master-data rationalization and harmonization.
* Assess alignment of the existing Chart of Accounts with the future ERP design.
* Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or poorly governed master data.
* Define data cleansing and remediation requirements before migration.
  

  

4. Functional Readiness

* Assess the organization's preparedness for key capabilities, including:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA (in case of S4HANA), New Asset Accounting, Business Partner, Parallel ledgers, Multiple currencies, Profitability Analysis, Fiori-based finance processes, Embedded analytics, Intercompany accounting and Centralized finance processes
* Identify implications of moving from legacy ERP environments to current ERP environments.
* Assess existing customizations and determine which should be retired, redesigned, replaced with standard ERP functionality, or retained.
* Support clean-core readiness assessments.
  

  

5. Data Migration Readiness

* Lead assessment of finance data migration preparedness.
* Define requirements for historical and open-item data migration.
* Assess data quality and reconciliation requirements.
* Establish data ownership and accountability across Finance and IT.
* Define cleansing, transformation, mapping, and validation requirements.
* Establish reconciliation principles between legacy systems and new ERP systems.
* Identify data migration risks and dependencies early in the program.
  

  

6. Integration & Technology Readiness

* Assess FI/CO dependencies and integration points with:
* MM, SD, PP, Asset Management, Treasury, Procurement, Sales, Payroll, Banking platforms, Tax systems and Data warehouses and reporting platforms
* Identify upstream and downstream systems that require remediation or redesign.
* Assess interfaces, data flows, integration dependencies, and reconciliation requirements.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture and technical teams to address integration readiness.
  

  

7. Reporting & Management Information Readiness

* Assess existing statutory, management, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Identify reports dependent on legacy ERP structures, custom tables, or manual data manipulation.
* Map critical reports to the future reporting architecture.
* Assess readiness for analytics and enterprise reporting platforms where applicable.
* Define reporting rationalization opportunities and critical reporting requirements for migration.
  

  

8. Controls & Compliance Readiness

* Assess the impact of ERP implementation on finance controls and compliance processes.
* Identify key controls affected by changes to processes, organizational structures, master data, workflows, and system configurations.
* Assess segregation-of-duties implications.
* Ensure critical financial controls are incorporated into the future-state design.
* Support audit, compliance, and control stakeholders in understanding S/4HANA implications.
  

  

9. Stakeholder & Program Leadership

* Act as a key interface for the transformation program.
* Partner with CFO organization, Controllers, Finance process owners, IT, ERP implementation teams, and business leadership.
* Lead workshops to assess readiness and agree remediation priorities.
* Present readiness findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies and ensure timely resolution of readiness issues.
* Establish governance mechanisms for tracking preparedness activities.
  

  

10. Team Leadership

* Lead a team of finance transformation professionals.
* Define workplans, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Review and ensure quality of readiness assessments and recommendations.
* Coach team members on ERP capabilities, finance processes, and consulting methodologies.
* Coordinate activities across FI/CO, data, integration, reporting, controls, and change management teams.

  

**Qualifications**

* 3-8 years of experience in ERP transformation and implementation programs
* Experience conducting ERP implementation readiness, assessment, or transformation planning activities.
* Strong experience with SAP / Oracle Fusion / MS Dynamics
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Finance processes and their ERP enabl

jobs.description:
**At Bayer, we believe work should matter. Every day, our teams push toward a future where "Health for all, Hunger for none" is within reach, and every role, from the lab to the field to the boardroom, helps us get there. We give people the ownership to shape outcomes, the support to grow through new skills and experiences, and a global community where different perspectives are valued. If you want your work to count and the room to become your best, you'll find it here.**

  

**We’re changing the way we work at Bayer, for higher productivity, faster innovation, and better results. We call it Dynamic Shared Ownership (DSO). Learn more about what DSO will mean for you in your new role here** **https://www.bayer.com/en/strategy/strategy**

  

**Job Purpose**

The **Associate – Cash Applications** is responsible for the accurate and timely application of customer payments within the Accounts Receivable process. The role involves matching remittance information, clearing open items, reconciling cash receipts, resolving unapplied or unidentified payments, and supporting day-to-day Cash Application activities.

The Associate works closely with customers and internal teams to ensure accurate processing, timely resolution of exceptions, strong controls, and high-quality service delivery.

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities**

* Process and apply incoming customer payments accurately and within agreed timelines, including bank transfers, lockbox receipts, cheques, cards, direct debits, and other payment methods.
* Match remittance advice with customer payments and correctly allocate receipts against invoices, customer accounts, deductions, credit notes, and other open items in the ERP system.
* Perform daily cash and bank reconciliation activities and ensure alignment between bank statements, cash receipt records, and the Accounts Receivable sub-ledger.
* Investigate unapplied, unidentified, misapplied, duplicate, short, or excess payments and coordinate with customers and relevant internal teams for resolution.
* Maintain customer accounts, clear open items, process approved adjustments, and follow up on workflow items and process exceptions.
* Handle customer and internal queries through email, calls, workflow tools, and other communication channels.
* Record and execute transactions in line with approved process documentation, accounting policies, service-level agreements, and quality standards.
* Complete required Internal Control System activities accurately and on time and maintain supporting documentation for audit purposes.
* Support month-end and period-end closing activities.
* Prepare and maintain operational reports related to cash posting, unapplied cash, unidentified cash, ageing, productivity, quality, and other relevant KPIs.
* Identify recurring process issues and escalate exceptions or process gaps to the Senior Associate or Team Lead.
* Support process improvement, automation, analytics, and AI initiatives within Cash Applications.
* Maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and work instructions.
* Participate in knowledge-sharing, cross-training, and continuous-learning activities.
* Adapt to changes in processes, systems, regional requirements, and transformation initiatives while maintaining service quality.

**Who you are**
