jobs.description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
People Management
  
  
Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
  
  
Model - Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.
  
  
Coach - Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.
  
  
Care - Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.
  
  
Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
  
  
Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes, and ensures that proposed solutions are aligned with broader organizational strategy. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.
  
  
Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Advises team on managing changes and facilitating feedback. Uses broad patterns of feedback to develop strategic and actionable insights and presents a compelling business case to program managers that influences product roadmaps and decision making. Contributes to Microsoft-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
  
  
Drives internal advocacy by facilitating insight sharing with Product Engineering teams, and providing guidance through escalation, acceleration, and prioritization. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. Mentors peers and teams on best practices around internal resources usage. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.
  
  
Architecture Design and Deployment
  
  
Holds teams accountable for leveraging existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft's agreed commitments to the customer/partner and developing new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners and markets. When appropriate, governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.
  
  
Guides team in defining and documenting the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix. Ensures team is equipped to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Guides team in cost-based and technology-based discussions to explain the architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Promotes a business-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs-savings over technical ease of execution. Provides coaching to allow architects to scale solutions. Support new customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft, as needed.
  
  
Collaborates with the other managers to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. Provides end-to-end governance, oversight, and thought leadership within assigned account. Provides guidance to team in understanding and demonstrating business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.
  
  
Guides team in working with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Supports team in managing and resolving highly complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Ensures maintenance of the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Oversees development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer.
  
  
Leads team in collaborating to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Ensures team builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex solution approach. Provides thought leadership on oversight and governance sets expectations for quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Promotes a cohesive build methodology so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre-sales value proposition. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams. When appropriate, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes. Challenges deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on regular cadence, as needed. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. Innovates and implements long-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio, as needed. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.
  
  
Creates a culture and clarity around technical insights and escalations, and ensures broad sets of projects move forward. Provides support and guidance to team in identifying scenarios that could slow or impede pre-sales/delivery. Anticipates blockers and resolves escalations as needed and coaches team on best practices for handling escalations. Ensures that issues and blockers and addressed by the appropriate groups. Identifies widespread patterns in blockers across business areas or territories. Develops strategies to prevent blockers and issues in the future. When necessary, attends steering committee meetings with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.
  
  
Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to anticipate, identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. Outlines methodology and governance principles and practices for the broader organization that allows others to minimize risks.

jobs.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – RCT**
**Manager – Data, Cloud & AI Engineering**
**Manager – Technology Consulting**
**Experience: Strictly 8+ years**
**Mandatory eligibility:**
Candidates must have 8 or more years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on Python, advanced SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. Candidates below 8 years or without any mandatory capability are not eligible.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Lead the delivery of data, cloud, and AI-enabled Financial Crime solutions for global financial services clients. This Manager role combines technical depth with delivery leadership, stakeholder management, team development, and end-to-end ownership. The successful candidate will shape solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud while remaining close enough to the technology to guide architecture, review critical designs, resolve delivery risks, and assure quality.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with strong Python and advanced SQL capability, practical cloud and AI delivery experience, and broad Financial Crime Compliance knowledge. The role owns outcomes from discovery and estimation through design, build, testing, deployment, transition, and production stabilization. It also includes team leadership, work planning, governance, financial oversight, client communication, and development of reusable assets and delivery standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Financial Crime technology workstreams, programs, or managed-service outcomes.
* Own solution scope, delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, quality, resource needs, and stakeholder commitments.
* Provide technical direction for Python applications, advanced SQL solutions, cloud architecture, data pipelines, APIs, analytics, and AI components.
* Translate KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud requirements into scalable technical solutions and delivery roadmaps.
* Partner with compliance SMEs, product owners, architects, engineering teams, data teams, model-risk stakeholders, QA, infrastructure, and operations.
* Lead design reviews, code and SQL quality reviews, architecture decisions, defect triage, performance tuning, release readiness, and production stabilization.
* Ensure appropriate security, privacy, auditability, explainability, data lineage, model governance, monitoring, and regulatory-control considerations.
* Drive automation, reusable components, engineering standards, knowledge assets, and continuous improvement across the delivery lifecycle.
* Prepare and present status, decisions, risks, dependencies, and recovery plans to senior client and internal stakeholders.
* Support proposals, solutioning, effort estimation, staffing, capability development, and account growth activities.

**Deliverable ownership**

* Accountable for agreed deliverables, acceptance criteria, delivery schedule, quality, and business outcomes across assigned workstreams.
* Build and maintain integrated delivery plans covering requirements, design, data readiness, engineering, testing, deployment, transition, and support.
* Establish governance routines, delivery metrics, RAID management, change control, escalation paths, and executive reporting.
* Validate estimates, capacity, sequencing, dependencies, and release scope; act early on slippage, quality gaps, or unresolved decisions.
* Ensure traceability from business and compliance requirements to technical design, test evidence, deployment artefacts, and operational handover.
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies and secure timely sign-offs from business, compliance, technology, model-risk, security, and operations stakeholders.
* Own defect closure, production-readiness checks, go-live decisions, warranty support, and lessons learned for assigned deliveries.

**Team management and leadership**

* Lead multidisciplinary teams of software engineers, data engineers, analysts, QA professionals, and domain specialists.
* Define team structure, roles, goals, operating model, work allocation, and individual accountability for delivery outcomes.
* Provide regular coaching, technical mentoring, feedback, recognition, and career-development support.
* Monitor capacity, utilization, skills coverage, onboarding, knowledge transfer, succession needs, and delivery continuity.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, quality-focused environment with clear standards for ownership and communication.
* Resolve delivery conflicts, remove blockers, manage escalations, and support sound decisions under competing priorities.
* Identify capability gaps and create targeted upskilling plans across Python, SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime domain knowledge.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Python: Strong hands-on experience designing and reviewing production-grade Python solutions, including object-oriented design, data processing, APIs, testing, logging, exception handling, security, and performance optimization.
* Advanced SQL: Expert-level capability in complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, stored procedures, query optimization, large-volume analysis, reconciliation, data profiling, and investigation queries.
* Cloud: Mandatory delivery experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP, covering solution design, deployment, data services, security, monitoring, integration, scalability, and operational support.
* AI: Mandatory practical experience delivering AI or machine-learning capabilities, including generative AI or predictive analytics, model or prompt evaluation, API integration, responsible AI controls, security, explainability, and production monitoring.
* Engineering leadership: Ability to guide architecture, review code and designs, define standards, oversee CI/CD, manage non-functional requirements, and resolve complex technical issues.
* Data and integration: Experience with data pipelines, APIs, batch processing, data quality, lineage, metadata, and integration across enterprise platforms.

**Mandatory Financial Crime domain knowledge (2 or more mandatory)**

* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, remediation, and enhanced due diligence.
* AML: Financial crime risk indicators and typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, regulatory reporting concepts, and control effectiveness.
* Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario and rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning, back-testing, false-positive reduction, and data-quality controls.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlists, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, screening effectiveness, and data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, transaction and event analysis, rules or models, alert prioritization, investigation workflows, case outcomes, and prevention controls.

**AI leadership expectations**

* Identify and prioritize AI use cases for alert triage, investigation support, entity resolution, anomaly detection, document analysis, quality assurance, and engineering productivity.
* Ensure human oversight, explainability, privacy, security, bias assessment, auditability, model-risk alignment, and appropriate use of regulated data.
* Define measurable acceptance criteria and monitoring for accuracy, grounding, latency, reliability, operational risk, and business value.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for code, testing, documentation, and analysis while maintaining review and security controls.

Resource management associate will operate as the day-to-day staffing and workforce planning coordinator for Life Sciences. The role requires strong verbal and written communication, self-direction, comfort working with stakeholders from consultants through Partners/Directors, strong data-analysis skills, and the ability to manage a high volume of concurrent requests with accuracy and follow-through. The individual should be technology proficient, able to learn new systems quickly, and able to work hours that provide meaningful overlap with U.S. East Coast mornings and, when needed, UK stakeholders.

The Resource Management associate will help maintain an accurate, forward-looking view of staff availability and project demand, coordinate staffing changes, and support practice leadership with the data and follow-through needed to make timely staffing decisions. The role works closely with project managers, service-line leads, people managers, and practice leadership to balance project needs, employee skills and availability, utilization, and project economics.

**Specific responsibilities include:**

* Own day-to-day staffing coordination and serve as a central point of contact for project staffing requests, extensions, releases, holds, and schedule changes.
* Maintain accurate staffing plans and workplans in ProjectHub and related resource-management systems, including start/end dates, allocations, extensions, and temporary availability.
* Proactively follow up with project managers to confirm staffing plans, close outstanding requests, and ensure requested changes are completed and communicated.
* Monitor current and near-term staff availability, including partial availability and upcoming roll-offs, and identify potential staffing conflicts, over-allocation, underutilization, and opportunities to redeploy capacity.
* Match staffing needs with available resources based on skills, experience, availability, development interests, and project requirements; coordinate with project and service-line leaders when tradeoffs or conflicts require decisions.
* Support weekly staffing discussions by preparing the underlying data, tracking open needs and decisions, maintaining notes/action items, and following through on agreed staffing updates.
* Analyze staffing, utilization, scheduled hours, project budgets, and related financial data to identify exceptions and actionable insights for leadership.
* Support project financial and capacity-management activities, including monitoring scheduled versus budgeted hours, identifying excess or remaining hours, flagging potential over/under-budget conditions, and helping ensure staffing changes are reflected accurately in systems.
* Coordinate with project teams on special project setup and revenue/staffing requirements where standard scheduling does not fully capture the engagement model.
* Maintain high data quality across staffing tools and reports by cross-checking requests against current project and availability information before making changes.
* Adapt to evolving staffing processes and tools, including changes to ProjectHub, Engagement Hub, forecasting, and other firm resource-management systems.

**Qualifications:**

* BA/BS degree required.
* 3+ years of relevant work experience preferred, including experience in resource management, staffing operations, project management, consulting operations, workforce planning, or a similarly fast-paced environment.
* Strong interpersonal, customer-service, conflict-resolution, and negotiation skills, with the confidence to work effectively across organizational levels.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to follow up persistently and professionally with busy stakeholders and close the loop on open actions.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to interpret staffing, utilization, capacity, and project financial data and translate it into clear actions.
* Highly organized and self-motivated; able to prioritize and execute numerous concurrent staffing requests and recurring processes with limited supervision.
* Strong proficiency with Excel and Microsoft Office, including manipulating and analyzing spreadsheets; demonstrated ability to learn new enterprise systems quickly.
* Experience with staffing, workforce-planning, project-management, ERP, or forecasting systems is strongly preferred.
* Ability to build trusted working relationships with project managers, practice leadership, people managers, and consultants while balancing business needs and employee considerations.
* Ability to work hours that overlap with U.S. East Coast mornings; flexibility to coordinate across U.S., UK, and India time zones as business needs require.

**About Guidehouse India**

At Guidehouse India, we’re redefining what’s possible by creating opportunities that change lives. Guidehouse is a global professional services firm that delivers advisory, technology, and managed services to clients across both the commercial and public sectors. Our teams turn bold ideas into solutions that transform industries, strengthen communities, and drive meaningful impact worldwide.

Across our Chennai, Trivandrum, and Gurugram locations, you’ll find opportunities where your passion and curiosity help shape what comes next. With cutting edge benefits, innovative learning and development programs, and a people first culture, we empower our people to lead with purpose.

We continue to expand our teams and capabilities across India, investing in state-of-the-art offices and high impact work. Here, you’ll collaborate with experts from around the world, build deep expertise, explore new domains, and accelerate your professional growth while making a real impact.

jobs.title: PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Opensity Solutions is the largest tech‑enabled managed services organization serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms. At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. Our capabilities include IT and technology solutions, document processing and administrative support, marketing and communications, billing and AP/AR services, records and information governance, workflow automation, consulting and hospitality and facilities services.

**Our Mission:**

Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support, and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.

Opensity Solutions delivers technology projects for professional services and enterprise clients. Our Project Managers own those projects — scope, commitments, budget, and the client relationship — and they are at their best when they are spending their time there, rather than rebuilding a resource schedule or chasing a missing time entry. The PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator takes that resource coordination load off them.

You will own the resource assignment and scheduling process across the projects you support: building and maintaining schedules against planned effort, processing modifications and confirming their downstream impact, monitoring availability and over-allocation across both project and support demand, and improving how scheduling works over time.

You will assist the PMO Director in monitoring time entry compliance in ServiceNow — reviewing entries and narratives for accuracy and routing corrections through the Project Manager and the engineer's resource manager, who are responsible for their team's accuracy.

And you will assist Project Managers with project plans, WBS structures, task records, RIDAC logs, change order documentation, recurring reporting, and meeting materials, working at their direction and with their approval.

We are looking for someone with 1–3 years in project coordination, project support, PMO analyst, scheduling, or project administration on technology projects, with hands-on exposure to a PPM platform — ServiceNow strongly preferred.

Experience with resource scheduling or assignment is the closest match to the core of this role, and experience reviewing timekeeping or billing data for accuracy is a significant advantage. Success here takes exceptional attention to detail, the willingness to hold peers to a standard, and sound judgment about which calls are yours and which belong to the Project Manager.

Employment decisions at Opensity are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, discipline, and termination.

Opensity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities, for pregnancy related conditions, and for sincerely held religious beliefs, in accordance with applicable law. We do not tolerate retaliation against individuals who raise concerns or participate in an investigation related to equal employment opportunity.

Opensity will never ask candidates to provide credit card information, banking details, or payment of any kind as part of the interview or recruitment process. If you receive a communication that appears suspicious or does not come through an authorized Opensity channel, please verify its authenticity before providing any personal information.

**Job Title:** Financial Accountant  
**Experience:** 3+ years  
**Industry:** Engineering Consulting / Manufacturing / Project Management Company / EPC

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented **Account Manager** with at least **3 years** of experience in managing banking operations, personal accounting, and international trade (import/export). The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in **Bank Guarantees**, **Personal Accounting**, and **Import & Export documentation and compliance**. You will be responsible for managing financial records, ensuring regulatory compliance, and acting as the liaison between internal stakeholders and external financial institutions.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**1. Bank Guarantees & Financial Instruments**

* Manage the full lifecycle of **Bank Guarantees** (issuance, renewal, cancellation).
* Work closely with banks to handle **Letters of Credit (LCs)**, **Standby LCs**, and **foreign remittance processes**.
* Ensure all financial instruments are in line with internal policies and regulatory standards.

**2. Personal Accounting**

* Oversee personal financial planning, expense tracking, investment reporting, and tax preparation for key stakeholders or directors.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy in personal records, assets, and liabilities.
* Handle payments, credit card reconciliations, and property-related financial records.

**3. Import & Export Management**

* Prepare and review all documentation related to imports/exports including commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, and shipping instructions.
* Liaise with customs agents, freight forwarders, and banks for timely clearance and compliance.
* Monitor currency fluctuations and advise on cost impacts.

**4. Financial Reporting & Analysis**

* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and MIS reports.
* Analyse variances in budgets vs. actuals and recommend corrective actions.
* Support cash flow forecasting and working capital management.

**5. Vendor and Client Account Management**

* Maintain up-to-date records of receivables and payables.
* Ensure timely invoicing, collections, and vendor payments.
* Reconcile customer and vendor accounts regularly.

**6. Taxation & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with **GST, TDS, Income Tax, Customs Duties**, and other local and international tax laws.
* File statutory returns on time and support audits by internal and external authorities.
* Liaise with CA firms, legal advisors, and consultants as required.

**7. Banking & Treasury Operations**

* Handle all bank transactions including fund transfers, FD management, and online banking.
* Maintain strong relationships with banking partners to support financial needs.
* Monitor daily cash positions and support investment decisions.

**8. Internal Controls & Audit Support**

* Implement and maintain robust internal controls over financial transactions.
* Prepare documents and respond to internal, statutory, or external audit requirements.
* Ensure all transactions are properly documented and authorized.

**9. Coordination with Cross-Functional Teams**

* Work closely with logistics, procurement, legal, and sales teams to ensure end-to-end transaction support.
* Provide financial insights and data support for business decisions and planning.

**10. Technology and System Support**

* Use accounting software efficiently for bookkeeping, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Recommend and help implement automation or ERP tools for improving financial processes.

**Educational Qualification:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Finance or any related field.

**Office Timing:**  
10:30 AM to 7:30 PM / Flexible timing (Second and Fourth Saturday Off)

**Office Location:**  
Lower Parel West, Mumbai 400013

**Kindly share your updated cv at hr@airotherms.com or what's app on 8291570650**

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Kroll is seeking a
**Vice President**
to join our Financial Services Compliance & Regulation practice in the UAE. In this leadership role, you will advise banks, asset managers, investment firms, and other regulated financial institutions on a broad range of regulatory, risk, governance, compliance, and financial crime matters. You will lead complex client engagements, drive business development initiatives, mentor junior professionals, and play a key role in expanding Kroll’s Financial Services Regulatory Advisory practice across the region.
  
  
**Apply now to join One Team, One Kroll.**
**Description**
**Responsibilities**
As a
**Vice President**
within an expanding and dynamic team, you will lead high-profile regulatory advisory engagements while building and maintaining strong client relationships across the financial services sector. You will be responsible for the delivery of complex projects, development of junior team members, and the continued growth of the practice through thought leadership and business development activities.
  
  
**As a Vice President, You Will**

* Lead and oversee regulatory, risk, compliance, and financial crime engagements for financial institutions across the UAE and wider GCC region.
* Direct risk-based reviews, identifying control deficiencies, compliance gaps, governance weaknesses, and operational risk exposures.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, including Boards, Executive Management, Compliance Officers, Risk Leaders, and Internal Audit functions.
* Manage and strengthen key client relationships, ensuring high-quality delivery and long-term partnership growth.
* Review and approve reports and presentations prepared for clients, regulators, and executive committees.
* Provide strategic advice on regulatory developments, regulatory remediation programs, and compliance transformation initiatives.
* Lead engagement teams, providing coaching, mentoring, and performance management to junior colleagues.
* Oversee data analysis, risk assessments, and the development of meaningful insights to support decision-making.
* Drive business development activities, including proposal development, client presentations, thought leadership, networking, and market outreach.
* Identify opportunities to expand client relationships and develop new service offerings within the regulatory advisory practice.

**You Will Lead a Wide Range Of Engagements, Including**

* Skilled Person Reviews
* Risk and Compliance Health Checks
* Regulatory Remediation Programs
* Regulatory Assurance Reviews
* Regulatory Readiness Assessments
* Enterprise Risk Management Reviews
* Operational Risk Framework Development
* Controls Testing and Assurance
* AML / Financial Crime Compliance Reviews
* Regulatory Reporting Reviews
* Consumer Protection and Conduct Risk Reviews
* Governance Reviews
* Regulatory Gap Assessments
* Internal Audit and Second-Line Risk & Compliance Reviews

**The Ideal Candidate**
We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded leader who is passionate about helping clients navigate an increasingly complex regulatory environment. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with strong client management and business development capabilities.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Law, Economics, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of relevant experience within a regulator, financial institution, consulting firm, or professional services organization.
* Demonstrated experience leading regulatory, compliance, risk management, or financial crime advisory engagements.
* Strong knowledge of banking and financial services regulations and industry practices.
* Significant exposure to UAE-regulated financial institutions and UAE regulatory frameworks.
* Experience working within a Big 4, Big 6, or leading advisory firm is highly desirable.
* Proven ability to manage senior client stakeholders and lead complex engagements.
* Strong business development track record, including proposal writing, client acquisition, and revenue generation.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; Arabic is advantageous.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.
* Prior experience in one or more of the following areas:

+ Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Financial Crime
+ Enterprise Risk Management
+ Operational Risk
+ Regulatory Compliance
+ Internal Audit and Controls Assurance
+ Regulatory Change and Transformation Programs

**Professional Qualifications**
Professional certifications are highly desirable, including:
  
  

* International Compliance Association (ICA)
* Chartered Institute for Securities & Investment (CISI)
* ACAMS
* CFA, FRM, CIA, CPA, or equivalent professional qualifications

**About Kroll**
Join the global leader in risk and financial advisory solutions—Kroll. With a nearly century-long legacy, we blend trusted expertise with cutting-edge technology to navigate and redefine industry complexities. As a part of
**One Team, One Kroll**
, you’ll contribute to a collaborative and empowering environment while helping clients build, protect, restore, and maximize value.

jobs.title: Financial Advisory Job Opportunities (Manager, Associate Director, Director & Managing Director)
jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**
----------------------------------------

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**
------------

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**
---------------------------

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**
---------------

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with capital markets activities.

* Strong understanding of statistical and numerical techniques (e.g., Monte Carlo, finite difference methods)
* Knowledge of derivative pricing concepts across asset classes (rates, equities, credit, FX, commodities)

* Understanding of optimization techniques (e.g., gradient‑based methods) relevant to calibration, risk analytics, and numerical model implementation.

* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in risk management, model validation, and quantitative workflow automation.

* Experience with risk/pricing systems such as Murex, Calypso, Numerix, Bloomberg, RiskMetrics, etc.

**Position:** Associate Director – ESG & Sustainability

  
  

**Experience:** 12–16 Years

  
  

**Preferred Location:** Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon

  
  

**Project Type:** ESG Transformation, Sustainability Consulting & SAP Sustainability Implementation Projects

  
  

### **Role Overview**

  
  

We are looking for an experienced Associate Director – ESG & Sustainability to lead enterprise-wide sustainability consulting, ESG transformation, and digital implementation engagements. The candidate should have extensive experience in ESG strategy, sustainability reporting, carbon accounting, regulatory compliance, and sustainability transformation initiatives.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of global ESG reporting frameworks, sustainability disclosure requirements, environmental impact assessments, and greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting. The candidate should be capable of advising CXOs, Chief Sustainability Officers, CFOs, and senior business stakeholders on ESG strategy, sustainability roadmaps, reporting requirements, and technology-enabled transformation.

Candidates with experience in SAP Sustainability solutions, SAP Sustainability Control Tower, SAP Sustainability Footprint Management, Big 4 sustainability consulting, and large-scale ESG transformation programs will be highly preferred.

  
  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**1. ESG Strategy & Sustainability Consulting**

  
  

* Lead enterprise-wide ESG and sustainability consulting engagements across industries.
* Drive ESG assessments, sustainability maturity assessments, gap analysis, and strategic roadmap development.
* Advise clients on developing and implementing ESG strategies aligned with business objectives and sustainability commitments.
* Lead materiality and double materiality assessments to identify key sustainability topics, impacts, risks, and opportunities.
* Support organizations in defining ESG priorities, sustainability targets, and long-term decarbonization strategies.
* Drive integration of ESG considerations into business operations, corporate strategy, and decision-making processes.
* Advise senior leadership on emerging ESG trends, sustainability risks, and regulatory developments.
* Identify opportunities for operational improvements, cost optimization, resource efficiency, and sustainable business practices.
  

  

**2. ESG Reporting & Regulatory Compliance**

  
  

* Lead ESG reporting and disclosure engagements aligned with global and domestic sustainability reporting requirements.
* Drive reporting initiatives based on frameworks such as GRI, ISSB/IFRS S1 and S2, ESRS/CSRD, and BRSR.
* Lead ESG data collection, consolidation, validation, and reporting initiatives across business functions.
* Define ESG metrics, key performance indicators (KPIs), reporting methodologies, and governance frameworks.
* Support the preparation of sustainability reports, ESG disclosures, and management presentations.
* Establish ESG data controls, audit trails, and documentation processes to ensure reporting transparency and audit readiness.
* Advise clients on evolving sustainability reporting standards and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with finance, legal, HR, procurement, operations, and compliance teams to ensure reliable ESG reporting.
* Support internal and external ESG assurance and reporting readiness initiatives.
  

  

**3. Carbon Accounting & Decarbonization Strategy**

  
  

* Lead carbon accounting and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions management engagements.
* Drive the development and implementation of corporate carbon footprint assessment methodologies.
* Oversee measurement, calculation, monitoring, and reporting of Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 emissions.
* Work on GHG inventory development, emission factor selection, data validation, and emissions reporting.
* Lead development of carbon reduction strategies, decarbonization roadmaps, and sustainability targets.
* Support clients in assessing emissions across manufacturing, procurement, logistics, supply chain, and business operations.
* Drive initiatives related to renewable energy, energy efficiency, water conservation, waste reduction, and circular economy.
* Advise organizations on carbon management strategies and alignment with recognized GHG accounting methodologies.
  

  

**4. SAP Sustainability Solutions & Digital Transformation**

  
  

* Lead digital sustainability transformation engagements using SAP sustainability and enterprise technology solutions.
* Drive solution design and implementation of SAP Sustainability Control Tower for ESG performance management, data consolidation, and sustainability reporting.
* Lead implementation initiatives involving SAP Sustainability Footprint Management for corporate and product carbon footprint calculation.
* Evaluate and drive the adoption of SAP Sustainability Data Exchange for sustainability data sharing across value chains.
* Define enterprise ESG data architecture and integration strategies across SAP S/4HANA, SAP EHS, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, and non-SAP systems.

Responsibilities include setting regional strategy and resource allocation, ensuring quality and regulatory compliance, leading people development and PV automation initiatives, and supporting client and business development, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence safety service outcomes.

You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through strategic leadership, pharmacovigilance automation and digital transformation, and client partnership. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Associate Director, Patient Safety can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive strategic direction and resource allocation for regional Safety Services in partnership with the Senior Director, and provide input into business plans, budgets, growth strategies, and global expansion.
* Align Safety Services with global organizational strategy, lead continuous improvement of regional processes and procedures, and collaborate with key stakeholders to ensure harmonized global pharmacovigilance operations.
* Ensure regulatory compliance, quality standards, and departmental procedures across regional Safety Services, demonstrating effective compliance and risk mitigation strategies and maintaining current knowledge of professional standards and safety regulations.
* Support audits and inspections related to pharmacovigilance processes and automation and respond to audit reports and address identified issues.
* Lead the implementation and optimization of pharmacovigilance automation tools and digital solutions, including supervising testing and validation of system upgrades and new technology implementations.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives to accelerate digital transformation in pharmacovigilance, assess emerging technologies, and develop and execute innovation roadmaps that enhance efficiency and compliance.
* Analyze performance metrics of automated safety processes, drive continuous improvement, and manage technology budgets and resource allocation for digital safety initiatives.
* Supervise, mentor, and develop team members through personnel management, recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and professional development, while fostering team building, morale, and motivation.
* Design and supervise technology-related training programs for the patient safety organization and team adoption of new safety technologies, and support the Global Head of Safety Services in training program development.
* Support Project Managers and team leaders to deliver projects to expected standards of productivity, quality, compliance, and revenue, oversee projects or processes for clients based on team size, complexity, and span of control, and provide project updates with forecasting and resourcing assessments to patient safety management.
* Oversee efficient budgeting and financial monitoring to maximize the profitability of assigned projects, manage individual, partner, stakeholder, and customer relationships and performance, and ensure appropriate changes in scope are escalated and executed.
* Deliver expert-level Safety Services consultation to internal teams, external partners, and clients, and represent the Safety Services organization at international conferences.
* Contribute strategic and project planning intelligence to proposal generation, support market and business development initiatives, attend business development meetings, bid defenses, and governance meetings, and provide Safety Services expertise and training across the organization.

**You'll thrive in this role if you bring:**

* Strengths in deep clinical, regulatory, and medical expertise, strategic leadership, and stakeholder management
* Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly, with excellent negotiation skills
* An adaptable mindset, enthusiasm for learning, and a patient-focused approach
* Comfort working with pharmacovigilance automation and AI tools, digital safety solutions, and multi-region PV processes

**Required Qualifications**

* Degree in Pharmacy, Nursing, Life Science, or another health-related field, or equivalent qualification or work experience
* 15+ years of experience in Safety Services, including demonstrated success in clinical, medical, or scientific domains and substantial senior-level clinical experience with progressive responsibilities
* Proven people management experience, including leading high-performing teams in professional services environments
* Comprehensive understanding of pharmacovigilance operations, clinical research methodologies, drug development processes, and global regulatory frameworks, with an excellent understanding of International Council for Harmonisation (ICH), Council for International Organizations of Medical Sciences (CIOMS), and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) requirements, including Safety Quality standards
* Experience with automation and AI in pharmacovigilance
* Established history of successful business development and client relationship management
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

**JOB IDENTIFICATION**

**ABOUT US**

Wolters Kluwer is a global leader in professional information services, providing software and content solutions for legal, business, tax, accounting, finance, audit, risk, compliance, and healthcare professionals. Serving clients in over 180 countries with operations in 40+, the company helps professionals make confident decisions and drive results. Headquartered in Alphen aan den Rijn, the Netherlands, it employs around 21,000 people worldwide.

The Global Finance Shared Services (FSS) is a finance function designed to bring together finance and accounting professionals to streamline and enhance processes and tools. Within FSS, the Finance Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Pune, India, provides centralized financial and analytical support across all Wolters Kluwer divisions. The team, comprising finance professionals and data scientists, focuses on finance reporting harmonization, technology enablement, and reporting and analytics enhancements.

In this senior individual-contributor role, you will independently lead key financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and controlling activities for the Financial Shared Services (FSS) team. You will act as a trusted finance partner to business and finance leaders, converting complex financial and operational data into actionable insights, challenging assumptions, identifying risks and opportunities, and driving process and control improvements. The role requires ownership of recurring deliverables, coordination across entities and functions, and high-quality communication with senior stakeholders.

**SUPERVISORY RELATIONSHIPS**

**Reports To :** Manager/Associate Director, Finance COE

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education :**

* Minimum: Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, or data analytics, with relevant experience in FP&A, controlling, accounting, or consulting.
* Preferred: Master’s degree/MBA in finance or a professional qualification such as CPA, CMA, CA, or equivalent.

**Experience :**

* Progressive experience in FP&A, financial controlling, accounting, or business finance, preferably supporting technology, shared-services, or multinational organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple priorities, meet tight deadlines, and deliver accurate, decision-ready outputs.
* Experience partnering with senior finance and business stakeholders, reviewing complex analyses, and influencing actions through data-driven recommendations.
* Experience improving financial processes, internal controls, reporting governance, or automation is strongly preferred.

* Strong analytical capability with experience handling large datasets and translating financial and operational data into actionable insights.
* Advanced Excel and Microsoft Office skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas (IF, VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS), macros, and exposure to SQL or Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications (VBA).

* Flexible, reliable, quick to learn, and comfortable operating in changing or ambiguous environments.

* Own the preparation and analysis of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial results across cost centers, entities, divisions, and product levels, with a strong focus on P&L and balance-sheet accuracy, including variance analysis and commentary versus Latest Estimate (LE), Budget, and prior year.
* Prepare complete monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting for the parent company under IFRS, maintain records supporting differences between statutory and reporting statements, and upload reporting packages into the parent company's reporting system.
* Lead assigned month-end close and reporting activities, reviewing outputs for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
* Analyze ARR, revenue, expenses, profitability, margins, cash flow, and operational metrics against budgets, forecasts, and long-range plans; explain key drivers and recommend actions.
* Prepare materials for the directors of business entities, including performance reports covering revenues, costs, EBITA, and cash flow; product-level revenue overviews; monthly revenue and cost forecasts by source compared with actual results; and budgets for revenues, costs, and cash flow by business area and product.
* Prepare requirements requested by the parent company, including analyses, budgets, long-term financial strategies, and ad hoc projects.

* Prepare documentation for auditors and support the annual financial statement audit.

**Systems, Data & Process Improvement**

* Provide user support for employees within the Entity ERP system information system environment.

* Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies governing the financial management and accounting of business entities, including Wolters Kluwer rules and procedures.

* Implement standardized and automated workflows and drive continuous improvement across business units.

jobs.title: Director, People Strategy
jobs.description:
Join the team behind iconic brands like Huggies®, Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, Kotex®, Poise®, and Kimberly-Clark Professional®. At Kimberly-Clark, it’s all here for you - innovation, growth, and the chance to make a real impact.

  
  

You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes a certain kind of person and teams who care about making a difference. Here, you’ll bring your professional expertise, talent, and drive to building and managing our portfolio of iconic, ground-breaking brands. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.

  

**About You**

  
  

The Director, People Strategy will lead the development, integration and governance of our enterprise People Strategy. Acting as a principal strategy partner to the Global People Leadership Team, this role will translate business priorities into clear workforce, organization, talent, capability and People-function choices.

  
  

You will connect priorities across Centers of Excellence, People Business Partners, Global Business Services, Finance, People Analytics, Digital and Technology. You will bring clarity to complex enterprise challenges, identify necessary trade-offs and provide evidence-based recommendations that guide investment and strategic decision-making.

  
  

Key responsibilities

* Lead the development, periodic refresh, governance and communication of the enterprise People Strategy.
* Translate business strategy into clear workforce, organization, talent, capability, culture and People-function priorities.
* Serve as a trusted strategy partner to the Global People Leadership Team, shaping agendas and providing clear recommendations on enterprise-level choices.
* Integrate functional and Center of Excellence strategies into a coherent global People agenda, identifying gaps, overlaps and dependencies.
* Define enterprise business requirements and strategic principles for technology, data and AI-enabled People solutions.
* Develop evidence-based options and scenarios using workforce data, employee insights, financial information and external trends.
* Connect the People Strategy with portfolio priorities, investment decisions, multi-year roadmaps and annual planning.
* Define measures of success and prepare concise strategy papers, executive briefings and decision materials for senior leadership.
  

To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, strategy, human resources, finance, economics, organizational development or a related field.

* Significant senior-level experience in enterprise strategy, corporate or functional strategy, human capital strategy, management consulting or business transformation.

* Proven experience translating enterprise strategy into functional priorities, business requirements and multi-year plans.

* Experience developing executive-level strategy papers, recommendations, scenarios and decision materials.

* Experience working within a global, highly complex or matrixed organization.

* Experience negotiating across senior functional leaders and resolving competing priorities through explicit choices and trade-offs.

* Excellent written, verbal and executive-level communication skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing or refreshing an enterprise People or workforce strategy.

* Experience integrating multiple HR or People functional agendas into one enterprise direction.

* Experience with mergers and acquisitions, business integration or significant operating-model transformation.

* Experience connecting strategy with portfolio prioritization, sequencing and investment decisions.

* Experience partnering with People Analytics, Finance and enterprise strategy teams.

* Understanding of how technology, data and AI can enable workforce and People strategies.

  

**What success looks like**

You will establish a clear and actionable People Strategy that reflects enterprise business requirements, aligns functional priorities and enables leadership to make better-informed decisions. Your work will help convert competing priorities into explicit choices, ensure People investments are connected to measurable outcomes and create a consistent direction across strategy, portfolio and transformation activities

  

**Led by Purpose. Driven by You.**

  
  

**Total Benefits**

We believe that our employees are our greatest asset, and we're committed to providing them with the resources they need to be successful.

If you're looking for a rewarding career with a company that cares about its employees, then Kimberly-Clark is the place for you.

jobs.title: Services Analytics Team Leader
jobs.description:
**Services Analytics Team Leader**
==================================

You will lead analytics for the **Services** cluster — the set of domains that protect trust, safety, and quality across every interaction on our platform. This is where the integrity of the marketplace is safeguarded and where millions of passengers and drivers experience inDrive as a safe and reliable place to be. Your teams will span five closely connected areas: **Watchdocs** (driver document verification and work with the compliance base), **Trust & Safety** (everything related to trust and safety in rides — incidents and safety features), **Customer Support** (both the product tooling for handling user requests and the automation of that work, plus WFM analytics of support agents' performance), **Customer Experience** (Voice-of-the-Customer feedback and connecting satisfaction metrics such as CSAT/DSAT to business metrics), and **Antifraud** (protecting rides, transactions, ratings, and more from abuse across inDrive).

  

You will build and manage a team that partners closely with **product, operations, support, and compliance** to turn a large volume of behavioral, operational, and feedback signals into decisions that reduce risk and improve experience at the same time. From detecting and quantifying fraud across rides and transactions, to measuring the real business impact of safety features and support automation, to linking customer-feedback metrics (CSAT/DSAT) with core business outcomes — your work will define how the company balances protection, cost, and user satisfaction.

  

In this role, you will act as a **strategic partner** to product and business leaders, as well as to Trust & Safety and Compliance stakeholders — shaping the analytics agenda for the Services cluster, defending its strategy in front of senior leadership, and building scalable processes, metrics, and standards that make trust and safety measurable across the whole platform.

  

Department

Analytics Department

Employment Type

Full Time

Location

United Arab Emirates

Workplace type

Fully remote

Requisition ID

1635

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the **analytics strategy and roadmap** for the Services cluster (Watchdocs, Trust & Safety, Customer Support, CX, Antifraud), align it with company-level priorities, and defend it in front of senior leadership
* Build, grow, and develop a **team of 11+** (analysts) — hiring, mentoring, and setting quality standards across the cluster
* Lead **Antifraud analytics**: detect and quantify fraudulent behavior across rides, transactions, and ratings; evaluate the effectiveness of anti-fraud rules and models and their trade-off with false positives
* Drive **Trust & Safety analytics**: measure incident rates, evaluate the impact of safety features, and help prioritize initiatives that reduce risk for passengers and drivers
* Oversee **Customer Support analytics**: assess support tooling and automation effectiveness, contact-rate drivers, resolution quality, and WFM analytics for agent capacity and performance
* Lead **CX analytics**: connect Voice-of-the-Customer metrics (CSAT/DSAT) to business outcomes such as retention and revenue, and turn feedback into prioritized product and operational actions
* Guide **Watchdocs analytics**: the document-verification funnel, compliance coverage, and the balance between compliance rigor and a smooth driver onboarding experience
* Define and **standardize metrics, definitions, and monitoring** across the cluster; ensure data quality in partnership with DWH, DS, and Engineering
* Establish best practices in **experimentation (A/B testing), causal inference, forecasting, and effect measurement** across the team
* Partner cross-functionally at the **company level** (Product & Tech & Business, DWH, DS, Engineering) and act as a trusted advisor to Head / Director / C-suite stakeholders

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
-----------------------------------

* 6+ years of experience in data or product analytics, preferably in tech, ride-hailing, marketplace, or platform businesses
* 2+ years of people management, leading teams of 10+ people, including other managers or team leads
* Strong expertise in SQL and Python (or R), with a solid foundation in statistics and experimentation (A/B testing, causal inference)
* Proven ability to translate large volumes of behavioral, operational, and feedback data into decisions that balance risk, cost, and user experience
* Experience partnering with senior stakeholders (Head / Director / C-suite) and forming and defending strategy at the company level
* Proficiency in BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Redash, or similar)
* Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Proven experience working on global products serving international audiences is required
* English: Professional Working Proficiency

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience in one of the Services domains — Trust & Safety, Antifraud, Customer Support / WFM, CX / Voice-of-the-Customer, or compliance
* Experience with fraud / risk modeling, anomaly detection, or safety analytics
* Familiarity with text / sentiment analysis for customer-feedback data
* Experience scaling analytics across multiple countries and verticals

**Why join us**
---------------

* Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 47 countries
* Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs
* Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program
* Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects
* Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow
* Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs

Final benefits may vary depending on the location.

**About inDrive**
-----------------

inDrive is a global tech company on a mission to challenge injustice through fair choices. We started in 2012 in the coldest city on Earth, when a group of friends created a way for people to agree on fair ride prices. That idea grew into one of the world’s top ride-hailing apps, now with 400M installs across 47 countries.

  
  

Today, we offer more than rides: from freight and delivery to intercity travel and financial services, all designed to put people first. We are committed to having a positive impact on people’s lives both through our core business, which supports local communities via a fair pricing model; and through the work of our impact programs.

Ready to ignite your inner drive?

**Education:**B.Com / M.Com; CA Inter or CMA Inter preferred.

**Experience:** 2-5 years of relevant experience

jobs.title: Presales Associate
jobs.description:
**We are hiring**

  

**Pre-Sales Associate**

Help parents discover the one class that changes how their child sees technology.

* **Bengaluru, HSR Layout • Onsite**
* **Full-time**
* **0- 2 years**
* **3.5 - 4.2 LPA Fixed**

  

**About Codingal**

Codingal is on a mission to inspire school kids to fall in love with coding.

We have empowered 500,000+ students to start learning to code through personalised 1:1 live classes with expert Computer Science teachers. Our curriculum is built on the K-12 Computer Science Framework and accredited by STEM.org, and kids find it genuinely fun. Parents and children in more than 70 countries trust Codingal for high-quality coding education. We are a global company headquartered in the US, backed by top investors including Y Combinator and Rebright Partners.

  

Coding improves logical thinking and problem-solving by 70% in young children, and lifts their performance in other school subjects too. Coding roles already make up more than 60% of all jobs in science, technology, engineering and maths, so kids who start early will be the creators of the future. Read what parents say about us at codingal.com/reviews-and-testimonials.

  

**About the role**

  

As a Pre-Sales Associate, you are the first human voice a parent hears from Codingal. You will call parents who have shown interest in coding for their child, understand what they are really looking for, and help them see the value of a free trial class. You are not pushing a product you are helping a parent make a good decision for their child, and setting up our sales team with a warm, well-qualified conversation.

  

It is a fast-paced, target-driven role with a lot of conversations every day. If you like talking to people, learn quickly, and want a clear path into a full sales career, this is a strong place to start.

  

**What you will do**

* Make outbound calls to prospective and existing Codingal parents to generate and qualify leads for coding classes.
* Run a customer needs assessment (CNA) on every lead understand the childs age, interests, school workload and the parents goals before recommending anything.
* Book and confirm free trial classes, and follow up with reminder calls so parents actually show up.
* Prime and nurture leads across channels calls, WhatsApp, email and SMS so no interested parent goes cold.
* Hand over qualified, well-documented leads to the Business Development team with clear context on what the parent wants.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in LeadSquared CRM and our telecalling tools every single day.
* Own your daily and monthly numbers calls made, connects, CNAs completed, trials booked and trial attendance.
* Track your own performance metrics, spot what is working, and share it with the team.

  

**What we are looking for**

* 0-2 years of experience in pre-sales, telecalling, inside sales or customer support. Freshers with strong communication are welcome.
* Clear, confident and warm communication in English and Hindi, spoken and written. Additional regional languages are a big plus.
* Genuine empathy you listen to what a parent is worried about before you talk about the product.
* The ability to ask sharp questions and qualify a need, rather than reading from a script.
* Comfort with numbers and targets, and the resilience to keep going in a high-performance environment.
* Strong multitasking and follow-through — you can hold 40+ conversations a day and still remember who needs a call back.
* A learning mindset. You should be able to understand our product well enough to speak to a parent about it within your first few days.
* Flexibility on working hours. Our parents are spread across 70+ countries, so some shifts include evenings or weekends.
* A graduate degree in any discipline.

  

**Why join Codingal**

* **Uncapped incentives.** Exceptionally high performance-linked rewards for top performers — your effort shows up in your payslip.
* **Real, fast growth.** We are scaling quickly and promote on performance, not tenure. Strong performers move into Business Development and then team leadership.
* **Genuine sales training.** You will learn structured discovery, objection handling and consultative selling — skills that stay with you for your whole career.
* **Work that means something.** Every trial class you book is a child who might discover they love building things. That is a good reason to pick up the phone.
* **A young, sharp team.** You will sit with people who are ambitious, collaborative and genuinely fun to work with, in our HSR Layout office.
* **Y Combinator-backed.** A globally recognised, well-funded EdTech company on your CV from day one.

  

**Where this role can take you**

We hire pre-sales associates as the start of a sales career, not a dead end. A typical strong performer moves along this path:

**Pre-Sales Associate Business Development Associate Senior BDA / Relationship Manager Team Lead**

  

Movement is based purely on performance. We would much rather promote from inside the team.

  

**Compensation and location**

* **Annual compensation:** 3,50,000 – 4,20,000 fixed per year, plus a variable performance incentive of up to 3,00,000. The final offer depends on your experience, communication skills and interview performance.
* **Location:** HSR Layout Sector 7, Bengaluru. This is an onsite role and cannot be done remotely.
* **Interviews:** Conducted at our Bengaluru office.

  

**Our hiring process**

* **1. Application review** — we look at your CV and communication.
* **2. Telephonic screening** — a short call to hear how you speak with people.
* **3. Interview at the HSR office** — including a live mock call with a parent scenario.
* **4. Offer** — we move fast and aim to close within a week.

  

**Frequently asked questions**

  

**What salary can I expect?**

3,50,000 to 4,20,000 a year — a fixed base -- plus a variable performance incentive of up to 3,00,000. Where you land depends on your experience, communication skills and interview performance. Top performers earn meaningfully more through incentives.

  

**What is the eligibility criteria?**

A graduate degree in any discipline and 0–2 years of experience. Freshers with excellent communication skills are encouraged to apply.

  

**What skills matter most for this job?**

Clear, confident spoken English and Hindi, real empathy for parents, and the discipline to follow up. A Computer Science background is not required — we will teach you the product.

  

**Who can apply for this role?**

Anyone who meets the criteria above. Codingal is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applicants of every gender, background, religion, caste and ability. We do not discriminate on any of these grounds.

  

**Is this a work-from-home job?**

No. This is a full-time onsite role at our HSR Layout Sector 7 office in Bengaluru.

  

**What do the working hours look like?**

Standard full-time hours with shift flexibility. Because we serve parents in 70+ countries, some shifts include evenings or weekends. Your shift is confirmed before you join.

  

**Are there any charges or deposits to apply or join?**

Absolutely not. Codingal never asks for money at any stage of hiring or employment. If anyone claiming to represent us asks you for a payment, it is a scam — please report it to us.

  

**Ready to apply?**

Come join a young, smart team on a mission to inspire school kids to fall in love with coding, and help us prepare every K-12 student for the future.

Apply at codingal.com/careers or write to careers@codingal.com.
