jobs.title: CA Industrial Trainee
jobs.description:
**Job description**

Hello Aspirants,

At Finnable we like to keep things uncomplicated, exciting, and fast well, that’s our brand promise to our customers also. We want to give them loans in under 3 minutes -UNCOMPLICATED AND FAST!

**So, who are we?**

We are a fintech start-up based out of Bangalore. We are three founders onto our 2nd innings. All three of us are ex-bankers. Nitin and Viraj are successful entrepreneurs, and Amit is a seasoned banker.

Finnable Credit is an RBI-registered NBFC offering personal loans to salaried professionals and loans against property, through a digital-first, tech-led lending model.

We are backed by marquee investors including Claypond Capital (Ranjan Pai), Z47, TVS Capital, Wealth Company and Pratithi Investment, among others.

**Are you the right person for the job?**

* At Finnable, we believe in “Getting Things Done”. If you are a self-starter who can take ownership of deliverables with minimal direction, you will love this role!
* A start-up enthusiast including the ability to swoop and soar, charting your own path, and being crazy to dream big are a few must-haves if you want to enjoy this ride!
* This is a challenging role in a fast-paced, agile start-up environment. Priorities shift quickly, problems rarely come with a playbook, and you will be trusted with real responsibility from day one.
* Strong command of Excel and a genuine comfort with numbers and data. Working knowledge of Power BI is a plus. If you don’t know SQL or Python yet, be ready to learn them on the job.
* A structured thinker with a sharp eye for detail, who can turn data into clear, crisp insights for senior leadership.
* Must have cleared both groups of CA Inter in first attempt.
* Must be eligible and ready to join Industrial Training immediately, with close to 12 months of Industrial Training tenure remaining.

**Job Description**

**1. Management Dashboard & Business MIS**

* Build and own an end-to-end **management dashboard** that gives leadership a single, reliable view of business performance across functions.
* Define KPIs and metrics in line with **industry best practices** for lending and fintech businesses (disbursements, portfolio quality, collections, unit economics, cost metrics).
* **Automate recurring MIS and reports** to cut manual effort and turnaround time.
* Keep dashboards accurate, consistent and decision-ready, with clear commentary on trends and exceptions.

**2. Data Management & Reconciliation**

* Take **ownership of organising and structuring the company’s financial and operational databases**, so that data is clean, consistent and easy to use.
* Lead **data clean-up exercises**: identify gaps, duplicates and inconsistencies across systems, and fix them at the source.
* Perform and streamline **reconciliations** between the loan management system, books of accounts, bank and partner data, and drive closure of open reconciling items.
* **Automate everything that can be automated**: data pulls, reconciliations and recurring reports, so that manual work becomes the exception and not the norm.
* Put in place **data hygiene checks and documentation** so the data stays reliable going forward.

**3. Business Analytics**

* Analyse business, portfolio and financial data to surface **trends, risks and opportunities**.
* Carry out deep-dive analyses such as **product and channel profitability, cohort and vintage analysis**, and cost and efficiency reviews.
* Convert analysis into **crisp presentations and actionable recommendations** for senior leadership.

**4. Special Projects**

* Work closely with **senior leadership on high-priority, cross-functional strategic projects**.
* Support **fundraising, investor and board reporting**, and due diligence data requirements.
* Research and evaluate new initiatives, partnerships and process improvements, and build **business cases** to support decisions.
* Coordinate with Business, Product, Risk, Operations and Technology teams to drive projects to closure.
* Any other ad hoc assignments as required by the business.

**5. What you will gain**

* Exposure to how a **regulated fintech NBFC** is run end to end, across finance, strategy, risk and operations.
* **Direct visibility to senior leadership** and the way key business decisions are made.
* Ownership of **real, high-impact work** that the leadership team uses every day.

**Stipend**

35,000 per month.

jobs.description:
**We have urgent requirment for Sales Maneger (Industrial Automation).**

**Role Understanding & Purpose:**

The Manager Sales is responsible for developing business opportunities and building long-term relationships with customers in industries requiring automation, machine control, and engineering solutions.

This role is not only about selling products / services but also about understanding customer processes, identifying automation opportunities, and positioning the right technical solution with the support of engineering teams.

  

The Sales Manager acts as the bridge between customers and internal engineering teams, ensuring that customer expectations are translated into clear project requirements and commercial proposals.

  

**Detailed Job Role & Activities**

**1. Business Development**

* Identify new business opportunities in manufacturing and industrial sectors for automation projects and services.
* Develop relationships with OEMs, system integrators, and end-user industries.
* Foster a progressive and growth-oriented approach to continuously develop capabilities and build a future-ready team, supporting sustainable business expansion.

  

**2. Customer Engagement**

* Understand customer processes, pain points, and automation needs.
* Conduct technical discussions along with the engineering team to propose suitable solutions.

  

**3. Proposal & Commercial Management**

* Prepare techno-commercial proposals in coordination with engineering and estimation teams.
* Participate in negotiations and close orders with mutually beneficial terms.

  

**4. Market Intelligence:**

* Track industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging automation opportunities.
* Identify sectors with potential for automation upgrades.

  

**5. Relationship Management:**

* Build strong long-term relationships with customers.
* Maintain regular engagement even after project delivery to generate repeat business.

  

**6. Internal Coordination:**

* Coordinate with engineering, project, and service teams during project execution to ensure customer expectations are met.

  

**7. Staying Updated on Industry Trends:**

* Stay abreast of industry trends, technological advancements, and regulatory changes affecting the industrial automation sector. Use this knowledge to adapt sales and marketing strategies accordingly and maintain a competitive edge in the market.

  

**Mandatory Skill Set Requirements**

**1. Education**

* MBA (Marketing) or Equivalent Qualifications
* Graduation: Engineering-Electronics/ Electrical/ Instrumentation/ Mechanical/ Automation

  

**2. Competency Requirement**

* 10+ years of experience as Business Development Role specialised Industrial Automation Industry.
* The ability to understand how automation solutions improve manufacturing efficiency.
* Basic Understanding about technical specs:
* PLC programming (Rockwell/Allen Bradley preferred) o HMI & SCADA development (FactoryTalk desirable) o Motion control & drive integration o Machine automation and safety systems o Control panels & electrical systems

  

**3. Behavioural & Professional Competencies**

* Strong communication and customer-handling skills.
* Problem solving and solution-based approach.
* High ownership mindset with willingness to take responsibility and accountability.
* Ability to manage time, travel, and multi-tasking effectively.
* Expert in business negotiation, close deals without damaging relationships.
* Good existing network and relationship in Industrial Automation industry.

  

**Work Environment & Support**

We ensure a safe, supportive, and structured environment, including:

* Planned travel schedules
* Clear documentation and engineering standards
* Team assistance during critical phases

  

**Compensation**

We offer a competitive salary aligned with industry standards.

Family Insurance to support and provide security.

Performance based incentives

  

**Why Join Us**

* Opportunity to Work on high-value automation solution sales, not just products
* Strong technical team support for proposals and execution
* Opportunity to build long-term customer relationships
* Ownership and flexibility in driving your sales strategy
* Exposure to multiple industrial sectors
* Growth driven by performance and results
* Backed by a stable and growing global organization EPIQ Machinery.

jobs.title: HCM Cloud Payroll Functional Consultant (Principal/Sr Principal)
jobs.description:
**Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant**

  

*Deliver accurate, integrated payroll solutions across country legislations with Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM.*

  
  

**Role Overview**

  

As an Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant, you will translate business and legislative requirements into Oracle Fusion Cloud Global Payroll solutions. You will independently deliver requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, data migration, cutover, and stabilization, helping clients achieve accurate payroll processing and production readiness. Working with HR, Payroll, Finance, and technical stakeholders, you will apply mandatory Core HR knowledge to worker and assignment dependencies and coordinate related HCM integrations. The role requires 8+ years of overall professional experience relevant to HCM consulting, including Oracle Cloud payroll implementation experience; at least two full end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM implementations involving Payroll; and implementation experience across at least two country legislations. You will bring strong hands-on Global Payroll expertise and moderate hands-on proficiency in Payroll Fast Formulas and data migration.

You will work with geographically distributed clients and delivery teams. Hiring location, employment model, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead requirements and design workshops with HR, Payroll, Finance, and technical stakeholders, translating business and legislative needs into functional designs and Oracle Payroll configurations.
* Configure Legislative Data Groups, Payroll Statutory Units, Tax Reporting Units, payroll definitions, calendars, consolidation groups, and payment methods to establish payroll structures.
* Configure elements, eligibility, balances, calculation cards, rates, earnings, deductions, employer contributions, retroactivity, proration, and termination settlements to support accurate payroll calculations.
* Design and validate payroll flows, gross-to-net calculations, statutory reports, payments, payslips, costing, and reconciliation to meet business and legislative requirements.
* Apply Core HR knowledge to worker and assignment data, resolve dependencies with Absence Management, Time and Labor, Benefits, and Compensation, and define functional requirements for banking, statutory, third-party payroll, time, benefits, and Finance integrations.
* Create, modify, and troubleshoot Payroll Fast Formulas; support migration mapping, preparation, loading, validation, and reconciliation using HDL/HSDL where applicable, including opening and year-to-date balances.
* Prepare functional designs, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, operating procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials to support delivery and payroll operations.
* Conduct functional testing, lead payroll parallel runs, resolve discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and obtain stakeholder sign-off to establish payroll readiness.
* Support cutover, initial payroll cycles, and stabilization; assess quarterly updates and legislative changes and support regression testing to maintain reliable payroll processing.
* Communicate deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and decisions to clients and project leadership; mentor consultants and lead the Payroll workstream when required.

  

**Skills - Mandatory**

**Experience**

* 8+ years of overall professional experience relevant to HCM consulting, including Oracle Cloud payroll implementation experience.
* At least two full, completed end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM implementations involving Payroll, with demonstrated hands-on functional ownership.
* Implementation experience across at least two country legislations from the areas below. For Middle East experience, identify the specific countries implemented.

**Country-specific functional expertise**

* United States: Federal, state, and local taxation; deductions; garnishments; multi-state payroll; and quarterly and year-end reporting.
* United Kingdom: PAYE, National Insurance, statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, student loans, RTI, and P45/P60 processing.
* Middle East: Country-specific payroll localization, social insurance or pensions, end-of-service benefits, gratuity, and WPS where applicable.
* India: Income tax/TDS, tax regimes, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, gratuity, arrears, and full-and-final settlements.
* Canada: Federal and provincial taxation, CPP/QPP, EI, QPIP where applicable, taxable benefits, ROE, and year-end reporting.
* Strong understanding of gross-to-net processing, retroactivity, proration, balances, payments, costing, and reconciliation.
* Experience leading payroll parallel testing, resolving discrepancies, and supporting payroll acceptance and production readiness.
* Understanding of HCM security and appropriate access to sensitive payroll information.

**Oracle Products**

* Strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion Cloud Global Payroll, with the majority of relevant experience in Oracle HCM Cloud.
* Mandatory functional knowledge of Core HR and its dependencies with Payroll.

**Technical Skills**

* Moderate hands-on proficiency in Payroll Fast Formulas and data migration.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Ability to independently facilitate workshops, explain solution options, and resolve complex functional issues.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Good to Have

* Experience with global or multi-country Payroll implementations.
* Experience with midyear transitions, opening balance migration, and the first statutory year-end following go-live.
* Experience with Payroll-to-General Ledger integration and accounting reconciliation.
* Relevant Oracle Payroll Cloud certifications.
* Experience mentoring consultants or leading functional delivery teams.
* Presales experience covering demonstrations, proposals, solution assessments, or estimation.
* Experience using AI and automation tools to support implementation delivery, with appropriate data access and output validation.

jobs.title: HCM Cloud Payroll Functional Consultant (Principal/Sr Principal)
jobs.description:
**Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant**

  

*Deliver accurate, integrated payroll solutions across country legislations with Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM.*

  
  

**Role Overview**

  

As an Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant, you will translate business and legislative requirements into Oracle Fusion Cloud Global Payroll solutions. You will independently deliver requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, data migration, cutover, and stabilization, helping clients achieve accurate payroll processing and production readiness. Working with HR, Payroll, Finance, and technical stakeholders, you will apply mandatory Core HR knowledge to worker and assignment dependencies and coordinate related HCM integrations. The role requires 8+ years of overall professional experience relevant to HCM consulting, including Oracle Cloud payroll implementation experience; at least two full end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM implementations involving Payroll; and implementation experience across at least two country legislations. You will bring strong hands-on Global Payroll expertise and moderate hands-on proficiency in Payroll Fast Formulas and data migration.

You will work with geographically distributed clients and delivery teams. Hiring location, employment model, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead requirements and design workshops with HR, Payroll, Finance, and technical stakeholders, translating business and legislative needs into functional designs and Oracle Payroll configurations.
* Configure Legislative Data Groups, Payroll Statutory Units, Tax Reporting Units, payroll definitions, calendars, consolidation groups, and payment methods to establish payroll structures.
* Configure elements, eligibility, balances, calculation cards, rates, earnings, deductions, employer contributions, retroactivity, proration, and termination settlements to support accurate payroll calculations.
* Design and validate payroll flows, gross-to-net calculations, statutory reports, payments, payslips, costing, and reconciliation to meet business and legislative requirements.
* Apply Core HR knowledge to worker and assignment data, resolve dependencies with Absence Management, Time and Labor, Benefits, and Compensation, and define functional requirements for banking, statutory, third-party payroll, time, benefits, and Finance integrations.
* Create, modify, and troubleshoot Payroll Fast Formulas; support migration mapping, preparation, loading, validation, and reconciliation using HDL/HSDL where applicable, including opening and year-to-date balances.
* Prepare functional designs, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, operating procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials to support delivery and payroll operations.
* Conduct functional testing, lead payroll parallel runs, resolve discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and obtain stakeholder sign-off to establish payroll readiness.
* Support cutover, initial payroll cycles, and stabilization; assess quarterly updates and legislative changes and support regression testing to maintain reliable payroll processing.
* Communicate deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and decisions to clients and project leadership; mentor consultants and lead the Payroll workstream when required.

  

**Skills - Mandatory**

**Experience**

* 8+ years of overall professional experience relevant to HCM consulting, including Oracle Cloud payroll implementation experience.
* At least two full, completed end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM implementations involving Payroll, with demonstrated hands-on functional ownership.
* Implementation experience across at least two country legislations from the areas below. For Middle East experience, identify the specific countries implemented.

**Country-specific functional expertise**

* United States: Federal, state, and local taxation; deductions; garnishments; multi-state payroll; and quarterly and year-end reporting.
* United Kingdom: PAYE, National Insurance, statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, student loans, RTI, and P45/P60 processing.
* Middle East: Country-specific payroll localization, social insurance or pensions, end-of-service benefits, gratuity, and WPS where applicable.
* India: Income tax/TDS, tax regimes, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, gratuity, arrears, and full-and-final settlements.
* Canada: Federal and provincial taxation, CPP/QPP, EI, QPIP where applicable, taxable benefits, ROE, and year-end reporting.
* Strong understanding of gross-to-net processing, retroactivity, proration, balances, payments, costing, and reconciliation.
* Experience leading payroll parallel testing, resolving discrepancies, and supporting payroll acceptance and production readiness.
* Understanding of HCM security and appropriate access to sensitive payroll information.

**Oracle Products**

* Strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion Cloud Global Payroll, with the majority of relevant experience in Oracle HCM Cloud.
* Mandatory functional knowledge of Core HR and its dependencies with Payroll.

**Technical Skills**

* Moderate hands-on proficiency in Payroll Fast Formulas and data migration.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Ability to independently facilitate workshops, explain solution options, and resolve complex functional issues.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Good to Have

* Experience with global or multi-country Payroll implementations.
* Experience with midyear transitions, opening balance migration, and the first statutory year-end following go-live.
* Experience with Payroll-to-General Ledger integration and accounting reconciliation.
* Relevant Oracle Payroll Cloud certifications.
* Experience mentoring consultants or leading functional delivery teams.
* Presales experience covering demonstrations, proposals, solution assessments, or estimation.
* Experience using AI and automation tools to support implementation delivery, with appropriate data access and output validation.

jobs.title: B2B Inside Sales & Proposal Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented, proactive, and organized **B2B Inside Sales & Proposal Specialist** to support our business growth initiatives in New York.

This role combines proposal coordination with lead generation, prospect research, and sales follow-up. You will work closely with the Marketing & Sales Managers and collaborate with our technical, operations, and leadership teams to identify business opportunities, coordinate proposal submissions, and maintain consistent communication with prospective and existing clients.

The ideal candidate has strong written and verbal communication skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a remote work environment.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. RFP, RFI, & RFQ Research and Coordination**

* Identify and monitor relevant Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Information (RFIs), Requests for Quotations (RFQs), tenders, and other business opportunities.
* Research government procurement portals, public-sector opportunities, corporate procurement platforms, and relevant industry sources.
* Review solicitation documents to identify eligibility criteria, submission requirements, deadlines, and mandatory documentation.
* Maintain a centralized tracker of opportunities, deadlines, submission status, and follow-up actions.
* Coordinate with technical, operations, finance, and leadership teams to collect the information required for submissions.
* Draft, format, proofread, and compile proposal responses and supporting documents.
* Ensure submissions are complete, accurate, professionally presented, and delivered before deadlines.
* Maintain an organized repository of previous proposals, company profiles, case studies, certifications, and standard response documents.
* Track submission outcomes and help identify opportunities to improve the quality and efficiency of future proposals.

  

**2. Lead Generation & Prospect Research**

* Research potential clients, target industries, government agencies, and organizations that may require IT products, managed services, and/or cybersecurity solutions.
* Build and maintain targeted prospect lists using online research, company websites, professional networks, procurement portals, and other relevant sources.
* Identify relevant decision-makers and business contacts within target organizations.
* Support outbound lead generation activities through personalized email outreach, LinkedIn research, and other approved channels.
* Identify potential opportunities for cross-selling, repeat business, and engagement with existing clients.

  

**3. Lead Follow-Up & Sales Support**

* Follow up with prospective clients after initial outreach, meetings, referrals, proposals, and other sales interactions.
* Track leads, outstanding responses, upcoming follow-ups, and sales opportunities to ensure timely action.
* Support the Marketing & Sales Manager in maintaining an organized sales pipeline.
* Help re-engage existing clients and previous contacts through relevant, professional communications.
* Prepare basic sales reports covering lead activity, follow-ups, proposal submissions, and opportunity status.

  

**4. Marketing & Business Development Support**

* Assist with market, competitor, and industry research to identify growth opportunities.
* Support the execution of targeted B2B marketing and lead generation campaigns.
* Assist with company presentations, capability statements, service descriptions, and other sales collateral.
* Support social media and content-related activities when required.
* Maintain accurate records of campaign responses, lead sources, and business development activities.
* Provide administrative and coordination support for other marketing and business development initiatives as needed.

  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Approximately 25 years of relevant experience in proposal coordination, business development support, sales operations, or B2B lead generation.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Experience researching business opportunities and coordinating documentation against defined requirements.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
* Ability to write professional business emails and follow up confidently with prospects.
* Strong ownership, reliability, time management, and follow-through in a remote working environment.
* Willingness to work hours that provide sufficient overlap with U.S. business teams.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with an IT Managed Service Provider (MSP), cybersecurity company, IT consulting firm, or technology services provider.
* Experience with government or public-sector RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and procurement portals.
* Familiarity with North American B2B sales processes and business communication practices.
* Experience using platforms such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Microsoft Planner, or similar tools.
* Basic understanding of managed IT services, cloud services, and cybersecurity solutions.
* Experience supporting proposal libraries, reusable content, compliance checklists, and submission workflows.

  

**Who Will Thrive in This Role?**

You are someone who takes ownership of tasks and sees them through to completion. You enjoy research, organizing information, writing professional communications, and coordinating with different teams. You are comfortable balancing detailed documentation with proactive business development activities and understand that consistent follow-up is essential to building business relationships.

If you are organized, resourceful, and eager to contribute to the growth of a technology and cybersecurity services business, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - HR Business Partnering & Learning
jobs.location: Bengaluru(Bangalore City Municipal Corporation Layout), Bangalore Rural, India
jobs.description:
**Role Description**

This is a senior HRBP Leadership role at the intersection of HR strategy, people capability, and organisational effectiveness. The Senior Manager HR Business Partnering & Learning serves as the primary people strategy architect for the Centre of Excellence, operating at the confluence of business partnership, workforce development, and HR governance.

The role demands someone who can seamlessly shift between strategic advisory and operational rigour translating enterprise people priorities into tangible centre outcomes, while simultaneously building HR capability that is future-ready, data- informed, and deeply human.

Success looks like a CoE where HR is a strategic growth enabler rather than a support function: where leaders are advised with confidence and where HR frameworks and systems are built to scale not just maintained.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

1. HR Business Partnering Excellence

* Drive a high-quality, end-to-end HR delivery model across the employee lifecycle, anchored in business alignment and proactive people stewardship.
* Architect and lead BU-aligned HRBP delivery positioning the HR function as a strategic growth partner, not a transactional support layer.
* Own the people strategy narrative for the CoE: translate enterprise priorities and business goals into relevant, timely people interventions that move the needle on talent, culture, and productivity.
* Lead workforce planning and organisation design conversations in partnership with the Centre Head and global HR ensuring role architecture, career pathways, and headcount structures are built for scale and sustainability.
* Navigate complex employee relations with sound judgement, genuine empathy, and legal rigour including performance interventions, probations, and compliance cases protecting both people and the organisation.
* Champion the 'How We Work' operating framework, holding the centre accountable to process integrity and behavioural standards that define the people experience.

  

2. People Management

* Build and sustain a high-performing HR team that operates with cohesion, care, and a shared commitment to delivering for the business and for each other.
* Lead, coach, and inspire a team creating clarity of purpose, consistency of delivery, and genuine pride in the function.
* Own the individual development journeys within the team: conduct regular 1:1 coaching conversations, co-create IDPs, and actively sponsor internal mobility and career growth.
* Monitor team health as a strategic priority act on engagement signals early, manage attrition proactively, and build a psychologically safe environment where diverse voices are heard and valued.

  

3 . Stakeholder Engagement

* Build the credibility and visibility of HR as an indispensable strategic voice trusted by leaders, valued by managers, and respected across the global HR community.
* Cultivate trusted, long-term partnerships with business leaders, people managers, global HRA partners, and senior CoE leadership serving as a proactive, credible, and commercially-aware HR voice.
* Design and operationalise a structured Stakeholder Engagement Framework: regular business reviews, HRBP connect cadences, and leadership feedback loops that create accountability and shared ownership.
* Represent the HR function with authority in CoE leadership forums, People Leader connects, and cross-functional governance bodies — influencing decisions that shape the people's agenda.

  

4. Operational Efficiency & Process Governance

* Ensure accurate and timely execution across HR processes such as- PIP, probation, ER, IJP, and HWW cycles — serving as the quality control layer that protects process integrity and employee experience simultaneously.
* Lead continuous process re-engineering: reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times, define clear accountability structures, and regularly simplify HR processes to keep pace with a growing organisation.5. External Intelligence
* Position as a destination employer and HR thought-leader — bringing the outside in, and representing the organisation with conviction on public platforms.
* Actively represent in the HR ecosystem through conferences, panel discussions, and professional forums (People Matters TechHR, SHRM India, and equivalent platforms).
* Continuously import external best practices, emerging talent trends, and market benchmarks into the CoE — ensuring the HR function evolves ahead of, not behind, the business.
* Model a growth mindset across the team and the centre — investing in personal development, embracing learning publicly, and building a culture where curiosity and continuous improvement are celebrated.

  

**Knowledge and Skills**

* Strong business acumen, with the ability to translate strategic priorities into practical people plans that drive measurable outcomes.
* Coaching skills, to guide and coach senior leaders
* Data literacy and analytical thinking: able to use HR metrics, engagement data, and workforce analytics to diagnose issues and inform decisions.
* High stakeholder influence and executive communication skills — comfortable presenting to and influencing CHROs, Centre Heads, and global HR leadership.
* Operational rigour: able to maintain high execution standards across a broad portfolio without losing sight of the strategic agenda.
* Demonstrable experience in org design, workforce planning, succession management, and leadership development at scale.

Amtech provides enterprise software for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems support order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics, helping customers improve efficiency and operational performance.

With Vistas investment and strategic guidance, Amtech combines the agility of a growing technology organization with the stability and career opportunities of a global software ecosystem.

Our Employee Value Proposition

At Amtech, you can:

* **Make an impact:** Help shape manufacturing and supply chain operations through mission-critical enterprise software.
* **Keep growing:** Access learning, leadership development, and opportunities across Vista’s global network.
* **Work collaboratively:** Join a transparent, people-first culture grounded in accountability and integrity.
* **Contribute to innovation:** Help modernize business processes and explore technologies such as AI-driven automation.

Role Overview

We are hiring Product Owners at the **Product Owner II and Senior Product Owner levels** to support product execution across Amtech’s labeling and corrugated ERP platforms, with a focus on automated scheduling applications.

Depending on experience and scope, the role may focus on owning the scheduling product backlog or performing product-management execution for the labeling product line while coordinating and supporting the product-owner community across both product lines.

In either focus, you will work with product management, engineering, QA, UX, architecture, and customer-facing teams to turn roadmap initiatives and manufacturing needs into clear development work and useful product outcomes.

The Senior Product Owner focus includes coordinating agile planning and ceremonies, supporting product owners, and maintaining quality standards for product development lifecycle (PDLC) artifacts. This is a coordination and enablement role and does not carry direct people-management responsibility. Market-facing direction, priorities, and customer strategy are set in partnership with in-market product leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Execution

* Own or support the product backlog for automated scheduling applications and related labeling or corrugated ERP capabilities.
* Work with Product Managers and in-market product leadership to translate roadmap initiatives into epics, user stories, and actionable backlog items.
* Define and prioritize features, enhancements, and fixes based on customer needs, product direction, and business goals.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and ensure items are ready for sprint planning.
* Work with tech leads and development teams to plan delivery across multiple sprints and longer-term initiatives.
* Maintain product artifacts and, at the Senior Product Owner level, review PDLC artifacts for completeness and quality.

Manufacturing and Customer Insight

* Engage with customers, customer support, implementation, and services teams to understand manufacturing workflows and scheduling challenges.
* Translate production scheduling and manufacturing requirements into scalable product capabilities.
* Help resolve software defects and define customer-specific features in collaboration with product management.
* Ensure product decisions reflect customer needs and support broader product goals.

Agile Delivery and Coordination

* Work closely with engineering, QA, UX, and architecture teams during planning, development, and release cycles.
* Coordinate with Product Managers, tech leads, and development teams in Program Increment (PI) planning.
* Participate in or facilitate sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other agile ceremonies.
* Clarify requirements and help teams understand the intended product outcomes.
* At the Senior Product Owner level, coordinate and support product owners across the India-based labeling and corrugated teams, and help build shared practices through a community of practice.

Product Delivery and Continuous Improvement

* Validate delivered functionality against acceptance criteria and business objectives.
* Support product releases through documentation, training, and internal enablement.
* Provide product expertise to internal stakeholders and contribute to continuous improvement of scheduling capabilities and product-owner practices.

Skills and Qualifications

* **Product Owner II:** Typically 3–5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or in a similar software product role.
* **Senior Product Owner:** Typically 7+ years of experience in product ownership, product management, or business analysis, including experience coordinating or supporting other Product Owners.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments.
* Experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and defining requirements.
* Experience with ERP systems and the ability to translate business needs into technical product specifications.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including experience working with distributed teams.
* For the Senior Product Owner focus, experience facilitating agile ceremonies, including PI planning, and establishing or maintaining standards for product artifacts.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with manufacturing, production scheduling, scheduling optimization, or ERP applications.
* Knowledge of production operations, shop-floor workflows, or manufacturing analytics.
* Experience with ERP integrations and manufacturing workflows.
* Experience working with in-market product leadership in a distributed or offshore delivery model.
* Experience coaching or supporting other Product Owners or building a community of practice.
* Familiarity with Jira or similar backlog-management tools.

Why Join Amtech

At Amtech, you’ll help deliver software that supports real manufacturing operations while benefiting from Vista’s global ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented teams, access cross-portfolio learning opportunities, and contribute to the continued development of Amtech’s ERP and scheduling products.

jobs.title: Manager, Finance Transformation Risk and Assurance
jobs.description:
Key responsibilities

* **Own the risk view for an assigned workstream.** Proactively assess the assigned process or risk domain across deployment waves using the common Risk & Compliance methodology. Apply sound judgment to new scope, process variants, handoffs and emerging risks, and update mitigations as design and implementation progress.
* **Build strong partnerships with assigned functions.** Engage functional leads across Plan, Make, Source, Deliver, Finance, Customer Excellence or Master Data as relevant, including Global Process Owners, Technical Process Owners and business process owners. Understand how their decisions affect controls and end-to-end outcomes.
* **Connect business risks to financial outcomes.** Examine how transactions are initiated, approved, recorded, reconciled and reported. Prioritize risks to completeness, accuracy, valuation, authorization and timely reporting, alongside material operational risks within the assigned processes.
* **Design and document the future control environment.** Partner with process owners and Finance to define preventive and detective controls, including automated and manual steps, exception management, control ownership, frequency, evidence and escalation. Challenge gaps and avoid controls that cannot operate sustainably after go-live.
* **Address transition and coexistence risks.** Assess handoffs and reconciliations between legacy and S/4HANA environments, temporary workarounds, changing responsibilities and controls during phased deployment; define mitigation and monitoring until the target process is stable.
* **Translate risks into testing and deployment evidence.** Specify risk-based business scenarios, negative cases, end-to-end outcomes and acceptance criteria. Work with testing, data migration, cutover and dress rehearsal teams to ensure relevant risks are tested, exceptions are resolved or mitigated, and evidence is retained.
* **Track issues and residual risks to closure.** Maintain a clear record of assessments, control decisions, test outcomes, open gaps, owners and agreed actions across releases within the assigned workstream. Explain implications for deployment milestones and escalate material issues in time for informed decisions.
* **Support audit readiness and pre-implementation reviews.** Organize the risk and control narrative, design decisions, test evidence and issue status for the assigned workstream. Engage with internal and external auditors during pre-implementation audits, respond to inquiries with the relevant process and program teams, address findings and track remediation through closure.
* **Connect risks across processes, programs and technology.** Identify upstream and downstream effects, dependencies on other transformation programs, and risks at process or system handoffs. Partner with Digital Solution Risk & Assurance on configuration, applications, interfaces, automation and data flows; align with IT compliance and access specialists as needed.
* **Build the integrated release risk profile.** Share risks, evidence gaps and dependencies with other Risk & Compliance Managers and the Senior Manager. Combine findings across workstreams to explain the end-to-end release risk story and inform appropriate de-risking actions and leadership decisions.

**Support control adoption after deployment.** Confirm that process and control owners understand their responsibilities, that procedures and evidence expectations are usable, and that early-live issues feed back into control improvements and subsequent releases.

**Qualifications and experience**

  

* Experience in business process risk, internal controls, Finance transformation or deployment assurance on a complex ERP program, preferably SAP S/4HANA. Direct involvement in at least one implementation or major release is important.
* Ability to map an end-to-end process, identify meaningful failure points and turn them into workable control requirements, test scenarios and evidence expectations.
* Sound understanding of financial risk and controls in supply chain processes, including transaction flows, reconciliations, master data and period-end implications.
* Experience preparing risk and control documentation and evidence for internal or external audit reviews, including pre-implementation audits; familiarity with SOX requirements is advantageous.
* Ability to build effective working relationships with Global Process Owners, Technical Process Owners, functional leads and delivery teams, and to challenge decisions constructively in a matrix organization.
* Ability to connect risks within an assigned stream to upstream and downstream processes, parallel programs and digital solution changes, and contribute clearly to an integrated release risk profile.
* Clear written and verbal communication, sound judgment in prioritizing risks, and willingness to investigate process detail while presenting concise conclusions to senior stakeholders.
* University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems or a related field. Experience in a regulated life-sciences environment is advantageous.

**About the Company**

The company provides an agentic Transportation Management System for enterprises for all-mile and all-channel, trusted by global enterprises.

  

The platform unifies orders, capacity, and carrier networks into one living plan, aligning planning, execution, and settlement so promises become proof. AI co-pilots with guardrails surface risk early and recommend the next best move to protect SLAs and reduce empty miles.

  

**The Companys Journey and Impact**

The company has been on a mission to make logistics decision-making intelligent, sustainable, and real-world ready. Its platform has powered billions of deliveries across 30+ countries for global enterprises, driving measurable impact in cost savings, carbon reduction, and SLA performance.

  

**Global Footprint**

Headquartered in Bangalore, with teams across the U.S., U.K., UAE, and Southeast Asia, the company brings together 170+ engineers, designers, and problem-solvers united by a single goal: to reinvent how the world moves goods.

  

**Traits the Company Values**

The company looks for people who are:

* Global in mindset: curious about diverse markets and ideas.
* Unrelenting in drive: energized by complex challenges.
* Intelligent in approach: analytical, creative, and thoughtful.
* Dynamic in execution: adaptive and decisive in fast-moving contexts.
* Exact in craft: detail-oriented and committed to excellence.

  

**Why this role**

This is an execution-heavy role working directly with the companys Director of Product. You will not be tied to one product: you take on execution for whichever products he owns, today and as they change. That means cross-product work and a seat in customer conversations.

  

**What you will do**

* Help build and run the roadmap: plan the quarter, size and sequence the work, and check the team is ready to deliver it (scope, dependencies, people) before committing.
* Take a problem from first ask to shipped: spec, acceptance criteria, grooming, release, adoption.
* Work daily with engineering, design and solutions to unblock and ship.
* Turn customer and field feedback into small, clear tickets, and say no to the rest.
* Join customer workshops and requirement calls; write and chase the follow-ups.
* Own cross-product items no one else owns, including the unglamorous parts.

  

**You have**

* 6 to 10 years in product, with real time in logistics or supply chain (TMS, last mile, carrier or fleet management, warehouse or network planning).
* Shipped B2B SaaS features, and can show the spec, the ticket and the outcome.
* Comfort with data (SQL or sheets) and APIs (you can read a payload).
* Clear, short writing. Daily use of AI tools.

  

**Who you are**

* High agency. You don't wait to be told. You see the gap, own it and close it.
* You get stuff done. You finish what you start and chase it until it ships.
* Ambitious and hungry to prove yourself; you want more ownership, fast.
* Ready to get your hands dirty: test the build, fix the data, sit with ops.
* Happy to work hard, especially around go-lives.

  

**What the Company Offers**

Join the company and become part of a visionary team that is redefining logistics through innovation and smart distribution. The company provides competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative environment where your expertise will drive both your growth and that of the organization.

  

The company is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Strategy & Planning

* Develop business cases, pricing strategies, product positioning, and profitability models for new and existing products.
* Define product portfolio strategy across relevant Heavy Equipment’s products segments, applications, capacities, and configurations.
* Establish product value propositions based on performance, safety, productivity, total cost of ownership, and customer requirements.

2. Market & Customer Insights

* Conduct market research to understand construction, infrastructure, industrial, and material-handling market trends, customer needs, and regulatory requirements.

* Monitor developments in crane technologies, including safety systems, telematics, automation, electrification, digital solutions, and operator-assistance technologies.

3. Product Development & Lifecycle Management

* Work closely with R&D, engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and quality teams to define product specifications and ensure timely product development.
* Manage the complete product lifecycle from concept, feasibility, development, testing, validation, and launch through product maturity and phase-out.
* Define product requirements based on customer applications, duty cycles, capacity, reach, mobility, operating conditions, and applicable standards.
* Ensure products meet required quality, safety, performance, reliability, and environmental standards.
* Drive continuous product improvements based on field performance, customer feedback, warranty data, and market requirements.
* Coordinate product testing, field trials, demonstrations, and validation activities before commercial launch.

4. Cross-functional Collaboration

* Coordinate with sales and marketing teams to develop effective go-to-market strategies, product positioning, sales tools, and launch plans.
* Support sales teams with technical presentations, product training, customer meetings, demonstrations, and tender support.
* Work closely with service and after-sales teams to identify recurring product issues and improve product reliability, serviceability, uptime, and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with manufacturing and supply-chain teams to improve product cost, manufacturability, delivery timelines, and overall competitiveness.
* Act as the key interface between customers, commercial teams, and engineering for product-related requirements and decisions.

5. Performance Monitoring & Product Optimization

* Track product performance metrics such as sales volume, market share, revenue, margins, utilization, customer satisfaction, warranty performance, and product reliability.
* Monitor product profitability and identify opportunities for cost optimization and value enhancement.
* Analyze field performance and customer feedback to identify opportunities for product improvement.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions in collaboration with engineering, quality, and service teams.
* Continuously optimize the product portfolio based on data-driven insights, market feedback, and business performance.

Education

Experience

* 6+ years of relevant experience in Product Management, Product Development, Business Development, or Technical Sales within the Crane, Construction Equipment, Material Handling, or Heavy Engineering industry.
* Strong understanding of crane products, lifting applications, construction equipment, and material-handling solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Lead  Ultima Platform
jobs.description:
Job Title

Senior Technical Lead Ultima Platform

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)

Department: Engineering – Platform / Infrastructure

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Level: Senior (10–15+ years)

Role Summary

Diamanti is seeking a Senior Technical Lead to lead the design, development, and

evolution of the Ultima platform, a Kubernetes-native hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI)

appliance.

This role requires deep expertise across Kubernetes internals, CSI and CNI subsystems,

storage architecture, embedded and kernel-level development, and high-performance

networking (including SR-IOV). You will act as a hands-on technical authority, owning

critical platform subsystems end-to-end while also serving as a senior escalation point

for complex customer issues.

Key Responsibilities

Ultima Platform & Storage Architecture Ownership

* Own the end-to-end storage architecture for the Ultima platform, supporting

enterprise-grade, stateful Kubernetes workloads.

* Design and evolve storage solutions across:
* NVMe-based block storage
* Distributed storage concepts
* Performance tiers and failure domains
* Make architectural decisions balancing performance, scalability, durability, and

operational simplicity.

* Define and maintain storage best practices and reference architectures for

internal teams and customers.

CSI-Based Storage Subsystems

* Architect, implement, and optimize Diamanti CSI drivers, including:
* Volume provisioning and lifecycle management
* Snapshots, cloning, resizing, and performance classes
* Failure handling, idempotency, and upgrade safety
* Ensure CSI subsystems integrate correctly with:
* Kubernetes scheduling and lifecycle events
* Kernel block layer and underlying storage hardware
* Drive root cause analysis for complex CSI and storage-related issues.

CNI, Networking & Acceleration

* Own CNI-based networking subsystems, including:
* Pod networking models and isolation
* Network policy enforcement
* Performance-critical data paths
* Lead design and optimization of high-performance networking, including:
* SR-IOV and NIC offloading
* Low-latency, high-throughput data paths
* Ensure tight integration between CNI, kernel networking, and hardware

acceleration.

Embedded & Kernel-Level Development

* Design and develop embedded Linux services, kernel modules, and low-level

platform components.

* Lead kernel-level debugging and optimization across:
* Storage I/O paths
* Networking stacks
* Interrupt handling, memory management, and performance tuning
* Ensure kernel and embedded components meet enterprise reliability and stability

requirements.

Performance, Reliability & Failure Handling

* Own platform performance benchmarking and regression analysis for storage

and networking.

* Define performance baselines (latency, IOPS, throughput) and track them across

releases.

* Design and validate behavior under:
* Disk, node, and network failures
* Power loss and restart scenarios
* Rolling upgrades and scale operations
* Ensure data durability, recoverability, and predictable failure behavior.

Customer Escalations & Technical Leadership

* Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex customer issues related to:
* Storage, CSI, and CNI subsystems
* Kernel-level and performance-critical problems
* Lead deep-dive investigations into customer-reported issues, working across

Engineering, QA, and Support.

* Provide clear technical guidance and direction to engineering teams during

escalations.

* Ensure customer issues are driven to root cause, resolution, and long-term fix,

not just workarounds.

* Translate customer learnings into product and platform improvements.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

* Provide hands-on technical leadership and mentorship to engineers across:
* Storage and networking
* CSI/CNI subsystems
* Kernel and embedded development
* Review designs, code, and test plans to ensure high quality, performance, and

maintainability.

* Raise the bar for systems engineering excellence across the team.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner closely with:
* Product Management to translate customer requirements into technical

solutions

* QA to ensure comprehensive validation of platform subsystems
* Support and Services teams for smooth customer deployments and

escalations

* Act as a technical bridge between internal teams and customer-facing functions.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 10–15+ years of experience in systems, platform, embedded, or infrastructure

engineering.

Mandatory Requirements

* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) – required
* Deep hands-on expertise in:
* Kubernetes architecture and internals
* CSI and CNI frameworks and implementations
* Linux kernel internals and kernel-level development
* Embedded Linux systems

Storage & Networking Expertise

* Strong experience with:
* NVMe and block storage architectures
* Distributed storage concepts
* CSI driver development and lifecycle management
* CNI plugin development and pod networking
* SR-IOV, NIC offloads, and high-performance networking

Preferred / Differentiating Skills

* Experience with Kubernetes-native HCI platforms or appliance-based

infrastructure products.

* Strong programming skills in C, C++, Go, and Python.
* Experience compiling and customizing Linux kernels.
* Familiarity with hardware bring-up, PCIe devices, or firmware interactions.
* Experience working in on-prem, air-gapped, or regulated environments.
* Prior experience as a Technical Lead, Staff Engineer, or Architect.

Key Success Metrics

* Stability, performance, and scalability of storage, CSI, CNI, and kernel subsystems.
* Reduction in customer escalations related to platform, storage, and networking.
* Time-to-resolution and quality of root cause analysis for critical issues.
* Successful delivery of complex platform initiatives.
* Technical growth and effectiveness of the engineering team.

Why Join Diamanti?

* Lead deep systems engineering for a Kubernetes-native HCI appliance.
* Own storage, networking, and kernel subsystems with real enterprise impact.
* Act as a key technical authority for customer-critical issues.
* Influence long-term platform architecture and technical direction.
* Build mission-critical on-prem infrastructure for modern workloads

1. **Purpose of the Position**

Lead the Mechanical and Electronics Design & New Product Development functions from customer requirement and feasibility through design, prototype, testing, validation and successful transfer to mass production. Drive innovative, reliable and cost-effective automotive products for domestic and export customers, ensuring QCD performance and compliance with customer requirements, APQP, PPAP, ISO 9001 and IATF 16949.

2. **Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* Strategy & customer interface: Define product development priorities and timelines; review RFQs, drawings and specifications; assess technical feasibility, risks, cost and resources; lead customer technical discussions and design reviews.
* Electronics development: Guide circuit, PCB and hardware design, component selection and product integration for automotive electronics such as sensors, actuators, switches, controllers and EV applications; review schematics, PCB layouts and BOM.
* Mechanical development: Lead mechanical design of housings, enclosures, brackets, plastic/metal components and assemblies; review 2D/3D designs, materials, dimensions and GD&T ensure DFM/DFA and manufacturability.
* Integrated product engineering: Ensure effective mechanical-electronics integration, fitment and functionality; coordinate with tooling, moulding, machining and component suppliers; resolve design and manufacturing issues.
* Design validation & launch: Lead prototype builds, trials, verification and validation; coordinate applicable electrical, mechanical, environmental, thermal, vibration and durability testing; secure customer approval and ensure smooth production handover.
* APQP & engineering control: Ensure design reviews, design records, DFMEA, PFMEA, Control Plans, Process Flow, PPAP and customer-specific requirements are addressed; control drawings, BOM, revisions and ECN/PCN.
* Project, cost & supplier management: Manage multiple projects, milestones and budgets; coordinate with Sales, Purchase, SCM, Quality, Production and PPC; drive VA/VE, localization, alternate components and cost optimization.
* Team leadership & problem solving: Lead, allocate and review work of 2 Mechanical and 2 Electronics Engineers; develop team competency; lead RCA, 8D and corrective actions; report project status, risks and performance to management.

3. **Authorities**

Review and approve designs, drawings, BOM, technical specifications and development plans within the approval matrix; allocate team resources; coordinate customer and supplier technical matters; recommend prototypes, testing, tooling, software, equipment and CAPEX; initiate engineering changes and escalate critical risks.

4. **Qualification**, Experience & Competencies

B.E./B.Tech in Electronics / Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering; minimum 15 years of relevant automotive product design and development experience. Proven ability to lead both Mechanical and Electronics engineering teams and manage products from concept to mass production. Strong understanding of electronic circuit/PCB design, sensors, actuators, embedded systems, mechanical design, 2D/3D modelling, GD&T, tooling, DFM/DFA, product testing, APQP, PPAP, DFMEA/PFMEA and IATF 16949. Strong leadership, customer-handling, project management and problem-solving skills. Mechanical CAD and electronics design software knowledge preferred.

5. **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

On-time project completion; customer design and PPAP approvals; successful product validation and mass-production handover; design quality and reduction in design-related failures; development cost and VA/VE savings; timely closure of customer/audit issues; effective team performance and competency development.

6. **Key Interfaces & General Responsibilities**

Internal: Sales, Purchase/SCM, Production, Quality, PPC and Management. External: Domestic/export customers, component suppliers, tooling vendors and testing laboratories. Maintain confidentiality of customer/company designs and records; follow company procedures, quality, safety and statutory requirements; perform other relevant duties assigned by management.

**Product Manager Corporate Functions**

**Function:** Digital Transformation & Innovation  
 **Department:** Digital & IT  
 **Location:** Hyderabad  
 **Reporting To:** Lead – Digital Transformation & Innovation  
 **Role Type:** Full-time

**1. Role Purpose**

Own the digital product roadmap and transformation initiatives across Olectra's corporate and business functions, driving process efficiency, automation, employee experience and business productivity through technology.

The role will work closely with functional stakeholders to identify business challenges, translate requirements into digital solutions, manage product lifecycles and ensure successful adoption and measurable business outcomes.

The Product Manager will act as the bridge between business functions, technology teams and external solution partners, ensuring that digital capabilities evolve in alignment with Olectra's business priorities.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Develop and maintain a digital product roadmap for corporate and business functions.
* Identify opportunities for process digitisation, simplification, automation and innovation.
* Evaluate business requirements and prioritise initiatives based on business value, feasibility and strategic alignment.
* Define product vision, objectives, milestones and success metrics.

**B. Business Process Transformation**

* Engage with functional leaders and process owners across Finance, HR, Procurement, Administration, Legal and other corporate functions.
* Understand existing business processes, identify bottlenecks and recommend technology-led improvements.
* Drive standardisation and process optimisation before translating requirements into digital solutions.
* Identify opportunities for workflow automation, low-code/no-code solutions, AI and intelligent automation.

**C. Product Development & Delivery**

* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories and product requirements.
* Work with internal technology teams, implementation partners and vendors to design and deliver solutions.
* Manage product backlogs, prioritisation, sprint planning, testing and release management, as applicable.
* Ensure seamless integration with enterprise platforms and existing applications.
* Drive solution delivery within agreed timelines, scope and budgets.

**D. Stakeholder & Vendor Management**

* Act as the primary product interface between business stakeholders and technology teams.
* Facilitate requirement workshops, solution discussions and product demonstrations.
* Manage external product vendors and implementation partners.
* Evaluate solution proposals, product capabilities, scalability and commercial considerations.
* Ensure alignment between business expectations and technology delivery.

**E. Product Lifecycle & Adoption**

* Own the product lifecycle from ideation and business case through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Drive user acceptance testing, change management, training and adoption.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities for enhancement.
* Establish product KPIs and measure business benefits, productivity improvements and user satisfaction.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, governance, security and support arrangements.

**3. Key Deliverables**

* Corporate Functions Digital Transformation Roadmap.
* Prioritised digital product portfolio and implementation pipeline.
* Business process digitisation and automation initiatives.
* Functional requirements, product specifications and solution designs.
* Successful implementation and adoption of digital products.
* Measurable improvements in process efficiency, turnaround time and productivity.
* Product performance dashboards and benefits realisation reports.

**4. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of enterprise business processes across corporate functions.
* Product management and business process transformation capabilities.
* Experience in workflow automation, enterprise applications and digital solutions.
* Understanding of API integrations, application architecture and enterprise technology ecosystems.
* Ability to translate business problems into technology solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience managing vendors, implementation partners and cross-functional teams.
* Analytical thinking, problem-solving and prioritisation capabilities.
* Working knowledge of Agile methodologies and product lifecycle management.

**5. Educational Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.
* 7–12 years of overall experience in enterprise technology, digital transformation, business applications or product management.

**6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Delivery of the approved corporate digital product roadmap.

* Reduction in manual effort and process turnaround time.
* Improvement in employee and business-user experience.
* Product adoption and active usage.
* Realisation of defined business benefits and productivity improvements.
* Delivery adherence against approved timelines and budgets.

**7. Ideal Candidate Profile**

A business-oriented technology professional who understands enterprise processes, thinks like a product owner and can independently drive digital transformation initiatives. The candidate should be equally comfortable engaging with business leaders, challenging existing processes, defining product requirements and working with technology teams to deliver scalable solutions.

jobs.title: Social Media Executive
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

**1. Influencer Identification & Relationship Management**

* Research and identify relevant mom influencers, parenting creators, lifestyle influencers and content creators who align with Soulslings' brand and target audience.
* Build and maintain a database of potential influencers based on audience demographics, engagement, content quality and brand fit.
* Proactively reach out to influencers through Instagram, email and other channels.
* Initiate conversations, discuss collaboration opportunities, negotiate commercials and finalise deliverables.
* Manage the entire influencer collaboration process, from initial outreach and product dispatch to content creation, approvals and publishing.
* Maintain ongoing relationships with influencers and identify opportunities for repeat collaborations.
* Track influencer deliverables, timelines, engagement and campaign performance.
* Actively interact with relevant mom and parenting communities and profiles on Instagram to build brand visibility and relationships.

  

**2. Social Media & Instagram Management**

* Manage the day-to-day Instagram presence of Soulslings.
* Plan and maintain a content calendar for Instagram posts, reels and stories.
* Publish content consistently, including feed posts, reels and carousels.
* Reshare influencer collaborations, customer testimonials, user-generated content and relevant community posts.
* Plan engaging Instagram stories around new posts, influencer collaborations, product features, customer feedback and brand activities.
* Ensure that stories and feed content work together to create a consistent and engaging brand presence.
* Monitor comments, DMs and audience interactions and respond promptly to customer queries.
* Escalate product-related or technical customer queries to the appropriate team members when required.
* Keep the Instagram page active, engaging and aligned with the brand's communication style.

  

**3. Content Ideas & Trend Research**

* Stay updated with Instagram trends, popular audio, reels formats, content styles and emerging trends in parenting and lifestyle categories.
* Identify relevant trends that can be adapted to Soulslings without compromising the brand's identity.

**4. Basic Photo & Video Editing**

* Create simple Instagram stories, reels and other social media creatives.

* Good negotiation and relationship-building skills.

* Someone who is proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities.

jobs.description:
**Inviting applications for the role of Principal Consultant - Business Analyst**

In this role, you will act as a critical bridge between business stakeholders, data science teams, and engineering functions. This role focuses on translating business problems into AIready problem statements, defining measurable success criteria, and ensuring AI solutions deliver **tangible, ethical, and scalable business impact**.

The BA will work closely with Product Owners, Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and Architects across the full AI lifecyclefrom usecase ideation and data readiness to model validation, deployment, and value realization.

  

**Responsibilities**:  
 **Business & UseCase Definition**

* Partner with business stakeholders to identify, shape, and prioritize **AI/ML/GenAI use cases** aligned with strategic goals
* Convert ambiguous business problems into **clear AIready problem statements** and hypotheses
* Define **business KPIs, success metrics, and ROI measures** for AI initiatives
* Support feasibility assessments considering data availability, model complexity, and risk

**Requirements & Analysis**

* Elicit and document **functional, nonfunctional, and data requirements** for AI/ML solutions
* Define **model outcome expectations** (accuracy, precision/recall, latency, explainability, confidence thresholds)
* Document **data requirements** (sources, quality, volume, lineage, labeling assumptions)
* Create BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and AIspecific requirement artifacts

**AI Delivery & Collaboration**

* Work closely with **Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and GenAI solution teams** to refine usecase assumptions
* Participate in model review discussions to validate alignment with business intent
* Support prompt engineering discussions for GenAI use cases by defining business context and constraints
* Assist in tradeoff decisions between model performance, cost, timetomarket, and explainability

**Validation, Testing & Adoption**

* Define **businessdriven test scenarios** for model validation and user acceptance
* Validate AI outputs against defined business expectations and compliance requirements
* Support user training, change management, and adoption planning for AIenabled solutions

**Governance & Responsible AI**

* Ensure adherence to **Responsible AI principles** (fairness, bias, explainability, data privacy)
* Participate in model risk assessments, audit reviews, and compliance documentation
* Support stakeholder communication with clear narratives around AI decisions and limitations

jobs.title: Manager, Digital & AI Solutions
jobs.description:
**About Ghintell**  
Ghintell is the AI-first healthcare intelligence, research and analytics company within Zealth Group. Together with Zealth, our market access business, and ijovi, our strategy and creative business, we support some of the worlds largest pharmaceutical companies. Our Bengaluru centre of excellence brings together expertise in medical research, analytics and health economics.  
We are expanding how we deliver that expertise through web applications, interactive dashboards and connected data solutions that help clients access insights and put them to work.

**The opportunity**  
We are looking for an internationally experienced, business-minded leader to head our Digital & AI Solutions team in Bengaluru and help our pharmaceutical clients get more value from data, analytics and AI.  
You will be the bridge between our clients, our consultants and our technical team. You will understand what clients need, shape the right solution with the team and explain technical choices in understandable language, so that clients and colleagues can make good decisions with confidence.  
You will lead a team spanning analytics, IT and web application engineering. This is not a hands-on development role, but it calls for enough technical understanding to set direction, ask the right questions and ensure that everything we deliver is secure, reliable and well run.  
The role is international by nature. You will work across cultures and time zones, with colleagues in Copenhagen and the US and with clients across North America, Europe and international markets.  
You will report to the VP of Finance, IT and AI Analytics, with a dotted line to the Site Head in Bengaluru.

**What you will do**  
**Lead and develop the team.** Set priorities, coach team members and build a culture of quality, ownership and continuous improvement.  
**Understand client needs.** Work with consultants and client stakeholders to understand business questions and turn them into clear, practical solutions.  
**Translate between business and technology.** Explain technical options, risks and trade-offs in simple terms, and make sure the team understands the business context.  
**Own delivery.** Make sure solutions are delivered on time, to the agreed quality and within budget, from scoping to handover and ongoing support.  
 **Keep solutions secure and well run.** Make sure the team follows good practice for security, data protection and client IT requirements, and lead our input into client IT and security reviews.  
**Grow what we offer.** Shape new services in data, analytics and AI with colleagues across Zealth Group, and contribute to proposals and client conversations.  
**Oversee internal IT.** Work with our Senior IT Partner to keep internal systems reliable and aligned with business priorities.

**How you will work with AI**  
AI is changing how we deliver. Our consultants and analysts create prototypes, dashboards and tools with AI. You will help the team turn the best of these into solutions clients can rely on, decide where AI adds real value for clients, and make sure it is used responsibly, with the right tools and data for each engagement.  
Deep AI engineering expertise is not required. We value curiosity, sound judgement and the ability to explain clearly what AI can and cannot do.

**What you bring**

* At least six years of experience in consulting, professional services, analytics or digital delivery, including experience leading teams.
* Substantial experience in international companies or with clients across several countries, working comfortably across cultures and time zones.
* A track record of working directly with clients and senior stakeholders and building trusted relationships.  
   Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technical work to client value.
* Sufficient technical understanding of data, analytics, web applications and cloud services to guide a technical team and make sound decisions.
* The ability to explain complex technical topics clearly and simply.  
   Excellent written and spoken English at a professional, client-facing level.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life science or healthcare, a consulting or professional services background, and experience with AI-enabled services or digital products would be valuable.

**What we offer**

* A leadership role with an established team and a direct say in how the function grows.
* Meaningful ownership of solutions used by leading pharmaceutical companies.
* Close collaboration with colleagues across Bengaluru, Copenhagen and the US.
* An environment where you can apply new technology to practical client needs and see the impact of your work.
* A culture grounded in trust, direct communication, teamwork and accountability, drawing on our Scandinavian roots and international outlook.  
  **How to apply**  
  Send your CV and a short cover letter describing a client solution you were responsible for, how you led the team behind it, and how you explained it to non-technical stakeholders. Please share only examples you are authorised to disclose.  
  We review applications on an ongoing basis.

AstroLokal is a rapidly growing astrology platform that connects users with experienced astrologers through chat, audio, and consultation services. Were building a trusted ecosystem where astrologers can grow their practice while helping users find guidance in their preferred language.

As we continue to grow, were looking for creative minds who can help us reach new audiences through relatable stories, engaging content, and compelling regional-language advertisements.

As a Content & Creative Executive, you'll play a key role in creating advertisements that attract new users and drive app growth for AstroLokal.

This role combines creative writing, storytelling, and audience understanding with performance marketing. You'll get the opportunity to explore different content formats, experiment with creative ideas, and understand how your work translates into measurable business results.

You don't need to be a performance marketing expert already. We're looking for someone with strong writing skills, creative thinking, and a curiosity to learn what makes an advertisement successful.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience in copywriting, content creation, scriptwriting, or social media. Internships and freelance projects count too!
* A creative mindset with an eye for storytelling and engaging content.
* Basic understanding of performance marketing metrics such as **CTR, CPI, and CAC.**

**Preferred candidate profile** :
