jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Voice and Digital Sales
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**

The Digital Sales professional will own the sales pipeline generated through digital channels, end to end. Beyond closing deals, the role turns every customer interaction and funnel stage into intelligence that improves marketing messaging, targeting, and funnel design. The person acts as the bridge between Sales, Marketing, and Product, using 360-degree funnel feedback to find and fix leaks from the first ad impression to activation.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Digital Sales Ownership

* Own revenue and conversion targets for leads sourced from digital channels (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, website, referral, and other digital sources).
* Manage the inbound enquiry-to-activation cycle: lead qualification, follow-up cadence, plan recommendation, objection handling, and closure.
* Set and enforce SLAs for lead response time, follow-up, and activation, and track adherence.
* Work with the Field and Sales organisation so digital leads are routed, tracked, and closed consistently.

2. 360-Degree Funnel Feedback

* Build and maintain a view of the full funnel: awareness enquiry qualification plan selection payment installation activation retention and referral.
* Track conversion, drop-off, and time-in-stage at every step, split by lead source, city, plan, and persona.
* Identify where prospects stall, abandon, or go cold, and diagnose the cause (price, speed of response, plan fit, availability, form friction, trust, or competitor offer).
* Produce a fortnightly funnel health report with clear actions, owners, and expected impact.

3. Customer Interaction Insights

* Capture structured call and chat insights: objections, questions, competitor mentions, and reasons for drop-off or purchase.
* Convert recurring objections and questions into a prioritised list for marketing (messaging gaps) and product (feature or process gaps).
* Listen to call recordings and chat transcripts regularly to validate what the data shows.

4. Marketing Loophole Detection

* Audit end-to-end marketing journeys, from ad copy and landing page to enquiry form, thank-you page, and sales follow-up, to find breaks in the chain.
* Flag mismatches between what ads promise and what the sales conversation delivers (for example, speed, price, coverage, or installation timelines).
* Identify attribution and lead-quality gaps, such as junk referrals, duplicate enquiries, or leads from channels that never convert.

5. Funnel and Messaging Recommendations

* Recommend changes to messaging at each stage: ad copy, landing page, plan descriptions, sales script, and follow-up communication.
* Recommend targeting changes based on which audiences, geographies, and personas convert and retain best.
* Propose funnel changes such as form simplification, call-back triggers, instant-activation flows, or offer structures, and back each with a hypothesis.
* Run A/B tests or structured pilots on recommendations and report results.

6. Cross-Functional Execution

* Partner with Digital Marketing (Performance, SEO, CRO) on campaign and landing page changes.
* Partner with Product on SmartWiFi, the super app, and onboarding flows based on customer feedback.
* Partner with Field and Sales leadership on lead handover, territory coverage, and objection-handling training.
* Present funnel findings and recommendations to senior leadership, with a clear impact estimate for each.

Impact Expectations

For each recommendation, the role is expected to state the expected action, the outcome it should drive, and the business impact (for example, higher lead-to-activation rate, lower cost per activation, or faster response time). Results are reviewed monthly against that forecast.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Marketing Consultant
jobs.description:
**Looking for Senior Digital Marketing Consultant**

**Experience:** 3-5 Years  
**Location:** Pune (Work from Office)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

  

**Job Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Digital Marketing Consultant to plan, strategise, execute, and manage end-to-end digital marketing activities for multiple clients across diverse industries. The role involves developing integrated marketing strategies, managing client relationships, driving campaign performance, coordinating internal teams, and identifying growth opportunities.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**1. 360 Digital Marketing Strategy & Planning**

* Develop and execute customised digital marketing strategies for clients across diverse industries.
* Understand client objectives, target audiences, products, services, and competitors to create marketing roadmaps.
* Plan integrated campaigns to improve brand visibility, engagement, lead generation, customer acquisition, and conversions.
* Identify new marketing opportunities, platforms, and emerging digital trends.

**2. Performance Marketing & Paid Advertising**

* Plan, execute, manage, and optimise paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, and other relevant platforms. • Manage budgets, audience targeting, bidding strategies, A/B testing, ad creatives, and landing page recommendations.
* Monitor CPL, CPA, CPC, CTR, ROAS, conversion rates, and other campaign metrics.
* Continuously optimise campaigns to improve performance and advertising ROI.

**3. Social Media & Community Marketing**

* Develop social media strategies across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Prepare monthly content calendars, campaign themes, and platform-specific distribution plans.
* Plan posts, carousels, reels, stories, videos, and other engaging formats.
* Execute community marketing across Reddit, Quora, Medium, and relevant online communities to build awareness, reach, and credibility.

**4. Marketplace & E-commerce Marketing**

* Manage marketplace marketing across Amazon, Flipkart, eBay, Gumtree, and other e-commerce platforms, as well as Blinkit and Zepto wherever applicable.
* Plan product visibility campaigns, sponsored advertising, promotions, and marketplace optimisation.
* Coordinate product listings, catalogues, descriptions, images, A+ content, and brand stores.
* Monitor product performance, sales, conversions, and advertising ROI.

**5. Content Marketing & Blog Management**

* Develop content strategies aligned with client objectives and campaign requirements.
* Plan and coordinate blogs, articles, website content, newsletters, case studies, and marketing collaterals.
* Create blogs and marketing content as required for assigned projects. • Maintain brand messaging, content quality, and consistency while coordinating with writers and designers.

**6. Email, Influencer & Video Marketing**

* Plan email campaigns, newsletters, audience segmentation, and automation.
* Identify influencers, creators, and industry experts; manage outreach, briefs, collaborations, and deliverables.
* Plan video initiatives including reels, promotional and product videos, brand films, and testimonials.
* Explore AI-powered content creation and emerging digital formats.

**7. Client Relationship & Account Management**

* Conduct client meetings, understand business requirements, and present marketing strategies and recommendations.
* Manage end-to-end client communication, project updates, deliverables, timelines, and feedback.
* Act as the primary point of contact between assigned clients and internal teams.
* Prepare proposals, campaign plans, presentations, and monthly roadmaps; handle additional projects and ad-hoc requirements.
* Identify opportunities to expand client engagements through additional marketing services.

**8. Analytics, Reporting & Performance Optimisation**

* Track campaigns using GA4, Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, marketplace dashboards, and other analytics tools.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports against defined KPIs and business objectives.
* Analyse data, identify performance gaps, and recommend actionable improvements.
* Present campaign insights and ensure budgets are utilised effectively

**9. Team Management & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with design, content, video production, SEO, website development, and other internal teams.
* Prepare briefs, allocate deliverables, monitor progress, and ensure timely execution.
* Guide and mentor junior digital marketing executives whenever required.
* Review campaign quality and manage multiple projects while meeting deadlines and client expectations.

**10. Marketing Research & Industry Awareness**

* Conduct competitor analysis, market research, audience research, and digital presence audits.
* Stay updated with digital marketing trends, advertising technologies, marketplace developments, and industry practices.
* Explore new channels, AI tools, campaign formats, and growth opportunities.
* Recommend strategies to improve brand visibility, campaign performance, and client outcomes

  

**Requirements**

* Bachelors degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
* 3-5 years of digital marketing experience, preferably in an agency environment.
* Strong knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, SEO/SEM, and analytics tools.
* Understanding of social media, performance, marketplace, community, and content marketing.
* Experience managing multiple client accounts and end-to-end campaigns.
* Excellent client communication, presentation, project management, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage projects independently, coordinate teams, and deliver measurable results.

  

**Good to Have**

* Experience in B2B marketing and growth-driven strategies.
* Knowledge of marketplace advertising and e-commerce marketing.

* Experience with Canva, Figma, or Adobe Creative Suite.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - IT Compliance, CSV & QMS (Pharma)

**Assistant Manager - IT Compliance, CSV & QMS (Pharma).**

  

**Department:** Information Technology (IT)   
**Function:** IT Compliance, Computer System Validation (CSV), QMS & Digitalization   
**Industry:** Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences   
**Qualification:** Degree / Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Instrumentation, or related discipline   
**Experience:** 8-10 Years

  

**Position Summary**

The role is responsible for ensuring compliance, validation, and lifecycle management of GxP-regulated computerized systems across Manufacturing, Operational Technology (OT), and Enterprise Applications. The incumbent shall support Computer System Validation (CSV), Quality Management System (QMS) activities, digital transformation initiatives, and regulatory compliance while maintaining the validated state of business-critical systems. The position requires expertise in enterprise applications, OT systems, data integrity, and pharmaceutical regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. IT Compliance & Regulatory Governance**

* Ensure compliance of computerized systems with GxP requirements, 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, and applicable regulatory guidelines.
* Support Data Integrity initiatives in alignment with ALCOA+ principles.
* Participate in regulatory inspections, customer audits, and internal compliance audits.
* Develop, review, and maintain IT policies, procedures, standards, and validation documents.
* Manage and support Quality Management System (QMS) activities including Change Control, CAPA, Deviations, Risk Assessments, and Audit Observations.
* Monitor compliance status of GxP systems and ensure inspection readiness.

**2. Computer System Validation (CSV)**

* Lead and execute the complete CSV lifecycle for Quality Control, Manufacturing, OT, and Enterprise Applications.
* Prepare, review, and execute validation deliverables including:
* Validation Plan
* User Requirement Specification (URS)
* Functional Requirement Specification (FRS)
* Functional Risk Assessment (FRA)
* Design Specification (DS)
* Installation Qualification (IQ)
* Operational Qualification (OQ)
* Performance Qualification (PQ)
* Traceability Matrix
* Validation Summary Report (VSR)
* Implement risk-based validation methodologies in accordance with GAMP 5 guidelines.
* Conduct periodic reviews, revalidation, and system assessments to maintain validated status.
* Evaluate system changes and perform impact assessments as part of change management.

**3. Enterprise Applications Support**

* Support and maintain validated enterprise applications such as:
* TrackWise
* PAS-X
* Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)
* SAP
* Other GxP-regulated business applications
* Ensure system availability, security, compliance, and data integrity.
* Coordinate application upgrades, patches, enhancements, and validation activities.
* Provide user support, troubleshooting, and training as required.

**4. Operational Technology (OT) Systems**

* Support implementation and qualification of Level-1 and Level-2 automation/OT projects.
* Manage and maintain OT infrastructure and systems including:
* PLC
* SCADA
* Historians
* Manufacturing Automation Systems
* Troubleshoot PLC programming and automation-related issues.
* Support qualification and validation activities for OT systems.
* Maintain high-level understanding of OT databases and system architecture.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to improve operational efficiency and system reliability.

**5. Digitalization & Project Management**

* Participate in digital transformation and Industry 4.0 initiatives.
* Lead and coordinate IT compliance, CSV, and automation-related projects.
* Manage project timelines, documentation, resources, and stakeholder expectations.
* Coordinate with external vendors, consultants, and service providers.
* Ensure project execution aligns with compliance and validation requirements.
* Track project deliverables, risks, and mitigation actions.

**6. Functional Competencies**

* Regulatory Compliance Management
* Audit & Inspection Readiness
* Risk Assessment & Impact Analysis
* Root Cause Investigation
* Documentation Management
* Validation Planning & Execution
* Vendor Management
* Cross-functional Collaboration

**7. Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Leadership and project coordination abilities.
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving approach.
* High attention to quality, compliance, and documentation accuracy.
* Ability to work effectively with QA, QC, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Corporate IT teams.

**8. Preferred Experience**

* Experience in Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, or Life Sciences industry.
* Participation in US FDA, MHRA, WHO, EU GMP, or customer audits.
* Exposure to Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), PAS-X, TrackWise, SAP, and LIMS.
* Experience in Digital Transformation, Industry 4.0, Automation, and OT cybersecurity initiatives.
* Knowledge of computerized system qualification and validation of laboratory and manufacturing systems.

jobs.title: RDE India Lead
jobs.description:
Job Description and Requirements

  

BHS Corrugated India Pvt Ltd, based in Pune, has been a subsidiary of BHS Corrugated, Germany, since 2011. We bring together start-up culture and decades of corporate experience, and we work on the digital future of the corrugated cardboard industry.

We are building GCC RDE India (Research, Development & Engineering), a delivery organisation in our Pune Global Capability Centre that works for our engineering sites in Weiherhammer (Germany) and at BHS Intralogistics. As its Director, you build and run this organisation and its three areas: Development, Lifecycle and AI.

  

AI is more than a third area of its own. AI-enabled workflows, agents and engineering harnesses are also built into Development and Lifecycle. You drive delivery across all three areas and make sure they work as one organisation, not as silos.

Your Future Tasks

* Lead GCC RDE India as a delivery organisation. You lead the three area leads (Development, Lifecycle, AI) and, through them, their teams.
* Own the budget. You own the budget of all three areas, and that includes AI usage. You control cost against this budget and release in writing any spending beyond an area's approved budget. This includes AI consumption (tokens), also for work packages Weiherhammer commissions in India, as well as building harnesses and agents, trial work, cloud hosting during trials and AI governance effort.
* Make AI consumption measurable. You set up how AI consumption is measured for each work package of Weiherhammer commissions, with KPIs that compare the tokens used with the output they produce, and the reasoning behind each number. You discuss this mechanism with the ordering sites, get it approved, and then report against it.
* Deliver against commitments. You turn the requirements and work packages from the ordering sites into delivery plans that Pune can execute: who works on what, milestones, quality criteria, acceptance and escalation. You agree quality criteria with the ordering sites, make sure results are checked before they are handed over, and follow up on defects.
* Report. You deliver a monthly report per area on bookings, consumption, forecast and milestones to the programme coordination in Germany.
* Orchestrate the three area leads: capacities, priorities, dependencies, interfaces and escalation paths.
* Keep one shared technical foundation. Weiherhammer and BHS Intralogistics both order from GCC RDE India. You orchestrate their orders so that the areas build on one shared foundation and no parallel world grows up beside it.

  

* Be the single point of contact between GCC RDE India, the ordering sites, the Head GCC and top management, and translate technical progress into clear business updates. For our global engineering and AI transformation programme, you present delivery status, business value, budget and forecast, risks, resource needs and decision requests credibly to senior and top management.
* Build the leadership team. You lead senior hiring together with the Head GCC and HR, and you onboard, develop and retain the area leads.
* Connect Pune and Germany. You lead Pune delegations to Weiherhammer and host German delegations in Pune, in the rhythm the current topics need, with the leads and experts those topics need.
* Grow the organisation on delivery. Growth follows demonstrated delivery and is re-assessed at each step.

  

What This Role Is Not

  

This is a leadership and delivery role, not a specialist role. Technical direction runs from the technical architects in Germany directly to the area leads, and the area leads own their technology. You need enough technical understanding to follow and challenge them, but you do not decide technical questions.

You must understand AI-enabled engineering delivery well enough to challenge feasibility, capacity demand, delivery risk and business value, and to turn technical direction into delivery that works across functions.

  

Requirements

  

Must have:

* Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology or a comparable qualification.
* 15+ years of professional experience, of which 5+ years leading managers.
* Has run a GCC, a captive centre or the delivery organisation of an offshore engineering or development centre for a European or German parent.
* Proven experience managing complex cross-functional engineering or digital-transformation work packages across onshore and offshore teams, with measurable responsibility for delivery, cost, quality and schedule.
* Budget and cost responsibility across several teams, with controlling discipline.
* Has managed managers, not only individual contributors, and has grown an organisation of several teams step by step, tied to delivery.
* Board-level stakeholder management across sites and cultures, in English.
* Hiring and onboarding of senior people in the Pune talent market.

  

* General technical background in engineering, manufacturing or industrial equipment, enough to understand a technical strategy built on engineering data, cloud and AI, and to follow what the three area leads talk about.
* Experience establishing scalable, reusable workflows or platforms across several engineering processes and tools, rather than managing individual software licences or isolated AI use cases. Relevant examples include SAP, Solid Edge, MATLAB, other engineering software and lifecycle workflows.
* Strong business acumen, strategic thinking and decision-making, with a structured and delivery-oriented approach.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal and leadership skills across diverse teams and geographies.
* Very good written and spoken English; willingness to travel to Germany regularly.

  

Good to have:

* German language skills, or experience working with a German headquarters.
* Experience in industrial machinery, capital equipment, manufacturing or R&D environments.

  

Explicitly not required:

  

* Specialist depth in mechanical, electrical, data or AI engineering.

  

We Offer You

  

* The chance to build and lead a new delivery organization inside a growing Global Capability Centre.
* Close work with international leadership and technical teams in Germany and India.
* Ownership and responsibility from the first day, in a solidly financed organization.
* Influence on organizational capabilities, processes and long-term growth.
* Flexibility, openness and an entrepreneurial working culture.

  
  

Regards,

Rivka Pawar

HRBP

jobs.title: Head GRID Automation & Digital System
jobs.description:
ARAKAN SMART GRID   
   
WE ARE HIRING  
   
HEAD GRID AUTOMATION & DIGITAL SYSTEMS  
   
Smart Grid | Distribution Automation | SCADA | FPI | GIS | GridWatch  
   
Location: Pune, Maharashtra\  
Experience: 10 to15 Years\  
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation / E&TC Engineering\  
Preferred Qualification: M.Tech in Power Systems, Control Systems or Automation\  
Salary: 80,000 to 1,30,000 per month\  
Employment Type: Full-time\  
Reporting To: Managing Director / Business Head Grid Solutions  
   
   
 1. ABOUT ARAKAN SMART GRID SOLUTIONS  
   
Arakan Grid Solutions, a specialised division of Arakan GROUP., is being established to deliver advanced Smart Grid Technologies, Electrical Distribution Automation, Communicable Fault Passage Indicators (FPI), SCADA Integration and Digital Grid Monitoring solutions.  
   
Our objective is to provide end-to-end technology and EPC solutions to electricity distribution companies, utilities, infrastructure developers and power-sector organisations.  
   
Our business activities include:  
   
- Communicable FPI supply, installation and commissioning.  
- 11 kV , 22 kv and 33 kvfeeder monitoring and fault detection systems.  
- RTU/FRTU and communication gateway integration.  
- SCADA-based feeder monitoring.  
- GIS-based electrical distribution network mapping.  
- Digital grid monitoring and analytics.  
- Turnkey distribution automation EPC projects.  
- Annual maintenance and technical support services.  
   
We are developing our own branded digital monitoring platform, ARAKAN GRIDWATCH, through a technology partnership with an established SCADA software provider.  
   
We are looking for an experienced technical leader who can establish, manage and scale this technology business.  
 2. ROLE OVERVIEW  
   
The Head Grid Automation & Digital Systems will be responsible for the complete technical direction and implementation of Arakan Grid Solutions.  
   
The selected candidate will lead the engineering team, manage SCADA technology partnerships, supervise FPI and RTU integration, and oversee the development of Arakan GridWatch.  
   
The candidate will act as the principal technical authority for the organisation and ensure successful delivery of turnkey distribution automation projects.  
   
The SCADA core engine will be sourced from an established technology partner. The candidate will be responsible for technical integration, configuration and supervision of Arakan's customised GridWatch modules rather than developing an entire SCADA engine from scratch.  
 3. ALTERNATIVE DESIGNATIONS FOR CANDIDATE SEARCH  
   
Candidates currently working under any of the following designations may be considered:  
   
1. General Manager Smart Grid & Automation  
2. General Manager SCADA & Distribution Automation  
3. Senior Manager SCADA & Automation  
4. DGM Smart Grid Projects  
5. DGM Distribution Automation  
6. AGM SCADA & Power Systems  
7. Head Substation Automation  
8. Head Digital Grid Solutions  
9. Technical Head Power Automation  
10. Principal Engineer Power Systems Automation  
11. SCADA / ADMS Solution Architect  
12. Lead Engineer Distribution Automation  
13. Project Director SCADA & Smart Grid  
14. Senior Manager Utility Automation  
15. Technical Manager RTU, FRTU & SCADA  
   
Candidates from DISCOMs, transmission utilities, SCADA system integrators, smart grid companies and electrical automation EPC organisations are encouraged to apply.  
   
 4. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
   
 A. Smart Grid & Distribution Automation  
   
- Lead technical planning and implementation of smart grid and distribution automation projects.  
- Develop technical solutions for 11 kV distribution feeder monitoring.  
- Design system architecture for communicable FPI-based fault detection and monitoring.  
- Evaluate and select suitable FPI, RTU, FRTU and communication gateway equipment.  
- Prepare technical specifications, system architecture documents and engineering standards.  
- Study utility tender specifications and develop suitable technical solutions.  
- Ensure compatibility between equipment supplied by different OEMs.  
- Develop standardised solutions for utility deployments.  
   
 B. SCADA System Architecture & Integration  
   
- Lead SCADA architecture design and implementation.  
- Evaluate and manage established SCADA technology partners.  
- Supervise SCADA platform configuration and integration.  
- Define data acquisition architecture between FPI, RTU/FRTU, gateways and SCADA servers.  
- Oversee integration using IEC 60870-5-101, IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus RTU/TCP and MQTT.  
- Establish communication architecture using 4G, Ethernet and other approved communication technologies.  
- Configure and review device tags, alarms, events and historical records.  
- Ensure reliable communication between field devices and monitoring systems.  
- Supervise cloud-based and customer-hosted SCADA deployments.  
- Coordinate troubleshooting and technical escalations.  
   
 C. FPI, RTU & Field Device Integration  
   
- Evaluate communicable FPI products from different OEMs.  
- Review FPI specifications, sensing technologies and communication capabilities.  
- Supervise integration of overhead and underground FPI devices where applicable.  
- Define RTU/FRTU configuration and communication requirements.  
- Develop device signal lists and communication mapping documents.  
- Verify fault indication, restoration indication, device health and communication status.  
- Coordinate factory testing and field integration.  
- Develop standard installation and commissioning procedures.  
- Ensure interoperability between different OEM devices and GridWatch.  
   
 D. Arakan GridWatch Product Development  
   
- Lead the technical roadmap and architecture of Arakan GridWatch.  
- Coordinate development with the SCADA technology partner and software team.  
- Define requirements for customer dashboards and web-based monitoring.  
- Supervise integration of SCADA data through APIs and databases.  
- Develop requirements for customer-wise and utility-wise dashboards.  
- Ensure scalable architecture for multiple customers and large device networks.  
- Review software development progress, testing and release management.  
- Maintain product specifications and technical documentation.  
- Ensure appropriate ownership and control of Arakan-funded custom product modules.  
   
Proposed GridWatch modules:  
   
1. Live FPI monitoring and device status.  
2. Feeder and substation GIS mapping.  
3. Fault and restoration alerts.  
4. Historical event monitoring.  
5. Feeder-wise fault analytics.  
6. Communication health monitoring.  
7. Maintenance and field-team workflow.  
8. Customer dashboards and reports.  
9. Device management and configuration records.  
10. Multi-customer user access and reporting.  
   
E. GIS & Digital Grid Intelligence  
   
- Supervise GIS-based mapping of electrical distribution networks.  
- Define mapping standards for substations, feeders, poles, DTCs and FPI locations.  
- Oversee GPS-based field asset mapping.  
- Coordinate GIS database architecture and data management.  
- Integrate GIS information with SCADA and GridWatch.  
- Develop requirements for fault-event visualisation on feeder maps.  
- Supervise feeder analytics and network performance reports.  
- Ensure accuracy and consistency of utility asset information.  
   
 F. Technology Partner & OEM Management  
   
- Identify and evaluate SCADA software technology partners.  
- Lead technical evaluation of FPI and RTU manufacturers.  
- Review technical capabilities, integration flexibility and product compliance.  
- Coordinate technical discussions and product demonstrations.  
- Review API/SDK availability and integration documentation.  
- Ensure appropriate white-label, deployment and customisation rights.  
- Manage technical support and escalation mechanisms.  
- Coordinate training and knowle

In this role, you will drive the design, development, and optimization of ServiceNow implementations across multiple modules including ITSM, CSM, FSM, and EAM while also focusing on third-party integrations, identity access management (IAM), and role-based access control (RBAC). As part of a growing team, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to shape digital transformation initiatives that support enterprise-level business objectives.

  Configure, develop, and customize core ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, CSM, FSM, and EAM to meet evolving business needs.

  Drive platform enhancements, version upgrades, and solution design while adhering to best practices.

3. Strong understanding of agile delivery practices, backlog management, user story writing, acceptance criteria and prioritization techniques.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Do you want to shape the future of fintech and healthtech? Energized by challenges and inspired by bold goals? Ready to elevate your career alongside driven and talented colleagues? If that sounds like you, explore a career at Alegeus today.

**Opportunity Happens Here**.

**Responsibilities**

Alegeus is modernizing into an API first, open integration platform that powers partners, employers, and participants across consumer-directed-healthcare. You will own the Integrations product surface so that partners can integrate faster with higher reliability, enabling new experiences and AI/agentic workflows. Integration

**Ownership Scope**

You will own all external integration modalities at Alegeus, including:

* Data integrations: Public APIs, webhooks, event streams, real-time interfaces, and asynchronous messaging patterns
* File-based integrations: EDI, CSV, batch processing, and secure file transfer (e.g., SFTP)
* Experience integrations: front-end microservices, embeddable widgets, and partner-facing UI extensions
* This role ensures that the above is designed, delivered, and evolved as one cohesive platform, not disconnected channels, with shared standards for security, versioning, observability, reliability, and partner experience.

**Outcomes you'll own**

* Reduce partner time to first value and increase adoption across key use cases.
* Ship a coherent v2 API set with clear versioning, deprecation, and a reliable release cadence.
* Launch a webhook/event framework (subscribe, replay, DLQ, idempotency) with partnergrade SLAs.
* Deliver a developer experience that delights: dev portal, docs, SDKs, samples, error taxonomy, sandbox, chatbot, etc.
* Establish product analytics KPIs (adoption, latency, reliability, errors, partner NPS) with dashboards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap for Data, File and Experience integrations; define problem statements, success metrics, and crisp PRDs.
* Partner with design/engineering/Product owners to deliver secure, scalable interfaces and reference implementations.
* Work directly with marquee partners to map JTBD and translate into stable contracts/schemas.
* Drive packaging, auth models (OAuth/OIDC), rate limits, quotas, SLAs, and change management.
* Orchestrate launches: docs, changelogs, guides, enablement, and internal readiness.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6-10+ years in PM with SaaS integrations as your product (not just "has APIs").
* Hands-on track record shipping public REST APIs and webhooks at scale; familiarity with async patterns, retries, backoff, and event semantics.
* Strong grasp of DX: information architecture for docs, quickstarts, SDK stewardship, error design.
* Data exchange expertise: realtime + bulk, schema evolution, validation, and observability for integrations.
* Excellent partner-facing skills: discovery, solutioning, negotiating tradeoffs, clear communication.

**Nice to have**

* Healthcare, claims/eligibility, fintech/payments, or benefits ecosystem experience.
* API monetization/packaging, partner marketplaces, or appecosystem playbooks.
* Observability for integrations (schema drift detection, tracing, deadlettering, replay tools).

**How we'll measure success**

* Adoption of v2 endpoints webhook subscriptions; reduction in partner integration time.
* Reliability (SLO attainment), latency improvements, and error rate reductions for integration flows.

**About Wego**

**Wego is the leading travel app and the largest online travel marketplace in the Middle East and North Africa. Our mission is to make travel better by helping millions of people discover, compare, and book flights, hotels, and travel experiences with confidence.**

**Founded in 2005, Wego has grown from a metasearch engine into a full travel platform, combining search with our own OTA products. We dont just point travelers at a fare: we sell it, ticket it, and stand behind it when plans change.**

**That means we own the whole transaction: the checkout, everything we sell alongside the ticket, and the tools our support agents use when a traveler needs help. This role works across all three.**

**Role summary**

**You will own product work across three areas of our flights booking business: new ancillary services, booking funnel optimisation, and improvements to the Customer Support Admin Tool our support agents use every day. You will join a team of product managers, including a Senior Product Manager who leads our post-booking work, and you will take features from problem definition to launch and measured result.**

**This is a product execution role. We care more about how well you take a problem from definition to a measured outcome than about how many years you have spent in travel. Flights experience helps, and you will learn the domain fast here, because the people around you know it deeply and the problems are concrete.**

**Key responsibilities**

**Feature ownership.** Own features and initiatives from problem statement to launch and measured result. Make the product calls within your scope, and know when to escalate.

**Specification.** Write clear PRDs, user stories, decision tables and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from without a meeting. Cover the edge cases, the failure paths, and what we will not do.

**Delivery with engineering and design.** Work daily with engineering and design on scope, sequencing and trade-offs. Unblock decisions quickly. Keep scope honest when timelines slip.

**Experimentation.** Design and run A/B tests on the booking funnel and on ancillary offers. Define one primary metric and guardrails up front, test one change at a time where you can, and report results you would defend.

**Testing and launch.** Define test scenarios with QA and operations, run acceptance testing, plan staged rollouts with clear go/no-go criteria, and check that it works in production, not just in staging.

**Measurement.** Define the success metric for every feature before it is built. Instrument it, read the data yourself, and report what moved and why.

**Partnership with operations and commercial.** Work with customer support, finance and commercial teams, and with ancillary partners. Make sure every launch includes what support agents need to handle it.

**Communication.** Keep stakeholders informed with short written updates: what shipped, what it did, whats next, and what is blocked.

**Who you are** **Required**

* **3+ years in product management, with direct ownership of features that shipped to customers or operational users.**
* **A strong execution record. You can point to features you took from a messy problem to a measured outcome, and explain the trade-offs you made along the way.**
* **Hands-on experimentation. You have designed and read A/B tests yourself, and you know the common ways they mislead.**
* **Excellent written specifications. Your PRDs and acceptance criteria are precise, cover edge cases, and hold up when engineers build from them.**
* **Analytical and hands-on with data. You write your own queries (SQL or equivalent), build the dashboard you need, and change your mind on evidence.**
* **Experience building for operational users, such as support agents, fulfillment or back-office teams, or a clear interest in doing so.**
* **Clear, direct communication with technical and non-technical audiences, and the confidence to raise a problem early.**

**Preferred**

* **Experience in travel, ideally flights: OTA, airline, GDS or travel-tech.**
* **E-commerce checkout, payments or conversion optimization.**
* **Ancillary or add-on products: insurance, protection, upsells, bundles.**
* **Internal tools for customer support or operations, such as agent consoles or case management.**

**This is probably not the role for you if**

* **You prefer setting strategy to getting the details of a launch right.**
* **Youd rather hand testing, experiment analysis and post-launch checks to someone else.**
* **You see internal tools as less important than customer-facing products.**

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager - Ads Monetisation & Retention  
About the Role  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive ads monetisation and user retention for a high-scale consumer mobile application.  
This role sits at the intersection of product, content, data, engineering, ad technology and business growth. You will be responsible for building and optimising the product experiences, systems and strategies that maximise advertising revenue while maintaining a healthy user experience and long-term retention.  
The ideal candidate is highly analytical, strong in first-principles thinking, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and capable of translating complex business problems into actionable product solutions.  
You will own critical business metrics, identify growth opportunities, design experiments, and work closely with cross-functional teams to drive measurable business outcomes.  
Key Responsibilities  
1. Ads Monetisation & Revenue Growth  
Own and drive advertising revenue growth through improvements in ad impressions, fill rates, eCPM, yield and overall monetisation efficiency.  
Identify opportunities to optimise ad placements, formats, frequency, timing and user-level ad experiences.  
Work on ad mediation strategy, demand partner performance and monetisation infrastructure.  
Build a deep understanding of the advertising ecosystem, including ad networks, mediation platforms, bidding, waterfall optimisation and revenue attribution.  
Identify opportunities to improve revenue per user without compromising user experience.  
2. User Retention & Engagement  
Own key user engagement and retention metrics across the product lifecycle.  
Identify drop-offs and friction points in the user journey through quantitative and qualitative analysis.  
Develop strategies to improve user engagement, session frequency, consumption and long-term retention.  
Understand the relationship between advertising load, user experience, engagement and retention.  
Drive initiatives that balance short-term monetisation with long-term user and business value.  
3. Data, Analytics & Experimentation  
Develop a strong understanding of product and business metrics, identify trends and proactively surface opportunities or problems.  
Perform deep-dive analysis and root cause investigations to understand changes in business performance.  
Formulate hypotheses, design experiments and evaluate results using data-driven approaches.  
Build measurement frameworks to assess the incremental impact of product and monetisation initiatives.  
Work with analytics and data teams to improve dashboards, tracking and decision-making frameworks.  
4. Product Strategy & Execution  
Identify, evaluate and prioritise product opportunities based on business impact, user value and execution complexity.  
Translate business objectives into product roadmaps, detailed requirements and actionable execution plans.  
Work closely with engineering, design, data science and business teams to drive initiatives from ideation to launch.  
Take end-to-end ownership of product outcomes, from problem identification to post-launch optimisation.  
Navigate ambiguity, challenge existing assumptions and continuously look for better ways to solve business problems.  
Requirements  
3+ years of experience in Product Management, Growth, Monetisation or related roles.  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems using first-principles thinking.  
Strong understanding of product metrics, funnels, cohorts, retention and monetisation.  
Experience using data to identify problems, generate hypotheses and drive product decisions.  
Ability to independently conduct deep-dive analysis and root cause investigations.  
Strong business acumen and an understanding of revenue drivers, unit economics and growth levers.  
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.  
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with high ownership and accountability.  
Good to have:  
Experience in consumer mobile applications, particularly content, gaming, entertainment or other high-engagement products.  
Understanding of mobile advertising ecosystems, including AdMob, AppLovin, Unity, Meta Audience Network, mediation platforms and programmatic advertising.  
Experience with A/B testing, experimentation frameworks and product analytics tools.  
Familiarity with SQL, analytics platforms and working with large datasets.  
What Success Looks Like in 6 Months  
Build and execute a prioritised product roadmap for ads monetisation and retention, aligned with key business objectives.  
Drive measurable improvements in advertising revenue and monetisation efficiency through data-driven initiatives and experimentation.  
Identify key drivers of user behaviour and implement initiatives that improve engagement and long-term retention while balancing ad experience.  
Develop deep business and product understanding, demonstrate strong first-principles thinking, and independently drive initiatives end-to-end with high ownership and accountability.

The Opportunity Sitetracker is on a mission to accelerate the transition to a fully connected and sustainable future. We are at an exciting phase of our product journey and are seeking a customer- and market-centric Sr. Product Manager to join our India R&D hub. In this role, you will deliver agent-first product leadership across core Sitetracker Central product lines including Project Central, Field Central, Finance Central, Agreement Central, Site Central, and GIS Link. At Sitetracker, our product leaders drive the value we provide to the market. This is an opportunity to take ownership of key product initiatives, work with agency, and make a significant impact on how our global customers plan, develop, build, and operate critical infrastructure assets. What Youll Do

As a Sr. Product Manager at Sitetracker, you will hit the ground running and make an immediate impact by anchoring product leadership in our India R&D hub. Taking an agent-first approach across our Sitetracker Central product lines (Project Central, Field Central, Finance Central, Agreement Central, Site Central, or GIS Link), you will partner closely with customers to uncover high-value investment opportunities and guide features through the NPI process. You will build deep domain insights across critical infrastructure sectors (telecom, mobile towers, EV charging, data centers) while driving alignment directly with India Product Design and Engineering squads. With strong agency and a sharp focus on prioritization, you will manage initiatives from concept to execution translating complex enterprise problems into clear goals, measurable North Star metrics, and scalable automated workflows that accelerate customer value and market adoption.

### The Skills You ll Have

* Domain expertise in telecom, mobile towers, EV charging networks, data centers

**Job Title:** Product Owner - Finance AI  
  **Location:**  Bangalore

  

**ABOUT UNILEVER:**

Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you ll be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Among them, you ll channel your purpose, bring fresh ideas to the table, and simply be you. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we ll work to help you become a better you.

**Role Purpose**   
 - Lead the design, delivery and adoption of AI solutions (GenAI, agentic AI and intelligent automation) across Finance processes.   
 - Turn Finance problems into AI use cases that can be audited and scaled, and that deliver measurable value.   
 - Make sure solutions meet clean-core, SOX and data governance standards.

**Key Responsibilities**   
 1. Finance AI Use-Case Ownership  
 - Find and prioritise AI and automation opportunities across R2R, P2P, O2C, Treasury and FP&A .   
 - Build business cases with baseline KPIs: cycle time, manual effort, error rate and cost savings.   
 - Own the use-case backlog and roadmap, from proof of concept through MVP to scaled rollout.   
 2. Solution Design & Delivery  
 - Work with Enterprise Architecture, HAP and vendor teams on how agents are designed: orchestration, context memory, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and confidence scoring.   
 - Define integration patterns between AI platforms (e. g. , GCP Vertex AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio) and SAP S/4HANA or ECC .   
 - Write functional specs, prompt and rule logic, test scenarios and acceptance criteria.   
 - Run delivery across the stage gates: Initiate Plan Build Test Deploy Stabilise.   
 3. Governance, Controls & Responsible AI  
 - Make sure AI outputs are explainable, traceable and ready for audit (logs, evidence, sign-offs, version history).   
 - Uphold SoD, access controls, data privacy and Responsible AI policies.   
 - Define how model performance and drift are monitored, plus exception handling and rollback.   
 4. Vendor & Cost Management  
 - Challenge vendor estimates, separating reusable from use-case-specific components.   
 - Track budget, burn rate and SLAs, and measure benefits against the business case.   
 5. Stakeholder Engagement & Adoption  
 - Work with Finance process owners, Controllership, Treasury, IT, Data and Audit teams.   
 - Present steerco updates, demos and value stories to senior leadership.   
 - Lead change management, user training and AI upskilling in Finance teams.

**Behavioral Competencies**   
 - Can explain AI in Finance terms and Finance in AI terms.   
 - Delivery-focused and data-led, measuring outcomes rather than activity.   
 - Influences without authority across Finance, IT and vendors.   
 - Practical about innovation: tries standard features and the platform first, and builds custom only when needed.   
 Qualifications  
 - Bachelors degree in Engineering, Commerce, Finance or IT. CA/CMA/MBA (Finance) is a plus.   
 - AI certification preferred

**Success Measures**    
 - At least 2-3 Finance AI use cases live in production, with signed-off benefits.   
 - Measurable cut in manual effort and cycle time against baseline.   
 - No audit findings on deployed AI solutions.   
 - Higher adoption and AI skills across the Finance teams supported.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**    

CDW is seeking a Product Manager to help define, build, launch, and continuously improve strategic solutions that solve meaningful customer business and technology challenges.

The Product Manager will own the end-to-end solution lifecycle-from customer discovery and solution definition through launch and ongoing enhancement-for one or more solutions within CDW's Solutions portfolio.

This role partners closely with customers, Practice Areas, Engineering, AI teams, Delivery, Sales Enablement, Partner Management, and Solution Owners to develop scalable, repeatable offerings that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, AI, accelerators, and delivery methodologies.

This role requires strong customer empathy, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

  
   
  **Key Areas of Responsibility**    
   
  **Customer Discovery & Solution Definition**    

* Define customer problem statements, target personas, use cases, business outcomes, and solution requirements through customer engagement and market research.

  
   
  **Solution Strategy & Roadmap**    

* Develop solution strategies, value propositions, business cases, and roadmaps aligned to customer needs and CDW priorities.
* Create and manage a prioritized backlog of solution enhancements, features, and capabilities.

  
   
  **Solution Development & Delivery**    

* Lead solution development across Engineering, Delivery, Practice Areas, and Partner teams.
* Drive solutions through the defined lifecycle from discovery and planning through build, testing, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, commercially viable, and operationally ready for delivery.
* Define implementation guidance, delivery playbooks, reference architectures, reusable assets, and supporting documentation.
* Manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs while aligning diverse stakeholder groups.

  
   
  **AI, Feedback & Continuous Improvement**    

* Gather customer, seller, and delivery feedback and translate insights into solution improvements.
* Leverage AI, automation, and reusable intellectual property to improve customer outcomes and delivery efficiency.
* Establish success metrics and measure solution adoption, customer impact, and business outcomes.

  
   
  **Working Model**    

The Product Manager partners closely with a Solution Owner.

The Solution Owner is responsible for commercial strategy, go-to-market execution, portfolio performance, seller adoption, and business success.

The Product Manager is responsible for customer discovery, solution strategy, roadmap management, cross-functional execution, and ensuring solutions are scalable, repeatable, and ready for successful customer adoption.

  
   
  **Key Performance Indicators (Examples)**    

* Customer problem statements and solution requirements validated through discovery activities.
* Roadmap commitments delivered on time and with quality.
* Time-to-market for new solutions and enhancements.
* Solution adoption and customer satisfaction.
* Delivery readiness, including documentation, playbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Reuse of accelerators, automation, AI capabilities, and reusable assets.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional execution effectiveness.
* Measurable customer and business outcomes delivered through solutions.

  
   
  **Qualifications**    
   
  **Education and/or Experience Qualifications**    

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Solutions Management, Presales, or related roles.
* Experience building enterprise solutions that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, and delivery models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Strong customer discovery, requirements definition, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience translating customer needs into scalable, repeatable offerings.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical feasibility.
* Experience working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

  
   
  **Preferred Qualifications**    

* Experience in one or more of the following:
* Artificial Intelligence & Automation
* Cloud Platforms
* Data & Analytics
* Cybersecurity
* Infrastructure Modernization
* Experience with Design Thinking
* Jobs-to-be-Done
* Agile Product Management
* Lean Product Development

  
   
  **Customer Focus and Quality Management Responsibilities**    

Each CDW coworker is responsible for maintaining customer focus and conforms to the CDW quality management system. Specific responsibilities include:

* Periodic reviews of CDW Circle of Service Philosophy and the Quality Policy to understand CDW's commitment to excellent client service and continual improvement and to conform to these policies and philosophies at all times.
* During your orientation period, review with your supervisor as needed the quality procedures and operating instructions listed at Connect / Departments / Resources / ISO intranet site that apply to your specific assignment(s) within the scope of this job position.
* And after the orientation period to conform to these procedures and instructions, including any reporting (and/or record keeping) responsibilities.
* Report any client problem, or any service outage that may cause potential client problems to your supervisor.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will collaborate closely with senior leaders to shape a dynamic product strategy that solves for user problems, business and partner objectives. This role will require you to define the commerce experience on JioHotstar across multiple categories that enables users to get inspired and transact without disrupting their content watching experience. * Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in AI, chatbots, and collaboration.

jobs.description:
### Job Summary

About the Role: Identity is the new security perimeter, and JumpCloud's Access Authentication team owns it.

With remote work and the domainless enterprise here to stay, every login is now a security decision. Our products decide who gets access to what across devices, SSO apps, servers, RADIUS and LDAP. They power MFA, passwordless, and Zero Trust conditional access built on identity, location, risk, and certificate-based device trust.

As a Senior PM, you'll define how millions of users prove who they are. You'll balance two customers: IT admins who need control, and users who just want to get to work. And you'll shape the strategy for our platform in a market being redefined right now. If you want to prove security and simplicity aren't a tradeoff, join us.

JumpCloud is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help drive the authentication roadmap and significantly influence the future of frictionless authentication at JumpCloud. You will own one or more product capabilities and be responsible for strategy, meeting KPIs and objectives.

If you love authentication and are passionate about Kerberos, Zero Trust principles, and conditional access; let's have a conversation.

### Responsibilities

* Setting strategy and roadmap. Stay close to customers, competitors, and the market, and turn what you learn into clear priorities.
* Championing the customer. Understand what IT admins and end users need, not just what they ask for, and make sure it shapes what we build.
* Making access simple. Partner with UX, architecture, and engineering to turn complex authentication flows into experiences that feel effortless.
* Driving outcomes across teams. Align engineering, design, security, and go-to-market around shared goals, and deliver against them.

### Requirements

* 5+ years of product management experience owning strategy and execution for SaaS, enterprise, or security products.
* Deep domain knowledge in identity and authentication, including several of the following: certificate-based authentication, Kerberos, MFA, FIDO and passwordless, Zero Trust, and continuous authentication.
* A talent for untangling complexity. You can take a messy, interconnected authentication landscape, make it simple, and get a cross-functional team moving in one direction.
* Fluency with AI tools in your day-to-day product work, from customer research and specs to analysis and prototyping.

### Bonus Points for

* A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience. An MBA is a plus.

### Location / Language

**Location:** JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.

**Language:** JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

### Notes

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans.

Job Description

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven AI Product Manager to spearhead both internal and external AI-powered product initiatives. The ideal candidate possesses a compelling blend of strategic vision and tactical execution, with a demonstrated ability to manage the full AI product lifecycle - from ideation to delivery. In this role, you will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Services, Engineering, and executive leadership to define and deliver AI-driven product outcomes that align with organizational objectives and create measurable business impact.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Product Planning & Roadmap**

* Strategically own and maintain the product roadmap, balancing long-term vision with tactical, near-term execution.
* Synthesize business goals and customer requirements into well-defined product initiatives and actionable milestones.
* Clearly communicate roadmap progress, updates, and trade-off decisions to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

**User Story Development & Backlog Management**

* Author and refine high-quality user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria within JIRA to guide development.
* Proactively manage a healthy, prioritized product backlog to ensure Engineering teams have clear and actionable work queues.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospective sessions to drive continuous delivery and improvement.

**Goal Setting & Outcome Ownership**

* Establish and monitor SMART goals for all product initiatives to ensure alignment with broader business outcomes.
* Drive full accountability for product performance, identifying both successes and opportunities for strategic pivots.
* Define KPIs and success metrics, providing regular, data-driven reporting to leadership and key stakeholders.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Sales, Services & Support teams to gather market insights and customer feedback to inform the product lifecycle.
* Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring technical feasibility and shared understanding.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Senior Product Manager**

Product Team | Pune, India | In Campus

  
 **The Role**

We are seeking a high-ownership Product Manager to own the complete software surface of our robotics platform - spanning the core robot software stack, fleet management across the sorting systems, AMRs, customer integration pipelines, and the operator-facing UI applications used on the warehouse floor every day. You will be the single owner of the software experience, from intelligence running on each robot to the dashboard a warehouse manager opens every morning.

**The opportunity**

Own the product direction and business outcomes of assigned product lines, from customer discovery and new product development through launch, adoption and improvement of systems already operating at customer sites. Turn market needs and field evidence into a clear strategy, measurable product requirements and a prioritised roadmap.

You will work across robots, induction and discharge systems, embedded controls, batteries and fleet software. Bring the technical judgment to challenge engineering assumptions, the commercial discipline to choose valuable opportunities, and the ownership to verify that customers realise the promised value. Expect to spend time in warehouses, engineering labs and the factory.

**How the role works with other teams**

You own customer problems, product strategy, priorities, product requirements and acceptance criteria. The Technical Program Manager owns the integrated delivery plan and dependencies.

Engineering leaders own architecture, technical decisions and validation; Engineering Managers own people and capacity. Operations and Service own manufacturing, deployment and support execution. You drive scope and priority decisions, challenge commitments and escalate gaps.

Release decisions follow assigned authority, with the required technical, safety, quality and operational approvals.

**Key responsibilities**

Customer insight and product definition

**Customer discovery and market choices**

1. Observe warehouse workflows and speak directly with operators, supervisors, maintenance teams, buyers and integration partners. Combine site visits, customer interviews, usage data and win/loss analysis to identify unmet needs and validate demand.
2. Define target segments, priority use cases, competitive positioning and the conditions in which the product is a strong fit. Evaluate alternatives, including existing manual processes and other automation, and recommend opportunities to pursue, defer or stop.

**Strategy and product economics**

1. Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap, balancing new capabilities, reliability improvements, customer commitments and platform reuse. Prioritise investments using customer value, market potential, evidence, cost, risk and engineering capacity.
2. Build business cases covering addressable demand, customer payback, pricing and packaging, product cost, deployment effort and lifetime service costs. Set cost and margin objectives with Finance, Engineering and Operations; track commercial results with Sales and refine the investment case as evidence changes.

**Requirements and customer experience**

1. Own business and product requirements (BRDs and PRDs), use cases, operating assumptions and measurable acceptance criteria. Work with Systems and domain Engineering to derive traceable system and subsystem requirements and assess changes.
2. Define sustained throughput, accuracy, availability, parcel and payload ranges, footprint, scalability and operator productivity targets under representative workloads. Specify installation, recovery, diagnostics and serviceability needs so performance claims reflect real operating conditions.
3. Define operator and supervisor workflows, exception handling, reporting and warehouse software integration needs. Work with design and engineering teams to make systems practical to learn, operate, recover and maintain.

**Technical judgment and commitments**

1. Challenge estimates, dependencies, capacity assumptions and validation evidence with the TPM and engineering leaders. Make explicit scope and priority decisions when performance, cost, reliability or timing changes, and drive timely resolution of decisions affecting customer commitments.
2. Assess technical alternatives for their customer value and lifecycle implications. Ensure intended use, safety and compliance requirements inform product decisions from the start, with engineering and functional safety owners retaining technical approval.

**Key responsibilities**

New products, commercial launch and the installed base

**New Product development and pilots**

1. Define customer hypotheses, target outcomes and evidence for concept, prototype, pilot and production gates. Use representative workload sand, where appropriate, simulation with Engineering to test assumptions, assess capacity and validate sizing claims before scaling.
2. Agree pilot baselines, supported configurations, acceptance criteria and rollout conditions with customers, Solutioning, Engineering and Delivery. Own the product acceptance assessment and launch recommendation; use results to decide whether to scale, iterate or stop.

**Launch and repeatable growth**

1. Lead product launch planning with Sales, Marketing, Solutioning, Operations and Service. Equip teams with clear positioning, validated capabilities, sizing limits,pricing guidance, demonstrations, documentation and training requirements; measure adoption and realised value after deployment.
2. Define standard capabilities and configurable options.Evaluate customer-specific requests against strategic value, repeatability, engineering effort and support cost. Keep proposals and commitments within validated productlimits, with exceptions explicitly assessed and approved.

**Deployed products and lifecycle decisions**

1. Own the improvement backlog. Define product metrics and instrumentation requirements with Engineering, establish reliable baselines, and prioritise work using telemetry, customer feedback and recurring field issues. Verify with Engineering and Service that releases improve customer outcomes.
2. Own product policies and requirements for supported variants, compatibility, upgrades, migration, component obsolescence and end of life. Align lifecycle decisions with Engineering, Supply Chain and Service, including the cost and operational impact on installed systems.

**What you will deliver**

An evidence-backed product strategy and business case; a prioritised roadmap and backlog; clear product requirements and acceptance criteria; launch and lifecycle plans; and a product scorecard linking customer outcomes to commercial performance.

**First 90 days**

Review customer workflows, installed systems and economics. Agree product metrics, reliable baselines and priority gaps. Prioritise the roadmap and backlog. Define the next pilot or release scope, supported configurations, acceptance evidence and decision owners.

**Experience and capabilities**

The background and results we are looking for

1. Typically 10-15 years of relevant experience, including 5+ years owning hardware and software products. Product decisions, technical judgment and results matter more than tenure alone.
2. Evidence of taking a complex product from discovery through production and customer deployment, with measurable outcomes after launch.
3. Engineering grounding across mechanical systems, electronics, embedded software, controls, power and software architecture, sufficient to challenge assumptions and assess system trade-offs.
4. Experience with structured NPD, pilot builds, change control and software releases. Understand how design risk reviews, DFMEA and validation evidence inform product decisions.
5. Strong commercial and analytical skills: assess customer ROI, product economics and pricing, analyse operational data, and defend investment and priority decisions.
6. A record of influencing multidisciplinary team

Data Governance and Data Hygiene Product Owner

One role Contract-to-hire India

Role summary

You will own the data hygiene program day to day. You will turn a backlog of more than 40 known data problems into defined, prioritized, and verified cleanup work. Over time, you will build that into a lasting data governance practice. You work directly with business leaders and operations teams, so clear communication and a real understanding of how the business runs matter as much as technical skill.

What you will do

* Own and prioritize the data hygiene backlog, sequenced against the 2027 roadmap releases.
* Meet with business owners and operations leads to understand their processes, why the data breaks, and what clean data has to look like for them.
* Write clear business definitions and a business glossary for each data domain, in plain language business users can sign off on.
* Define critical fields, data quality rules, and how quality is measured for each domain.
* Plan bulk cleanups: what to fix, how (mass update, matching algorithm, or reload), how to validate it, and who signs off.
* Lead the two Data Quality Analysts: assign work, review their output, and remove blockers.
* Keep a gap log of each data issue found, who owns the fix, and when it closed.
* Work with the data platform and Salesforce teams on field and model changes, and with the data team on automated quality checks.
* Report progress to U.S. leadership in short, clear updates: what was cleaned, what changed in the numbers, and what is next.
* Over time, set up change control for new fields and definitions with business owners.

What we are looking for Critical (must have)

* **Communication.** You explain data problems and trade-offs clearly to nontechnical business leaders, in writing and live. You run a meeting, push back politely, and follow up.
* **Business understanding.** You learn how an operations business works (how work moves from sale to field to invoice) and connect each data problem to its business impact.
* **Technical skill.** You write and read SQL well enough to profile data, check a cleanup, and challenge an analysts work. Snowflake experience is preferred.

Also required

* 5+ years in data governance, data quality, master data management, or a data product owner or business analyst role.
* Experience owning a backlog and prioritizing with business stakeholders.
* Experience writing data definitions, glossaries, or data quality rules.
* **Comfortable working with U.S. teams until at least 12:00 p.m. Pacific.**

Nice to have

* Field service, facilities, utilities, telecom, or energy industry experience.
* Salesforce data model experience (Service Cloud or Field Service).
* Experience with data catalog or governance tools.
* Power BI or another BI tool.
* Agile and Azure DevOps.

What success looks like in the first 90 days

* Glossaries and quality baselines in place for the asset and technician domains.
* The first bulk cleanups delivered and signed off by their business owners.
* A working weekly rhythm with business owners and the analysts, with a backlog leadership can see.

Required Skills

Business Process Modeling Presentation and Communication skills Power BI Snowflake Stakeholder Communication ADO SQL Agile Methodologies

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Manager
jobs.description:
**Role:** Accounts Payable Manager

**Work Mode:** Hybrid, 3days from office

**Shift Timings:** 2pm to 11pm IST

**Work Location:** Bellandur, Bengaluru

**Notice Period:** Between 30 to 60days only

  

**ROLE SUMMARY:**

We are partnering with one of our clients and they are currently seeking an Accounts Payable Manager for a Real Estate portfolio company in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India.

  

The Accounts Payable Manager is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of Accounts Payable function, including invoice processing, approval workflows, payment execution, vendor management, exception resolution and period-end activities. The role leads the Bengaluru-based Accounts Payable team and is accountable for the accuracy, timeliness and quality of the teams output, while maintaining strong service levels for property, corporate and vendor stakeholders.

  

The Accounts Payable Manager, in consultation with finance and accounting leadership, establishes operating standards, procedures and controls for the function; monitors performance against defined service levels and key metrics; and ensures compliance with policies, internal control requirements and applicable vendor reporting obligations. The role partners closely with US-based leadership and other functions to resolve issues, strengthen processes and drive automation and scalability across Accounts Payable. The position also provides oversight of certain Development Accounting activities, including review of monthly development draws.

  

**Primary Role:**

* Provide leadership over the end-to-end execution of Accounts Payable operations, including invoice processing, non-invoice (i.e. tenant) payment processing, approval workflows, payment execution, vendor maintenance, exception resolution and period-end activities, ensuring transactions are processed accurately, timely and in accordance with established service levels.
* Lead the Bengaluru-based Accounts Payable team, establishing clear performance expectations, allocating workload, managing priorities and developing team capability through coaching, training and ongoing performance management.
* Establish and monitor key operating metrics for the Accounts Payable function, including invoice processing timeliness, payment execution, aging, unresolved exceptions, error rates and other measures of quality, productivity and service.
* Partner closely with leadership in overseeing payment processing and related controls, ensuring approved obligations are paid accurately and on time and that payment exceptions, returned payments and other issues are identified and resolved promptly.
* Own vendor onboarding and vendor master data governance, including appropriate validation, vendor record maintenance and compliance with 1099 and applicable reporting requirements.
* Establish and maintain scalable Accounts Payable policies, procedures, workflows and review standards, and ensure they are consistently understood and followed across the team.
* Maintain a strong Accounts Payable control environment in accordance with the control framework, including compliance with internal control requirements, segregation-of-duties standards, approval authorities, internal policies and documented operating procedures.
* Working with US-based leadership, serve as a key Accounts Payable liaison and subject-matter leader across property teams, corporate functions and external vendors, ensuring timely escalation and resolution of payment, invoice, vendor and process-related issues.
* Oversee and work in close partnership with the Accounting teams preparation of monthly development draws and related activities, ensuring completeness, accuracy and timely delivery in support of development and construction teams.
* Lead continuous-improvement initiatives across Accounts Payable, identifying opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls and improve transaction accuracy and service levels, leveraging AI and inherent ERP automation capabilities.
* Maintain a strong working knowledge of evolving accounting best practices and strategies that can be applied to day-to-day work, the department and the organization, and proactively communicate these to the relevant team members and leadership.
* Partner with US-based leadership and Revantage India on staffing, hiring, performance management and organizational development to ensure the Accounts Payable function has the appropriate capacity and capabilities to support the business.
* Work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with working hours aligned to provide a meaningful daily overlap with US business hours; flexibility is expected during month-end close and peak processing cycles.
* Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:**

* Bachelors degree in accounting is preferred; a professional qualification such as CA, CMA or MBA (Finance) is an advantage.
* Minimum of six years of related professional experience within a large organisation processing high volumes of invoices.
* Four or more years of supervisory experience is required, including managing and developing a team.
* Hands-on experience with accounts payable ERP platforms (Oracle Fusion preferred), paperless accounts payable systems, travel and expense (T&E) software, and ACH or card payment methods.
* Working knowledge of key internal control requirements and internal control environments within an accounts payable function.
* Experience with vendor onboarding, vendor master data governance and 1099 or equivalent statutory reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead process improvement, system implementations and software conversions within a finance function.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail when working with large volumes of transactional data.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in business English, with the ability to document procedures and communicate them clearly to staff and stakeholders.
* Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise competing deadlines and ensure on-time delivery.
* A service-oriented approach to supporting internal stakeholders and external vendors, with the ability to build trust with onshore teams across time zones.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, with emphasis on Excel.

jobs.title: Senior Executive - Costing, BOM & 3P Operations

We are seeking a sharp, analytical Assistant Manager / Senior Executive to own Bill of Materials (BOM) standardization, SKU-level margin analysis, and third-party (3P) manufacturing productivity. * **3P Productivity & Conversion Cost Control:** Benchmark and monitor production yields, line efficiency, and conversion costs across 3P manufacturers; lead cost-reduction and process-efficiency initiatives.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** CMA (ICWA) / CA Inter / MBA (Finance or Operations) / M.Com.
