jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Logistics Controller Global SCF FP&A
jobs.description:
**JD for Senior Analyst Logistics Controller, Europe**

  

**Job Title:** Senior Analyst Logistics Controller, Europe

**Band:** 14

**Department:** Global Supply Chain Finance

**Industry**: Preferably from FMCG / Manufacturing Industry

**Location:** Bangalore, Karnataka, India

**Reports To:** Manager – Global Supply Chain Finance at GCC Bangalore, India

**Timing**: 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM Indian time

**Work Model**: Hybrid (3 days office, 2 days WFH)

  

**Position Summary:**

We are seeking a strong, business-oriented Finance Professional to join our Global Supply Chain Finance team as Logistics Controller for Europe. The role will have end-to-end financial ownership of logistics accounting and controlling activities for Europe, ensuring accurate bookkeeping, SAP postings, reconciliations, accruals, allocations, cross-charges, and month-end reporting. The role will also strengthen financial controls, analyze logistics cost performance, identify key cost drivers, risks and opportunities, and provide actionable financial insights to business stakeholders. In addition, the role will partner with Logistics Operations, Accounting/A2R, Procurement and Supply Chain Finance teams, and review existing processes to drive standardization, simplification and automation across Europe. The ideal candidate combines a strong accounting and controllership foundation with SAP knowledge, analytical capability, logistics finance understanding, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

  

**Role Scope & Expectations:**

* **Scope:** Up to 10 Business Units (USD 185M FY spend), onboarded in phases.
* **Expected outcome:** All recurring routines (month-end close, reconciliations, reporting and controls) delivered on time and in full, while improving current ways of working to deliver smoother, standardized and automated processes.
* **Role type:** Individual contributor with no direct reports, requiring strong peer influencing to align country and cross-functional teams.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* **Month-End Close & Accounting**
* Own logistics accounting and controlling activities for Europe, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting.
* Manage logistics-related month-end closing activities, including review and validation of postings, accruals, provisions, allocations, recharges, and cross-charges.
* Review SAP postings and ensure logistics expenses are recorded accurately against the appropriate GL accounts, cost centers and business dimensions.

  

* **Reconciliations & Financial Controls**
* Perform detailed reconciliation of logistics spend across SAP General Ledger, invoices, accruals, and other supporting financial information, identifying and resolving discrepancies.
* Maintain and strengthen financial controls, accounting processes, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
* Challenge unexplained spend, incorrect financial treatment, unsupported assumptions, and recurring accounting issues.

  

* **Logistics Cost & Performance Analysis**
* Analyze transportation, freight, warehousing, handling, and other logistics costs to improve visibility and control over logistics spend.
* Analyze actual financial performance against AOP, forecast, prior year, and run rate, identifying key variances, risks, opportunities, and underlying cost drivers.
* Differentiate between accounting/timing variances and underlying operational or commercial drivers to provide a clear understanding of logistics performance.
* Perform root-cause analysis of significant cost movements, unusual transactions, recurring accounting issues, and reconciliation differences.

  

* **Business Partnering**
* Partner with Logistics Operations, Procurement, Accounting/A2R, Supply Chain Finance, and other relevant stakeholders to resolve financial issues and ensure accurate reporting.
* Support management with clear, fact-based and actionable insights and recommendations on logistics financial performance, key cost trends, risks, and opportunities.

  

* **Continuous Improvement & Automation**
* Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize finance processes, reduce manual activities, and improve process efficiency and data quality.
* Drive continuous improvement and automation using SAP, Advanced Excel, Power Query, Power BI, and other analytical tools where appropriate.
* Influence peers and cross-functional teams to promote ownership, accountability, strong financial discipline, continuous improvement, and collaboration.

  

**Key Stakeholders**

* Europe Country Finance teams
* Europe Logistics Operations
* Logistics Controllers and Logistics FP&A
* Accounting / A2R team
* Procurement team
* Global & Regional Supply Chain Finance teams
* Business / Zone Finance teams

  

**Qualifications and Skills**

  

**1. Education:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.
* Preferred: professional finance/accounting qualification such as CA, CMA, ACCA, or MBA Finance.

**2.** **Experience:**

* 5–7 years of relevant experience in Accounting, Financial Controllership, Supply Chain Finance, Logistics Finance, or a similar controlling role.
* Strong hands-on experience in month-end closing, accounting reconciliation, accruals, and financial reporting.
* Experience working with SAP financial postings and General Ledger transactions.
* Good understanding of P&L, balance sheet, cost centers, GL accounts, accruals, allocations, and cross-charges.
* Preferred: experience in logistics, supply chain, manufacturing, or FMCG finance.
* Preferred: experience supporting multiple countries or business units in a global or multinational environment, with strong business-partnering exposure.
* Preferred: exposure to budgeting, forecasting, AOP, and financial variance analysis.

**3. Technical Skills:**

* ERP: SAP, with a strong understanding of financial postings.
* Advanced MS Excel, including the ability to work with and reconcile large financial datasets.
* Strong financial reconciliation, variance analysis, and root-cause-analysis capability.
* Good understanding of accounting principles and financial controls.

4. **Soft Skills:**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and financial storytelling skills.
* High level of ownership and accountability.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly around financial accuracy.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to align peers and cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams across Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and Logistics.
* Ability to challenge financial results and assumptions constructively.
* Strong stakeholder-management and business-partnering skills.
* Proactive and continuous-improvement mindset.
* Strong coordination and follow-up, with the ability to manage multiple countries and tight deadlines.

jobs.title: LEAD CAPEX
jobs.description:
**Position:** Lead CAPEX, Zero-Based Costing & Cost Optimization  
**Department:** Finance / Commercial / Strategic Cost Management  
**Industry:** Automotive / Auto Components / Manufacturing  
**Location:** As per business requirement  
**Reporting To:** Head – Finance / CFO / Business Head

**Job Purpose**

To lead CAPEX planning and management, zero-based costing (ZBC), cost-saving initiatives and cost optimization across manufacturing operations. The role will focus on improving cost efficiency, optimizing investments, controlling expenditure and driving sustainable savings through financial analysis, process improvements and cross-functional collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities (KRAs)**

**1. CAPEX Planning & Management**

* Develop and manage annual CAPEX budgets and investment plans.
* Evaluate CAPEX proposals, business cases, ROI, IRR and payback periods.
* Monitor CAPEX utilization, expenditure and budget variance.
* Ensure effective utilization of capital investments and timely project execution.
* Conduct post-investment reviews to assess actual returns against projected benefits.
* Identify opportunities to optimize capital expenditure.

**2. Zero-Based Costing (ZBC)**

* Drive zero-based costing initiatives across manufacturing operations.
* Review existing cost structures and challenge traditional budget assumptions.
* Analyze material, labour, overhead, utilities and operational costs.
* Identify cost reduction opportunities through detailed cost breakdown analysis.
* Work with production, procurement, engineering and finance teams to implement ZBC initiatives.

**3. Cost Saving & Optimization**

* Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities across all business functions.
* Drive productivity improvement, waste reduction and process optimization.
* Monitor manufacturing costs, conversion costs and operational expenses.
* Develop cost reduction strategies without compromising product quality.

jobs.description:
**Job Description Accounts Receivable Specialist**

  

Position: Accounts Receivable Specialist

  

**Experience:** 37 Years  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Shift:** US Shift / Flexible as per business requirements

  

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Accounts Receivable (AR) Specialist** with strong experience in **direct client coordination, invoicing, collections, payment reconciliation, and SAP Ariba**. The candidate will be responsible for managing the end-to-end accounts receivable process, coordinating directly with clients regarding invoices and payments, resolving billing discrepancies, and ensuring timely collections.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the **end-to-end Accounts Receivable process**, including invoicing, payment tracking, reconciliation, and collections.
* Coordinate **directly with clients/customers** regarding invoices, payment status, outstanding balances, and billing discrepancies.
* Prepare, review, and submit invoices through **SAP Ariba** and other client/vendor portals.
* Manage **SAP Ariba invoice processing**, including invoice submission, status tracking, rejection resolution, and payment follow-up.
* Monitor **Accounts Receivable aging reports** and proactively follow up on overdue invoices.
* Perform **cash application and payment reconciliation** against customer accounts.
* Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies, short payments, deductions, credit notes, and billing issues.
* Work closely with internal **Sales, Operations, Finance, Billing, and Delivery teams** to resolve client billing issues.
* Maintain accurate records of invoices, payments, collections, and customer account balances.
* Respond to client queries related to invoices, purchase orders, payment terms, tax details, and account statements.
* Follow up with clients for **POs, service confirmations, approvals, and payment commitments**.
* Prepare regular **AR aging, collections, outstanding invoices, and cash-flow reports** for management.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, client requirements, and financial controls.
* Support month-end and year-end **AR closing activities**.
* Identify recurring billing/payment issues and recommend process improvements.

  

**Required Skills**

* 37 years of relevant experience in **Accounts Receivable / Order-to-Cash (O2C)**.
* Strong hands-on experience with **SAP Ariba**, particularly invoice submission and invoice/payment status tracking.
* Experience working with **direct clients/customers** in the US or international market.
* Strong understanding of **invoicing, collections, cash application, payment reconciliation, and AR aging**.
* Experience working with **PO-based and non-PO invoices**.
* Strong knowledge of **Purchase Orders, invoice matching, payment terms, credit notes, and deductions**.
* Excellent communication and client-facing skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Good working knowledge of **MS Excel**, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, filters, and reconciliation.
* Ability to manage multiple client accounts and follow up on outstanding payments.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with **Microsoft or other large enterprise clients**.
* Experience with client/vendor portals such as **SAP Ariba, Coupa, Beeline, Fieldglass, or similar platforms**.
* Experience in IT services, staffing, consulting, or professional services organizations.
* Knowledge of **US invoicing, billing, and payment processes**.
* SAP Finance/Accounts Receivable knowledge is an advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely and accurate invoice submission.
* Reduction in overdue receivables.
* Collection and DSO performance.
* Invoice rejection and resolution turnaround time.
* Payment reconciliation accuracy.
* Client query resolution and response time.
* Accuracy of AR reports and aging schedules.

  

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in **Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field**.
* MBA Finance / M.Com / equivalent qualification is preferred.

jobs.description:
* We are hiring for the role of SVP / VP / AVP / Relationship Manager.
* The incumbent will be responsible for managing and growing high-value client relationships while delivering customized financial solutions.
* The candidate will work closely with HNI/UHNI clients, corporate clients, and institutional investors to understand financial goals and provide suitable investment strategies.
* The role requires deep understanding of financial markets, investment products, wealth management strategies, and regulatory frameworks.

* Prior experience in wealth management, private banking, stock broking, or financial advisory is preferred.
* Certifications such as NISM, AMFI, or IRDA will be an added advantage.
* The ideal candidate should demonstrate integrity, client-first approach, and strong business ownership mindset in handling sensitive financial information and managing high-value portfolios.

jobs.description:
* We are hiring for the role of SVP/VP/ AVP / Relationship Managers , Private Bankers.
* The incumbent will be responsible for managing and growing high-value client relationships while delivering customized financial solutions.

* The role also involves achieving assigned revenue targets, AUM growth targets, and cross-selling investment and protection products.
* Candidates must ensure strict adherence to regulatory guidelines, KYC norms, and internal audit standards.
* Maintaining high client satisfaction, retention, and relationship depth is critical for success in this role.
* Candidates should possess strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills along with strong analytical thinking and financial acumen.
* Prior experience in wealth management, private banking, stock broking, or financial advisory is preferred.
* Certifications such as NISM, AMFI, or IRDA will be an added advantage.
* The ideal candidate should demonstrate integrity, client-first approach, and strong business ownership mindset in handling sensitive financial information and managing high-value portfolios.

jobs.title: IT Recruitment Manager(3rd Party -Whitefield)
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Manager IT / Technology Recruitment**

**Role Purpose**

The IT Recruitment Manager will lead end-to-end talent acquisition for technology functions, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality talent across both volume and niche technology requirements. The role will manage a team of recruiters, partner closely with technology and business leaders, develop sourcing strategies, and drive recruitment performance through data, market intelligence, and process discipline.

The position requires a strong combination of **technology recruitment expertise, people leadership, stakeholder management, sourcing strategy, and recruitment analytics**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technology Recruitment Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end recruitment for technology roles across multiple levels, from individual contributors through senior leadership.
* Manage hiring across areas such as:

+ Software Engineering and Application Development
+ Cloud and Infrastructure
+ Cybersecurity
+ Data Engineering, Data Science and Analytics
+ AI / Machine Learning and GenAI
+ DevOps / SRE
+ Enterprise Applications
+ Product and Agile roles
+ Technology Architecture
+ IT Operations and Support

* Own recruitment delivery against agreed hiring plans, SLAs and workforce priorities.
* Monitor recruitment funnel performance including sourcing, screening, interviews, offers, joins and offer dropouts.

**2. Team Leadership**

* Lead and develop a team of technology recruiters and/or sourcing specialists.
* Allocate requirements based on recruiter capability, workload and business priority.
* Establish clear performance expectations around hiring delivery, quality, candidate experience and stakeholder management.
* Conduct regular hiring reviews, pipeline discussions and recruiter coaching sessions.
* Build capability within the team for niche and emerging technology hiring.

**3. Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with Technology leaders, Hiring Managers, HR Business Partners and Workforce Planning teams to understand hiring demand and business priorities.
* Conduct intake meetings to clarify technical skills, role expectations, candidate profiles, compensation parameters and sourcing strategy.
* Challenge unrealistic hiring expectations using talent-market data and recruitment insights.
* Provide regular updates on pipeline health, recruitment risks, ageing positions and hiring outcomes.
* Act as a trusted Talent Acquisition advisor rather than solely an execution partner.

**4. Sourcing & Talent Strategy**

* Develop sourcing strategies for difficult-to-hire and business-critical technology capabilities.
* Build proactive talent pipelines for recurring and niche skills.
* Drive an appropriate sourcing mix across employee referrals, direct sourcing, recruitment partners, internal mobility, professional networks and campus/early-career channels where relevant.
* Promote direct sourcing through platforms such as **LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri and GitHub**, alongside targeted technology communities and professional networks.
* Develop talent maps for specialist skills and competitor organizations.
* Reduce dependency on external agencies through stronger internal sourcing capability.

**5. Technology Talent Market Intelligence**

* Track demand, supply and compensation trends for technology talent across major Indian markets including Bengaluru, Gurugram/Noida, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai and Mumbai.
* Provide hiring managers with actionable intelligence on talent availability, location strategy and competitive hiring conditions.
* Identify emerging skill areas and proactively develop pipelines for future requirements.

**6. Recruitment Analytics & Governance**

* Track key TA metrics such as:

+ Time to Fill
+ Time to Offer
+ Ageing of requisitions
+ Offer-to-Join ratio
+ Interview-to-Offer conversion
+ Source effectiveness
+ Diversity representation
+ Hiring-manager satisfaction
+ Candidate experience

* Use recruitment dashboards and data to identify bottlenecks and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure recruitment processes comply with internal governance, data privacy and hiring policies.
* Promote consistent, structured and bias-aware selection practices.

**7. Candidate Experience & Employer Brand**

* Ensure candidates receive timely, transparent and professional communication throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
* Partner with Employer Branding and business teams on targeted campaigns for technology talent.
* Support recruitment events, hiring drives, referral campaigns and targeted talent-engagement initiatives.

**8. Continuous Improvement & Recruitment Technology**

* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate recruitment processes.
* Drive effective utilization of ATS, sourcing platforms, recruitment dashboards and AI-enabled recruiting capabilities.
* Encourage responsible use of GenAI and automation for activities such as talent research, sourcing support, market mapping and recruitment content.
* Continuously improve recruitment efficiency while maintaining candidate quality and compliance.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Technology or a related discipline.
* MBA / postgraduate qualification in HR would be advantageous.
* Typically **8–12+ years of Talent Acquisition experience**, with significant exposure to technology recruitment.
* Typically **2–4+ years of team leadership or recruitment delivery leadership experience**.
* Experience working in a large multinational, GCC, IT services, consulting, financial services or technology organization is preferred.

**Required Experience & Skills**

**Must Have**

* Strong understanding of the India technology talent market.
* Proven experience recruiting across multiple technology domains.
* Experience managing high-volume as well as niche technology requirements.
* Strong sourcing and talent-mapping capability.
* Experience managing recruiters and driving recruitment delivery.
* Strong hiring-manager and senior-stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to interpret recruitment data and translate it into actionable recommendations.
* Strong negotiation, influencing and communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience recruiting across multiple India locations.
* Exposure to financial services, insurance, consulting or GCC environments.
* Experience with ATS and recruitment technology platforms.
* Understanding of skills-based hiring and structured interviewing.
* Experience using AI-enabled sourcing or recruitment productivity tools.

**Key Competencies**

* Technology Talent Acquisition Expertise
* People Leadership
* Business & Stakeholder Partnership
* Strategic Sourcing
* Talent Market Intelligence
* Data-driven Decision Making
* Candidate Experience
* Negotiation & Influencing
* Recruitment Governance
* Operational Excellence
* Change & Continuous Improvement

**Success Measures**

Success in this role would be demonstrated through:

* Consistent achievement of hiring plans and agreed service levels.
* Improved time-to-fill and reduction in ageing technology requisitions.
* Strong offer acceptance and joining conversion.
* Increased direct-sourcing contribution.
* Stronger pipelines for niche and critical technology capabilities.
* High-quality engagement with technology leaders and hiring managers.
* Effective development and utilization of the recruitment team.
* Improved visibility of recruitment performance through dashboards and analytics.
* Consistent candidate experience and adherence to recruitment governance.

.**Role & responsibilities**

  
  

**Preferred candidate profile**

The role requires an HR professional who is **curious about AI, digital technologies and analytics**, is comfortable working with data, and has the ability to translate business and people challenges into pragmatic HR solutions. The incumbent should have a strong interest in leveraging **AI, automation, dashboards and analytics** to improve HR processes, employee experience, workforce insights and business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic HR Business Partnering & Analytics Domain Knowledge**

* Partner closely with Analytics & AI business leaders as a strategic HR advisor and provide solutions to people-related business challenges.

**6. Advanced Analytics & Technology Skills**

* Should have practical exposure to **Microsoft Copilot and Claude**, with the curiosity and capability to explore new AI tools and their application to HR.

* Continuously explore new technology and automation opportunities that can strengthen HR effectiveness and decision-making.

**7. Employee Engagement & Experience**

* Ensure consistent communication of people initiatives to foster a positive, collaborative and engaged work environment.

**8. Employee Relations, Grievance Management & Governance**

**Role:** Machine Learning Engineer

**Role Summary:**

  

The Machine Learning Engineer will design, build, and productionize machine learning solutions for the Manufacturing AI Suite. The role will work with product, data, cloud, and manufacturing domain teams to transform plant and enterprise data into reliable models and services for use cases such as asset health, quality inspection, production performance, and forecasting etc. The engineer will contribute across the ML lifecycle, from data exploration and experimentation through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Develop, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models for manufacturing use cases, including predictive maintenance, quality prediction, anomaly detection, and process optimization.

* Work with product and customer-facing teams to understand requirements, assess feasibility, and translate business problems into measurable ML solutions.

* 4 to 7 years of experience in machine learning, data science, or ML engineering, including experience deploying models into production.
* Strong programming skills in Python and experience with common ML and DL libraries such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow.
* Experience with data preparation, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and optimization for real-world datasets.
* Experience with of time-series forecasting, computer vision, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, or quality analytics.
* Hands-on experience building production ML pipelines and deploying models through APIs, batch workflows, or streaming applications.

* Experience with MLflow, SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, Kubeflow, or similar MLOps platforms.
* Exposure to GenAI or LLM applications, including retrieval-augmented generation, when relevant to manufacturing workflows.
* Relevant certifications in cloud, machine learning, or data engineering.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Data Engineer**  
**Data Vault , Oracle  •  ODI 12c  •  Snowflake**  
**Contract -1 Years**  
**Shift -2pm IST -11 pm IST**  
**Experience: 7 Years   •**  
**Role type: Individual contributor, hands-on**

  

**Apply - nidhi@intersourcesinc.com, sarang@intersourcesinc.com**

**The Role**  
We run a complex, Data Vault 2.0based data warehouse on Oracle, orchestrated end-to-end in Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) 12c with our own batch-control framework. We are looking for a senior, self-driven engineer who can own this environment: design and extend the Data Vault model, write and tune heavy SQL on Oracle, and triage production ODI issues quickly and independently.  
Genuine Data Vault depth is rare, so we value a sharp engineer who can pick up Data Vault concepts fast and apply them to a real, intricate ODI implementation — as much as someone who already has deep DV experience.  
**Key Responsibilities**  
•Design, build and maintain Data Vault 2.0 structures (Hubs, Links, Satellites) and the loads that feed them on Oracle.  
•Write high-performance SQL and tune it on Oracle — execution plans, indexing/partitioning, MERGE/bulk patterns, and diagnosing long-running or unstable jobs.  
•Own batch execution through our ODI batch-control tables: scheduling, dependencies, restart/recovery, and keeping nightly/incremental loads reliable.  
•Triage and resolve ODI 12c issues end-to-end — from Operator errors and session logs down to the generated SQL and knowledge modules.  
•Extend and optimize ODI mappings, packages, load plans and knowledge modules using advanced ODI features.  
•Contribute to replication/streaming into Snowflake and support downstream consumption.  
•Document designs and work independently against delivery timelines.  
**What We're Looking For**  
**Must have**  
•SQL & Oracle performance tuning: Expert-level SQL and strong hands-on Oracle performance tuning (reading explain plans, indexing, partitioning, statistics, set-based/bulk processing).  
•ODI 12c — issue triaging: Proven ability to triage and fix ODI 12c problems quickly: Operator, session logs, scenarios, agents, generated code.  
•ODI 12c — advanced & navigation: Very strong, fluent ODI navigation and advanced concepts — knowledge modules, load plans, variables, scenarios, reusable mappings, topology.  
•Batch execution: Hands-on experience running data loads via batch-control tables (batch IDs, dependencies, restart/recovery), as we use in our Data Vault executions.  
•Snowflake: Hands-on Snowflake experience (SQL, loading, warehouse/query basics).  
•Data Vault aptitude: Either solid Data Vault 2.0 knowledge, or a demonstrated ability to learn complex modeling concepts fast and apply them in a demanding ODI environment.  
•Mindset: Self-driven, independent problem-solver comfortable owning a complex system with limited hand-holding.  
**Good to have**  
•Working knowledge of Kafka (streaming/CDC into the warehouse).  
•Prior exposure to a Data Vault implementation in production.  
•Experience with CDC, data replication, or GoldenGate-style pipelines.
